jobs.title: Senior Manager eBay Live Data Science
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About EBay Live

eBay Live is eBay’s interactive live shopping platform where sellers and creators broadcast in real time and buyers participate through chat, bidding, and instant purchases. It combines entertainment, community, and commerce into an engaging, trust‑based approach to discover and shop. Join us to develop the analytics and AI foundation that drives discovery, engagement, and quality moderation throughout Live. It’s a highly visible, priority growth project with substantial potential—a chance to create measurable impact at marketplace scale.

Opportunity

In your role as a Staff Data Scientist, you will combine advanced analysis skills with initial leadership responsibilities. You will manage complete analytical projects, prioritize unclear problems, choose suitable methods, maintain quality, and share insights that drive decisions. Additionally, you will define protocols for analysis, evaluate outputs from the team, and develop solutions (including data pipelines and tracking schemas) alongside engineering to expand product-impact analytics for eBay Live.

Specifically, you will contribute to developing the Data Science engine that drives eBay Live’s rapid growth across Seller Product & Seller Success, Buyer Product, Categories/Markets expansion, Trust & Safety, Data Foundation, and Business Performance—providing measurable results through causal measurement, experimentation, marketplace and risk modeling, and production‑quality insights/dashboards.

What You’ll Do

You will focus on one of the following pillars, while mentoring and improving analysis quality:

Own end-to-end analyses for live commerce features. Define product metrics and tracking. Lead experiments that inform the roadmap and growth. Review peers’ work to uphold rigor.
Seller Product & Seller Success: Build and govern growth experiments; analyze onboarding, listing quality, conversion, and retention; propose interventions and measurement plans; enforce review standards and reproducibility.
Model category–market dynamics and size opportunities. Build selection and expansion frameworks. Advise sequencing and launch decisions. Architect lightweight data assets, such as derived tables, to unblock analyses.
Analyze marketplace risk signals and collaborate on guardrail building and monitoring. Apply practical ML/AI techniques. Refine test builds and metrics to reduce false positives while protecting good actors.
Data Foundation & Instrumentation: Clarify metric/event taxonomies; ensure instrumentation quality; build curated datasets and dashboards; troubleshoot data issues; automate recurring tasks with a product‑first approach.
Business Performance: Own important metrics within scope; synthesize daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly performance narratives; surface opportunities/risks; influence decisions with evidence‑based recommendations.

What You Bring

Technical leadership and depth: Lead analyses end‑to‑end, from prioritization to presentation; select robust methods (advanced experimentation, econometrics, statistical modeling) for complex measurements.
Review standards and quality bar: Establish and enforce coding, analysis, and verification guidelines; conduct code/analysis reviews; ensure recipient‑ready outputs.
Architecting solutions: Identify and drive data solution needs (new pipelines, tracking schemas, derived tables) with engineering; build for scale and maintainability.
Applied AI/ML integration: Spot high‑impact opportunities for ML/AI and automation; prototype solutions and partner with specialists to productionize where appropriate.
Influential communication: Distill complex analyses into crisp narratives; present insights and recommendations to senior collaborators (directors/VPs) to drive decisions.
Ownership of domain and collaborator management: Operate autonomously as the primary analytics partner for your area; prioritize high‑impact work; manage cross‑functional project delivery to outcomes.
Player‑coach leadership: Balance hands‑on contributions with mentoring and guidance; set hiring/engagement standards; build a culture of continuous learning and positivity.

Qualifications

Education/experience: MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, CS) or equivalent experience. Typically, 7+ years in analytics or data science with multiple production-quality projects or complex analytical programs.
Skills: Strong SQL/Python; experimentation build; statistical/econometric modeling; dashboarding; familiarity with marketplace dynamics and product analytics.
Communication: Executive‑ready storytelling that translates analysis into actionable recommendations and influences product decisions.

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$170,400 - $227,500

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives .

We are seeking a motivated Civil Engineer with 4-7 years of experience in California to support civil site development projects, including grading, drainage, utilities, and roadway design. This role is ideal for an early‑career engineer eager to grow technical skills while working alongside experienced engineers and project managers.

Responsibilities

Design and preparation of civil site development plans, including grading, drainage, stormwater management, and utility layouts
Develop and modify engineering drawings using AutoCAD; utilize Civil 3D for surfaces, alignments, and corridors where applicable
Perform engineering calculations and quantity takeoffs
Preparation of construction documents, technical reports, and permit submittals

Conduct site visits, field observations, and assist with construction support tasks as needed
Ensure work complies with applicable codes, standards, and regulations

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field
4-7 years of civil engineering experience in California with Civil Site, Roadway, or Subdivision Development projects
Engineer‑in‑Training (EIT) certification is a must
Professional Engineer (PE) certification
Proficiency with AutoCAD/Civil 3D
Strong understanding of basic civil engineering principles
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Exposure to local grading, drainage, and stormwater standards

What We Offer

Mentorship and professional development opportunities
Exposure to a variety of civil site development projects
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Supportive, team‑oriented work environment

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Exploration
jobs.description:
DRW
is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW
is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

As a Data Analyst, Exploration
you will play an integral role in all operational aspects of onboarding, managing and maintaining various datasets used by traders and quantitative researchers. You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders, including data strategists and data engineers, as well as teams across technology, operations, research, and risk management. You should be comfortable investigating complex data issues in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Do In This Role

Analyze new datasets to profile their content, identify collection and storage requirements for data engineering teams and proactively surface insights about the datasets for data strategists and front-office stakeholders
Collect metrics and analyze datasets across different dimensions of data quality including completeness, validity, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency
Curate data catalog entries to ensure our research data assets are accurately represented and easily discoverable
Engage with global front office research teams to support datasets throughout their lifecycle, addressing content inquiries and managing communications with external data vendors
Monitor and resolve production data issues while engaging key stakeholders across multiple teams and facilitating global support
Assist the wider team by identifying opportunities to improve existing datasets and data management processes

What You Will Need In This Role

1-2 years of relevant experience
Strong foundational knowledge of financial instruments and market data symbology, with an interest in developing further expertise in these areas
Proficiency with SQL and Python for exploratory data analysis (PySpark, pandas, numpy, Jupyter Notebooks)
Ability to document and clearly explain complex data analysis findings
Exceptional attention to detail and effective communication skills
Ability to think both independently and collaboratively

Additional skills or experience which enhance consideration for this role:

Experience with cloud services such as AWS Athena and Amazon S3
Familiarity with Linux and basic Bash scripting skills
Experience with version control tools such as Git
Good understanding of data management and data quality principles, with experience developing data quality checks or reports
Prior experience using the Bloomberg Terminal
Experience with Apache Airflow or similar tools

The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $120,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

jobs.description:
Work Schedule

JOB DESCRIPTION

Onsite work arrangement.

Budgeted Salary

$142,192 - $180,000/year

School/Unit Description

nano@stanford is the University's largest shared experimental research facility, providing access to world-leading expertise and capabilities in nanoscale science and engineering. We serve over 1,400 researchers from Stanford and as well as academic, industrial, and government institutions across the US and globally—spanning fields from medicine and biology to fundamental physics and astronomy. Our nearly 40,000 sq ft of cleanrooms and satellite laboratories house 300+ state-of-the-art instruments for fabricating and characterizing materials and devices. But beyond the equipment, nano@stanford is a vibrant, collaborative research community where innovation thrives. For more information, visit: https://nanolabs.stanford.edu.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) scientist to join our Electron and Ion Microscopy team. This position will be part of the TEM group supporting a Thermo Fisher Scientific Spectra 300, Talos F200i, Talos L120C, and FEI Titan G2 ETEM. We expect to add a Nion HERMES 200 in 2027. The TEM scientist will provide training and support to researchers, maintain the microscopes and related equipment, work closely with equipment vendors, maintain and develop training procedures, develop and implement advanced techniques, assist and advise users on specimen preparation and data analysis, provide proof-of-concept service, and engage in research activities. The TEM scientist will work to utilize a range of advanced techniques to the highest extent, making them known to the user community, matching appropriate techniques to the individual research projects. They will interact with the broader research community and equipment vendors to be aware of advances in the field and make recommendations and prepare proposals for future equipment purchases. They will promote and collaborate in the publication and presentation of results. Please join us in our mission to enable and train the next generation of scientists and engineers.

Preferred/Desired Qualifications

MS in materials science, physics, or related field plus at least 8 years of related experience; or a PhD in the same fields with at least 4 years of TEM experience.

Experience in one or more of the following: aberration-corrected S/TEM, in-situ TEM, environmental TEM, 4D STEM, sample preparation.
Solid understanding of the principles of transmission electron microscopy, including imaging, diffraction, spectroscopy, simulations, data interpretation, etc.
Experience applying scientific and engineering principles and practices to perform technical services and support.
Experience with data analysis, experimental process, design, and development of prototypes, equipment, and/or systems related to area of specialization.
Ability to write clear documentation, perform administrative duties, and research protocol maintenance related to research studies and/or scientific/engineering projects.
Experience with software applications, systems, or programs relevant for the job.
Ability to interpret and determine validity of data and check own work.
Ability to communicate, liaise, and work with staff, students, faculty, and outside vendors.
Ability to effectively supervise and train a diverse work staff.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Provide leadership and scientific expertise in the planning and implementation of major projects, services, facilities, and activities.
Develop advanced technological ideas, and guide their development into a final product or new approaches to research. Carry out complex or unique assignments important to the advancement of the field.
Provide expert consultation and collaboration regarding technical requirements, capabilities, and advancement opportunities; make substantive contributions in diverse technical areas.
Provide technical direction to other research staff, engineering associates, technicians, and/or students; facilitate workshops and demonstrations on research methods; educate and train users on research methodology and effective tools and techniques.
Contribute to or co-author published articles, presentations, or scientific papers; identify research and development funding opportunities.
Supervise staff and resources to meet program objectives.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree and five years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Expert knowledge of the principles of engineering and related natural sciences.
Demonstrated project leadership experience.
Demonstrated experience leading and/or managing technical professionals.

jobs.title: Staff CAD/EDA Tools Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title

Staff CAD/EDA Tools Engineer

About Cognichip

At Cognichip, we are building AI-native tools that transform how semiconductor engineers create, verify, and optimize chips. Our platform combines large proprietary models, agentic workflows, domain-specific engineering intelligence, and high-performance simulation infrastructure to accelerate one of the world's most complex engineering disciplines.

About The Role

We are seeking a Staff CAD/EDA Tools Engineer to own the application layer of our EDA tool ecosystem: the wrapper scripts, CLI tooling, and container images that let engineers and AI systems run open-source and commercial chip design tools reliably and consistently. You will maintain and extend internal tooling running on the cloud at scale. If you like turning EDA tool quirks into clean, dependable software that other engineers and AI agents can build on, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain and evolve wrapper scripts and CLI tooling that give a single, consistent interface across open-source EDA tools (Verilator, Yosys, slang, Icarus Verilog, cocotb) and commercial tools.
Build, harden, and version Docker images that package EDA tools with correct dependencies and licenses, and publish them for reliable use across the team.
Own the application layer of the EDA tool stack end-to-end: evaluate and integrate new open-source tools, and write the scripts and configuration that make them usable in real design and verification flows.
Diagnose and fix tool compatibility issues, version drift, and build breakages across simulators, synthesis tools, and container environments.
Support application-layer license configuration for commercial EDA tools (e.g., FlexLM-based license servers), partnering with DevOps, who own the underlying infrastructure.
Collaborate with DevOps on how containerized tools are deployed and consumed, while owning the container image content and correctness yourself.
Partner with RTL design, verification, and AI/ML engineers to understand workflow needs and translate them into reliable, documented tooling.
Write clear documentation for tool usage, wrapper APIs, and container images so other engineers, and Cognichip's AI agents, can self-serve.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
10+ years of experience in software/tools engineering, and CAD/EDA infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with open-source EDA/HDL tools such as Verilator, Yosys, Icarus Verilog, or similar RTL simulation/synthesis tools.
Strong scripting and software engineering skills in Python and Bash, including building CLI tools or wrappers around third-party software.
Solid working knowledge of Docker: writing Dockerfiles, building and versioning images, and troubleshooting containerized environments.
Familiarity with digital design EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens
Comfortable working in Linux environments and debugging tool, build, and dependency issues independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with hardware verification methodologies and frameworks (UVM, or similar).
Experience with declarative build/dependency systems for hardware projects
Experience with FlexLM or other license-management systems for EDA tools.
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) as a consumer of container images built for cloud deployment.
Startup or small-team experience owning a tooling area end-to-end with minimal hand-holding.

What It's Like Here

We're a fast-moving AI startup with a collaborative, high-trust culture. We value technical excellence, ownership, and the freedom to experiment. What You’ll Do

Apply hands-on knowledge of molecular biology, nucleic-acid biochemistry and next generation sequencing to develop and optimize NGS based methods and processes following principles of Design Controls for IVD development.

Receive, sort, open, and process incoming specimens from various sources, ensuring accuracy and proper handling. Document all received specimens in the case receipt log.

Perform quality control (QC) tasks, including reagent and calibrator aliquoting, and follow established protocols for proper disposal procedures.
Assist in manufacturing media for testing.
Conduct sample management and quality control tasks, including verifying that all required testing is completed prior to sample disposal, disposing of materials/items per schedule, ensuring critical results are managed timely, and preparing samples for send-outs, while ensuring accuracy of accompanying documentation and proper specimen handling.
Monitor inventory and support workflow coordination activities as needed.

Under the direction of the Laboratory Director, Laboratory Technician I performs a variety of chemical, physical, and biological analysis on drinking water, environmental water, wastewater and soil, as required for state water quality compliance, public health, and plant operations. **Essential Functions**

Data Analyst (Remote)

Work arrangement:
Remote within the United States. Employment type:
Full-time.

Position overview

The Data Analyst position focuses on turning organized datasets into dependable reports, visual summaries and useful observations. The position calls for thoughtful handling of routine tasks, reliable documentation and a consistent approach to changing priorities.

How the work is approached

The role moves from raw information to a clearer picture of what the numbers indicate. That progression involves cleaning source material, checking unusual results, building repeatable reports and explaining patterns in language others can understand. An interesting result is only useful when its source and limitations are clear, so documenting assumptions is as important as producing a neat table or chart.

Core responsibilities

Clean and organize data from approved sources.
Build recurring reports and simple dashboards.
Verify data quality and investigate unusual results.
Summarize patterns and actionable findings.

Contribution and outcomes

Careful analysis helps teams discuss patterns using consistent information rather than isolated impressions. By checking accuracy and making results understandable, the analyst contributes to more informed follow-up questions and clearer routine reporting.

Remote collaboration

A well-organized remote routine leaves a clear trail of decisions, document changes and unresolved questions. Timely communication is especially useful when work passes between people who do not share the same office or working schedule.

Quality and consistency

Consistent results come from a repeatable process: check the request, organize the relevant details, complete the authorized action and review the outcome. If the available information does not support a conclusion, the record should make that limitation visible.

Relevant capabilities

Excel and spreadsheet analysis.
Basic SQL or reporting tools helpful.
Clear documentation and attention to detail.

What dependable performance looks like

Success in the role is reflected in clear records, appropriate handling of exceptions and dependable completion of agreed tasks. Each careful update makes the next step easier for the people who rely on the information. The role particularly values structured analysis, precise documentation and curious investigation.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Wonderful Pistachios & Almonds is the largest vertically integrated pistachio and almond processor in the world. Located in California's Central Valley, our nuts are Non-GMO Project Verified and sustainably harvested, providing a smart, healthy choice for consumers around the world. Our facilities are equipped with the most advanced processing technology available, allowing us to efficiently sort, grade, process, roast, flavor, and package billions of nuts each year. We are committed to providing the highest-quality nuts to our customers and consumers worldwide.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Professional Civil Engineer is responsible for planning, designing, managing, and overseeing civil engineering projects that support plant operations, infrastructure improvements, and facility expansion. This position ensures projects comply with California engineering regulations, applicable building codes, safety standards, budgets, and timelines. The Civil Engineer collaborates with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and external contractors to develop cost-effective solutions, improve infrastructure reliability, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Plan, design, and oversee civil engineering projects, including site development, grading, drainage, foundations, utilities, roadways, and facility infrastructure improvements.
Prepare, review, and approve engineering drawings, technical specifications, calculations, and construction documents in accordance with applicable California regulations and engineering standards, including review of vendor and contractor structural submittals and equipment anchorage designs.
Design, review, sign, and seal civil and structural engineering drawings and calculations within the scope of professional licensure, competency, and responsible charge including structural steel equipment platforms, mezzanines, catwalks, stairs, ladders, pipe and conveyors supports, and equipment anchorage subject to vibrating and dynamic equipment loads.
Evaluate the structural integrity of foundations, equipment support, buildings, and existing plant structures, including their capacity for added equipment loads, and provide engineering recommendations.
Manage engineering projects from initial planning through completion, ensuring compliance with established budgets, timelines, quality standards, and safety requirements.
Conduct site inspections and engineering assessments to evaluate existing infrastructure, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions or improvements.
Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, contractors, consultants, and regulatory agencies to ensure successful project execution.
Ensure compliance with applicable California Building Standards Code requirements, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and company safety policies.
Develop project budgets, cost estimates, feasibility studies, and recommendations for infrastructure improvements, equipment installations, and capital investments.
Oversee contractors and construction activities to verify work meets approved engineering plans, specifications, and project requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve facility infrastructure, operational efficiency, reliability, and long-term maintenance through engineering solutions.
Lead problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives using PDCA methodologies to address recurring infrastructure and operational challenges.
Provide technical guidance and engineering recommendations to management, project teams, and cross-functional departments.
Maintain accurate engineering documentation, project records, permits, inspection reports, and regulatory compliance records.
Develop, monitor, maintain, and analyze departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), communicate performance results during Floor Management Development System (FMDS) meetings, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Support long-term facility planning, including infrastructure upgrades, expansion projects, and capital improvement initiatives.
Deliver exceptional customer service by responding to internal and external customer needs, building positive relationships, and ensuring timely and effective resolution of concerns.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited program; MS in structural engineering preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of civil engineering experience, including at least 3 years designing industrial steel and concrete structures with a record of sealed structural drawings and calculations, preferably involving industrial facilities, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, or construction project management.
Experience managing capital projects, contractors, engineering consultants, and construction activities.
Working knowledge of California Building Code (including its structural and seismic provisions), ASCE 7 (including nonbuilding structures and equipment anchorage), AISC steel design standards, ACI 318 concrete design and anchoring, Cal/OSHA and federal OSHA requirements for platforms, guardrails, stairs, and ladders, permitting processes, and applicable environmental regulations.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and in structural analysis and design software such as RISA, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, or Enercalc.
Experience preparing engineering calculations, construction drawings, technical specifications, and cost estimates.
Strong understanding of project management, budgeting, and continuous improvement methodologies.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Active California Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Civil Engineering required; California Structural Engineer (S.E) license preferred.

Pay range: $110,000 - $150,000/yr

jobs.description:
About Fabric Health

At Fabric Health, we are powering boundless care by solving healthcare’s biggest challenge: clinical capacity. We aren’t here to disrupt healthcare; we’re here to fix it. We unify the care journey from intake to treatment, using intelligent automation to remove administrative burdens and make care delivery 2-10x more efficient. Our technology empowers clinicians to move faster and focus on what matters most: the patient.

We are a mission-driven team of brilliant minds trusted by leading organizations including Intermountain Health, OSF HealthCare, SSM Health, and MUSC Health. Our vision is backed by premier investors such as Thrive Capital, GV (Google Ventures), General Catalyst, and Salesforce Ventures. We move quickly for good reason, listen deeply to solve big challenges, and build products with the same care and quality we’d want for our own loved ones.

Learn more:
About Us | News & Press | LinkedIn | Careers

About The Role

Fabric is looking to bring on a Data Analyst to provide customer insights and support our medical leadership through actionable reporting. As part of our analytics team, you partner with the clinical organization to deliver strategic analyses and build automated reporting around clinical operations and health outcomes. You will dive into complex datasets to analyze trends, identify opportunities, and quantify the potential value of new initiatives. Your work helps ensure our clients have clear visibility into the clinical value Fabric provides, supporting the continuous improvement of our medical practice to best serve our patients.

This role requires proven quantitative and critical thinking skills along with a solid understanding of healthcare analytics. As a vital contributor to a lean team, you clearly communicate complex findings to diverse audiences, collaborate across multiple functions, and leverage modern AI tools to accelerate data processing and generate insights.

What You'll Do

As a Data Analyst, your primary responsibilities include:

Build and maintaining reporting that tracks physician performance, care quality, and consistency of clinical standards across the platform.
Design dashboards and visualizations that make clinical and business metrics easy to act on for both clinical and non-clinical leaders.
Partner closely with our client-facing organization to surface clinical insights for customers and prospects.
Collaborate with clinical operations and physician enterprise leaders to translate open questions into clear, well-scoped analyses.
Write and maintaining SQL for the data warehouse to transform raw clinical and operational data into analysis-ready datasets, utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate query development.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve the quality, structure, and reliability of underlying clinical data.
Support ongoing reporting needs to help the team move from one-off requests toward scalable, repeatable reporting.
Leverage AI tools for advanced data cleaning, initial pattern recognition, and drafting analytical summaries to increase efficiency.

Why You Might Be a Good Fit

You enjoy translating ambiguous clinical questions into clear, actionable data models and dashboards.
You have a solid foundation in healthcare analytics and understand the nuances of clinical and operational data.
You excel at bridging the gap between technical data engineering and business-facing clinical leadership.
You are proactive in seeking out ways to scale reporting rather than manually answering the same questions repeatedly.
You are an early adopter of technology, actively using AI tools to write queries faster and streamline your analytical workflows.

This Might Not Be The Right Fit If...

You prefer working with perfectly clean, strictly structured data over navigating the messy reality of real-world healthcare datasets.
You want to focus solely on building complex machine learning models rather than delivering practical, descriptive analytics and BI reporting.
You struggle to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear, digestible manner.
You prefer traditional manual coding workflows and are hesitant to adopt AI assistants to scale your data analysis tasks.

Your Qualifications

2+ years of experience analyzing data in a professional setting, ideally within healthcare.
Proven proficiency in SQL.
Experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool such as Tableau or Thoughtspot.
Familiarity with Python or R for complex analyses.
Proficiency in utilizing modern AI assistants for query generation, data cleaning, and workflow automation.
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a quantitative discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.
Comfort managing multiple analysis projects at once and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points

Familiarity with common healthcare datasets, standards, and measures such as HEDIS.
Experience with analytics tools such as Heap, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
Experience with A/B testing, including statistical hypothesis testing methodologies.
Experience working within Databricks.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Research Associate - Chemistry (1 year contract) to join our R&D team focused on the development of next-generation magnetic particle technologies for life science applications. This is a hands-on laboratory position where the successful candidate will work on the synthesis, surface modification, characterization, and optimization of magnetic particles and magnetic bead systems.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in chemistry, materials science, chemical engineering, nanotechnology, or a related discipline, with experience in nanoparticle synthesis, colloidal systems, or surface chemistry.

If you are passionate about directly contributing to scientific advancement alongside industry veterans in a highly collaborative environment, we want you!

Synthesize and optimize magnetic nanoparticles and magnetic particle formulations.

Perform particle functionalization using various chemical approaches to introduce desired surface properties.
Characterize particle physical and chemical properties using analytical techniques such as DLS, zeta potential, FTIR, SEM/TEM, and UV-Vis spectroscopy.
Investigate particle stability, dispersibility, aggregation behavior, and magnetic performance.

As Scientist II, Bioinformatics, you will be a member of PacBio's Applications Lab, an internal customer and services laboratory that supports product development, customer evaluations, and commercial opportunities.

You will be responsible for bioinformatics analyses for internal and customer projects, collaborating with laboratory scientists, Product Management, Marketing, and Sales teams to deliver results that demonstrate the capabilities and value of PacBio technology.

You will also maintain the computational tools and infrastructure needed for laboratory operations, collaborating with laboratory scientists and Information Technology. This includes sample and project tracking, data organization, and automated analysis workflows.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong programming skills, scientific expertise, and the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems.

Sequencing lab project support Collaborate with laboratory scientists to support sequencing projects, ensuring reliable data processing, analysis execution, and timely delivery of results.
Bioinformatics analysis Analyze PacBio sequencing data for internal projects, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept studies. Deliver accurate results, visualizations, and summaries to scientific and commercial stakeholders.
Laboratory computational infrastructure maintenance Maintain tools and infrastructure supporting laboratory operations, including sample and project tracking, and data organization.
Pipeline development and automation Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot bioinformatics pipelines and automated workflows using Python, Linux, and high-performance computing (HPC) environments. Reduce manual intervention and improve processing reliability.
Scientific collaboration Evaluate emerging bioinformatics methods and sequencing applications along with academic and commercial collaborators.

Qualifications

Required

PhD and a minimum of 0-2 years related experience; may include post-doctoral experience. Alternatively, Masters with a minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience or B.S. with a minimum of 5-7 years of related experience.
A degree in Bioinformatics, Biology, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field.
Proficiency in Python programming, including data processing.
Strong working knowledge of Linux, including command-line tools, shell scripting, and file system organization.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) environments, including job schedulers, computational resource allocation, and pipeline execution.
Familiarity with scientific development practices include testing, version tool, code review, workflow management frameworks (e.g. WDL, NextFlow), reproducible computational environments (containers), and code documentation.
Experience with next-generation sequencing data analysis and bioinformatics pipelines.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and organizational skills, with the ability to independently solve technical problems and manage multiple priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document workflows and explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Preferred

Experience working in a sequencing facility, genomics core laboratory, or commercial sequencing service provider.
Experience with laboratory operations, including sample tracking, metadata management, and project coordination.
Experience analyzing PacBio HiFi or other long-read sequencing data.
Experience with cloud-based data storage and analysis, particularly AWS.
Experience with SQL and relational databases for managing and querying scientific data.
Familiarity with AI agentic software development tools like Claude Code or Codex.
Experience in a customer-facing role.
Experience communicating scientific results in conference presentations or peer-reviewed publications.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Viral Production (Fixed-Term Contract)
jobs.description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.
Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.
Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:
Virtual Cell Initiative
:
Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
Alzheimer's Disease Initiative
:
Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.
Why this position could be the best job you’ve ever had 

Join Arc's Alzheimer's Disease Initiative as the production engine behind a first-of-its-kind 3D brain-model screening program, where the cells you make drive disease-target discovery.

About the position

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Research Associate, Viral Production to join the Molecular Engineering team within the Genome Engineering Technology Center at the Arc Institute. This will be a fixed-term, 18-month position. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
In this role, you will serve as a dedicated producer of lentivirus, supplying high-quality, well-characterized viral preps that power perturbation screening and cell engineering efforts across Arc's wet lab Tech Centers (including Genome Engineering, Cellular Models, and Mammalian Disease Models). This work directly enables the large-scale perturbation screening and cell engineering efforts behind Arc's Virtual Cell Initiative and Alzheimer's Disease Initiative (ADI). The role is focused on planning, consistency, and throughput: executing staggered production rounds ahead of demand, scaling cell expansions and production runs to reflect projected needs across requesting teams, maintaining reagent and consumable stock levels to prevent production delays, and documenting and QC'ing each lot against established standards prior to delivery.
As production infrastructure and standards continue to be developed, this role will contribute to process optimization efforts — supporting improvements in output scaling, cost reduction, and lot-to-lot consistency. This includes assisting with the rollout of automation and higher-throughput production formats, as well as onboarding additional viral systems.
The ideal candidate is experienced in lentivirus production at scale using suspension (e.g., LV-MAX) and/or adherent systems, and proficient in viral titration, and quality assessment. They execute and troubleshoot independently, with outstanding attention to detail and a commitment to dependable, reproducible work. They communicate proactively across teams and bring a continuous-improvement mindset to a high-volume workflow.
About you

You take pride in producing consistent, high-quality results on a predictable schedule.
You are diligent, meticulous, and committed to thorough documentation and good record-keeping practices.
You are organized and plan ahead, keeping workflows, reagents, and timelines on track.
You respect the process and are comfortable with routine execution while continuously identifying opportunities to troubleshoot and address bottlenecks.
You communicate proactively and enjoy coordinating across teams to anticipate and meet demand.
You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, team-science environment.

In this position you will

Execute staggered rounds of lentivirus production, spanning arrayed small-scale productions (e.g., 24- and 96-well plate formats) through large-scale pooled-library productions, using suspension (LV-MAX) and/or adherent systems.
Concentrate, filter, and aliquot virus into single-use aliquots, and perform quality control on each lot — including functional titration on relevant target cell lines — ensuring delivered virus meets the acceptance criteria defined by requesting teams.
Help coordinate cross-functionally to forecast demand in advance, scaling and scheduling each round of production accordingly to meet the projected needs of requesting teams and the ADI screening calendar.
Maintain rigorous, organized documentation of production runs, titer/QC outcomes, and viral inventory and distribution in Benchling (including matrix-tube aliquot tracking and metadata capture).
Perform troubleshooting on failed productions, escalate and reschedule as needed to maintain supply continuity.
Maintain inventory of key reagents, media, and consumables to ensure uninterrupted production, including proactive procurement.
Help establish, refine, and run an efficient end-to-end viral production platform spanning demand intake to final delivery, including a request/intake system, plasmid hand-off, and QC standards.
Contribute to process optimization aimed at improving the scale, quality, and lot-to-lot consistency of production.

Requirements

BS degree in relevant field with 4+ years of relevant experience, or MS degree in relevant field with 2+ years of relevant postgraduate experience. Industry or core-facility experience in viral production is strongly preferred.
Proficiency in mammalian cell culture procedures and associated aseptic techniques, with direct hands-on experience producing lentivirus at scale using suspension (e.g., LV-MAX) and/or adherent systems.
Demonstrated ability to execute reproducible, multi-step production protocols consistently across repeated rounds.
Experience with viral titration and QC methods.
Experience with filtering, single-use aliquoting, cryopreservation, and inventory management of viral stocks.
Meticulous documentation and record-keeping; comfort working to a production schedule, with strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills and the ability to manage staggered production schedules and anticipate demand.
Familiarity with reagent inventory, operations management, and LIMS/ELN platforms (e.g., Benchling).
Excellent communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively across teams.
Work onsite in our Palo Alto office 5 days per week. Occasional early or late hours or weekend work may be required to accommodate production schedules. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing or leveraging automation for viral production and/or titration at scale.
Prior experience independently optimizing processes and workflows to improve viral yield, quality, and consistency.
Hands-on experience with multiple viral production systems and protocols, including AAV production.
Experience producing lentivirus in arrayed (plate-based) formats as well as large-scale pooled-library formats.
Experience managing external vendor relationships for cloning and plasmid preps.

The base salary range for this position is $84,250 to $106,000. These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. Job Description

The Clinical Data Strategy and Operations (CDSO) DMO Lead or Clinical Data Scientist (CDS) serves as the data management domain expert and key strategic partner to the clinical study team. This role owns the data collection strategy, drives implementation, oversees data quality delivery, and supports on-time achievement of key study milestones. As the Data Operations single point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders, the DMO Lead or CDS applies strong project management, risk oversight, and continuous process optimization to enable data quality, inspection readiness, and successful trial delivery.

Responsibilities:

Serves as the CDSO data management subject matter expert and single point of contact for assigned studies, owning data collection, data cleaning, and database lock strategies to enable high-quality, inspection-ready study delivery.
Leads risk-based and continuous data review strategies from study start-up through database lock, leveraging centralized monitoring, statistical review, and clinical data science methodologies to proactively identify and mitigate study risks.
Triages data quality standards across studies to identify trends, drive site-level actions through effective cross-functional communication, and maintain data currency in support of timely, reliable study decisions.
Interprets clinical and operational data, quality metrics, predictive signals, and dashboard outputs to develop data-driven recommendations that strengthen study execution, risk management, patient safety oversight, and quality across the clinical development lifecycle.
Contributes to defining, managing, and monitoring data-driven protocol deviations.
Defines and manages study data flow and triages issues from raw EDC data through mapped SDTM data, partnering with internal technology teams, service providers, and vendors to drive timely mitigation and support end-to-end data integrity.
Performs data mining and custom analytics, gathers business requirements for study dashboards, and generates operational metrics that support study decisions.
Ensures adherence to federal and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie SOPs, and functional quality standards; stays abreast of evolving guidance. 
Influences cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, aligning clinical, statistical, medical, safety, regulatory, technology, and vendor organizations around data-driven decisions and clinical data science strategies.
Leads CDSO innovation and process improvement initiatives and participates in cross-functional efforts that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, and study delivery quality.
Coaches and mentors team members.

Demonstrated performance as a functional leader
Demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority
Demonstrated ability to successfully coach / mentor in a matrix environment

Demonstrated effective analytical skills

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

Our electrical design toolchain covers PCB design tools, signal/power-integrity and RF analysis tools, an ECAD data-management server, a component and design-data sync into PLM, and an internally built integration platform that is replacing a legacy ECAD-to-PLM gateway. This role keeps that toolchain running day to day, fixes it when data goes wrong, and builds the automation and add-ins that remove manual work for hardware engineers.

We hire for fundamentals and train on our systems. If you can script, know at least one ECAD tool well as a user, and like tracing a problem from symptom to root cause, we will teach you the rest.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

#### **ECAD Platform Administration**

* Administer the ECAD data-management server: user access, groups and permissions, SSO, backups, updates, and health monitoring.
* Test upgrades and configuration changes on a staging server before they reach production.
* Evaluate and configure ECAD design and analysis tools for users.
* Track license usage and produce usage reports that feed license planning.
* Work with IT and Information Security on servers, networking, identity, and access.

#### **Integration Operations**

* Maintain the scheduled jobs that sync component and design data from ECAD into PLM. Monitor runs, triage failures, and correct bad data.
* Support engineers publishing designs to PLM: publish errors, part-number problems, missing or wrong datasets.
* Run acceptance and regression testing on new integration releases. Report defects with reproducible evidence.
* Read logs, API responses, and database records to find where data went wrong.

#### **Tooling Development**

* Build and maintain add-ins and enhancements for our internal ECAD-to-PLM integration platform.
* Write scripts to automate administration, reporting, and data checks.
* Query tool APIs and databases to answer usage and data questions.
* Use version control, code review, and automated tests for everything you ship, including code written with AI assistance.

#### **ECAD****MCAD Collaboration**

* Configure and maintain ECADMCAD data exchange between PCB design tools and MCAD/PLM systems.
* Maintain attribute, layer, and keep-out mappings. Test exchange workflows with electrical and mechanical designers.

#### **Standards and Templates**

* Maintain design templates (schematic, PCB, PCBA, flex) and their parameter conventions, including CUI markings.
* Keep EE design standards, checklists, and work instructions current in the quality management system.
* Migrate legacy designs and data between tools and systems.

#### **Support and Documentation**

* Provide Tier 1–2 support to hardware engineers across the toolchain.
* Write runbooks and system documentation that someone else can follow without asking you.
* Train users on tool workflows and new releases.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years in at least one of: PCB/ECAD design, ECAD or CAD/PLM administration, or engineering tools development.
* Working fluency as a user of at least one ECAD tool (Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD/Allegro, PADS/Xpedition, or similar).
* Scripting in Python or PowerShell for automation or data processing.
* SQL: write SELECT queries with joins and filters against a relational database.
* Windows administration basics: services, scheduled tasks, event logs, file shares, permissions.
* Git for day-to-day version control.
* Clear written documentation.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* U.S. person status (export-controlled data).

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 4+ years in the areas above.
* Altium Enterprise Server, Altium 365, or a similar ECAD data-management server: administration experience.
* PLM experience (Teamcenter preferred; Windchill, Arena, Aras also relevant), especially ECAD-to-PLM integration.
* TypeScript/Node.js; REST and GraphQL APIs; OAuth 2.0/OIDC.
* ECADMCAD exchange (IDX, IDF) with NX, SolidWorks, or Creo.
* Administration of signal/power-integrity or RF tools (HyperLynx, Ansys).
* KiCad, including Git-based design version control.
* IPC standards and PCB fabrication/assembly knowledge.
* Has supported a CAD tool migration or a data migration between systems.
* Uses AI coding and research assistants in an engineering workflow, with a habit of verifying their output.

A world leader in water treatment solutions, IDE specializes in the development, engineering, construction and operation of desalination, water reuse, and industrial water treatment plants.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION:**

Under the general supervision and direction of the Laboratory Director, this position performs microbiological and chemical water quality analyses required for NPDES permit compliance, plant operations, environmental monitoring, and Division of Drinking Water (DDW) requirements. Performs quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) tasks in conformance with the Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Program (ELAP) standards set for in the California Code of Regulations; and performs other related duties as assigned.

This is an entry-level position within a specialized laboratory operating in the complex, technically demanding environment of a large-scale seawater desalination facility.

The position plays a critical role in protecting public health by generating accurate, defensible analytical data used to monitor treatment performance, verify regulatory compliance, and optimize plant operations.

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:**

* Collect raw seawater, process stream, and finished drinking water samples on daily basis.

* Conduct field measurements.

jobs.description:
Merge Labs is a frontier research lab with the mission of bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency and experience. We’re pursuing this goal by developingfundamentally new approaches to brain-computer interfaces that interact with the brain at high bandwidth, integrate with advanced AI, and are ultimately safe and accessible for anyone to use.

**About the Team:**

On the Expression team, our work combines biochemistry, protein engineering, and cell biology to ensure the efficient assembly of complex protein systems for use as molecular readouts of neural activity.

**About the role:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Research Associate to evaluate engineered genetic constructs in iPSC-derived or primary neurons, measure expression efficiency, and investigate effects on neuronal health and function.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain and perform experiments with iPSC-derived or primary neurons.
* Evaluate the expression of different genetic constructs and quantify expression efficiency.
* Perform assays to assess neuronal health, fitness, and viability.
* Develop novel assays to investigate cellular pathways contributing to toxicity.
* Analyze results, troubleshoot experiments, and help optimize workflows.
* Maintain detailed experimental records and organized cell and reagent inventories.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in biology, neuroscience, bioengineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with neuronal or primary mammalian cell culture and excellent aseptic technique.
* Hands-on experience in at least one of: high-content imaging, immunofluorescence, or viability/cytotoxicity assays.
* Familiarity with transfection and viral transduction.
* Familiarity with assays measuring expression of introduced genetic cargo, such as RT-qPCR or fluorescent/luminescent reporter assays.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience using high-content imaging and automated assays to assess cellular viability.
* Experience with neuronal activity assays.
* Familiarity with proteostasis concepts.
* Quantitative image analysis experience.
* Assay development and optimization experience.
* Scientific understanding of neural pathologies, including neurodegeneration and neurotoxicity.

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, please apply. As we build, we're hiring for complementary strengths to form a high-impact team.

jobs.title: Research Associate II, Scientific Services
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Performs technical procedures, restrains animals, operates laboratory equipment, collects specimens, and collects data on laboratory animals (canines, mice, rabbits, rats, non-human primates, swine, etc) as specified in Protocols and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in compliance with GLP standards. Supports Study Supervisor(s) and Study Director(s) by performing and assisting with sample and data collection on research studies. Mentors and trains junior staff.

  
  

**What You'll Do Here**

* Follows SOPs and Protocols to perform procedures on study or stock animals, including,
* but not limited to: clinical observations, food consumptions, body weights, urine collection,
* administering injectable anesthesia, mating procedures, restraint, enrichment, and
* feeding and food removal.
* Assist with blood draws (some routes), catheter placement, dose administration, and euthanasia.
* Follows written and verbal instruction: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Protocols,
* Daily Schedules, etc.
* Records and reviews raw data, study and facility.
* Handles and restrains laboratory animals, including but not limited to, mice, rats, rabbits,
* canines, swine and nonhuman primates.
* Obtains animal information (tattoo, sex, ear tag, ear notch, etc), recognizes animal behavior
* health status, and reports to appropriate personnel.
* Sets up procedures and maintains ancillaries on study animals.
* Operates selected laboratory equipment (i.e., glucometer, Harvard pump, digital
* thermometer).
* Monitors and reports changes in animal behavior or health and problems with animal room
* (e.g., caging, lights, and temperature) to all appropriate personnel.
* Monitors and reports study changes to Study Director and all appropriate personnel.
  

  

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* High School Diploma and/or GED required; BS/BA in a scientific discipline
* Meets majority of target levels for procedures set for a Scientific
* Services, Research Associate I in at least one species (small animal or nonhuman primate). 1+ year related work experience.
* LAT certification preferred.
* MS Office suite. Able to adapt easily to new software programs
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, software manuals, study documents, and procedure manuals; and the ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
* Ability to work cross functionally on process improvements.
* Demonstrated attention to detail.
* Ability to multi-task and maintain organization in a fast paced, changing environment.
* Ability to manage change.
* Readily adapts to new projects.
* Positive attitude toward work and co-workers.
* Be comfortable communicating with all levels of
* management and employees.
* Able to identify and resolve problems as they are encountered.
  

  

**What We Offer**

The pay range estimated for this position is $22.00 - $28.00 hourly. Please note that hourly rates/salaries vary within the range based on factors including, but not limited to, prior relevant experience, skills, education, certification, location as well as internal equity and market data.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**This role is designed to be 100% onsite, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with your team and immerse yourself in the energy of our workplace. Please note that hybrid or remote work options are NOT available for this position at this time.**

We encourage you to apply if you bring experience supporting epidemiologic, clinical, or health services research studies, including literature reviews, data collection and management, and data analysis. Cancer research experience is preferred but not required. We are particularly interested in candidates with strong project coordination and organizational skills who can independently manage multiple research activities, track timelines and deliverables, and communicate effectively with study teams and collaborators. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work with minimal supervision are also preferred.

This position offers an opportunity to contribute to a growing research program focused on cancer epidemiology, breast cancer survivorship, and cardiovascular health. The RA III will work on multiple studies, collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams, and gain experience across different stages of the research process, from study development and implementation to data analysis and dissemination. There will also be opportunities to contribute to scientific abstracts, manuscripts, and grant applications.

Under general guidance, the Administrative Research Associate III works closely with PI, providing technical and/or administrative support in large or multi-project oriented labs. May be requested by PI to take on specific supervisory activities, and provide administrative leadership, and/or technical expertise. May develop hypothesis and assist in planning steps for the investigative process. Will review and remain current on literature as it relates to clinical/research study. **Responsibilities**

* Provides miscellaneous clinical/research support (ad hoc data analysis, hypothesis development, programming, troubleshooting, etc.).
* Organizes clinical/research trials in conjunction with the Principal Investigator and sponsor and/or funding source.
* Monitors and ensures compliance with safety standards and procedures.
* Analyzes data and prepares scientific findings for publication as author or co-author.
* May make independent presentations.
* May provide system administration and maintenance for the local workstation network.
* Leads and trains Research Lab Assistants, Research Fellow, lower level Research Associates, and other related support staff and may be requested by PI to take on specific supervisory activities.
* Orients new Research Fellows and/or Research Scientists to day-to-day lab operations and procedures.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of research laboratory experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in the research specialty.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Gene Therapy
jobs.description:
At Insmed, every moment and every patient counts — and so does every person who joins in. As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition from leading workplace and culture organizations, including Science's Top Employers, Great Place To Work® in the U.S., and Fortune's Best Workplaces in BioPharma.

  
  

For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

  
  

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for a Senior Research Associate on the Gene Therapy Research Team to help us expand what’s possible for patients with serious diseases. Reporting to the Executive Director, Gene Therapy, you’ll be responsible for design and development of droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) assays, quantitating DNA and mRNA both in vitro and from in vivo samples. Additionally, you will document methods and studies and participate in the technical transfer of assays to third party contractors. Depending on experience, you will expand molecular and product specific assay development working with the analytical development team.

**What You'll Do:**

**In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to:**
-------------------------------------------------

* Master and execute ddPCR assays developed in partnership with supervisor
* Follow protocols and SOPs related to ddPCR lab work with in vitro and in vivo samples
* Extract DNA and RNA from samples for analysis
* Document results in appropriate formats provided by supervisor

**Who You Are:**

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

You meet one of the following minimum education and experience requirements:

* Master's degree; OR
* Bachelor's degree and 1 year of experience in droplet digital PCR (ddPCR)
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

In addition to meeting the basic qualifications above, you will also possess some or all of the following:

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, Chemistry, or related field. Graduate degree holders are encouraged to apply
* Significant and demonstrated experience in operation of BioRad ddPCR equipment (QX200), as well as assay development, optimization, and interpretation
* General cellular and molecular biology proficiency
* Western blot, cloning, general mammalian cell culture, and transfection
* Excellent communication skills with ability to interact professionally with colleagues and present research results in written reports and team presentations
* Willingness to learn new techniques and train other laboratory staff in technical matters
* Entrepreneurial spirit, with strong willingness to take on new challenges required to bring novel medicines to the clinic
* Strict adherence to environmental, health, and safety guidelines
  

**Where You’ll Work**

This role is based out of our San Diego, CA office and requires full-time, in-person presence to support hands-on collaboration, access specialized equipment, and/or operational needs.

Minimal travel expected

jobs.title: Temporary Research Associate / Lead Identification Group, Antisense Drug Discovery
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, and with offices in Boston, Massachusetts, and Dublin, Ireland, Ionis has been at work for more than three decades discovering medical breakthroughs that have redefined life for people with serious diseases. We’re pioneers in RNA-targeted medicines, and our platform continues to revolutionize drug discovery and transform lives for patients with unmet needs. With multiple marketed medicines and a leading pipeline in neurology, cardiology and select areas of high patient needs, we continue to drive innovation in RNA therapies in addition to advancing new approaches in gene editing to provide greater value to patients and are well positioned financially to deliver on our strategic goals.

At Ionis, we pride ourselves on cultivating a challenging, motivating and rewarding environment that fosters innovation and scientific excellence. We know that our success is a direct result of the exceptional talents and dedication of our employees.

With an unprecedented opportunity to change the course of human health, we look to add diverse individuals, skill sets and perspectives to our exceptional team. We continue to invest time, money and energy into making our onsite, hybrid and remote work environments a place where solid and lasting relationships are built and where our culture and employees can thrive.

We’re building on our rich history, and we believe our greatest achievements are ahead of us. If you’re passionate about the opportunity to have meaningful impact on patients in need, we invite you to apply and join us. Experience and contribute to our unique culture while you develop and expand your career!

  

**Temporary Research Associate / Lead Identification Group, Antisense Drug Discovery**

  

**(Hiring Manager: Clare Quirk**

  

**SUMMARY:**

Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a leader in RNA-targeted therapy research and drug discovery, seeks a highly motivated individual to join as a Temporary Research Associate **(temp position)** in the Antisense Lead Identification team. This is a temporary position with a fixed term of 3-6 months. The role will not be extended beyond 6 months or converted to a permanent position and contract renewal is not anticipated. We are seeking an enthusiastic and self-driven candidate to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and rewarding environment. In this temporary position the successful candidate will work as a member of the group responsible for *in vitro* assay development for screening and characterizing oligonucleotides against novel gene targets.

The ideal candidate will have experience in primary and immortalized cells culture and maintenance, with strong aseptic cell culture skills. The candidate should have experience with a broad range of molecular biology techniques and cell-based assays. The candidate should possess a strong work ethic, good communication skills and ideally, experience in an automated high-throughput laboratory environment. The successful candidate will be able to perform the following responsibilities with a high degree of independence and attention to detail.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Ideal candidate must learn, optimize and meticulously follow preset workflows that has been established to study activity of oligonucleotides. Specific work includes:

* + Culture of various mammalian immortalized cell culture systems.
  + Ensure maintaining a sterile environment and practicing careful techniques to prevent contamination during cell culture and other downstream processes.
  + Perform quality control, feeding, passaging, harvesting and cryopreservation of cells.
  + Apply molecular and cell-based assays including but not limited to RNA purification, transfection, and gene expression analysis (RT-qPCR).
  + Operate established protocols on automated liquid handling instrumentation and robotics
  + Maintain detailed records of experiments

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* S./M.S. degree in molecular biology, biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or related field.
* Minimum of 1-2 years’ experience working in an academic or industrial laboratory setting.
* Experience and demonstrated expertise in mammalian cell culture is essential.
* Strong molecular biology and assay development skills
* Prior experience with automated instrumentation/liquid handlers for compound screening is desirable
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Expected to be a self-starter and work productively within a multidisciplinary team under demanding timelines
* We encourage all highly motivated candidates to apply

For more information about Ionis and to apply for this position, please visit our website, **http://www.ionis.com (http://www.ionis.com)**. Reference Requisition #TEMPO004198

The hourly pay scale for this position is $36.84/hour to $41.98/hour
