jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Molecular and Cellular Biology (CONTRACT)
jobs.description:
Septerna is a biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, CA on a mission to develop life-changing medicines for patients with the vision to become the industry-leading G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR)-focused drug discovery company. The company’s Native Complex Platform™ recapitulates GPCRs with their native structure, function, and dynamics outside of the cellular context. This approach enables novel access to modern structural and screening technologies used in industrial-scale drug discovery for the entire class of GPCRs. Septerna has an emerging pipeline of GPCR-targeted small molecule programs, many in the Endocrinology space, with potential for growth to target many GPCRs that have been undruggable and unexploited to date.

We are excited to expand our multidisciplinary team of individuals focused on creating revolutionary medicines to address the unmet needs of patients. At Septerna we strive to embrace diversity of thought, expertise, and background through collaboration. To join our ambitious team, be prepared to bring your real self to work every day; grow and learn from a talented team of drug hunters, scientists, and business professionals; and contribute your passion, creativity, and energy to accomplish our mission. We share a fearless pursuit of ground-breaking innovations and cultivate an environment where our employees succeed by learning from each other and working as a team.

We are committed to the development of meaningful therapeutics for patients with indications of high unmet need. This is a tremendous opportunity to work with talented individuals on the frontlines of therapeutic discovery and development. You will directly help move therapies through preclinical research, positioning them for success in the clinic. The successful candidate will add their passion, unique talents, and expertise to a dynamic team motivated to discover new disease-modifying therapeutics for patients in a fast-paced environment.

For more information see: www.septerna.com.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Research Associate or Associate Scientist Contractor who will support Septerna’s small molecule drug discovery pipeline. They will design, execute, and analyze in vitro and ex vivo studies to assess pharmacology, mechanism of action, and efficacy of Septerna’s drug candidates. They will work both independently and collaboratively to develop and run assays, generate preclinical data, and contribute biological insights to advance programs toward the clinic. They may also engage in assay development and implementation of advanced in vitro/ex vivo modeling approaches to support Septerna’s translational efforts.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to demonstrate their scientific expertise and grow within our R&D organization, contributing biological and physiological insights to projects as well as ideas for new therapeutic programs.

The position is based in South San Francisco, CA. Title and compensation commensurate with experience.

**Key Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):**

* Design and execute in vitro/ex vivo studies to evaluate therapeutic mechanisms of action in relevant models
* Generate, analyze, document, and interpret data to establish potency and efficacy relationships
* Support assay development and optimization
* Help build and expand in vitro/ex vivo modeling capabilities
* Conduct literature reviews and interpret scientific publications to inform experimental design and troubleshooting
* Participate in project teams and present results at lab, team, and departmental meetings
* Follow all company policies and practices; maintain accurate and complete laboratory records and electronic notebooks

**Required Education, Skills & Experience:**

* BSc or MSc in Biology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related field
* Minimum of 4 years (or 2 years with an MSc) of experience in academia, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry focused on metabolic, inflammatory, and/or endocrine disorders
* Significant hands-on experience with tissue culture, including handling cell lines and human primary cells for MOA or receptor signaling studies
* Experience using various scientific methods and techniques, including molecular biology (e.g., RNA/DNA/protein purification, qRT-PCR), immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, ELISA, and/or cell-based assays
* Results-oriented with a strong track record of research productivity, as evidenced by impactful contributions to drug discovery projects and/or high-quality publications
* Strong attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills, with experience using an ELN (e.g., Benchling), writing protocols, and troubleshooting biological experiments
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with colleagues and effectively interpret and present data

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Experience with models of bone, kidney, and/or endocrine organs
* Experience with stem cell culture/differentiation and advanced cell culture techniques (e.g., organoids, sandwich cultures)
* Hands-on experience with primary cell isolation from animal and/or human tissues
* Familiarity with multi-omics data analysis and interpretation of complex datasets
* Experience in small-molecule drug discovery
* Experience in GPCR biology

The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in South San Francisco, CA is $45.00/hr - 55.00/hr. Individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including, and without limitation, job-related skills, experience, work location and relevant education or training.

Job Description

Position overview:

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking a research associate in the Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) to develop new approaches to low-dose imaging that exploit correlations between photons. The successful candidate will have a leading role in a Laboratory Directed Research and Development (LDRD) project spanning simulation, instrument development and experimental demonstration. The candidate will build Monte Carlo models of imaging systems, design and commission a prototype in a SLAC laboratory, and compare measured images with simulation to quantify the achievable reduction in dose. The project brings together scientists across LCLS, SSRL and SLAC's detector groups with external university partners, and is closely linked to a DOE X-ray quantum imaging program. The candidate is expected to have core interests in quantum or correlated imaging, physics simulations and experimental setup.

The candidate will be required to engage in and drive scientific research on low-dose correlated imaging, from simulation through to experimental demonstration. The dissemination of scientific outcomes through peer reviewed publications, as well as presentations at meetings/conferences, is expected. SLAC is committed to fostering a work environment that promotes inclusion, diversity, equity and accountability. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply; you do not need to meet all the Preferred Qualifications to be considered.

Note: The Research Associate role is a fixed term staff position. Appointment duration is for 2- year fixed term
, with the possibility of extension. Assignment duration is contingent upon project needs and funding.

Applicants must provide evidence of either a recently completed PhD degree or confirmation of completion of the PhD degree requirements prior to starting the position. Applicants should also include a cover letter, a curriculum vitae which includes a list of publications, and names of three references for future letters of recommendation with the application.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

Develop and demonstrate low-dose correlated imaging by:

Building and running Monte Carlo radiation-transport simulations to optimize the imaging geometry, materials and detectors, and to establish the limits of the method
Designing, assembling and commissioning a prototype imaging system, including mechanics, detectors and data-acquisition electronics
Developing data-acquisition and analysis software, and comparing results with conventional imaging
Planning and performing imaging experiments on test samples, and quantifying image quality as a function of dose
Extending the method toward advanced detector technologies and multimodal imaging with collaborators
Collaborating with other scientists, postdocs, students, engineers, and technical staff to execute experiments and perform forefront research
Disseminating research results through peer reviewed publications and presentations at scientific meetings and conferences

To Be Successful In This Position You Will Bring

Ph.D. in Physics, Applied Physics, Medical Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, and course work or research experience in the following:
Radiation detection instrumentation and fast timing electronics, and a demonstrated ability to develop, design, and optimize scientific instrumentation.
Monte Carlo radiation-transport modelling (e.g. FLUKA, Geant4 or MCNP) and scientific programming (e.g. Python) for data analysis.
Familiarity with quantum imaging, imaging statistics, or medical imaging is an advantage.
Demonstrated record of scientific productivity through publications.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work and communicate effectively with a diverse population.
Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment.

Responsibilities

PhD with relevant coursework or equivalent relevant experience.

jobs.title: Sr Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior Data Analyst – Technology is a senior individual contributor responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data sources and translating raw data into reliable, decision-ready insights that advance Medicare Advantage technology operations. This role partners with product managers, platform engineers, clinical operations, and compliance teams to gather requirements, define data structures, and deliver scalable analytical solutions aligned with CMS regulatory standards, HEDIS/STAR performance objectives, and audit requirements. Operating with an AI-first mindset, this analyst owns the end-to-end insight lifecycle — from requirements gathering in an agile environment to production-grade analysis and stakeholder delivery — and serves as the team's data subject matter expert. This role is a key driver of data quality, analytical depth, and operational performance across the technology organization.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Data Architecture: Gather business requirements in an iterative agile/scrum model and define structural requirements for new analytical applications, including data transformation processes and source-to-target mappings that ensure data integrity and traceability.

Healthcare Data Analysis & Profiling: Analyze structured and semi-structured healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — to conduct detailed data profiling, ad hoc analyses, and complex investigations of functional data issues.

Scalable Reporting & Pipeline Development: Design and build scalable reporting processes and production-grade data pipelines using advanced SQL, Databricks, and cloud-native tools that support ongoing analytical and regulatory reporting needs.

Regulatory & Compliance Analytics: Produce analysis supporting HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter submissions, and risk adjustment reporting to ensure the organization is audit-ready and compliant with applicable CMS and HIPAA standards.

Data Quality & Governance: Validate data accuracy across systems, apply schema validation and data contract enforcement, and own data quality validation logic to ensure that all outputs are decision-ready, traceable, and compliant with PHI/PII requirements.

AI-First Automation & Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and apply AI-assisted querying, automated data preparation, and natural language analytics tools to accelerate insight generation and increase analytical capacity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Data SME Guidance: Serve as the data subject matter expert for the team, collaborating with analysts, product managers, and platform/cloud engineers to deliver reliable data solutions and provide technical guidance to junior analytical resources.

Documentation & Technical Communication: Own technical runbooks, operational handoff materials, and source-to-target mapping documentation to ensure knowledge continuity, team efficiency, and audit-ready records.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities. The Senior Data Analyst is expected to provide analytical guidance and informal mentorship to junior team members and may independently manage all data analysis work for a given project from initiation through delivery.

Experience

Job Requirements

Required:

Minimum of 8 years of progressive data analysis experience, with a proven track record of building and supporting production-grade data pipelines and analytical solutions
At least 5 years of hands-on experience in healthcare data analysis, with direct exposure to medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider datasets
Advanced SQL skills, including complex query design, performance tuning, stored procedures, and data quality validation logic
Demonstrated experience working within scrum teams in an agile development environment, including experience with agile tooling (e.g., Rally or equivalent)
Experience working with both structured and semi-structured data ingestion patterns, schema validation, and data contract enforcement across systems
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams — working closely with analysts, product managers, and platform/cloud engineers to deliver reliable data solutions
Strong documentation and communication skills, with experience owning technical runbooks and operational handoff materials
Experience in a regulated, HIPAA-compliant data environment with PHI/PII datasets

Preferred:

Experience in a Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or managed care health plan environment with knowledge of CMS reporting, HEDIS, STAR ratings, risk adjustment, or encounter data submissions
Experience with data platforms including Databricks, Apache Kafka, or equivalent streaming and cloud-native analytics tools
Experience applying AI or automation tools to analytical workflows, including natural language querying, automated data preparation, or predictive modeling

Education

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered

Preferred:

Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline

Training

Required:

Demonstrated proficiency in advanced SQL through direct production work experience; equivalent hands-on experience accepted in lieu of formal training
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project work

Preferred:

Completion of relevant healthcare data analytics, data governance, or AI-augmented analytics training (e.g., AHIMA, CPHIMS, or equivalent)

Skills & Competencies

Technical/Role-Specific Skills

Advanced SQL & Data Querying: Expert-level SQL skills covering complex query design, performance tuning, stored procedures, and data quality validation logic across relational and cloud-based databases.

Healthcare Data Domains: Deep working knowledge of medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data, including EDI standards (834/837), HL7/FHIR, ICD-10/CPT codes, and CMS encounter data formats.

Cloud Data Platforms & Pipeline Engineering: Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data transformation tools (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)

Data Quality & Governance: Demonstrated ability to assess data completeness, detect anomalies, apply quality validation logic, and enforce governance standards across regulated healthcare datasets.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Automation: Familiarity with AI-assisted querying, automated data preparation tools, and workflow automation to accelerate insight delivery and reduce manual analytical burden.

BI & Data Visualization: Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools for building scalable dashboards and executive-ready reports that translate complex data into clear operational views.

Licensure

Required: None

Preferred: None

At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.

With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.

About The Opportunity

QIAGEN Digital Insights is a leading provider of bioinformatics software and knowledge bases used by life scientists to gain insight from the molecular information in their biological samples. We have developed industry-leading software tools for analysis and reporting of biological data. We are passionate about our users, our products, and our vision, and are seeking smart, motivated engineers and scientists who are eager to join our team in creating software that helps improve people's lives.

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3-5 Test Automation and QA/QC engineers.

Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate testing coverage and represent content QA in release planning and tracking.

5+ years of industry experience in bioinformatics, including experience developing test automation for production-grade bioinformatics tools and pipelines.
2+ years of experience managing engineers or bioinformatics scientists.
Strong software development fundamentals, with experience in multiple general-purpose programming languages, including Python, and comfort operating in a Linux environment. Experience with Perl and Java is a plus. Mastery of software engineering best practices such as version control (git), code review, unit and integration testing, documentation, and collaborative development.
Domain knowledge of human genetics and genomics, and familiarity with tools and databases used in genomic biomedical research (e.g., NCBI, Ensembl, RefSeq, ClinVar, COSMIC, OMIM).
Practical experience with biomedical ontologies (e.g., Gene Ontology, Human Phenotype Ontology) and related semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
Experience with multiple data modeling paradigms, including relational databases (SQL) and non-relational approaches such as graph databases (e.g., Neo4j).
Experience with information extraction and knowledge modeling of structured and unstructured biological data sources is preferred.
Experience with API testing and browser-based test automation tools such as Selenium and WebDriver is a plus.

BlueRock Therapeutics, a wholly-owned and independently operated subsidiary of Bayer AG, is a leading engineered cell therapy company pioneering a new generation of cellular medicines. Utilizing our proprietary CELL+GENE™ platform, we direct cellular differentiation and genetically engineer cells to create transformative therapies for patients suffering from neurological and ophthalmological diseases.

Founded in 2016, BlueRock is at the forefront of the convergence of cell biology and genetic engineering. Our mission is to harness pluripotent stem cell technology and gene editing to deliver authentic, functional cell therapies that address the root causes of disease and offer hope to millions of patients worldwide.

What Are We Doing?

Our foundational science enables the generation and directed differentiation of universal pluripotent stem cells into authentic, functional cells for allogeneic cellular therapies.

We are passionate about realizing the promise of cell and gene therapy, shaping the future of regenerative medicine, and delivering new therapies to patients with limited or no treatment options.

The New York, USA site is seeking a Research Associate I or II for the Platform Bioprocess pipeline that will be reporting to the sub-team lead.

The incumbent will be a technical contributor in a dynamic and progressive team pioneering the generation of therapeutic cells from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs). Within an exciting collaborative environment, the individual is expected to learn and apply their knowledge of human pluripotent stem cell biology and lineage-directed differentiation techniques to help generate cell lines and bioprocess supply for BlueRock’s research pipeline. This may include assisting in the generation and performing the directed differentiation of hPSC lines engineered with gene editing technologies including CRISPR/Cas to determine whether genome alterations provide BlueRock authentic cell types with novel morphology or function for cellular replacement therapies.

Responsibilities

Execute in vitro experiments to characterize and cultivate hPSCs and their derivatives.
Perform DNA/RNA-based, cell-based, flow cytometric, immunofluorescence and other protein-based analytical assays as required.
Perform directed differentiation of hPSCs into various cell lineages.
Coordinate and interact with other functional areas to complete characterization of generated cell lines and their derivative products.
Analyze and document experimental data in electronic laboratory notebooks in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with the company quality management system.
Be responsible for data generation, collection and communication of results.
Prepare and follow standard operating procedures, batch records and other process documentation.
Attend and present scientific data to colleagues at internal meetings.

Minimum Requirements

B.S. or M.Sc. in cell biology, developmental biology, molecular biology, genetics or related discipline, with up to 5 years (if B.S.) or 3 years (if M.Sc.) laboratory research or industry experience.
Experience with human pluripotent stem cell or mammalian cell culture.
Experience with lineage-specific differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells is preferred.
Experience with cell characterization technologies including PCR, DNA sequencing, qPCR, flow cytometry and immunofluorescence.
Experience with molecular cloning and gene editing technologies is a plus.
Excellent analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
Strong written and verbal communications skills.

jobs.description:
CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments for independent financial advisors, empowering them to engage and transact with leading asset managers on a massive scale through a wide variety of alternative investment products and technology solutions. CAIS provides financial advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, real estate, digital assets, and structured notes. CAIS also delivers industry-leading technology, operational efficiency, and world-class client service throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets.

CAIS is hiring a full-time Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing team. This hybrid role blends marketing analytics, data modeling, and applied AI. You will turn campaign, event, and engagement data into clear answers on what drives advisor engagement and platform activity, and you will build the reporting and automation that gets those answers to Marketing, Sales, and leadership.

As we continue to expand our AI-first strategy, you will help explore and implement AI-driven workflows that improve efficiency, uncover opportunities, and accelerate how Marketing operates. We are looking for someone who can turn open-ended problems into structured solutions, explain what the data shows to colleagues who are not technical, and bridge technical and business perspectives.

You will report to Director, Digital Marketing and partner closely with the Data team, Sales, Product, and Operations. This is a hybrid position based in New York, NY, with an expectation of 3 days per week in the office.

Responsibilities

Insights and Reporting

Become an expert in alternative investments and CAIS data, and use what you learn to deliver insights that tie marketing activity to advisor engagement and platform outcomes
Build and maintain marketing performance reporting across email, campaigns, web, and events, covering engagement, attendance, pipeline influence, and post-event platform activity
Design and maintain dashboards and automated reports that give teams self-serve access to trends, patterns, and predictions
Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Product stakeholders to gather requirements, run analytics requests, and translate findings into clear recommendations

Data Modeling and Workflows

Develop scalable data models in Snowflake that unify marketing, CRM, and platform data into a single view of the advisor, with careful handling of attribution, deduplication, and timezones
Build and maintain automated data workflows that connect the data warehouse, marketing automation, CRM, and communication tools, including AI-enhanced enrichment and classification
Contribute to data governance and cataloging efforts, ensuring marketing data assets are documented, well-defined, and ready for AI use cases

Applied AI

Apply machine learning and AI techniques (such as segmentation, propensity and predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI) to improve targeting, personalization, and decision-making
Experiment with emerging AI tools, deliver proofs of concept for stakeholders, and create reusable documentation and training that share AI-powered practices across the team

Qualifications

2 to 4 years of experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, or data science, preferably in technology or financial services
Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python preferred) for analytics and automation
Strong data modeling skills, including pre-aggregation to avoid join fan-out and consistent handling of timezones
Experience building dashboards and reports in a business intelligence tool (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Streamlit) or custom HTML reporting
Hands-on experience with marketing and CRM platform data (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) and an understanding of campaign, email, and event metrics
Working knowledge of core machine learning concepts (regression, classification, and clustering) and their practical application to marketing use cases
Exposure to AI use cases such as natural language processing, generative AI, or applications built on large language models
Ability to turn open-ended problems into structured solutions and communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience with cloud data platforms and transformation tools (Snowflake, AWS, dbt)
Experience with workflow automation or orchestration tools (such as n8n) and REST APIs
Experience with marketing technology platforms (such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Typeform, or Cvent) and reporting for marketing programs
Experience using large language models in production workflows, such as classification, enrichment, or content generation
Experience with Lucidchart, Visio, or similar diagramming tools
Interest in contributing to an AI-forward data culture at CAIS

Position Description

The Vital Statistics Quality Assurance Specialist serves as an experienced data analyst responsible for planning, developing, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating quality improvement and quality assurance activities for Vital Statistics. To achieve this, the incumbent consults with data providers including health care facilities, physicians, the State Medical Examiner’s Office, and funeral directors as well as federal and state partners and other Oklahoma State Department of Health (OSDH) programs that rely on collected vital records data. Additionally, the incumbent oversees the file management and linkage of Oklahoma vital records data, including data processing, editing, finalization, file creation, and submission to internal OSDH programs and external state and federal agencies

Position Responsibilities/Essential Functions

Oversees file management of Vital Records data related to federal contracts and Oklahoma-mandated state partners, ensuring submission and data quality requirements are met or exceeded for the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) Vital Statistics Cooperative Program (VSCP) contract.
Designs, executes, and validates deterministic and probabilistic data linkages between Vital Records and internal or external health datasets (such as Hospital Discharge, Immunization, and Cancer Registry data) to improve data completeness and support public health surveillance
Develops data exports, dashboards, and statistical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborates with the Information Technology (IT) department to identify and resolve data inconsistencies, system bugs, and errors within Vital Records systems (ROVER, VRScan, and Imaging Repository).
Writes complex queries to identify data gaps, anomalies, and linkage discrepancies, and creates regular Quality Assurance (QA) reports for data providers.
Manages Electronic Verification of Vital Events (EVVE) and State and Territorial Exchange of Vital Events (STEVE) operations and data exchanges.
Provides data-driven recommendations to update agency policy, administrative code, and state statutes as appropriate.
Serves as a senior technical advisor to Vital Records staff.
Assists other Center for Health Statistics (CHS) data collection program managers with developing and implementing quality assurance and data linkage processes, including Hospital Discharge, Oklahoma Central Cancer Registry (OCCR), and Immunization data.
Consults with federal and state partners on improving Vital Records reporting systems, including Health Information Exchange (HIE) activities related to Vital Records.
Assists OSDH and Vital Records staff with system re-engineering, data cleaning, data archiving, and record issuance projects.
Serves on internal and external committees, councils, and workgroups, and represents the Department in meetings with partner agencies.
Consults with internal and external partners to coordinate grant writing and prepare grant-related data reports.
Represents OSDH on national organizations and workgroups related to Vital Records, Hospital Data, data linkage standards, and HIE activities.
Other duties as assigned.
Being present in the office is an essential function of this position.

Other Duties

Demonstrates knowledge of and supports mission, vision, value statements, standards, policies and procedures, operating instructions, confidentiality standards, and the code of ethical behavior.
Works effectively in team environment, participating and assisting their peers.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s degree in public health (Biostatistics/Epidemiology), analytics, informatics, or related Master’s level degree.
At least two years of experience as a statistician, biostatistician, or epidemiologist for a public health registry system.
Experience performing deterministic and probabilistic record linkages.
Proficiency with SQL and SAS.
Data Analytics Tools: Proficiency in utilizing data analytics tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power Bl, or similar platforms for data analysis, visualization, and reporting.

Valued Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Knowledge of statistical and research theory and methods, including probability, sampling, and inferential statistics.
Knowledge of data collection techniques, deterministic and probabilistic record linkage methodologies, and data processing applications for complex data management problems.
Ability to interpret and apply agency policy, administrative code, and statutory material.
Ability to transform and link large relational databases using SAS (including PROC SQL), R, and other applicable database or visualization software.
Ability to communicate statistical results clearly, both orally and in writing, and produce accurate technical and non-technical materials.
Ability to present data effectively to both technical and lay audiences and conduct public information programs when needed.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal staff, external partners, and the general public.

Application Requirements

If education, certification or licensure is required to meet qualifications, applicants must provide documentation at the time of application.
All applicants are subject to a background check and must be legally authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Physical Demands And Work Environment

This position is set in an office environment and computer based. While performing the duties of the job, employees are frequently required to stand, walk, lift, and reach. Applicants must be willing to perform all job-related travel associated with this position.

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential
. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

Position Summary

As a System Safety & Reliability Engineering Specialist you will lead safety activities to ensure the safety and reliability attributes of programs and demonstrators are understood and risks are managed to an acceptable level. This role involves the integration of diverse areas of knowledge to create and support complex systems with reliable system operation under challenging conditions. Your tasks include mathematical modeling, fault modelling, probabilistic safety assessments, and hazard assessments; extracting actionable insights to improve our products. You will apply multi-domain engineering knowledge for components and systems detailing failure mechanisms and their system effects.

What You Will Be Doing

Serve as the Safety Lead during New Product Introduction coordinating at all levels within the product program team.
Prevent and mitigate hazards by understanding the product’s or demonstrator's degradation and failure mechanisms, their associated consequences, and the hazards to which they contribute. Develop models that characterize these mechanisms using deterministic or probabilistic/data mining techniques.
Assess new and derivative design solutions/architectures, product operation and maintenance practices to evaluate their impact on product safety and reliability. Develop and validate models at component, system, asset, and fleet levels to characterize the product's safety and reliability attributes. Support the associated part/function classification activities.
Perform Safety & Reliability Engineering analysis including FHA, FMEA, SSA, Risk Assessment, Life Data Analysis, Human Factors, RCM, and FRACAS to ensure New Products are launched successfully.
Find the solutions that matter to our customers through our analysis and understanding of the solution space that influences the product lifecycle.
Lead and coach regarding System Safety & Reliability tasks. Provide technical task leadership / consulting to System Safety & Reliability Engineers. Develop System Safety & Reliability methods and tools for the global function.
Tasks include mathematical modeling of complex systems, probabilistic safety assessments, and hazard assessments, extracting actionable insights to improve our products. We apply multi-domain engineering knowledge for components and systems, detailing failure mechanisms and their system effects.

PhD in Engineering, Mathematics, Applied Statistics or Actuarial Science
In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen and must be eligible for a security clearance

Preferred Requirements

Member of ASQ possessing Certified Reliability Engineer credentials
Technical experience in the use of Safety and/or Reliability engineering tools (e.g.) the Synthesis Suite, @RISK, Isograph Reliability Workbench.
Knowledge of the acceptable means of compliance that may be used to support a new program or product.

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

At Lakeshore, we create innovative learning materials and world-class guest experiences for teachers, parents and children. Position Title

Specimen Processing Technician

Evenings - Full Time

Bell Hospital

Position Summary / Career Interest

Sunday -Thursday 2:30pm - 11pm

The Specimen Processing Technician is a position within the clinical laboratory and microbiology that is responsible for managing specimens once they arrive in the department and handling multiple pre-analytical variables. Depending on the area of the lab, this may include, but are not limited to: positive patient identification, correct tube types, specimen conditions and integrity and how they affect laboratory results. The Specimen Processing Technician accepts samples in the laboratory and performs tasks including releasing orders out of the Hospital Information System (HIS), receiving specimens in the Laboratory Information System (LIS), and processing specimens to include aliquoting and preparation for the automation line. The specimen Processing Technician troubleshoots specimen and order issues and communicates with care providers across the Health System. The Specimen Processing Technician working in Microbiology is responsible for performing pre-analytic functions such as: specimen receipt, sterile processing, specimen manipulation including sonication and tissue grinding, determination of appropriate culture media for different specimen types and plating. The Specimen Processing Technician follows regulatory, accreditation, safety and hospital standards, policies and procedures, and participates in quality assurance and quality improvement activities.

Responsibilities And Essential Job Functions

Creates Registration encounters, releases orders out of HIS when indicated; receives samples in LIS; prints barcode labels and affixes labels to specimens.
Completes order entry functions or paperwork as required. Ensures proper container type, centrifugation, specimen sterility, and transport conditions for specimens.
Ensures positive patient identification, correct specimen collection and handling/transport; performs specimen processing duties and prioritizes based on urgency
Ensures the specimen and orders received are appropriate for requested testing. Prioritizes specimens based on clinical urgency. - Performs specimen processing duties including but not limited to: aliquoting urine and body fluid samples, supply storage, Kanban supply, inventory monitoring and storing patient samples appropriately.
In Microbiology, uses sterile techniques to handle, manipulate, and inoculate specimens on to culture media, including but not limited to determination of selecting the correct culture media based on specimen, order and protocols, sterile aliquoting, sonification and tissue grinding.
Assists in pathology specimen preservation, by adding formalin to specimens, and/or paging residents or providers as needed.
Fields inquiries and communicates information in written and verbal formats. Answers the phone and provides customer service to internal and external customers following established standards.
Consults Specimen Processing Coordinator, supervisor or lab leadership when appropriate.
Assists other staff with processing questions or automation line issues.
Assists with training new hires, students, or medical students, if applicable.
Disposes of bio-hazardous materials, chemical waste, sharps and other potentially hazardous materials according to policy and strictly adheres to safety and infection control procedures. Uses and wears PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) as necessary to perform job duties safely and minimize risk.
Other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.
These statements are intended to describe the essential functions of the job and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Skills and duties may vary dependent upon your department or unit. Other duties may be assigned as required.

High School Graduate
6 months of experience in a clinical laboratory - working with biological specimens

Completion of a Phlebotomy program
1 or more years of experience in specimen collection and processing.

If required by position to be filled, must obtain Department of Transportation and International Air Transportation Association certification within 180 Days

jobs.title: Frontend CAD Flow Engineer, SI Hardware
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Tesla SI Hardware team is at the forefront of revolutionizing artificial intelligence through cutting-edge hardware innovation. The team designs and develops advanced AI inference and training chips that power the neural networks behind Full Self-Driving (FSD) and Tesla's humanoid robot, Optimus. By creating custom silicon and optimized architectures, the team keeps Tesla at the leading edge of computational efficiency and performance.

Our SI Hardware CAD team builds and maintains the end-to-end infrastructure that takes complex SoC and 3D IC designs from RTL to tapeout. As a Staff CAD Flow Engineer focused on the front end, you will build the flows that RTL and physical design engineers rely on every day: constraints, synthesis, equivalence, static RTL checks, power intent, and the handoff system that ties them together. Building these well takes real technical depth. You will bring each flow up on real blocks, analyze the results until you understand exactly why the tools report what they do, and turn that understanding into a system that gives designers correct, actionable answers. You are not the one fixing every CDC violation, but you understand them well enough to build the flow that helps every designer find and fix their own.

 **What You'll Do**

* Architect and build the RTL-to-PD handoff system: automated quality gates for elaboration, lint, CDC/RDC, SDC, UPF, smoke synthesis, and LEC. Give RTL and PD engineers clear pass/fail criteria they trust
* Build the timing constraint (SDC) flow: constraint linting, block-vs-top and RTL-vs-netlist consistency checks, and templates or generators for common clocking and I/O structures. Produce reports that point designers to the root cause instead of encouraging more exceptions
* Maintain the front-end build: file list and compile-spec generation, IP and library collateral management, and automated quality checks on internal and third-party IP deliveries
* Build and maintain synthesis flows (Genus, Fusion Compiler, or Design Compiler): library and dont\_use setup, hierarchy strategy, clock gating, DFT hooks, and QoR reporting, with correlation to post-route results
* Build lint, CDC, and RDC infrastructure (SpyGlass, Jasper, Questa, or equivalent): rule sets, constraint and waiver methodology, and sign-off criteria. Tune them on real designs to separate real issues from noise
* Build formal equivalence flows (Conformal LEC or Formality) from RTL through netlist and ECO. Automate setup, mapping, and first-pass triage of non-equivalence and aborts, including low-power-aware LEC
* Develop RTL power-intent flows: UPF guidelines and checks for RTL owners, low-power static checks (VC LP / Conformal LP) at RTL and netlist, and consistency with the implementation UPF
* Build automated detection and reporting of common RTL and synthesis issues so designers catch them before handoff: unintended latches, logic optimized away, undriven or multi-driven nets, black boxes, and unexpected area or power
* Bring up early RTL-level power and area estimation (e.g., Joules, PowerArtist) so designers see PPA impact during development
* Pilot every flow on real blocks and reference designs. Do the deep technical analysis needed to validate results, and iterate with RTL and PD engineers until the flow is right

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Typically 8+ years in front-end CAD, design methodology, synthesis, or RTL design for complex SoCs at advanced process nodes
* A track record of building front-end flows or tools that other engineers adopted and relied on through tapeout
* Deep technical understanding of the problems those flows solve, enough to build checks that are correct and to explain any result to a designer
* Hands-on experience running these flows on real designs and digging into the results: debugging constraint problems, synthesis QoR, and LEC failures yourself
* Hands-on experience with Genus, Fusion Compiler, or Design Compiler; Conformal LEC or Formality; and lint/CDC/RDC tools
* Working knowledge of UPF, low-power static checks, and how RTL power intent carries into implementation
* Strong Python and Tcl, plus software engineering habits: version control, testing, CI, and config-driven design that others can extend
* Ability to work independently on a small team: understand what designers need, take an ambiguous problem to a deployed solution, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to RTL and PD engineers

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

jobs.description:
Located in Templeton amongst the oak trees, Adventist Health Twin Cities has been serving northern San Luis Obispo County since 1977. Comprised of a 122-bed acute care facility, our team provides exceptional care in emergency medicine, orthopedics, obstetrics, digestive disorders, wound care, and various medical, surgical and outpatient services. Locals enjoy weekly farmers markets in downtown Templeton, farm-to-fork dining, beautiful landscapes for hiking and biking, and beach days just fifteen minutes away at Cambria and Morro Bay.

Job Summary:

Prioritizes and performs a wide variety of clinical laboratory tests on various biological specimens. Reviews, evaluates, documents and reports results. Preserves confidentiality of patients and follows lab safety and maintenance protocols. Trains and supervises trainees, laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory science, biological sciences, chemical sciences or allied health technologies or equivalent: Required
* Clinical laboratory experience: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
* Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred

Essential Functions:

* Employs positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
* Prioritizes lab orders according to type (STAT, ASAP, routine and timed studies) and performs various testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) following prescribed quality assurance policies and procedures. Performs, evaluates and documents quality control checks. Reviews testing results evaluating validity of test results in comparison to anticipated results indicated per procedure manual.
* Reviews and evaluates the validity and accuracy of test results, recognizing the interdependency of tests, the physiological conditions affecting results, patient age and normal values, controls, linearity errors, instrument codes, delta checks and more. Correlates test results with diagnoses and questions incompatible results. Thoroughly documents and communicates test results, expediting all critical values and results to appropriate clinicians.
* Disposes of contaminated materials and equipment in accordance with policy and assures that work area is properly cleansed after each test. Performs equipment and instrumentation maintenance, troubleshooting and calibration as needed. Inventories and restocks reagents, calibrators, controls and supplies as needed.
* Participates in the collection and evaluation of data for Performance Improvement evaluations. Documents adverse events using incident reporting tool. Orients, instructs and supervises laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

Overview:

The Center for Health Sciences at SRI International conducts multidisciplinary research to understand brain functioning, sleep, and their relationship with health and behavior. Our work includes a variety of research projects, including the longitudinal NIH-supported NCANDA study about brain development in adolescents and young adults. This project includes collection of neuroimaging, sleep, and wearable data as well as clinical interviews and neuropsychology testing.

This part-time RA position offers the opportunity to contribute to the center’s research program, with a main contribution to the NCANDA study. The RA will work alongside an interdisciplinary research team and gain practical experience in data collection from human participants across several domains, including MRI. Timing of participant-facing activities is flexible, based on participant and staffing availability but includes afternoon-evening shifts, as well as some weekend work.

The position will work onsite at our Menlo Park, CA office 15-20 hours per week.

Responsibilities:

* Support data collection on the longitudinal NCANDA study, including conducting MRI scans, clinical interviews, and neuropsychological testing.
* Assist with participant-facing research visits, which may include some evening and weekend assessments.
* Support other study-specific procedures as needed.
* Assist with research data entry, organization, quality control, and preparation for analysis.
* Follow study protocols and research procedures to ensure accurate, consistent, and high-quality data collection.
* Work collaboratively as part of a team and assist with other research activities as needed.

* Team player

SRI also has a competitive benefits package, to view details please go to https://www.sri.com/resources/benefits/. SRI will accept applications until the position is filled.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher
to conduct research in computational structural biology and develop bioinformatic methods for predicting protein-protein interactions in host-pathogen systems using evolutionary and structural information.

Current structure prediction tools, such as RoseTTAFold3, AlphaFold3, and ESMFold2, excel at monomeric structure prediction and at predicting known protein complexes. However, these tools struggle to identify which proteins interact and which do not. Residue-residue coevolution can be leveraged to predict interactions within organisms, but these signals are challenging to extract for interactions between organisms. You will build and leverage large protein sequence datasets to enable accurate interaction prediction and apply these methods to identify novel biological systems.

You will be an integral member of an interdisciplinary, cross-institutional team working with computational biologists and experimental biologists. You will leverage existing computational tools and develop new approaches for predicting binary interactions, interaction specificity, and protein structure. You will regularly present your work and publish your research findings, including through occasional travel to collaborate with external partners and attend conferences. This position is in the Computational Engineering Division (CED), within the Engineering Directorate.

Interested Candidates Should Submit a Complete Application That Includes

Cover letter (1-2pgs) describing the following:
Research interests
A description of graduate work and greatest scientific accomplishments
How previous work (postgraduate/graduate/prior research experience) makes you a strong candidate for developing bioinformatic methods for predicting protein-protein interactions
What are your career goals (briefly)
How do you seek to approach this research area? (~1 paragraph)

Curriculum vitae including full publication list
Contact information for three professional references

A complete application includes a cover letter, CV, and references. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

In this role, you will

Conduct research, and contribute to designing, analyzing, and extending sequence and structure based bioinformatic tools to develop databases that will enable protein-protein interaction predictions.
Interpret new/understudied biological systems through protein structure prediction.
Contribute to the development of protein sequence and structure computational frameworks and analysis tools.
Develop structure-based distillation datasets for team members to improve ML model development.
Collaborate with external partners (Universities, Industry, other National Laboratories) to advance computational biology simulation efforts.
Prepare complex and detailed progress reports, written analyses, and verbal briefings to support project needs and deadlines and to present research results to sponsors.
Independently pursue the development of new and innovative research methods relevant to the needs of Laboratory programs and/or external funding agencies.
Contribute to proposals and statements of work.
Publish research results in peer-reviewed scientific or technical journals and present results at external conferences, seminars, and/or technical meetings.
Travel as needed to coordinate with research collaborators and to attend external meetings and conferences.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

PhD in Life Sciences, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or a related technical or scientific field.
Experience working with protein sequence and structure.
Strong knowledge and research experience in bioinformatics and protein structure modeling.
Ability to work independently on defined research projects, as well as a member of a team with a diverse set of scientists, engineers, and other technical and administrative staff.
Programming experience with Python and expertise with UNIX and high-performance computing environments.
Ability to develop independent research projects as demonstrated through publication of peer-reviewed manuscripts.
Ability to travel as necessary.

Qualifications We Desire

Strong understanding of protein bioinformatics (sequence and structure), protein structure prediction, and/or protein function prediction.
Experience with DL structure prediction tools (RF3, AF3, ESMFold2).
Experience in collaborating with experimental biologists.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have an opening for a Nondestructive Assay Subject Matter Expert (SME)
and Analyst
. You will provide original solutions and develop innovative methods to solve complex and unique Nondestructive Assay (NDA) problems using specialized knowledge and requiring in-depth analysis. You will perform gamma ray isotopic analysis, statistical analysis for measurement control, and propagation of variance. There may also be opportunities for the advancement of knowledge to the NDA community through collaboration in the development of international NDA standards. This position programmatically supports the Security Organization’s NNSA NA-70 and is part of the Nuclear Material Control and Accountability (MC&A) Group in the Security Organization within the Operations and Business Directorate.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Provide specialized and in-depth technical analysis, using advanced knowledge to resolve complex gamma ray, neutron, and calorimetric Nondestructive Assay (NDA) problems.
Perform gamma ray isotopic analysis using multiple analysis codes of spectra for unique isotopes in complex and challenging compositions.
Provide statistical analysis of NDA instrument performance to establish measurement control parameters to ensure measurement validity.
Develop, certify, implement, and maintain NDA instrument procedures as well as provide instrument and procedure on-the-job training (OJT) and mentoring.
Provide MC&A oversight, audit, and performance testing of NDA laboratory operations.
Interact independently with LLNL NDA laboratory staff and MC&A staff at other NNSA/DOE sites with minimal LLNL MC&A direction.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Establish and direct activities to implement solutions to highly complex and not well-defined NDA problems as subject matter expert to enable Laboratory nuclear material operations by assuring MC&A requirements are met with consultative direction from MC&A.
Collaborate with high level MC&A and NDA technical personnel and senior managers at other sites.
Represent LLNL at NDA collaborative consensus standards writing committees (e.g., ASTM international, Institute of Nuclear Material Management, American National Standards Institute, etc.)

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Master’s degree in Physics, Nuclear Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant previous experience.

Advanced knowledge and experience using statistical methods for establishing measurement control criteria that can be applied to NDA measurement system instrumentation.
Significant knowledge and experience involving assurance activities such as performance testing and assessments, as well as documenting deficiencies and establishing corrective actions.
Significant experience developing procedural documentation and ability to perform on-the-job training using advanced verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Ability to become a Certified Fissile Material Handler, which requires becoming medically qualified to wear respiratory and other personal protective equipment.
Ability to secure and maintain certification in the Select Agent Human Reliability Program (SAHRP), which includes physical and psychological assessment, and random drug and alcohol testing.

Subject matter expert knowledge and substantial experience with highly advanced concepts of multiple NDA techniques.
Expert level application of skills, knowledge, and abilities to develop creative solutions to highly complex or novel NDA issues (e.g., inhomogeneous, unique, or complex isotopic compositions).
Expert communication skills to advise senior management and/or external entities.

Doctoral degree in Physics, Nuclear Engineering, or related field.
Technical lead or supervisory authority experience.
Certified DOE (Department of Energy) National Training Center (NTC) instructor.
Certified in Technical Management and experience providing audit and oversight.

jobs.title: PCR Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
As a PCR Laboratory Technician
at IDEXX, you perform laboratory testing that helps veterinarians diagnose and treat pets. You will be a key contributor at one of the largest veterinary diagnostic companies in the world, joining a fast-paced work environment that encourages teamwork, quality, and offers opportunities for personal growth.

(This is a full-time position with excellent day-one benefits.)

If you’d like more information about laboratory jobs at IDEXX before applying, you can explore our Laboratory Careers web page: https://careers.idexx.com/us/en/referencelaboratories

Why This Role Matters

IDEXX reference laboratories is a global network united by a shared commitment to enhancing pet care where the true strength in our name is the people behind it, including this role. Our reference laboratories make it possible for our customers to discover more with our unrelenting commitment to innovation, personalized support, guidance, and expertise, while providing the most complete and advanced menu of diagnostic tests along with technology and tools. The focus on enhancing the lives of people and pets, starts with our own employees and empowering them to achieve their goals, focusing on continuous improvement, and supporting the strong collaboration and inclusiveness that exist in our team.

In This Role

You will use automated analyzers, microscopes and other laboratory diagnostic tools to perform analyses and tests that diagnose animal illnesses, injuries and diseases in support of veterinarian animal treatment.    
You will perform diagnostic tests on blood, urine, fecal or pet biopsy samples that we receive in our lab by the thousands, every day.  
You can expect to specialize in the PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) Department: Examining samples for the presence of specific substances (often bacteria) using molecular diagnostic methods, including: Samples homogenization Total nucleic acid extractions from a variety of sample types Molecular testing via real-time PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) Use analyzer and other molecular diagnostic methods to detect the molecular presence of pathogens You will be operating and maintaining PCR instrumentation and analyzers. You will be following CLIA, CAP, GMP, GLP and other regulatory standards. You will set up and run lab tests, then read and release results according to SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures). You can expect to specialize in an assigned department; explore more about those here: https://careers.idexx.com/us/en/referencelaboratories

What You Need To Succeed

You possess a High School diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. A 2-, 3- or 4-year degree in a Science-related field is preferred.
Ideally, you will have experience setting up, running, and reading lab tests, and operating laboratory equipment (microscopes, pipetting and / or clinical diagnostic analyzers).
Extensive skillset in the PCR Laboratory-PCR and real-time (qPCR) techniques
Sample prep, extraction and handling of DNA/RNA background
Operations and maintenance skillset of PCR analyzers and instrumentation
You have a positive attitude and love to bring that energy into the lab every day to support your colleagues
You are looking forward to working in a team
You concentrate on the details and can work reliably and precisely
You have a great sense of team spirit and responsibility
Able to meet the physical requirements that go with working in a lab – standing and sitting for extended periods of time, phone & computer use, extended reach, lifting up to 50lb, and specific vision ability – close, color, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
This is a laboratory, so there is potential exposure to biohazards, agents known to cause zoonotic diseases, and hazardous chemicals.

What You Can Expect From Us

Hourly rates targeting: $24.00 / hr
Opportunity for annual cash bonus and merit pay increase consideration
Health / Dental / Vision benefits from day one
5% matching 401k
On-the-job training and career advancement opportunities
Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and more
The opportunity to do meaningful work where you positively impact the lives of people and pets all over the world

Schedule: 

The hours for this position are Monday – Friday, 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM and alternating Saturdays. On the weeks you work a Saturday, you will have a different day off during the week so you are only ever working 5 days.
The shifts and hours may vary slightly depending on business needs.
Reliable and dependable attendance is an essential function of the position.

Why IDEXX

We’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve since 1983, our team members help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, ensure safe drinking water for billions, and help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease.

We have customers in over 175 countries and a collaborative global workforce. Our culture is one that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you’ll be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement.

Knowing our work makes a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of pets and people is what motivates us every day. If meaningful work and a sense of purpose are at the top of your list, you’ll find it here.

Let’s pursue what matters together. 

IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.

IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.

As a PCR Laboratory Technician, you will work on site in our West Sacramento, CA lab.

Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Apply today!

Job Summary

Under the general direction of the Laboratory Director, or their designee, performs pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical procedures and analyses to provide data for health maintenance, diagnoses, treatment and monitoring of medical conditions. Enhances quality of patient care and service through interdepartmental cooperation and quality assurance protocols.

Essential Responsibilities

Correctly verifies that the proper specimen is being analyzed for the correct patients and that the correct test is being performed. Judges the adequacy and qualities of specimens submitted for testing.
Analyzes clinical laboratory specimens following the standard methods and procedures approved by the Laboratory Director or designee. Performs quality control procedures to ensure accuracy of clinical data.
Utilizes test reference ranges (including neonates, pediatric and adult) to determine reasonableness of test results. Validates test results through correlation with test parameters (e.g. Hgb/Hct, anion gap, platelet count/smear, dipstick/micro etc.). Confirms testing on all Critical Values to ensure accuracy prior to releasing of test results.
Performs routine preventative maintenance and troubleshooting on assigned instruments and equipment according to established schedule and procedure. Performs and documents instrument function by checking and calibrating specific lab instruments and documents data.

jobs.description:
About the role
  
Our Microscopy and Histology Core supports researchers with FFPE tissue processing, sectioning, staining, and advanced multiplexed imaging. We’re looking for a Microscopy Specialist to join our small, collaborative team. You’ll be the hands behind the high-quality sections that feed into everything from routine histology analysis to spatial transcriptomics and multiplexed imaging projects.
  
What you’ll do
  

* Embed and cut FFPE blocks to produce consistent, high-quality sections
* Perform routine and special stains and immunostaining
* Process incoming samples and track them through our work order system
* Help investigators with sample preparation questions, such as fixation and trimming
* Learn and help implement new techniques as the core grows, including multiplexed immunofluorescence and imaging workflows
* Maintain equipment, reagents, and documentation to keep the lab running smoothly

What we’re looking for
  

* Hands-on experience cutting FFPE blocks (required)
* Experience with H&E and/or IHC/IF staining (preferred)
* Meticulous, organized, and careful with sample tracking
* Genuine curiosity and openness to learning new methods
* Comfort working with researchers from many different labs
* HT/HTL (ASCP) certification is a plus but not required
* B.A./B.S. or higher in a biological science, chemistry, or biochemistry, or equivalent knowledge and experience; or documented 2 years of histology experience

What it’s like to work here
  
Our core is fast-paced and varied. No two days look alike, and we regularly juggle competing projects and shifting deadlines. You’ll need to be flexible, prioritize well, and communicate clearly. We’re also a team that values its people. We protect work-life boundaries, support each other, and believe good science comes from people who aren’t burned out.
  
What we offer
  

* A supportive, close-knit team and room to grow your technical skills
* Exposure to cutting-edge imaging technology and diverse research projects

How to apply
  
  
**Interested applicants should submit the following materials:**  

* A brief cover letter describing your interest in the Microscopy and Histology Core Facility
* A current resume or CV
* Contact information for at least two references; three references are preferred

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Protein Production
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Research Associate III / Senior Research Associate to join the Reagent Development team, supporting protein production, protein–DNA binder-conjugate development, and sequencing kit qualification. Working independently on routine production and selecting methods for new assignments, with guidance from a senior scientist on priorities, you will express, purify, and conjugate proteins, verify kit components, support process optimization, analyze data, author production reports, assist with SOPs, and generate documentation for manufacturing transfer. The role requires proficiency in bacterial protein expression and chromatographic purification, buffer formulation, and protein characterization, along with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize protocols and a working knowledge of GLP compliance.

**As part of our team, your core responsibilities will be:**

* Perform recombinant protein expression in *E. coli*, interpret and troubleshoot protocols, and drive optimization of expression conditions to improve product quality and recovery.

* Purify proteins using chromatographic techniques including IMAC, IEX, and SEC on AKTA/FPLC and preparative HPLC systems.

* Perform protein–DNA binder conjugation reactions and support optimization of conjugation, purification, and analytical methods.

* Support development and optimization of processes for protein expression, purification, and Semanufacturing.

* Contribute to reagent and assay development, independently executing routine development tasks and designing and executing new experiments with guidance from a senior scientist.

* Quantify protein yield and purity using standard analytical methods (Nanodrop, SDS-PAGE, nanoDSF, analytical SEC/HPLC, LC-MS).

* Perform buffer screening to improve protein storage stability.

* Support qualification of sequencing kits and reagents by performing on-chip sequencing runs and analyzing performance data.

* Author production documentation; assist with SOPs and Work Instructions; maintain accurate laboratory records and inventory.
* Communicate results clearly to team members, contribute to formal reports, and adhere to safety and quality standards in all laboratory activities.

**Qualifications**

* BS or MS in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

* 2–6 years of laboratory experience in an academic or industry environment.

* Hands-on experience with:

* Protein expression and purification

* Buffer formulation

The role may also involve in vitro and cell-based models of cardiac biology, and hands-on experience with those systems is a plus. While the focus is primarily on cardiac and cardiovascular indications, Cytokinetics’ mission spans muscle biology broadly, and the successful candidate may also contribute to programs targeting skeletal or other muscle-related disease areas.

  

The ideal candidate is a highly autonomous, detail-oriented bench scientist who thrives in a hands-on role, requires minimal day-to-day supervision, and contributes to compound progression within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. **This is a B.S.- or M.S.-level position, not a PhD-level role.**

* **In vivo experience:** hands-on rodent (rat and mouse) handling, dosing, tissue collection, and disease model support, in compliance with IACUC guidelines.

* **Education:** B.S. in Biology, Physiology, Pharmacology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline with generally 5–8 years of relevant experience, or an M.S. with generally 3–6 years. This is **not** a PhD-level position.

* **Autonomy:** broad knowledge of scientific techniques relevant to the discipline, a high level of bench proficiency, and the ability to use the scientific literature independently to design and conduct experiments.

  

**Preferred / Plus**

* Experience in cardiac/cardiovascular biology.

* Hands-on in vivo cardiac functional assessments and/or experience characterizing rodent cardiac disease models.

* Hands-on cell culture with cell lines, iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes, or primary cells.

Prior experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology setting.

* Perform hands-on rodent work (mouse and rat): handling, dosing, tissue collection, and disease model support.
