jobs.title: Life Sciences Data Management, Lead (MDM/DGov)
jobs.description:
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a visionary and results-oriented professional to help lead our Life Sciences Commercial Operations practice, specializing in trusted customer data and cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions for commercial operations (specializing in Customer MDM data structures (Reltio, Informatica, etc.), HCP/HCO and affiliation data, CRM (Veeva, Salesforce) data knowledge, IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc.), claims data, specialty pharma data, data governance, data quality, Customer 360, etc.). This strategic role demands a deep understanding of the life sciences industry, combined with expertise in master data management, data governance, and AI to ensure that Dynamic targeting, Segmentation, Call Planning, Brand planning, and Business Intelligence run on accurate, connected, and well-governed customer data. The Manager will be responsible for contributing to our go-to-market strategy, leading client engagements, building high-performing teams, and fostering innovation within the practice.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Data Management Engineer II on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for:

Leading delivery of Customer MDM and Data Governance engagements for Life Sciences / Pharma clients, with emphasis on trusted customer data foundations for Commercial AI, analytics, and digital enablement
Shaping and delivering MDM-enabled commercial use cases across Customer 360, account-based selling, HCP/HCO affiliations, dynamic targeting, segmentation, call planning, brand planning, and sales and marketing optimization
Designing Customer MDM solutions and target-state architecture on platforms such as Reltio and Informatica, mastering HCP, HCO, and affiliation data across CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA, claims, and specialty pharma sources
Guiding the design of match-and-merge rules, survivorship rules, data quality rules, and data stewardship workflows
Advising clients on data governance operating models, including ownership, standards, quality metrics, and issue management, along with roadmap sequencing and adoption considerations
Working across strategy, product, data, engineering, and client stakeholder groups to define solution approach and delivery plans
Leading engagement planning, staffing, and team mobilization for MDM and data governance initiatives; managing budgets, timelines, quality, and engagement risk
Defining deliverable structure and content for assigned workstreams
Managing day-to-day interactions with client leads and senior stakeholders and facilitating buy-in for proposed solutions
Supporting business development, including pursuit support, proposal development, solution materials, and pricing input
Coaching and developing practitioners through counseling, staffing input, recruitment, and delivery team leadership
Leading workshops, executive presentations, and stakeholder sessions
Contributing to practice, offering, and go-to-market development

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively

Qualifications

Required:

6+ years of relevant professional experience, including 4+ years in Life Sciences commercial operations with a proven track record of success delivering Customer MDM, data governance, and data solutions for pharma or biotech clients
4+ years of hands-on experience implementing Customer MDM on Reltio, Informatica, or a comparable platform, including HCP/HCO data models, affiliations, hierarchies, match-and-merge, and survivorship
4+ years of hands-on experience with Life Sciences commercial data, such as CRM (Veeva, Salesforce), IQVIA data structures (TRx, NRx, DDD, etc), claims data, and specialty pharma data
4+ years of professional Life Sciences consulting experience driving commercial transformation and innovation for clients, to include MDM, data governance, and AI in areas such as customer engagement, field force excellence and operations, Customer 360, and Sales & Marketing
2+ years of experience designing and implementing data governance frameworks, including data stewardship, data quality, and metadata management
2+ years of experience prioritizing MDM and data governance use cases, developing delivery roadmaps, and planning resources to ensure accelerated project delivery
2+ years experience leading and managing complex projects, budgets, and teams, including delivery teams across multiple locations
Bachelor's Degree
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Experience with Veeva Network / OpenData or IQVIA reference data sources, and exposure to AI-assisted data matching and stewardship
Experience with regulatory and compliance considerations in life sciences data privacy and security
Reltio or Informatica certifications
Experience understanding and communicating client strategic business drivers and operational process requirements, then linking specific business requirements to AI & Data capabilities
Experience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessions
Experience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Research Manager - Deloitte Center for Health Solutions
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about shaping the future of life sciences and health care?

Deloitte's Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is seeking an established professional who accelerates the Center's ability to sense sector and industry trends, develop business relevant research, and activate market-shaping insights-ensuring the right content reaches the right business leader at the right time to drive client and market conversations. The focus will be on market and business issues that impact the life sciences sector, particularly biopharma and medical technology organizations.

The individual in this role will have accountability for turning research strategy into scalable, high-impact insights that influence executive decision-making, inform client strategy, and accelerate Deloitte's growth in the business. The role combines thought leadership excellence, operational rigor, and commercial acumen to ensure the Center's work is relevant, differentiated, and impactful. This role is designed for a leader who can bridge research and business, inspire teams, and influence senior stakeholders across Deloitte and the broader life sciences and health care ecosystem.

As a Research Manager at Deloitte, you will:

Shape market-moving insights that guide and inspire curiosity among life science executives
Engage with top decision makers in industry and the market
Lead, manage and mentor the next generation of research leaders
Identify and lead the implementation of innovation, collaboration, and activities that create value for our business and help our practitioners scale insight driven client conversations.

This is a rare opportunity to lead with purpose, collaborating with incredible professionals across our firm, thinking boldly, growing the impact of our business, and delivering insights that inspire action and improve health for millions across our nation and the world.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

About Deloitte's Center For Health Solutions

Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte's trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care. Our mission is to turn evidence into influence
-delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.

The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership. As part of Deloitte's Research & Insights organization within the Growth and Purpose function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients - and the world - make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

What You will Do: As a Research Manager of the Center for Health Solutions, you will:

Lead Market-Making Research

Engage with senior Deloitte leaders from across the firm to define and lead the research agenda for the Life Sciences Sector (prioritizing issues facing biopharma and medtech organizations) ensuring alignment with Deloitte's strategic priorities and emerging industry challenges. Relevant topics include, but are not limited to, strategic choices, Research & development, innovation, artificial intelligence, finance, workforce, supply chain, commercial launch and market issues, cyber risk, governance, transformation, financing, operations, digital health, models of care, M&A, and the future of the life sciences sector. At times, the issues will integrate and interface with the health care sector, so we need to also consider times when the business benefits from industry level insight development.
Design and oversee large-scale, multi-method research studies (e.g., surveys, public data analysis, proprietary data analysis, econometric modeling, AI-enabled analytics, structured interviews, among others).
Advance innovative methodologies, integrating innovative tools, rigor, and diverse data sources to generate unique insights. Develop and promote new research methodologies via generative AI tools to increase quality, variety, and quantity.
Cultivate collaborations with business leaders, academic institutions, industry partners, and global thought leaders to expand the Center's research reach and impact.
Maintain Deloitte's reputation for intellectual integrity, quality, and independence.

Shape Thought Leadership

Serve as a visible thought leader within Deloitte and the broader LSHC community.
Publish research, deliver client, account team and market presentations and engage with media and other key stakeholders to elevate Deloitte's brand.
Translate complex findings into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with executive audiences and drive market impact.
Position research as a catalyst for client conversations, policy dialogue, and strategic decision-making.
Identify and communicate key industry trends and their implications to our clients and our business.

Inspire Teams & Drive Excellence

Lead and mentor a team of researchers, analysts, and strategists - cultivating excellence, innovation, and professional growth.
Build an environment that values intellectual rigor, collaboration, curiosity, and inclusion oriented in using data, AI, and technology.
Serve as a mentor and role model, helping emerging researchers grow into visible thought leaders.
Manage project delivery and quality, ensuring research meets Deloitte's high standards and deadlines.
Set clear expectations, provide feedback, and model leadership behaviors aligned with Deloitte's purpose and values.
Own sector workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and performance management to scale reliable development, delivery, operations, and execution.
Help implement the principles of our business unit thought leadership transformation

Engage with Clients & the Market

Partner with Deloitte industry and sector leaders to translate insights into solutions that can solve real-world client problems.
Engage with C-suite executives, policymakers, and global leaders to present findings, test hypotheses, and influence decisions.
Identify emerging issues and white-space opportunities to guide new research and strengthen Deloitte's position in key markets.
Support clients and account teams by identifying and supporting sector and related account needs as appropriate.

Drive Activation, Distribution, and Commercial Enablement

Partner with Industry, Sector, and Account leaders to position research as a growth catalyst, enabling differentiated client value propositions.
Help support and enhance an always-on distribution system (segmented audiences, executive moments that matter, enablement packaging, and digital/multimedia assets) so business leaders receive relevant and timely insights when they can act.
Serve as an internal ambassador for the distribution model - guiding integrated publishing, narrative consistency, and optimization practices.
Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, Communications, and PR teams to amplify reach, relevance, and impact.
Deliver on impact metrics (reach, engagement, influence on pipeline, client adoption) to demonstrate return on insight investment.
Modernize research workflows using emerging approaches (including analytics, automation, and responsible artificial intelligence (AI) where appropriate).
Improve speed-to-insight through rapid-cycle research and publishing models-without sacrificing quality or independence.

Basic Qualifications

Master's degree required in health administration, public health, economics, epidemiology, health policy, business, or related field.
Minimum of 8 years of professional experience with increasing leadership responsibility in research, thought leadership, or strategy roles.
Expertise in the LSHC industry, with proven ability to connect research to business and policy real world implications.
Strong analytical, research, and project management skills; expertise in large, complex data sets, industry data, public data and use of statistical methods (R, Python, Stata).
Experience using LLMs and similar AI tools to facilitate deeper research and develop new analytic approaches.
Demonstrated excellence in writing and communicating for executive audiences.
Ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights and a compelling narrative
Proven record of leading, developing and inspiring high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management and ability to build consensus in complex, matrixed environments
Experience in the professional services environment and comfort in operating in a matrixed organization
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Qualifications

Doctorate in business administration, AI, public health, medicine, economics, sciences, health policy, sociology, or related field
Record of creativity, resilience, and adaptability in ambiguous situations.
Strong stakeholder management and ability to build consensus in complex, matrixed environments.
Record of high performance; consultative and strategic mindset; ability to navigate ambiguous circumstances and complex structures.

We are looking for two Research Associates in biology to join our core onsite team and run the key experiments that move the needle on human aging. You will work hands-on with cell cultures, molecular biology, and chemical biology workflows that feed our drug discovery pipeline, and you will see your data shape real decisions about real drug programs.

Execute key experiments involving cell cultures and drug development
Design follow-up experiments and troubleshoot results with creativity and rigor
Maintain cell lines, reagent stocks, and day-to-day lab operations for assigned projects
Analyze and organize experimental data and maintain thorough lab notebook documentation
Communicate scientific results clearly to the team and to leadership

You're a good fit if you have

A B.A. or B.S. degree in bioengineering, biology, chemistry, or a related field
Hands-on experience working with cell cultures and chemicals in a research laboratory
Demonstrated enthusiasm for cellular and molecular biology or bioengineering
Excellent execution of planned experiments, and creativity to plan new ones
The ability to learn and adapt quickly as part of a small team
Willingness to work hard in service of moving the needle on human aging

Bonus points for

Experience with chemical biology and drug discovery
Experience with high-throughput chemical screening, including the handling of 96-, 384-, or 1536-well plates
Mouse handling experience
Experience with computational biology
Interest in the business of biotech, especially therapeutics and drug discovery

We respect personal time and give people room to do their best work within a collaborative team.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Microfluidics & Cell Culture
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is hiring a **Research Associate, Microfluidics & Cell Culture** within the Molecular Foundry division. This position will support the development of a vascularized lung-on-a-chip platform. The position combines microfluidic device fabrication, mammalian cell culture, fluorescence imaging, and biological assays in a collaborative scientific research environment. Working under supervisory guidance, the selected candidate will contribute to experimental reliability and reproducibility while gaining experience with specialized technologies that connect bioengineering, microfabrication, and cell biology.

**You will:**

* **Microfluidic Device Fabrication:** Fabricate, assemble, and refine microfluidic devices using techniques such as PDMS soft lithography, surface treatment, and device bonding. Prepare and maintain the materials and equipment needed for fabrication, monitor experimental conditions, and communicate technical issues or unexpected results to the supervising researcher.
* **Mammalian Cell Culture:** Culture and maintain mammalian cell lines and primary cells, including seeding and maintaining cells within microfluidic devices using perfusion and flow-based culture techniques. Prepare and sterilize culture materials and reagents, monitor cell health and experimental conditions, and identify deviations from established protocols.
* **Fluorescence Imaging and Analysis:** Perform fluorescence and live-cell imaging, including sample preparation, image acquisition, and analysis. Organize, label, and analyze imaging data to support accurate interpretation, consistency, and traceability of experimental results.
* **Biological Assays:** Conduct routine biological assays, including cell viability and cytotoxicity testing, immunofluorescence, ELISA, and protein analysis. Prepare necessary reagents and materials, follow established protocols, and assist with data collection, organization, and analysis to ensure reliable and reproducible results.
* **Laboratory Operations and Collaboration:** Participate in research group meetings, maintain accurate and detailed laboratory notebooks and experimental records, and assist with maintaining laboratory equipment, supplies, and safe laboratory practices. Document experimental observations, communicate unexpected results or technical concerns to supervising researchers, and support consistent and reproducible laboratory procedures.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent knowledge/training, in Biology, Bioengineering, Neuroscience, or a related field and a minimum of 1 year of related laboratory experience.
* Basic knowledge of mammalian cell culture, including aseptic technique, passaging, cryopreservation, and transfection.
* Familiarity with fluorescence microscopy, including sample preparation, image acquisition, and basic image analysis.
* Familiarity performing standard biological assays and analyzing experimental data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google applications.
* Strong oral and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative research environment.
* Ability to follow detailed experimental protocols, maintain aseptic conditions, and consistently document laboratory procedures and results.

Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  
  
To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

ULAR (University Laboratory Animal Resources) is an AAALAC-accredited animal care program that supports the University of California Irvine's research and teaching missions by providing high quality, humane care for vertebrate laboratory animals, in accordance with State and Federal laws and regulations pertaining to the use of animals in research and teaching.

  
Responsibilities:

The Transgenic Mouse Facility (TMF) seeks a skilled microinjectionist to produce genetically engineered mouse models. Under the supervision of TMF managing director, the core function of the role is pronuclear microinjection of DNA and CRISPR RNP into mouse zygotes, complemented by zygote electroporation, ES cell–blastocyst injection, embryo culture and assessment, and surgical embryo transfer. The incumbent manages the microinjection workflow and schedule, and independently troubleshoots and optimizes parameters for difficult constructs, low-efficiency strains, and novel transgenesis approaches, adapting standard protocols where established methods fall short. The incumbent also serves as the primary technical resource for the facility’s assisted reproductive technology (ART) services, including sperm and embryo cryopreservation, in vitro fertilization (IVF), and reagent quality control, resolving technical and procedural issues with minimal oversight. The role also involves using the scientific literature to establish best practices and effective rederivation methods for strains received from other institutions. Throughout, the incumbent keeps accurate procedure records and strain data sheets, prepares client reports that interpret embryo development and experimental outcomes, and communicates clearly with clients and the supervisor. Additional responsibilities include supporting the TMF husbandry workflow and training staff in microinjection, embryo transfer, and surgical techniques.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist II

* **We Make It Happen**: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
* **We Are Stronger Together**: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

### **The Position:**

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development**

* Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
* Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
* Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
* Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
* Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
* Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

### **Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving**

* Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
* Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
* Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
* Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
* Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

### **Quality & Documentation**

* Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
* Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
* Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

### **Who You Are:**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
* Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
* Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
* Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Do you love science, beauty, and innovation? We’re a global leader in skin care—our products reach over 35 countries worldwide—and our California headquarters is where the magic happens. From concept to creation, our team is passionate about advancing skin care science, and now we’re looking for a motivated **Lab Assistant/Pre-Weigh & Data Entry Clerk** to join our Science Department.

**About DMK**

DMK is an innovative leader in the skin care industry, distributing to over 26 countries worldwide. Our headquarters in Santa Fe Springs, California, is where our products are created, manufactured, and distributed. We are passionate about advancing skin care science and are looking for a motivated R&D Lab Assistant to join our team.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who’s detail-oriented, curious, and excited to learn the ins and outs of the cosmetics industry while working in a fun, collaborative lab environment.

The **Lab Assistant / Pre-Weigh & Data Entry Clerk** accurately weighs, packs and labels raw materials for skincare batches and keeps inventory records correct in our systems. This role is the link between the lab bench and the data: every gram measured must match every number entered. The person also supports chemists and lab staff with day-to-day tasks and keeps the lab clean, organized and audit-ready.

**What You’ll Do**

**Raw material pre-weigh**

* Weigh and dispense raw materials precisely to batch formulas and work orders, using calibrated analytical and bench scales.
* Verify each material's name, item code, lot number and expiration date before weighing.
* Follow good manufacturing practices (GMP) and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to prevent cross-contamination.
* Perform and record daily scale checks; report any scale out of tolerance right away.

**Packing and labeling**

* Pack weighed materials in the correct, clean containers, sealed and protected for transfer or shipment.
* Label every container clearly with material name, item code, lot number, weight, date and initials.
* Stage pre-weighed kits by batch so they are complete and ready for the lab or contract manufacturer.

**Data entry and documentation**

* Enter weights, lot numbers, receipts and usage into the inventory system and batch records accurately and on time.
* Complete weigh sheets, logs and batch paperwork legibly and in line with good documentation practices.
* Cross-check entries against physical counts and paperwork; flag and correct discrepancies promptly.
* Maintain raw material, formula and inventory records in Coptis or other company software.

**Inventory control**

* Receive, log and put away incoming raw materials and lab supplies.
* Rotate stock using first-expired, first-out (FEFO) and first-in, first-out (FIFO) methods.
* Conduct cycle counts and support periodic physical inventories.
* Monitor stock levels and alert the supervisor to low, expiring or quarantined materials.

**Lab support and housekeeping**

* Assist chemists and lab staff as needed, including sample preparation, bench samples and stability sample handling.
* Assist with data entry as needed into Coptis, formulation management system.

**Research Lab Technician in Human Health and Microbiome**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Ismagilov Lab at Caltech is hiring a full-time Research Lab Technician for a 2-year term position. Reporting to Professor Rustem Ismagilov, the successful candidate will contribute to the lab's ambitious projects and collaborations focused on human health. Examples include: discovering within human tissues the bacteria, fungi, and viruses (and corresponding genes and pathways) responsible for health and disease; developing novel diagnostic approaches; investigating the microbial origins of human diseases; developing tools that improve biological AI models by orders of magnitude; and developing closed-loop systems that combine robotics and AI for rapid autonomous experimentation. Additional details about the lab can be found at http://ismagilovlab.caltech.edu/. The selected candidate will receive mentorship and structured training in lab-specific protocols, electronic lab notebooks, biosafety, sample-tracking, qPCR/ddPCR, sequencing-library quality control, liquid-handler automation, and data analysis.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Support graduate students, postdocs, and research staff in their projects. The Technician will be a valued member of project teams and, after training, will take ownership of specific workflows/processes.
* Perform exceptionally high-quality experiments using established protocols; with training, contribute to experimental design and troubleshooting.
* Perform automated DNA and RNA extractions from many different sample types, including clinical samples (e.g., saliva, swabs, urine, blood, biopsies).
* Perform nucleic-acid amplification analyses using standard techniques such as qPCR, ddPCR, RT-qPCR, and RT-ddPCR.
* Assist with Illumina and Nanopore sequencing library preparations for 16S rRNA gene, shotgun metagenomic sequencing, and RNA sequencing.
* Perform crucial sequencing-library quality-control steps.
* Perform basic microbiology techniques such as bacterial culture, making media, and handling glycerol stocks with aseptic techniques.
* Analyze raw data and generate figures.
* Assist with scripting and validating protocols for automated liquid handlers.
* Maintain the lab's excellent standards for biosafety and chemical safety.
* Follow lab procedures for maintaining an accurate, complete, and detailed electronic lab notebook.
* Maintain the organization of lab workspaces and maintain stocks of lab supplies.
* A highly motivated and qualified candidate may additionally develop independent aspects of ongoing projects, while continuing to provide research support to the lab.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in science with an educational emphasis in chemistry, biology, microbiology, or a related field by the start date.
* Strong drive to learn and make a positive impact on the lab and the lab's mission.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and project-management skills.
* Hands-on lab experience (beyond academic coursework) in microbiology, molecular biology, and/or biochemistry, such as undergraduate research, internships, or equivalent experience.
* Highly detail-oriented; must have prior experience performing complex experiments, using standard laboratory techniques, and generating rigorous, reproducible data that others can rely on.
* Demonstrated ability to learn to perform highly technical workflows in a laboratory setting.
* Must be able to use sound judgment to handle a variety of tasks simultaneously and to shift priorities, as well as effectively solve problems.
* Must be able to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment in which multiple active projects are running in parallel.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact professionally and productively with faculty, staff, students, and collaborators.
* Ambition to learn how to do research at an increasingly higher level, including how to design high-quality experiments, interpret results, and answer scientific questions.
* Deep curiosity, reliability, and desire for mentorship/training.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Ambition to undertake rigorous research training before entering medical or graduate school or a similar high-performance, high-impact environment in industry or academia.
* Prior experience working at BSL-2.
* Prior experience performing qPCR and nucleic-acid extractions.
* Prior experience tracking and/or handling large numbers of samples in parallel.
* Prior experience handling and processing 96-sample assays, such as 96-well PCR plates or 96-well screening assays.
* Interest in liquid-handler automation of wet-lab workflows and closed-loop automation systems.
* Co-authorship on a scientific publication or other substantial contribution to a research project.
* Prior experience or undergraduate-level coursework with a basic programming language for data analysis (Python, MATLAB, R).

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume (describe relevant experiences and accomplishments).
* Cover letter with a) an explicit explanation of your alignment with the lab's mission; b) a concise example of how you have ensured accuracy, reproducibility, and careful documentation in your prior research; c) an explanation of the level of technical mastery of your top three experimental skills most relevant to this position.

Overview:

At Sherman Oaks Hospital, our dedicated team of professionals are committed to our core values of quality, compassion, and community. As a member of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, Sherman Oaks Hospital is actively seeking new members to join its award-winning team!  
  
Sherman Oaks Hospital is a 153-bed, not-for-profit, acute-care community hospital located in Sherman Oaks, California. Staffed with over 500 employees and an extraordinary team of physicians, the hospital is recognized for advanced technology and compassionate care and provides 24/7 emergency care in addition to a full range of specialized medical, surgical, and diagnostic services to improve and save lives. Sherman Oaks Hospital has been nationally recognized multiple times as a "100 Top Hospital" by Fortune/Merative, holds an "A" grade in patient safety from The Leapfrog Group, Patient Safety Excellence recognition from Healthgrades, and more. For more information, visit www.shermanoakshospital.org.

  
Responsibilities:

The Laboratory Assistant will follow the guidelines set by CLIA, and the California Business and Professions Code Sections 1212 and 1269. Unlicensed laboratory personnel (“aides”) are limited to pre-analytical and supportive functions only and may not read, record, result, verify, or interpret any laboratory test. They may not perform any test involving the quantitative measurement of specimens or reagents, conduct mathematical calculations related to test results, perform instrument calibration, or monitor or interpret quality control data used to assess test system performance. Unlicensed personnel shall not participate in any phase of testing that involves result generation, interpretation, verification, or reporting.

All duties must be performed under the direct and constant supervision of a physician and surgeon or a licensed laboratory professional, as defined by California regulations.

Unlicensed laboratory personnel may perform approved activities including specimen collection (patient preparation, labeling, handling, processing, preservation, transportation, and storage), assisting licensed personnel, preparing and storing reagents and culture media, assisting with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (without calibration or performance verification), and supporting quality control procedures (without interpretation of results). Specimen collection involving venipuncture or skin puncture may only be performed if the individual holds appropriate California phlebotomy certification (e.g., CPT I or CPT II) or other qualifying license, as required by law.

This individual: 1) Performs computer entry, filing, telephone communication, and other clerical duties. 2) Demonstrates professional telephone etiquette and greets patients and visitors courteously. 3) Possesses effective verbal and written communication skills. 4) Demonstrates knowledge of laboratory test terminology. 5) Demonstrates knowledge of phlebotomy practices; performs venipuncture or skin puncture only if appropriately certified per California law. 6) Processes specimens across laboratory departments including pathology, microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry, and blood bank limited to pre-analytical activities (e.g., specimen handling and centrifugation only in immunohematology). 7) Prepares and processes specimens for reference laboratories. 8) Stocks and orders routine supplies. 9) Maintains cleanliness and organization of storage areas, equipment, centrifuges, and collection sites. 10) Processes and places specimens on laboratory instruments for automated analysis only, without performing test setup, calibration, validation, or result review. 11) With documented training, may assist with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (excluding calibration and performance verification), assist in quality control procedures (without interpreting results), and perform permitted microbiology support tasks such as primary culture inoculation, slide staining, and subculturing. 12) Performs additional duties assigned by department leadership, including clerical support, communication tasks, specimen transport, and interdepartmental deliveries. 13) Assists Pathology with pre-analytical and clerical tasks only, including specimen receipt, accessioning, labeling, transport, and storage, under direct supervision and within regulatory limitations. 14) Functions as a runner to support laboratory workflow and specimen movement as needed.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING**

  

* HS Diploma or equivalent required.
* Active California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I or II license required for individuals performing phlebotomy.
* Current BCLS (AHA) certificate upon hire and maintain current preferred.
* BLS certification within forty-five days of hire and maintained current, according to hospital requirement.
* Minimum of 1 year clinical laboratory experience performing similar job functions preferred.

Pay Transparency:

Sherman Oaks Hospital offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. jobs.title: E11 Bio - Research Associate, In Vivo
jobs.description:
E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards whole brain scale for humans and other mammals. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable mammalian brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight-knit start-up. Read our technology roadmap.

E11 Bio is seeking a Research Associate to run the in vivo work that produces every sample the platform depends on. In collaboration with the team, you will run colony management, viral injections and perfusions, and grow into imaging and histology of downstream work. The role is open to early-career applicants as well as experienced technicians, and level and compensation are set by experience.

### **Responsibilities**

* Execute retro-orbital and stereotaxic viral injections, with post-operative monitoring
* Prepare perfusates and run perfusions to SOP standards, and keep perfusion and surgical setups operational
* Collect and process tissue, including sectioning of the fixed brain, histology and immunostaining, and imaging
* Run colony management and animal supply: breeding, weaning, genotyping workflows, health checks and record keeping
* Support perfusion development: run controlled perturbations and document QC outcomes
* Prepare equipment and supplies for experiments, keep the reagents and consumables for these workflows stocked, and flag supply problems early
* Work to approved animal protocols and comply with federal and institutional IACUC regulations governing animal research
* Keep accurate, reproducible experimental records

### **Outcomes**

#### **In 1 month**

* Completed training in retro-orbital and stereotaxic injections, and running routine surgeries with good survival and recovery
* Performing perfusions under supervision at the team's baseline quality level, with perfusates prepared independently

* Running the colony: health checks, weaning and genotyping workflows on schedule
* Trained on imaging and running it routinely
* Independently producing fixed tissue at baseline quality

### **Required qualifications**

* BS/BA in a STEM field with 0 to 4 years of relevant experience, or an MS, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Experience with rodent handling, restraint and procedures under an approved protocol, and willingness to work with small animals and animal tissue
* Strong lab notebook practice, careful experimental documentation and attention to detail
* Ability to work some weekends as needed, with days off swapped for weekdays

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Hands-on experience performing animal perfusions with PFA or related fixatives for brain tissue applications
* Experience with stereotaxic or retro-orbital viral injections, or clear interest and aptitude to train into them
* Experience with transgenic mouse colony management, including breeding and genotyping workflows
* Experience with histology, brain excision or sectioning, and with acquiring images on a fluorescence microscope, or clear interest in moving into imaging and histology as part of the role
* Mechanical or technical aptitude for maintaining and troubleshooting perfusion rigs and surgical setups

### **And you:**

* Are motivated by moonshot neuroscience and want to work on a high-impact project with a tight-knit team
* Are committed to open science and want to see the work disseminated transparently

### **We offer:**

* An opportunity to help change the world and work with some of the most talented and collaborative experts across scientific fields.

Senior Research Associate – Protein Development

**Location:** San Carlos, CA 94070  
**Duration:** 11-Month Contract  
**Work Environment:** Laboratory-Based

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Research Associate** to join the Vaccine Product Development – Protein Development and Clinical Manufacturing team. This role will focus on protein analysis, analytical assay execution, and process characterization to support cell-free protein synthesis development.

The successful candidate will independently perform complex laboratory studies, primarily using sandwich ELISA and Bradford protein assays to evaluate protein concentration and quality in raw materials and in-process samples. This position requires strong hands-on laboratory expertise, analytical skills, troubleshooting abilities, and excellent documentation practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform sandwich ELISA and Bradford total protein assays on raw material lysates and in-process samples.
* Conduct additional protein analysis using GFP activity assays, Capillary Western (Jess/Leo), and A280/SoloVPE.
* Execute analytical method qualification studies, including accuracy, repeatability, and intermediate precision.
* Support assay method development, qualification, and revision of testing procedures.
* Qualify and manage critical reagents, including antibodies, reference standards, and assay controls.
* Maintain accurate experimental records and reports using electronic laboratory notebooks such as Benchling.
* Troubleshoot instrumentation, assay variability, and analytical results.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Assistant | Hematology/Oncology
jobs.description:
Why Join Us?

Ventura County Hematology Oncology Specialists (VCHOS) was originally founded in 1971 with the goal of providing the highest quality of care for patients with cancer and blood disorders with office locations in the coastal cities of Ventura, Oxnard and Camarillo. Guided by an exceptional team of dedicated physicians, clinical professionals and support staff, VCHOS provides individualized treatment, personalized care and unwavering support to patients and their families. Through its partnership with One Oncology, VCHOS is at the forefront of cancer research. The VCHOS patient centered team inspires resilience and illuminates possibilities for a healthier and more hopeful tomorrow.

**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented, and bilingual (English/Spanish) Clinical Research Assistant to join our growing Hematology/Oncology Clinical Research Program. This is an exciting opportunity to help bring innovative clinical trials and treatment options to patients throughout Ventura County.

Working closely with the Lead Clinical Research Coordinator and research team, this position supports daily clinical trial operations, patient recruitment, study coordination, documentation, and regulatory activities. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, compassionate, and eager to grow within clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Clinical Trial Coordination & Patient Support**

* Assist the Lead Clinical Research Coordinator with daily trial activities across multiple hematology and oncology studies.
* Support patient prescreening, recruitment, and identification of potential study candidates.
* Communicate with patients, physicians, and clinical staff to coordinate research-related activities.
* Assist with scheduling study visits, procedures, laboratory assessments, and protocol-required activities.
* Support Spanish-speaking patients and coordinate appropriate translated study materials.
* Help prepare for patient visits and follow-up activities under the direction of the research team.

**Study Documentation & Regulatory Support**

* Maintain organized research records, including source documentation, study logs, and regulatory files.
* Support data entry, review, and query resolution in electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
* Assist with study documents in accordance with protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulations.
* Support study startup, monitoring visits, and other research activities as needed.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA and institutional policies.

**Laboratory & Research Operations**

* Prepare laboratory kits and research supplies for scheduled study visits.
* Assist with specimen handling, processing coordination, packaging, and shipping under applicable training and protocol requirements.
* Coordinate research shipments, specimen pickups, deliveries, and related logistics.
* Assist with investigational product documentation, supply tracking, and inventory as authorized.
* Support research operations and coordination across clinic locations.

**THE ROLE / QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Qualifications**

* **At least one year of experience working in a clinical research setting.**
* **Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish.**
* Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles and applicable clinical research regulations.
* Experience using electronic medical records (EMR) and clinical research documentation systems.
* Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, patient screening, source documentation, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing responsibilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including compassionate interactions with patients.
* Ability to collaborate with physicians, clinical staff, and research personnel.
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel to other locations as needed for research activities.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Previous experience in hematology or oncology clinical research.

**Work Location & Travel**

This position is based primarily at our **Oxnard** clinic, with travel to our **Ventura and Camarillo** clinics as needed. Travel to other locations may also be required for patient-related activities, specimen collection and pickups, shipping and supply coordination, meetings, and any other study-specific or general clinical research activities. Travel is not limited to the practice clinic locations.

**Professional Growth & Opportunities**

Our research program is actively expanding its portfolio of interventional and observational hematology/oncology trials. This role offers hands-on experience, additional training, and opportunities to take on greater responsibility as the program grows, with potential for future advancement into a Clinical Research Coordinator position.

**Join Our Research Team**

Be part of a growing program working to expand access to clinical trials for patients in Ventura County. We welcome candidates who are enthusiastic about research, committed to high-quality patient care, and excited to grow alongside our team.

The people here at Apple don't just create products. They create the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. From there, you scale across the full Apple platform, from Apple Watch and Health APIs to iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro, and build the partner ecosystem that makes it repeatable.

jobs.description:
Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect Your First Project To Make You The One Who Decides How a Solution's Components Fit Together, And The One Who Carries It Through Production. Depending On The Assignment, You May

For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery.
Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it.
Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs).
Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows.
Make application security standards, code reviews, and test-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead.
Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production.
Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs.
Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources.
Make implementation and review faster with AI-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship.

You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

7+ years of professional hands-on back-end software development experience in Python
5+ years of hands-on front-end software development experience in React.js
Bachelor's degree
A strong practical background developing cloud-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda
An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture
A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems
A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker
An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them
Direct, practical use of AI-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices
Certification in either Python or AWS
Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction

Who You Are

You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new.
Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you.
Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team.
The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs.
Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Carry out tasks in a wet chemical laboratory including building components for battery test cells, building and operating lab equipment, manufacturing small pilot runs of cells, basic electrical wiring, cleaning glassware and materials hardware, and maintaining an organized working environment.

Become a critical member of our fast-growing team working to develop a breakthrough battery technology to change the way batteries are made and used worldwide to enable a greener future. In this position, you will be a critical part of our core team, helping with day-to-day operations and progressing the development and manufacturing of advanced battery cells.

, to join our team in the Bay Park area of San Diego, CA. In this role you will help support personnel on necessary tasks including laboratory including building components for battery test cells, building and operating lab equipment, manufacturing small pilot runs of cells, basic electrical wiring, cleaning glassware and materials hardware, and maintaining an organized working environment. The ideal candidate can work independently following standard operating procedures, is thorough in their tasks, and able to effectively communicate in a dynamic environment. Work will primarily be in a wet lab environment and candidates should be able to comfortably and safely handle a variety of chemicals, tools, and equipment.

Support scientists and engineers with preparation, setup, assembly, testing of various tasks.
Follow written procedures to test and/or assemble components into battery cells.
Operate cell fabrication equipment such as various welders and electrolyte injection equipment.
Prepare electrolyte mixtures for pilot cell fabrication.
Operate basic machining tools such as band saw, drill press, etc.
Operate mechanical test systems for routine testing of new materials and components.
Accurately and comprehensively record data.
Operate laboratory equipment such as gloveboxes, multi-meters, high pressure regulators, etc.
Maintain an organized and functional laboratory workspace with general lab duties such as, but not limited to, stocking laboratory consumables, electrical wiring, cleaning, etc.
Follow protocols for safe handling of materials and chemicals.
Other duties deemed necessary by the company.
Deliver epic High Fives.

REQUIREMENTS

3-7 years of experience working in a laboratory environment.
Familiarity with chemical and hazardous material handling best practices.
Familiarity with basic electrical wiring, soldering.
Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and succeed in an environment with competing demands.
Ability to perform repetitive work according to established procedures.
Basic machining experience (drill press, band saw, sanding)
Ability to lift 35 lbs.
Stand for extended periods of time
Dexterous – able to safely grasp, move, or assemble small objects
Proficiency using Microsoft Office products
An aptitude for learning new things and a keen eye for improving processes

At the time of posting, the expected starting salary range for this role is $56,700 - 83,160 annually. The actual pay depends on multiple individualized factors, including education, job-related knowledge, experience, and skills, which will be assessed during the interview process. The base pay range and package is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Leveraging conventional materials and manufacturing, South 8 Technologies offers a unique solution for a variety of e-mobility, energy storage, and industrial applications.

jobs.title: R&D Technician II-III
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.

The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About The Team

As an R&D Technician, you will be at the forefront of our company’s critical operations in a fast-paced, innovative environment. You will take ownership of prototyping, machining, assembly, testing, and fabrication operations, ensuring attention to detail and proper documentation as we develop next-generation nuclear systems.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Work closely with engineering to fabricate prototypes, build and operate test systems while ensuring adherence to specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols.
Collaborate with engineering to improve designs through rapid iteration to refine manufacturing techniques.
Participate in design reviews, providing input on long term manufacturability, available resources, and design improvements.
Autonomously spec, source, and commission equipment, research new best practices, coordinate resources, and report project status.
Build, lead, and mentor a team of ambitious, quality-focused technicians, fostering a culture of technical excellence, teamwork, and accountability.
Develop and document best practices for machining, fabrication, assembly, and quality inspection.
Identify and resolve technical challenges, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support critical system testing and validation efforts, ensuring products meet performance and reliability requirements. Some of these efforts will require off-site travel.
Train and upskill technicians on new processes, tools, and industry best practices.
Performs other related duties as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment

Basic Qualifications:

5+ years in a high-performance manufacturing or R&D environment with experience in multiple of the following areas: fabrication, machining, welding, pneumatic/hydraulic systems, test processes, test stand development.
Understanding of aerospace-grade production/quality standards and a demonstrated track record of operating in them.
Experience interpreting engineering drawings and technical specifications & processes.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Experience developing complex systems from scratch and the corresponding manufacturing processes
Experience in aerospace, nuclear, defense, or advanced manufacturing industries.
Knowledge of materials science, precision machining, and quality inspection techniques.
Hands-on experience with fluid, gas, or high-voltage systems.
Experience with automation, robotics, and advanced manufacturing techniques.
Background in process optimization and lean manufacturing principles.
Familiarity with PLM, ERP, and manufacturing planning systems.
Strong problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to technical challenges.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build and coordinate a high-performing team.

Additional Requirements:

Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones.
The job may require frequently lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks as needed.

Technician II Pay Range: $31.50 - $38.50

Technician III Pay Range: $41.40 - $50.60

Location

We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.

Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system
Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle
Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”
Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together
Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption

Twist Bioscience is seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist to join our Scientific Computing team supporting R&D across DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions. We are looking for a curious scientist with strong computational skills and sound scientific judgment who enjoys learning new biology and turning open-ended questions into actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities

Develop novel computational methods and algorithms supporting DNA synthesis, sequence analysis, and protein characterization.
Partner with experimental scientists to formulate hypotheses, design experiments, and interpret results that guide product and process development.
Analyze NGS and other experimental datasets to identify biological patterns, understand sources of variability, and investigate unexpected outcomes.
Apply statistical methods, machine learning, and predictive modeling to connect sequence and experimental features with product quality and performance.
Evaluate and validate analytical approaches, including their accuracy, limitations, and applicability across experimental conditions.
Develop reproducible analysis pipelines using Nextflow and other scientific computing tools to support research and method evaluation.

Strong Python programming skills and experience analyzing biological or experimental data.

Experience developing and evaluating computational algorithms, statistical methods, or predictive models.

Job Description

Located in Templeton amongst the oak trees, Adventist Health Twin Cities has been serving northern San Luis Obispo County since 1977. Comprised of a 122-bed acute care facility, our team provides exceptional care in emergency medicine, orthopedics, obstetrics, digestive disorders, wound care, and various medical, surgical and outpatient services. Locals enjoy weekly farmers markets in downtown Templeton, farm-to-fork dining, beautiful landscapes for hiking and biking, and beach days just fifteen minutes away at Cambria and Morro Bay.

Job Summary

Collects blood specimens, as well as receives, handles and processes specimens for Laboratory testing. Receives, sorts and accessions specimens, assigning to appropriate pre-analytic and analytic workflow. Completes computerized tasks related to patient registration and/or test order entry, specimen collection, receiving and processing. Performs basic post-analytic tasks, including distributing reports, storing and/or retrieving specimens. Completes quality-related tasks such as documentation of work, maintaining a clean, stocked and safe work area, and monitoring pending work, as well as escalating priority work. Operates and/or uses basic pre-analytic lab equipment. Adheres to all local/state/federal regulations, codes, policies and procedures to ensure privacy and safety while delivering optimal patient care. This position is represented by SEIU.

Job Requirements

Education and Work Experience:

High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required
Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
Experience in Phlebotomy in acute care environment: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications

Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) license: Required

Facility Specific License/Certifications

Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

Essential Functions

Collects blood specimens for a variety of Laboratory tests using age-appropriate techniques; handles/transports Lab specimens and provides post-phlebotomy care to patients. Receives specimens for testing; assesses specimens upon receipt according to established criteria to determine acceptability and takes action according to protocol including escalating to licensed or certified personnel for direction. Handles and processes a variety of specimen types to prepare them for analysis; adheres to protocols to maintain specimen integrity at all times.
Completes computerized tasks as appropriate for affiliate to ensure complete patient registration and/or test order entry into the lab information system, as well as generation of collection lists and/or labels. Prepares and/or packages specimens for transport to another Adventist Health or outside reference laboratory and may complete computer steps necessary for processing referred specimens.
Maintains an adequate inventory of supplies in work area and/or on phlebotomy cart. Maintains required records by completing basic documentation of pre-analytic and post-analytic work, as well as quality-related tasks. Participates in managing the laboratory workflow by performing duties such as monitoring pending work, escalating priority work, locating specimens, and coordinating specimen recollections.
Verbally communicates released/reported results. Routes, distributes and retransmits released/reported results. Stores and retrieves specimens.
Receives incoming calls for the laboratory and assists the caller as appropriate or transfers these calls to the appropriate laboratory section or person. Communicates with customer to clarify ambiguous, unclear or duplicate test orders.
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
