Company Description

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

Job Description

Versant, an industry-leading news, sports and entertainment media business that provides content through a portfolio of iconic television networks (MS NOW, CNBC, USA Network, Golf Channel, E!, SYFY and Oxygen) and complementary digital assets (Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and SportsEngine), is seeking a Consumer Insights Senior Analyst who is energized by the idea of contributing to the growth of a new company within a fast-paced media landscape.

At Versant, data and consumer insights power how we connect with audiences across entertainment, news, sports, and digital experiences. As a Senior Analyst, Consumer Insights & Analytics, you'll help answer some of our most important business questions by combining consumer research with advanced analytics to uncover meaningful insights that influence strategic decision-making across the organization.

Working within the Consumer Insights team and partnering closely with the broader Data Insights & Strategic Analytics organization, you'll leverage quantitative research, audience data, behavioral analytics, and business intelligence tools to understand consumer behavior, measure brand performance, identify emerging trends, and deliver actionable recommendations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, thrives in a data-driven environment, and can bridge technical analysis with compelling business storytelling.

Collaborate with Consumer Insights colleagues and the broader Data Insights department to support ongoing research needs and custom research studies
Design, execute, and analyze quantitative consumer research, including brand tracking, audience segmentation, competitive benchmarking, market sizing, and custom research initiatives

Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Programming, Strategy, Research, and Data organizations to influence business decisions

Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying analytical thinking to solve business problems
Understanding of quantitative analytical methods such as regression, segmentation, clustering, key drivers, forecasting, price sensitivity, perceptual mapping, and/or other statistical techniques

Experience with SQL and analytical programming languages such as Python or R is a strong plus but not required

jobs.title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

jobs.title: AI Research Assistant — Machine Learning & AI
jobs.description:
About Studyfetch

StudyFetch is the #1 AI-native learning platform globally, transforming how millions of students learn through personalized AI-powered education. We’re growing fast with backing from top-tier investors and a mission that’s redefining the future of education and ethical learning.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Master's student in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field to join our AI research team on a part-time basis.

Our research focuses primarily on the intersection of artificial intelligence and education, including the development and evaluation of AI systems that can improve teaching and learning. You will work directly with researchers and engineers on projects involving machine learning, generative AI, large language models, multimodal AI, educational data, model evaluation, and AI systems.

This is a hands-on research position. You will not simply be assisting with administrative research tasks—you will be expected to read papers, implement ideas, run experiments, analyze results, and contribute to the development of new research directions.

Depending on your interests and experience, your work may include developing and evaluating models, building research datasets, designing benchmarks and evaluation methodologies, reproducing published research, fine-tuning open-source models, analyzing educational data, and investigating novel applications of AI in education.

You will also contribute to the broader research development process, including identifying relevant research opportunities, analyzing RFPs and funding opportunities, and assisting with grant and research proposal development.

What You'll Do

Read and analyze recent research papers in machine learning, AI, and AI in education.
Implement and reproduce methods from recent research.
Design and conduct controlled experiments and ablation studies.
Train, fine-tune, and evaluate machine learning models.
Develop datasets and data-processing pipelines for AI research.
Build and maintain evaluation and benchmarking systems.
Analyze model performance and experimental results.
Investigate new approaches to improving AI capabilities, reliability, and effectiveness in educational settings.
Develop research prototypes in Python and modern ML frameworks.
Analyze educational datasets and student interaction data to identify research opportunities and patterns.
Document experiments, findings, and methodologies.
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to refine research hypotheses.
Contribute to technical reports, research papers, presentations, and potentially open-source projects.
Research and analyze RFPs, grant opportunities, and government or foundation funding programs relevant to AI and education.
Assist with the development of grant proposals, research proposals, technical narratives, and supporting materials.
Help identify research questions and proposed technical approaches that align with funding opportunities.
Track relevant developments in AI research, education technology, and government research priorities.

Areas of Research

Our research primarily focuses on the application and development of AI for education. Projects may span several areas, including:

Large Language Models (LLMs)
Generative AI
Multimodal AI
Computer vision
Natural language processing
AI tutoring and educational agents
Personalized learning
Student modeling and learning analytics
Model training and fine-tuning
Reinforcement learning and post-training
AI evaluation and benchmarking
Synthetic data generation
Representation learning
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Educational datasets and data infrastructure
AI safety, reliability, and evaluation in education

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Depth in one area, strong research fundamentals, and demonstrated ability to learn quickly are more important than breadth.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning.
Strong Python programming skills.
Experience with at least one modern ML framework, preferably PyTorch.
Familiarity with fundamental concepts in neural networks, optimization, and statistical learning.
Ability to read and understand technical research papers.
Experience conducting technical or academic projects involving machine learning.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical concepts.
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a research team.
Genuine interest in the application of AI to education.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLMs, Transformers, multimodal models, computer vision, NLP, reinforcement learning, or generative AI.
Experience fine-tuning or training machine learning models.
Experience working with GPU-based ML environments.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers or similar ML ecosystems.
Experience designing datasets, benchmarks, or model evaluations.
Experience reproducing results from published research.
Research experience through a Master's thesis, research lab, internship, or independent project.
Experience working with educational, student, or learning data.
Experience with AI evaluation, benchmarking, or experimental design.
Publications, preprints, conference submissions, or other demonstrated research output.
Contributions to open-source ML/AI projects.
Familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, or distributed computing.
Experience researching or writing grant proposals, RFP responses, technical proposals, or research funding applications.
Familiarity with federal, state, foundation, or other research funding programs.

What We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in people who are curious, technically rigorous, and excited by the process of discovering something that doesn't already have an obvious answer.

The strongest candidates will be able to demonstrate that they have gone beyond simply completing coursework—for example, by:

Building and training their own models.
Reproducing a research paper.
Conducting an independent ML research project.
Developing a substantial Master's thesis.
Creating an interesting dataset or benchmark.
Investigating why a model succeeds or fails.
Working with real-world educational or student data.
Publishing or presenting research.
Contributing to an open-source ML project.
Writing or contributing to a research proposal or grant application.

You do not need to have published a paper to be successful in this role. We care more about your ability to think scientifically, write good code, design meaningful experiments, communicate clearly, and learn quickly.

We also value candidates who are interested in the broader research process—not just model development—including identifying research opportunities, understanding funding priorities, analyzing RFPs, and helping translate technical ideas into compelling research proposals.

Position Details

Position: Part-Time AI Research Assistant
Focus: Machine Learning & AI for Education
Hours: Approximately 15–25 hours per week
Location: On-site
Schedule: Flexible schedule designed to accommodate graduate coursework and research commitments
Compensation: $35–50/hour, depending on experience and qualifications

This position is designed for a graduate student who wants meaningful, hands-on experience conducting applied AI research in an industry research environment, with opportunities to contribute to research publications, funded research initiatives, datasets, benchmarks, and real-world AI systems.

Aquent is thrilled to partner with a globally recognized technology leader that stands at the forefront of innovation, continuously shaping how millions worldwide interact with technology and digital experiences. This visionary organization is dedicated to pushing boundaries, crafting intuitive products, and delivering unparalleled value to its vast customer base through cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence and data science. By joining forces with Aquent, you will gain access to an extraordinary opportunity to bring innovative concepts to life, from ideation to seamless deployment, and contribute to products that are truly at the leading edge.

We are seeking a visionary professional eager to drive significant business impact by building advanced intelligence products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional analytics experts to refine modeling approaches, manage the full model lifecycle, and serve as a primary technical resource. This is an unparalleled opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, build intelligent agents, and develop sophisticated forecasting models that redefine industry standards.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and productionize machine learning and Generative AI components for critical applications such as media planning, campaign estimation, and intelligence products.
Develop sophisticated forecasting, estimation, and marketing response models, including dynamic budget-allocation recommendations informed by response curves and diminishing-returns analysis.
Construct advanced Generative AI components, including intelligent agents, robust retrieval mechanisms, and sophisticated entity resolution systems, implementing rigorous evaluation frameworks to ensure reliable and consistent LLM output.
Independently manage the full model lifecycle, encompassing initial problem framing, meticulous feature engineering, comprehensive model development, thorough validation, deployment as Python services and automated pipelines, and continuous monitoring with strategic retraining.
Collaborate closely with internal analytics experts to refine modeling approaches and rigorously validate results, ensuring accuracy and business relevance.
Serve as a primary point of contact for ML engineering support during business hours.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in building and deploying machine learning models specifically for marketing use cases, including expertise in time-series forecasting, effort/resource estimation, and advanced media-mix style response curve and diminishing-returns (saturation) modeling.
A strong understanding of core marketing performance concepts such as budget allocation, marginal efficiency, campaign pacing, and incrementality.
Exceptional Python skills, demonstrating proficiency with essential libraries including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, and at least one forecasting or probabilistic modeling library (e.g., Prophet, PyMC, Stan).
A solid grounding in statistics and experimentation principles, including uncertainty quantification, robust backtesting methodologies, and comprehensive model validation techniques.
Hands-on experience building and operating batch ML pipelines, specifically within Apache Airflow, covering intricate scheduling, efficient backfills, data quality checks, and automated retraining processes.
Demonstrated ability to independently own the full model lifecycle, from initial concept to production deployment, including advanced feature engineering, meticulous model versioning, proactive drift monitoring, and effective retraining feedback loops.

Familiarity with various LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., creating golden datasets, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and regression testing).

Find your path and enjoy the journey at Haley & Aldrich.
With us, you’ll tackle clients’ most meaningful challenges in the built and natural environments – and, in turn, build stronger communities. You’ll work with teams of passionate colleagues, driven by a commitment to technical excellence and continuous learning.

As a company, we aim to build a world where communities go beyond resilience, embracing change as an opportunity to enhance safety, well-being, and quality of life. Join us to accelerate this vision and your professional development.

We are looking to add new talent to our growing team! We are seeking an experienced Senior Civil Engineer or Hydrologist 2
who is passionate about solving complex water resources challenges and ready to take ownership of meaningful work. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional who enjoys leading hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, developing practical solutions, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients.

The successful candidate will play a key role in the delivery of floodplain management, stormwater, drainage, watershed, and hydraulic design projects while helping grow and strengthen our water resources practice. As part of a nationwide team, this role offers opportunities to collaborate with leading practitioners across multiple regions and contribute to projects spanning a diverse range of hydrologic, hydraulic, and regulatory settings. Beyond managing projects, this position requires initiative, technical leadership, sound engineering judgment, and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for clients and communities.

We are looking for someone who naturally takes ownership, identifies solutions rather than problems, and is energized by the opportunity to help lead projects from concept through implementation. This position is well suited for an experienced water resources professional who has demonstrated technical excellence and is ready to expand their influence through project leadership, client engagement, and mentorship responsibilities. In return, this role offers the opportunity to influence project direction, mentor developing engineers and hydrologists, collaborate with talented multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to a growing practice with significant opportunities for professional growth and impact.

Duties/Responsibilities

In This Position, You Will

Lead and support hydrologic and hydraulic studies for floodplain management, stormwater, watershed, drainage, and water resources projects.
Develop, perform, and oversee hydrologic and hydraulic modeling using HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, SWMM, and related industry-standard tools.
Prepare, review, and direct technical analyses, engineering reports, calculations, drainage studies, floodplain studies, plans, specifications, and other project deliverables.
Provide technical leadership and engineering judgment for water resources planning, design, permitting, and implementation efforts.
Develop technical scopes of work, budgets, schedules, and cost estimates for water resources and hydrology/hydraulics projects.
Serve as project manager or technical lead for assigned projects, ensuring delivery of high-quality work that meets client objectives, project budgets, schedules, and regulatory requirements.
Build and maintain strong client relationships through responsive communication, technical excellence, and trusted project support.
Lead proposal preparation, project planning, staffing, subcontractor coordination, execution, and financial management activities.
Support business development efforts through client service, proposal preparation, and identification of opportunities to assist clients with emerging needs.
Mentor and support junior engineers and hydrologists through technical guidance, quality reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop practical, resilient, and innovative engineering solutions.
Promote a culture of safety, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Skills/Experience

Minimum Skills and Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
10+ years of related experience.
Professional Engineer (P.E.) registration in at least one state is required; registration in multiple states or the ability to obtain within a short time frame strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading or supporting hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, modeling, and design efforts for public and/or private sector clients.
Demonstrated ability to lead project teams to deliver projects that meet client objectives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and financial acumen.
Proficient computer literacy skills, including the use of AutoCAD Civil 3D, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Project.
Civil and/or environmental engineering experience that spans the entire project lifecycle.
Proven experience preparing technical scopes of work and cost estimate preparation.
Willingness to travel as needed to support clients, projects, and team collaboration.

Preferred Skills

Master’s degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
2+ years of related project management, financial management, or task management experience.
Construction and/or construction management experience with civil and environmental projects.
OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER or MSHA 40-Hour Miner training and refresher updates.
Experience preparing regulatory permit applications and leading multidisciplinary teams on hydrology and hydraulics design projects.

. Actual compensation will be based upon a variety of factors such as education, related work experience, certificates, skills, and current market conditions. . This bonus program is based on overall company performance and the results achieved compared to peers. This role is eligible to receive sign-on bonus.

Haley & Aldrich is committed to solving our clients’ most meaningful challenges in the built and natural environments. Our team of 1,000+ engineers and scientists across the United States draws inspiration from one mission: to work closely with clients as they navigate change to create safer, more robust places to live and work. About Us

California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI) is a non-profit medical research organization dedicated to translational research and medical device innovation across multiple biological systems, including cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, lymphatic, and endocrine systems. We are seeking a motivated Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research Technician to join our research team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Surgical & Interventional Procedure Support

Assist medical doctors, veterinarians, and principal investigators during acute and chronic surgical, interventional, and catheterization procedures on large and small animal models, including pigs, dogs, rabbits, rats, and mice.
Prepare operating rooms, organize surgical trays, and ensure sterile fields and appropriate instrumentation for cardiovascular, GI, lymphatic, and endocrine studies.
Assist in animal positioning, physiological monitoring (ECG, blood pressure, airway dynamics), and anesthesia logging under veterinary oversight.
2. Pre- and Post-Operative Care

Manage pre-procedure preparation, including fasting schedules, pre-medication administration, and surgical site clipping/cleansing.
Monitor animals during post-operative recovery, including vital sign tracking, pain assessment, and administration of prescribed medications/treatments.
Maintain clear and accurate surgical logs, recovery records, and medical progress notes.
3. Daily Animal Care & Husbandry

Perform daily animal husbandry, feeding, health checks, and behavioral observation for research models in compliance with facility standards.
Collect blood, tissue, and biological fluid samples following study protocols and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) principles.
Support animal acclimation, handling, and habituation to minimize stress and ensure study compliance.
4. Technical Support & Laboratory Maintenance

Maintain, clean, sterilize, and inventory surgical tools, anesthesia machines, monitoring equipment, and lab consumables.
Ensure procedure rooms and holding facilities are sanitized and prepared in accordance with institutional guidelines.
Assist with specimen processing, tissue harvesting, and preliminary lab testing/storage.
5. Compliance & Teamwork

Strictly adhere to IACUC protocols, Institutional Safety Guidelines, USDA regulations, and GLP standards.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including scientists, surgeons, veterinarians, and laboratory personnel.
Demonstrate flexibility in adopting new experimental procedures, handling various species, and fulfilling additional operational duties as assigned.
Qualifications & Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Animal Science, Health Sciences, or a related field.
Availability & Schedule: Available for an immediate start. Weekend and holiday work is required.
Experience: Open to recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. Prior hands-on lab or animal care experience is a plus, but comprehensive training will be provided.
Key Traits: Adaptable, eager to learn new technical skills, strong work ethic, and attention to detail.
Physical Demands & Work Environment

Exposure to animal allergens and repetitive motion.
Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift up to 50 lbs individually, and team-lift up to 250 lbs.
Required immunizations/screenings based on species exposure (e.g., Tetanus, Rabies, TB, MMR, Hepatitis B).
Benefits & Growth

San Quentin State Prison (SQ) is California's oldest and best known correctional institution, which was established on the site currently known as Point San Quentin on July of 1852 as an answer to the rampant lawlessness in California at the time. We currently have opportunities at SQ, located in desirable Marin County just across the bay from metropolitan San Francisco. Here, you can take advantage of your new work-life balance and discover the wineries of the Napa Valley, explore the beaches of the north coast, or enjoy the many hiking and biking trails throughout the area. Whether you choose city-living in San Francisco, one of the many family-friendly suburbs in the East Bay, or the laid back lifestyle of Marin and Sonoma Counties, you're sure to find the perfect fit for you and your family.

Vision

We enhance public safety and promote successful community reintegration through education, treatment and active participation in rehabilitative and restorative justice programs.

Mission

To facilitate the successful reintegration of the individuals in our care back to their communities equipped with the tools to be drug-free, healthy, and employable members of society by providing education, treatment, rehabilitative, and restorative justice programs, all in a safe and humane environment.

CDCR and CCHCS are committed to transforming the correctional landscape to create safer, more professional, and more fulfilling environments for our employees, the incarcerated population, and those supervised in our communities. Through systemwide improvements grounded in proven and emerging practices, we aim to strengthen rehabilitation, enhance workplace satisfaction, and support successful reentry into the community through our institutions, parole, and community partnerships. Our shared mission is to promote safety, wellness, and human dignity while fostering positive change for all those who live and work within our institutions and communities.

CDCR and CCHCS are committed to building an inclusive respectful workplace. We are determined to attract and hire candidates from all communities and empower employees from a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and personal experiences. We are proud to foster inclusion and drive collaborative efforts at all levels of the Department.

Across our organization, our programs work cooperatively to provide the highest level of health care possible to a diverse correctional population. We encourage creativity and ingenuity while treating others fairly, honestly, and with respect, all of which are critical to the success of the CDCR and CCHCS mission.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Data Science & Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Data Science & Machine Learning Engineer to build an intelligence layer for global manufacturing. In this hands-on, supplier-facing role, you will integrate factory images, deploy ML models, equipment signals, MES data, test results, and material genealogy into reliable production capabilities.You will deploy machine-vision and machine-learning solutions to enhance inspection, yield, process control, root-cause analysis, and traceability across contract manufacturers and suppliers. This role suits an engineer capable of working across factory floors, Python notebooks, and production data pipelines to deliver practical, robust analytics.

What You Will Do

Build manufacturing data foundations
Architect and integrate end-to-end manufacturing data systems (MES, testers, cloud) across the supplier network to capture accurate production data.
Standardize data models and improve traceability to ensure data integrity from raw components through to final product shipment.
Establish robust data-quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring frameworks to drive reliable operational decision-making.
Develop machine-vision systems for the factory
Identify and implement high-value machine vision and image-based inspection opportunities across factory operations.
Design and deploy end-to-end vision systems, covering hardware specifications (optics, cameras, lighting) and the development of robust classical and deep-learning algorithms.
Establish data-labeling workflows and model validation frameworks to translate vision insights into actionable manufacturing decisions that optimize yield and quality.
Automate manufacturing analysis
Build and deploy automated analysis engines and ML/Vision models to detect process drift, defects, and anomalies directly in the production environment.
Implement automated dashboards and alerts, correlating images with process parameters and test data to accelerate root-cause analysis and prevent yield loss.
Develop reusable analytics libraries and tools to scale data-driven insights across Oura’s manufacturing programs and partner network.
Explore digital-twin and simulation approaches to model manufacturing scenarios, line capacity, and process flows to optimize production before hardware availability.
Drive deployment and strategy
Lead the technical execution of data, machine-vision, and analytics workstreams through all NPI phases, from EVT and DVT to mass production and sustaining.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contract manufacturers, and equipment vendors to define technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and robust deployment/maintenance standards for production systems.
Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities in industrial AI, vision, and connected manufacturing to address production pain points and optimize quality, yield, and cycle time.
Define and communicate the long-term manufacturing intelligence roadmap, establishing reusable data/vision standards and effectively influencing leadership and stakeholders on technical investments.

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

What You'll Bring

5 to 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing software, industrial data science, machine learning, automation, test engineering, supplier development, or an equivalent combination of experience.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, robotics, data science, or a related field.
Experience deploying software, analytics, or machine-learning solutions in a factory, lab, warehouse, or other production environment.
Strong Python programming skills and experience with data-processing and machine-learning libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Experience with computer vision and image-processing techniques, such as OpenCV, image classification, object detection, segmentation, OCR/OCV, anomaly detection, or metrology.
Understanding of MES, manufacturing test systems, equipment interfaces, PLC or industrial-control data, and unit-level traceability concepts.
Experience with statistical methods, design of experiments, process capability, SPC, measurement-system analysis, or manufacturing-quality analysis.
Demonstrated ability to work directly with contract manufacturers, suppliers, equipment vendors, and cross-functional engineering teams.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to manufacturing sites in Asia and other supplier locations.

Nice To Have

Experience integrating cameras, lighting, lenses, barcode readers, robots, PLCs, motion systems, or automated inspection equipment.
Experience with digital manufacturing, discrete-event simulation, digital twins, or factory capacity modeling.
Experience with electronics, battery, precision assembly, SMT, molding, coatings, laser processing, or other high-volume consumer-electronics manufacturing processes.
Strong technical writing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and equity packages
Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
Paid sick leave and parental leave

Partner cross functionally to ensure value commitments are measurable and tracked.

Establish quality standards for analytical deliverables and reporting.

Qualifications & Experience

Strong understanding of contact center, CX, and conversational AI performance metrics.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python, React)
jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect your first project to make you the one who decides how a solution's components fit together, and the one who carries it through production. Depending on the assignment, you may:

For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery
Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it
Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs)
Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows
Make application security standards, code reviews, and test-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead
Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production
Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs
Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources
Make implementation and review faster with AI-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship

You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

7+ years of professional hands-on back-end software development experience in Python
5+ years of hands-on front-end software development experience in React.js
Bachelor's degree
A strong practical background developing cloud-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda
An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture
A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems
A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker
An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them
Direct, practical use of AI-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices
Certification in either Python or AWS
Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction

Who You Are

You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new
Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you
Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team
The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs
Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Associate DevSecOps Engineer (Python, CI/CD)
jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will share in operating the automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and secure cloud infrastructure that keep federal systems running. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect your first project to put you shoulder to shoulder with engineers, on pipelines a team leans on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may:

Contribute to the Terraform or CloudFormation code that defines infrastructure
Under senior engineers' guidance, develop and maintain deployment automation and pipelines
Pitch in on running Docker containers and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, from orchestration to monitoring and logging
Wire vulnerability checks, security scans, and policy controls into the delivery pipeline
Turn repeatable operational tasks into Python scripts, reaching for Bash or PowerShell when those suit better, and close out every finding that comes back
Take a hand in mapping and implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-53 (NIST SP 800-53) controls, and automate the evidence that shows compliance
Bring AI-assisted tools into your pipeline, testing, and scripting work, and verify every output they produce

Code review sees every change you make, and you walk reviewers through the change and your reasons. That is where you learn what makes a change correct, not just that it runs. You automate the team's manual tasks, and you build your share of a practice that designs security in from the start instead of bolting it on later.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

1+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or operations engineering
A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline
Practical use of one or more pipeline tools, grounded in a working knowledge of CI/CD concepts
Ability to write scripts in Python (Bash or PowerShell skills a plus)
Familiarity with Docker and containerization, together with the cloud services AWS offers
Exposure to tools that express infrastructure as code, for example CloudFormation or Terraform
A basic understanding of how containers are orchestrated
Experience with the fundamentals of Linux
Knowledge of web applications and application programming interfaces, together with networking concepts and load balancing
Grounding in the principles of cloud security and in practices for delivering software securely
Skill at tracking down and resolving problems in infrastructure and in deployments
Experience generating and reviewing code with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot
Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

Prior work in information technology for the federal government
Exposure to one or more of these areas: Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800-53 controls, or Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance
An AWS certification or practical experience delivering production workloads on AWS
A background with security tooling or vulnerability scanning, for example dynamic application security testing (DAST), policy-as-code, or static application security testing (SAST)

Who You Are

For you, security and reliability belong in the build from the first commit, never in a final gate, and you are eager to grow into an engineer whose automation replaces other people's manual work and leaves an audit trail. When you hit a wall, you ask rather than guess. Feedback is your fastest way forward, and when priorities move, you move with them. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

A grounding in cloud fundamentals, networking, Linux, scripting, and delivery automation, and an appetite to dig deeper into security
Delivery habits in secure configuration, code review, automated testing, and version control, or a willingness to build them quickly
Clear, plain updates: what you have finished, where you are stuck, and what you need
The care to hold up where accuracy and auditability cannot slip

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding challenge without AI.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Laboratory Technician (80%)

Starting 1 January 2027

How does life emerge from molecules and cells? This is the central question that motivates us. With curiosity and passion, we investigate the entire spectrum ranging from the atom to the organism. The Biozentrum of the University of Basel is one of the world’s leading life sciences institutes. With 32 groups and 500 employees, we are a dynamic and international research community that has spawned many fundamental discoveries in biology and medicine as well as several Nobel Laureates. Become part of our community!

The Bumann Lab at the Biozentrum, University of Basel, is looking for a highly motivated laboratory technician. The position is part of an SNSF Ambizione project led by Dr. Alaa Alhayek.

Your Responsibilities

The successful applicant will work closely with Dr. Alaa Alhayek on an Ambizione project investigating how Staphylococcus aureus crosses intact human skin. The project aims to identify bacterial entry routes and understand how the host contains them.

Your profile

Applicants should have a degree as “Laborant/in” or a Bachelor/Master Degree in Biology or related topics. Previous experience in cell/tissue culture, molecular biology, and microbiology is desired. Experience with human tissue, histology, confocal microscopy, RNA FISH, image analysis or biosafety level 2 work is advantageous but not required.

The role requires flexibility, reliable laboratory work, good organizational skills and the ability to work independently. Applicants should enjoy learning new methods and working in a collaborative research environment. Enthusiasm for infection biology and microscopy is essential.

We offer

The successful applicant will work closely with the Ambizione project leader while being fully integrated into the collaborative and international environment of the Bumann Lab and the Biozentrum. Training will be provided in ex vivo tissue models, microbiological methods, advanced microscopy and quantitative image analysis.

The position is available from 1 January 2027. The initial contract will be for one year.

For more information about the Bumann Lab, please visit: https://www.biozentrum.unibas.ch/research/bumann-projects

For more information about the Ambizione project, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek email: alaa.alhayekunibasch

Application / Contact

Please apply online: https://biped.biozentrum.unibas.ch/apply/labtech_bumannlab

The application should include a brief personal statement, explaining how your qualifications and experience make you a good candidate for this job, together with a full, up-to-date CV and contact details of two references.

We start reviewing applications from 15 October 2026 until the position is filled.

Please note that only online-applications will be accepted. For further information, please contact Dr. Alaa Alhayek (e-mail: alaa.alhayekunibasch)

jobs.description:
Rhombus Power, Inc. delivers AI-powered predictive intelligence in real time for defense and national security organizations worldwide. Our mission-built products— Ambient AI and Guardian— are transforming strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making. By empowering the shift from reactive analysis to proactive, predictive intelligence and decision support, Rhombus Power is providing foresight and freedom of action when it matters most.

Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions to transform global security.

Learn more about Rhombus Power, Inc. and watch a demonstration of Guardian, our AI Platform here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3PxY6su1Q-Q

https://www.youtube.com/@rhombuspower8558/videos

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iby5WVNfQiI

See the following articles to learn more about what we do:

https://www.rhombuspower.com/news-and-media

Location

Washington, D.C.

Job Description

As an Intelligence Analyst at Rhombus Power, you will create impactful intelligence assessments on topics including foreign military activities, information operations, regional conflicts, and country stability to support U.S. and Allied national security decision making. Analysts will fuse Rhombus Power’s unique, AI-derived data with a spectrum of open-source information to create these products.

Our Intelligence Analysts routinely perform thorough research and analysis on global security topics guided by client intelligence needs. The outputs from these efforts are primarily conveyed through intelligence assessments written in accordance with U.S. Intelligence Community standards; however, Analysts also deliver tailored briefings for internal and external audiences on topics in their areas of responsibility.

Candidates must excel at collaborative work and must exhibit strong interpersonal skills, as all team efforts depend on working closely within the intelligence team and with other cross-functional teams. Candidates should be able to provide and receive feedback that enhances overall team outputs and the company’s proprietary AI features.

Successful candidates will be solution-oriented self-starters who are tech savvy, can identify problems and opportunities, and propose solutions in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Flexibility and the ability to multitask and prioritize efforts are crucial due to the pace of global events and the sometimes rapidly evolving needs of our clients.

We are seeking a candidate with subject matter expertise on the Russian military, preferably with experience in a U.S. military or government intelligence role. The ideal candidate will have significant knowledge of Russian military capabilities, hybrid warfare, and information operations with an up-to-date understanding of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and the threat it poses to NATO countries. Candidates must have strong writing skills and be capable of producing a high volume of quality analytic assessments under tight deadlines and with minimal review.

If you do not have experience as an analyst in the U.S. Intelligence Community, a writing sample will be requested as part of your application for this role and is a requirement for consideration. All writing samples must be your own work and ideally will have been produced within the last 3 years. The sample should be between one and three pages in length and assess a geopolitical or international security-related topic.

Responsibilities

Identify impactful intelligence topics based on a detailed understanding of client intelligence needs and missions.
Produce high-quality intelligence assessments that answer our clients most important intelligence questions by following U.S. Intelligence Community intelligence analysis and writing standards.
Utilize Rhombus Power’s AI-informed intelligence capabilities and expert research skills to gather information that serves as the foundation of intelligence products.
Identify information gaps and work with the Model and Data Development team to acquire sources of information to bridge gaps.
Utilize structured analytic techniques to ensure team intelligence products meet the highest standards.
Brief finished intelligence products.
Support enhancement of Rhombus Power intelligence capabilities by providing feedback on existing features and supporting the development of new applications and features.
Serve as a subject matter expert on Russia with a focus on operations in Ukraine and threats to NATO.

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 (five) years’ analytic experience with subject matter expertise related to Russia and its military.
Analytic experience and training with the U.S. Intelligence Community or military are strongly desired.
At minimum, a BA or BS in International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, or a similar social science field. An advanced degree is desired.
Experience writing intelligence products tailored to answering key client intelligence questions.
Experience providing briefings on complex national security and international affairs topics.
Familiarity using and developing qualitative and quantitative analytical methodologies.
Intellectual curiosity and emotional intelligence.
We are seeking candidates who would be eligible for a DoD Secret or Top Secret security clearance. If you currently hold a clearance, please indicate the level and sponsoring agency.
Familiarity with data analysis, statistics, data science, big data manipulation, and coding (Python, etc.) is particularly welcome.

Salary
Range

This position has an estimated base salary range of $75,000/year to $220,000/year. Final salary will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Benefits

Full medical, dental, vision coverage for employee and dependents
401k matching program
PTO and Holidays
Bonus and other incentive programs
Access to mental health program
Access to Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care, Dependent and Commuter

(Rhombus) is a startup located in the heart of Silicon Valley at Stanford Research Park in Palo Alto.  We use cutting-edge cross-disciplinary approaches to solve pressing Big Data and Sensing problems in security, energy, and healthcare. Our advisory board includes two Nobel Laureates and a Draper Prize winner.

jobs.title: CAD Administrator
jobs.description:
About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders.

Why This Role Matters

As a CAD Administrator, you will be the backbone of engineering productivity across our fusion demonstration system. Engineers, designers, scientists, and technicians rely on our CAD ecosystem and PLM integration to rapidly iterate on complex mechanical and electrical assemblies. You will own the configuration, maintenance, optimization, and user support for our CAD tools and standard libraries — centered on PTC Creo and Windchill — ensuring our engineering team operates with maximum speed, accuracy, and efficiency. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of design engineering, IT, and PLM, enabling seamless hardware creation at startup speed.

What You'll Do

Administer, configure, and maintain our CAD software tools (Creo Parametric)
Manage CAD software licensing, user accounts, access permissions, server deployments, and software updates in partnership with IT and PLM Admin
Establish, standardize, and maintain standard CAD libraries, seed files, drawing templates, start parts, and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) component catalogs
Develop, document, and enforce CAD modeling best practices, layer standards, parametric modeling conventions, and drawing standards across the organization
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for design engineers encountering CAD crashes, performance bottlenecks, workspace sync issues, or assembly corruptions
Onboard and train design engineers, technicians, and contractors on company CAD standards, modeling workflows, and Windchill CAD integration
Optimize CAD environment performance, including local vault cache configurations, workstation hardware recommendations, and graphics driver settings
Spearhead the campaign to fully automate drawing creation and initial checking to increase engineering throughput in a phased approach

What You Bring

4+ years of experience in CAD Administration, CAD System Engineering, or CAD/PLM Application Support in a hardware design/manufacturing environment
Deep administrative expertise with major CAD platforms (e.g., PTC Creo Parametric, SolidWorks, Altium) and their system configuration tools
Hands-on experience managing CAD-to-PLM integrations, specifically PTC Windchill CAD Data Management (PDMLink / Workgroup Managers)
Demonstrated experience building and managing CAD part libraries, start parts, design templates, and modeling standards
Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex client-side CAD crashes, file dependencies, and dataset integrity issues
Proactive, "DOer," and self-starter capable of navigating the ambiguity of a first-of-a-kind research project
Excellent communication and customer-service mindset to support and influence cross-functional teams of scientists and engineers

Bonus Points For

Experience with CAD automation, scripting (e.g., Creo Toolkit, Python, VB.net), or macro development to streamline repetitive design tasks
Experience managing CAD/PLM environments in a high-complexity hardware startup or national laboratory environment (e.g., SNL, LANL, LLNL)

Pay Range

$140,000—$180,000 USD

Total Compensation And Benefits For Eligible Employees

💰 Industry-Competitive Salary
🚀 Equity Plan
🏦 6% Employer 401k Matching
🌴 Generous Paid Time Off (including sick leave, vacation, paid family leave)
🩺 Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

Actual base salary offered will be determined by: experience, skills, and work location. This range is for base salary, our total compensation includes equity and benefits. We welcome you to apply even if your expectations are outside our listed range.

Pacific Fusion is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Pacific Fusion is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures and throughout employment. If you need assistance or any accommodation, please let us know.

Curve Biosciences™ | Full Time | On-site - San Mateo, CA

About The Company

Curve Biosciences™ is creating AI-driven insights into biology for the approximately 130 million patients living with chronic disease.

We've created the first molecular blueprint of the human body by manually curating the world's largest collection of comprehensively characterized tissue samples into our Whole-Body Atlas. Our Whole Body Intelligence platform uniquely positions us to deliver precise biological insights that complement existing clinical tools.

Led by a team with decades of biotechnology experience and multiple successful exits, our mission is to equip physicians with better tools to alleviate the burden of chronic disease by anchoring medicine in biological truth.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Research Associate
or Associate Scientist
to execute development and validation studies for Curve’s cell-free DNA NGS assays as we prepare for clinical launch. We are looking for a self-motivated and collaborative candidate with excellent lab technique, meticulous documentation skills & the ability to troubleshoot NGS workflows. The ideal candidate will have experience executing development or validation studies for NGS assays, enjoys working in a fast-paced start-up environment and is looking for a lab-based role.

Key
Responsibilities

In this role you will:
Design and execute hands-on laboratory experiments supporting the clinical development and validation of NGS and protein assays. 
Collaborate with automation engineers to test, troubleshoot and operationalize automated workflows.
Develop reagent manufacturing and QC processes in collaboration with senior scientists.
Draft and review SOPs for reagent manufacturing, reagent QC and assay processes that meet relevant quality and regulatory requirements.
Support manufacturing and QC of reagents to release lots for validation studies.
Execute large scale validation studies (pre-AV, AV and CV) in collaboration with scientists, engineers and clinical lab personnel.
Analyze and interpret QC or other assay data to derive insights and iterate on experiments.
Clearly and proactively communicate QC results, troubleshooting outcomes and process deviations to technical and cross-functional teams.
Record work meticulously to a standard that supports relevant quality and regulatory inspections.
Train and tech transfer assay processes to clinical laboratory personnel.
Independently troubleshoot assay and workflow issues in the lab, and design experiments to resolve them.
Collaborate with lab operations to maintain a functional R&D laboratory.

Required Qualifications

SRA: BS in biology, biochemistry or a related field with 4+ years of biotech industry experience, or an MS with 2+ years.
Associate Scientist: BS with 6+ years or an MS with 4+ years.
Hands-on experience developing or validating NGS workflows, including DNA extraction, quantification, library preparation, hybrid capture and Illumina sequencing preferably at a clinical genomics, diagnostics or liquid biopsy company.
Track record of independently troubleshooting NGS workflow failures (e.g., low yield, low library complexity, poor capture performance, failed run QC) and getting studies back on track.
Experience with liquid handlers or automated extraction platforms, such as the Hamilton STAR, Agilent Bravo or KingFisher.
Precise bench technique, including pipetting and running large sample batches, with careful documentation in an ELN or LIMS.
Clear written and verbal communication of results, deviations and troubleshooting outcomes.
Scientific integrity, initiative and a collaborative approach, with a track record of taking on more responsibility over time.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in R, Python or equivalent tools for data analysis.
Familiarity with cell-free DNA and methylation assay development, such as bisulfite or enzymatic conversion.
Experience optimizing or developing NGS assays outside of standard kit protocols.
Experience in a regulated clinical lab or quality system (e.g., CLIA/CAP, ISO 13485, FDA design controls).
Experience with reagent manufacturing, lot release or QC testing.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Mateo, California. The role requires regular on-site days each week (3-5 days per week) for close in-person collaboration with scientific, engineering, laboratory operations, and leadership teams.
