jobs.title: Research Associate / Associate Scientist, Data Generation
jobs.description:
Research Associate / Associate Scientist, Data Generation

Divergence Labs is hiring a full-time Research Associate / Associate Scientist to run the laboratory data generation work that feeds our machine learning models for antibody and biologics design. We are seeking a capable candidate with a track record of scientific and professional achievement, including but not limited to 1 – 3 years of academic or industry experience in a molecular biology or protein science laboratory. The role is based on-site in San Francisco, CA, and works directly with our Machine Learning and Engineering team.

Divergence Labs is a biotechnology company on a mission to reshape standard of care across all disease areas. Founded in 2025 by an interdisciplinary team of biotechnology investors, drug hunters, hardware engineers, and machine learning scientists, we have assembled a high-performance team that unites investment acumen, world-class protein engineering, advanced computational research, and translational medicine to build repeatable methods for discovering new medicines which transform patient care. Divergence has presence across San Francisco, CA, Minneapolis, MN, New York, NY, and Cambridge, UK. Although we have not publicly disclosed our financing details, Divergence is well capitalized and backed by world-leading investors, each of whom are among the earliest investors in companies such as Isomorphic Labs, Xaira Therapeutics, Coefficient Bio/Anthropic, and Chai Discovery, among others. We are among a select set of biotechnology companies with a strategic relationship with Anthropic.

We are committed to identifying, developing, and rewarding world-class talent, and, as such, all positions at Divergence Labs come with market-leading compensation.

The Role

We are hiring a hands-on Research Associate / Associate Scientist to be the experimental half of our design loop in San Francisco. Our machine learning team designs antibodies computationally; this role turns those designs into physical molecules and measured data, and returns that data to the models that learn from it. The San Francisco group is small and tightly coupled: machine learning scientists, software engineers and hardware engineers working alongside the bench scientists who generate the experimental readouts their models depend on.

You will work day to day at the bench running our data generation pipeline: building designed sequences from synthetic DNA, expressing the encoded proteins, and measuring binding. The quality, consistency and turnaround of what you produce sets the pace for model development and pipeline execution, and the people who use your data one desk away.

This is also a role with room to grow. You will be trained on our core methods, work closely with engineers who are automating them, and have the opportunity to take on greater ownership of assay development, automation and data analysis as the pipeline scales.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a capable, motivated bench scientist who wants to learn fast in a small, integrated team and contribute from day one. Your background should include:

Solid hands-on molecular biology and protein experience
: Confident and independent at the bench with routine molecular biology, protein expression and plate-based assays, executed consistently and on schedule.
A data-minded, reliable working style
: You treat every plate as a dataset someone else will train on: consistent execution, careful controls and records, and problems flagged and troubleshooted.
Curiosity about machine learning and automation
: Keen to work at the interface of the bench and the model, and to grow into greater ownership as the pipeline scales.

Key Responsibilities

Run the data generation pipeline
: Execute our build-and-test workflow end to end, from synthetic DNA through expressed protein to binding measurements, on a regular weekly cadence.
Build designed sequences
: Carry out the molecular biology that turns computational designs into testable constructs: PCR, assembly, pooled and arrayed library handling, and sequence verification.
Express and quantify proteins
: Produce antibody fragments and target antigens in small-scale, plate-based formats, and confirm expression and quality before measurement.
Measure binding at scale
: Run high-throughput binding and kinetics assays (e.g., biolayer interferometry), including instrument setup, controls, and first-pass data review.
Deliver clean, structured data
: Record sample tracking, metadata and results in the formats our machine learning team consumes, and flag failed or ambiguous runs before they reach a model.
Operate and help improve automation
: Run liquid handlers and plate-based instruments, and work with our engineers to raise throughput, reduce cost per datapoint and shorten turnaround.
Troubleshoot and iterate
: Identify the source of failed runs, test fixes, and help refine protocols and SOPs as methods mature.
Keep the lab running
: Prepare reagents, manage consumables and ordering, maintain shared equipment, and coordinate with external vendors where needed.
Embody good lab citizenship
: Maintain lab cleanliness and organization and comply with local SOPs and health-and-safety requirements.

Required Experience

Successful candidates will have a BSc or MSc in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering or a related discipline, plus 1 – 3 years of hands-on laboratory experience in an industry or academic research setting.

The candidate must have:
Practical molecular biology experience: PCR, cloning or DNA assembly, gel electrophoresis, plasmid preparation and sequence verification.
Working experience with protein expression and with plate-based assays in 96- or 384-well format.
Careful, organized documentation habits: accurate record-keeping, sample tracking and comfort working to established SOPs.
Comfort with data: able to organize results in spreadsheets, review them for quality and spot when something looks wrong.
A genuine desire to be in the lab: hands-on, rigorous, and happy for the majority of your time to be at the bench.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, appropriate for a small, integrated team where cross-domain conversation happens daily, and the confidence to ask questions and raise issues early.
Motivation to excel in a fast-moving environment: comfortable with shifting priorities and a weekly experimental cadence.

Additional Experience Welcomed

Not required, but candidates with one or more of the following will be at an advantage:

Experience with binding/kinetics measurement: biolayer interferometry (Octet/Gator), SPR, or similar.
Experience with liquid handlers and laboratory automation (e.g., Opentrons, Hamilton).
Experience with oligo pools, pooled libraries, or cell-free protein expression.
Experience with antibodies, VHHs or other biologics, including small-scale purification and QC.
Familiarity with next-generation sequencing sample preparation.
Basic scripting in Python or R for data handling, or a strong interest in learning.
Experience with electronic lab notebooks and sample or inventory management systems.

Cultural Profile

At Divergence Labs, our culture is built on a foundation of intellectual honesty, independence of thought, and a relentless commitment to excellence. We believe in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute and grow. We are looking for individuals who embody the following characteristics and can fit in with a high-performing team of drug hunters, investors, engineers, and machine learning researchers:

Intellectual Honesty
: We value candid and open discussion. Our team admits when wrong, advocates when right, and never shies away from constructive feedback.
Bias for Action
: We take initiative and ownership of our work, actively seeking out new ideas, and taking well-researched and smart risks.
Team First Attitude
: We win as a team and lose as a team. There are "no egos" at Divergence Labs, and we understand great ideas can come from anywhere.
Independence of Thought
: We think critically and challenge assumptions. When it suits us, we develop hypotheses that may run counter to consensus, "zigging while others are zagging."
Resilience
: Drug development is a tough sport. We persevere in the face of challenge.
Embrace the Unfamiliar
: We are humbled and excited by how much there is left to learn.

Next Steps

Interested candidates can reach out to careers@divergencelabs.com with their resume and two to three sentences expressing their interest.

Divergence Labs is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate V
jobs.description:
Duties

Independently performs complex laboratory studies, analyzes data, troubleshoots methods and supports development activities.

Client is looking for a highly skilled, motivated, and talented contractor to join the Vaccine Product Development organization as a Senior Associate Scientist (contract) within Protein Development and Clinical Manufacturing.

The contractor will play a key role in executing and maintaining the plate-based analytical methods that measure protein concentration and quality for cell-free protein synthesis raw materials and in-process intermediates. The successful candidate will be the primary operator for the lysate ELISA and Bradford assays, support method qualification and critical reagent management, and apply these methods to process characterization studies.

This position is for a scientific role which will be lab based, and will require excellent scientific judgment, independence, precise and consistent data generation and thorough record keeping.

Skills

10+ years laboratory experience

Perform sandwich ELISA (RNA synthetase and RNA polymerase lysates) and Bradford total protein assays on raw material lysates and in-process samples to support process characterization and process development studies.
Perform additional protein analysis as needed, including GFP activity assays, Capillary Western (Jess and Leo), and A280/SoloVPE.
Execute method fit-for-purpose studies (accuracy, repeatability, intermediate precision) and support drafting and revision of test methods.
Qualify and bridge critical reagents (antibodies, reference standards, assay controls) and maintain reagent inventory.
Maintain good documentation practices for recording experimental plans and results in the electronic lab notebook (Benchling) and associated reports.
Assist in troubleshooting of instrumentation, assay variability, and test results.
Participate in group meetings, present results of work, interpret data, and report results in an accurate manner.
Work with lab automation to create high throughput methods leveraging liquid handling and robotic technologies, including automated ELISA on the Tecan EVO.
Work in collaboration with other scientists/SMEs to design experiments, train backup analysts, and advance more powerful analytical techniques.

Education

BS in Biology/Chemistry or related field

BS. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related field with minimum 5 years relevant industry experience; MS with minimum 3 years industry experience in Pharma/Biotech industry required.

Strong technical understanding in analytical chemistry and biochemistry. Hands-on proficiency with plate-based immunoassays (ELISA) and colorimetric protein assays (e.g., Bradford, BCA); experience with HPLC, CE-SDS, or Western blotting is a plus.

Experience with method qualification or validation activities, and accurate data analysis and interpretation of experimental results related to process characterization.

Ability to think critically and demonstrate troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Maintain accurate records of experimental procedures, results and conclusion in compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Team player, proactive and willing to work in a collaborative team environment.

Scientific creativity and curiosity for applying new technologies to complex analytical challenges; experience with liquid-handler programming (Tecan, Biomek) preferred.

Pay range: 70-90/hr DOE

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 29246

About Supermicro

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

Supermicro is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with Sales, Operations, Product Management, and Procurement teams to coordinate forecast meetings, foster cross-team alignment, and support planning initiatives.

Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and deadline management are essential. You will generate reports, analyze trends, and interpret data using tools such as Excel, SQL, and BI dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and thorough validation.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Prepare and deliver monthly reports to support forecasting and business review processes.
Assist in developing and enhancing data management systems to improve forecasting capabilities.
Maintain and update forecasts on a daily and weekly basis to reflect the latest trends and insights.
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales, Project Management, Product Management, and Procurement—to facilitate and support Sales Forecast meetings, ensuring alignment and effective collaboration.
Support system enhancements and changes related to operations and data workflows.
Provide strategic and analytical support to management for organizational planning and decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by applying best practices in data collection, validation, and analysis.
Monitor internal client and team feedback to identify and recommend process improvements.
Champion and uphold the company’s mission, vision, and core values in daily activities.
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Qualifications

SQL Server proficiency and Data modeling — including complex queries, joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, performance tuning, database design, normalization, and schema interpretation.
Microsoft 365 analytics tools: Excel, Power BI and SharePoint/OneDrive.
Data quality and validation — ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and integrity issues.
Basic scripting — Python or R for data manipulation or automation.
Windows environment fluency — file systems, permissions, scheduled tasks, and general troubleshooting.
Analytical & Business Skills — Skilled in translating business questions into measurable insights through KPI development, dashboard reporting, data analysis, and adherence to data governance, security, and compliance best practices.

Required Experience

2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or reporting role.
Hands‑on experience working with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards or similar BI tools.
Demonstrated history of supporting business teams (finance, operations, sales, HR, etc.) with data insights.
Experience working with large datasets, data cleansing, and data validation.
Prior work in environments using Microsoft 365 for collaboration and reporting.

Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have

Experience with SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services).
Familiarity with version control (Git) for SQL scripts or analytics code.
Experience with statistical analysis or forecasting.

Salary Range

$90,000 - $110,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

jobs.description:
Life Sciences Research Expert

Position:
Life Sciences Research Expert

Type:
Contractor

Compensation:
$60–$120 per hour equivalent

Location:
Fully Remote (Worldwide)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking experienced life sciences researchers with strong, hands-on Python skills to contribute to projects focused on evaluating and improving advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will apply your scientific expertise to create, solve, and review challenging research problems across biology, medicine, and related life sciences disciplines. You will use Python to analyze scientific data, develop reproducible solutions, validate computational results, and identify errors in technical reasoning or code.
Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the following areas:
Medicine and Biomedical Science
Computational Biology
Neuroscience
Molecular and Cellular Biology
Biotechnology and Bioinformatics
Genetics and Genomics
Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
Biostatistics and Biological Data Science
Other relevant life sciences disciplines

Key Responsibilities

Create and solve technically rigorous scientific problems within your area of expertise.
Develop reproducible Python-based analyses, models, simulations, and data-processing workflows.
Analyze and interpret scientific datasets using appropriate computational methods.
Review scientific solutions and Python code for correctness, clarity, and completeness.
Validate computational results and identify errors in scientific reasoning, methodology, or implementation.
Apply domain knowledge to assess the quality and reliability of AI-generated scientific outputs.
Provide clear, structured feedback to support the evaluation and improvement of advanced AI systems.

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on Python experience for scientific computing, data analysis, modeling, or simulation.
A solid scientific or applied research background in a relevant life sciences discipline.
Expertise in at least one relevant area, such as biology, medicine, neuroscience, computational biology, or bioinformatics.
Ability to analyze scientific problems, validate results, and evaluate technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD, MD, or master's degree with substantial research experience in a relevant life sciences discipline.
Research experience demonstrated through publications, thesis work, computational projects, industry research, or equivalent accomplishments.
Familiarity with scientific Python tools and libraries, including: NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, Jupyter
Relevant domain-specific scientific libraries
Experience developing reproducible computational workflows or scientific simulations.

We are a stealth mode startup building frontier cybersecurity models to help defend our customers. We’re looking for a researcher to develop the training methods and infrastructure behind them, with a focus on post-training and continual learning from real security work.

You’ll take research ideas from an initial hypothesis to deployed models. That means identifying useful signals in production telemetry, building training datasets, testing new algorithms, and developing evaluations that measure how well our models and agents perform. You’ll own the full experimental cycle, combining research with hands-on LLM training and serving.

As an early member of the team, you’ll work directly with the founders and design partners to decide what we build and how. Your work will shape the technical foundations, product direction, and the way we conduct research as a company.

Experience training large language models.
Proficiency in PyTorch, JAX, or a comparable ML framework, with the engineering skills to turn research ideas into working systems.
Strong experimental judgment: forming testable hypotheses, choosing meaningful measurements, and using results to guide the next experiment.

Evidence of independent technical thinking through research, open-source work, or ambitious personal projects.
A master’s degree or relevant research experience.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern - CSI-Assay Bioinformatics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

2027 Summer Intern - CSI-Assay Bioinformatics

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Department Summary

The CSI-Assay Bioinformatics Department is committed to advancing healthcare and biotechnology through the development of innovative bioinformatics solutions. The department plays a pivotal role in clinical diagnostics and molecular assay development, with a focus on creating cutting-edge tools that make a global impact on patient care. Key responsibilities include designing and implementing software tools and ML/AI algorithms to support molecular clinical assay development. The team works collaboratively with multidisciplinary experts, including bioinformaticians and wet-lab scientists, to deliver state-of-the-art algorithms and tools that drive transformative solutions, advancing biotechnology and enhancing patient outcomes.

This internship position is located in Pleasanton, on-site.

The Opportunity

Software Development and Optimization: Apply software engineering best practices, object-oriented programming, version control, and performance optimization to build scalable, maintainable, and efficient scientific data applications
Interactive Data Visualization: Develop dynamic scientific visualizations, including scatter plots, heatmaps, and comparative charts, to facilitate data exploration, comparative analysis, and interpretation of complex biological datasets
Advanced Data Analytics and Automation: Develop computational tools, statistical workflows, and automated data processing pipelines to analyze experimental datasets, identify trends, and generate actionable scientific insights
Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling: Explore, develop, and evaluate machine learning approaches for pattern recognition, predictive modeling, and data-driven scientific decision-making
AI-Powered Scientific Applications: Explore and integrate large language models (LLMs) and AI-driven tools to enable intelligent database querying, natural-language data exploration, automated analysis, and scientific reporting

Program Highlights

Intensive 12-weeks, full-time (40 hours per week) paid internship
Program start dates are in May/June (Summer)
A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship
Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects
Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry

Required Education

Who You Are (Required)

You meet one of the following criteria :

Must be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree (enrolled student)
Must have attained a Bachelor's Degree (not currently enrolled in a graduate program)
Must be pursuing a Master's Degree (enrolled student)
Must have attained a Master's Degree

Required Majors:
Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.

Required Skills:

Foundational proficiency in Python programming and software development best practices, including modular programming and version control using Git
Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and generative AI concepts, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS), SQL, and database querying (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL)
Experience or foundational knowledge in developing interactive web applications using frameworks such as Streamlit, Dash, React, or similar technologies
Proficiency in frontend web development using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or Next.js

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Qualifications

Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion
Experience with backend development frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django) and integrating frontend applications with REST APIs
Familiarity with DevOps practices, including Bash scripting, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and software deployment workflows
Experience through academic projects, coursework, or internships involving LLM API integration, AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), or open-source and commercial AI models
Knowledge of bioinformatics, molecular biology, or biological experimental data analysis
Familiarity with machine learning concepts and experience developing or applying models for classification, regression, data analysis, or predictive modeling

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $45.00-$52.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role

As a Data Analyst
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting data
to drive business insights and optimize product performance. You will create reports, dashboards, and performance metrics
to help teams make informed decisions and improve user experience.
This role requires a data-driven mindset, strong analytical skills, and experience with visualization tools
to turn complex data into actionable insights.
Responsibilities

Analyze user behavior, product performance, and key business metrics to identify trends and opportunities.
Create and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
Collect, clean, and structure large datasets to ensure accuracy and usability.
Define and track KPIs for marketing, product, and business performance.
Work with SQL, Python, or R to extract, analyze, and manipulate data.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to provide data-driven insights.
Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to improve product features and user engagement.
Identify bottlenecks and opportunities in user journeys and customer funnels.
Present findings in a clear and compelling way to stakeholders and leadership teams.
Stay up to date with industry trends, analytics best practices, and emerging data tools.

Requirements

Around 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio).
Strong analytical skills with experience in Python or R for data analysis.
Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.
Experience with Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar user analytics tools.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).
Familiarity with ETL processes and data pipeline optimization is a plus.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and manage multiple projects.

What benefits are we offering?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus.
Medical Insurance (including vision & dental).
Disability insurance - short and long-term.
401k up to 4% contribution.
Air Conference – an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Transportation budget
Free meals at the hub
Gym membership

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

email address. Additionally, all open positions are published only through our official careers platform, Ashby

Eaton’s IS AER ITD division is currently seeking a Aerospace Design Engineering Specialist - Interconnect Products. This position can be located at either our Camarillo, CA or City of Industry, CA facilities. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.

The Design Engineering Product Specialist serves as a technical expert within the Eaton Interconnect Technologies Division. This individual may focus on internal research and development (e.g. new technology), new product development, sustaining engineering, product manufacturing transitions (e.g. facility transfers), and new business proposals. In this role, you will serve in an advisory role to upper management at Eaton as well as to customers, industry groups, and suppliers. This specific design engineering specialist role will focus on military/commercial electrical wiring system components including connectors, backshells/connector accessories, conduit assemblies, and cable assemblies.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $129000 - $190000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical oversight to teams in the design/analysis/test of electrical wiring interconnect system (EWIS) components used in aerospace, industrial, and military applications, including electrical connectors, backshells, conduits, and cable assemblies.
Drive product line leadership around change management through engineering Change Orders (CO’s), leveraging Eaton’s Product Lifecycle Management system (Enovia).
Review and provide feedback on all engineering deliverables to the product engineering team.
Guide program teams (IPT’s) in effective requirements management at all stages of program/product lifecycle.
Provide direct technical support to customers, suppliers, internal manufacturing engineers, and internal sales and marketing teams.
Provide effective mentorship of junior engineers, and coaches cross-functional teams where appropriate.
Lead, or coach others engaged in, Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations. Determine and lead implementation of corrective actions.
Lead, or coach others engaged in MRB review of discrepant hardware and functional assessment.
Lead team in the application of Aerospace Common Engineering standards (ACES) on all projects within the framework of Eaton’s program management process, PROLaunch. Contribute to continuous improvement of ACES specifications.
Support the assessment of jurisdiction and classification of hardware and technical data in accordance with US Government ITAR and EAR regulations.
Attend and lead activities within industry group committees on interconnect products.

Qualifications

Required (Basic) Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Materials Science, or other related engineering field from an accredited institution.
Minimum of five (5) years of product engineering experience in interconnect product development, analysis, and test (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience leading engineering programs requiring delegation of tasks to, and coaching of, peers or junior engineers.
Experience leading and effectively resolving failure investigations through use of formal problem solving tools such as 8 Disciplines (8D) or RedX. Experience presenting to technical leadership inside and outside of his/her business on these investigations.
Experience leading product qualification programs for mechanical and/or electrical products.
Experience in directing structure, design, and authoring of compliance matrices and test plans/procedures/reports (validation and verification test plans and procedures).

This position requires access to export-controlled information. Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Materials, or Systems Engineering from an accredited institution.
Minimum of ten (10) years experience in aerospace product engineering, and specifically in interconnect technologies and products (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience using Enovia Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) software and Solidworks CAD software.
Experience supporting product launches in Low Cost Country/Best Cost Country (LCC/BCC) locations (ex. Mexico, China, Morocco, Caribbean).
Experience in product launches in US manufacturing locations.
Design for Six Sigma (DFSS/SSDD) and/or Green Belt certification.

Additional Information

Strong knowledge of materials science for metals, polymers, ceramics, and glass and graphite composites used in interconnect products.
Strong knowledge of materials science for conductive/corrosion inhibiting coatings and platings for interconnect products.
Ability to interpret and generate 3D CAD models and drawings in line with ASME Y14.5 geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
Knowledge of CN/CO (engineering Change Order or Change Notification) processes for change management.
Proficiency in Product Data Management or Product Life-Cycle Management (PDM/PLM) systems for document control and workflow management.
Ability to complete basic engineering calculations for sizing and design of mechanical components.
Ability to interpret Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to understand inputs, boundary conditions and failure modes of mechanical components.

Eaton’s IS AER ITD division is currently seeking a Aerospace Design Engineering Specialist - Interconnect Products. This position can be located at either our Camarillo, CA or City of Industry, CA facilities. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.

The Design Engineering Product Specialist serves as a technical expert within the Eaton Interconnect Technologies Division. This individual may focus on internal research and development (e.g. new technology), new product development, sustaining engineering, product manufacturing transitions (e.g. facility transfers), and new business proposals. In this role, you will serve in an advisory role to upper management at Eaton as well as to customers, industry groups, and suppliers. This specific design engineering specialist role will focus on military/commercial electrical wiring system components including connectors, backshells/connector accessories, conduit assemblies, and cable assemblies.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $129000 - $190000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical oversight to teams in the design/analysis/test of electrical wiring interconnect system (EWIS) components used in aerospace, industrial, and military applications, including electrical connectors, backshells, conduits, and cable assemblies.
Drive product line leadership around change management through engineering Change Orders (CO’s), leveraging Eaton’s Product Lifecycle Management system (Enovia).
Review and provide feedback on all engineering deliverables to the product engineering team.
Guide program teams (IPT’s) in effective requirements management at all stages of program/product lifecycle.
Provide direct technical support to customers, suppliers, internal manufacturing engineers, and internal sales and marketing teams.
Provide effective mentorship of junior engineers, and coaches cross-functional teams where appropriate.
Lead, or coach others engaged in, Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations. Determine and lead implementation of corrective actions.
Lead, or coach others engaged in MRB review of discrepant hardware and functional assessment.
Lead team in the application of Aerospace Common Engineering standards (ACES) on all projects within the framework of Eaton’s program management process, PROLaunch. Contribute to continuous improvement of ACES specifications.
Support the assessment of jurisdiction and classification of hardware and technical data in accordance with US Government ITAR and EAR regulations.
Attend and lead activities within industry group committees on interconnect products.

Qualifications

Required (Basic) Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Materials Science, or other related engineering field from an accredited institution.
Minimum of five (5) years of product engineering experience in interconnect product development, analysis, and test (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience leading engineering programs requiring delegation of tasks to, and coaching of, peers or junior engineers.
Experience leading and effectively resolving failure investigations through use of formal problem solving tools such as 8 Disciplines (8D) or RedX. Experience presenting to technical leadership inside and outside of his/her business on these investigations.
Experience leading product qualification programs for mechanical and/or electrical products.
Experience in directing structure, design, and authoring of compliance matrices and test plans/procedures/reports (validation and verification test plans and procedures).

This position requires access to export-controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must be a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Materials, or Systems Engineering from an accredited institution.
Minimum of ten (10) years experience in aerospace product engineering, and specifically in interconnect technologies and products (electrical connectors and associate components, cable harnesses, and conduit assemblies).
Experience using Enovia Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) software and Solidworks CAD software.
Experience supporting product launches in Low Cost Country/Best Cost Country (LCC/BCC) locations (ex. Mexico, China, Morocco, Caribbean).
Experience in product launches in US manufacturing locations.
Design for Six Sigma (DFSS/SSDD) and/or Green Belt certification.

Additional Information

Strong knowledge of materials science for metals, polymers, ceramics, and glass and graphite composites used in interconnect products.
Strong knowledge of materials science for conductive/corrosion inhibiting coatings and platings for interconnect products.
Ability to interpret and generate 3D CAD models and drawings in line with ASME Y14.5 geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
Knowledge of CN/CO (engineering Change Order or Change Notification) processes for change management.
Proficiency in Product Data Management or Product Life-Cycle Management (PDM/PLM) systems for document control and workflow management.
Ability to complete basic engineering calculations for sizing and design of mechanical components.
Ability to interpret Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to understand inputs, boundary conditions and failure modes of mechanical components.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp)
jobs.description:
Overview

The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.

This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.

Responsibilities

Influence product strategy: Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention.
Set the analytics vision: Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue.
Lead experimentation and causal measurement: Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible.
Size and prioritize opportunities: Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment.
Uncover growth opportunities: Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades.
Shape the AI-native roadmap: Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems.
Raise the scientific bar: Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality.
Lead and mentor: Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.

Qualifications

8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact.
Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus.
Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R.
Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making.
Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis.
Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems.
Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI.
Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start.
Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists.
Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.

® . Stout's Transformative Change practice combines data analysis, research, strategy, and operational experience to help clients achieve sustainable change in complex environments. The practice helps clients meet financial objectives, implement strategic initiatives, address compliance requirements, and evaluate impact.

Engagements may focus on designing, implementing, and improving programs, policies, and operational processes for clients, including government entities and nonprofit organizations. We work with nonprofit legal organizations, pro bono counsel, government entities, and court-appointed monitors on matters involving housing, education, disability rights, public benefits, immigration, family and child rights, and related civil rights and system reform issues.

Impact You’ll Make

As a Data Analyst in Stout’s Transformative Change practice, you’ll turn complex structured and unstructured information into clear, accurate analyses and accessible visualizations. Translate complex data into understandable visualizations and client-ready findings.
Support data collection, monitoring, and visualization for collaborative, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
Contribute analytical insights to data-driven strategy planning, financial and fiscal impact assessments, and implementation milestones.

What You’ll Do

Identify, normalize, and analyze large structured and unstructured datasets, including data limitations and quality issues.
Assess relationships among multiple data sources and organize information for effective analysis.
Design and implement database models; download, store, and import raw data; and maintain SQL database tables.
Use business intelligence tools, including Tableau, to build robust visualizations and practical client-facing tools.
Apply complex extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes and SQL querying to prepare and analyze data.
Maintain detailed workpapers documenting assumptions, methodologies, and information sources.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp)
jobs.description:
Overview

The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.

We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.

This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.

Responsibilities

Influence product strategy: Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention.
Set the analytics vision: Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue.
Lead experimentation and causal measurement: Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible.
Size and prioritize opportunities: Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment.
Uncover growth opportunities: Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades.
Shape the AI-native roadmap: Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems.
Raise the scientific bar: Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality.
Lead and mentor: Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.

Qualifications

8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact.
Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus.
Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R.
Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making.
Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis.
Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems.
Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI.
Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start.
Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists.
Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.

Our team partners closely with Intuit's HR leaders, COEs, Finance, and business partners to deliver data-driven insights that shape our people strategies and elevate decision-making across the company.

jobs.description:
Member of Technical Staff — Contract Position Engram Biosciences | San Francisco, CA | On-site
Expecting 9-12 months, with the opportunity to move to full-time. Hours: 8 hours a day, but can flex.
Hourly rate: $26-48 hourly About Engram Biosciences (https://www.engram.co/)

Engram Biosciences is building an autonomous brain organoid platform to improve how neurological diseases are studied and how potential therapies are discovered. Our long-term vision is to dramatically increase success in neurology by generating more informative, reproducible data from human biology.
We combine human iPSC-derived brain models with automation, high-content imaging, electrophysiology, and single-cell and spatial measurements. Consistent, well-characterized brain organoids are central to that work.

About the contract role

We are seeking a hands-on Research Associate for an on-site contract position focused primarily on producing and characterizing 3D human brain organoids, including forebrain and other region-specific models. You will maintain the stem cell cultures that support organoid production, monitor organoids through development, and help improve consistency between batches.
You will also support related neural cell models and assays, working closely with colleagues in biology, imaging, and automation. This is a bench-focused Research Associate role suited to someone with a bachelor’s degree and strong practical experience; a master’s degree is welcome but not required.

What you’ll do

Maintain human iPSCs and neural stem or progenitor cells, including passaging, banking, cryopreservation, and routine quality checks.
Generate and maintain forebrain and other region-specific brain organoids using established differentiation protocols.
Monitor organoid morphology, health, maturation, and variation within and between batches.
Induce and work with glial lineages, such as astrocytes, microglia, or oligodendrocytes, to support neural model development and characterization.
Prepare cultures and organoids for staining, imaging, and other downstream assays.
Document cell lines, organoid batches, culture conditions, deviations, and results clearly; help troubleshoot and refine protocols.
Support 2D neuronal cultures where they contribute to development or evaluation of the 3D models.

What you bring

A bachelor’s degree in neuroscience, stem cell biology, cell biology, bioengineering, or a related field. A master’s degree is also acceptable.
Hands-on experience with human iPSC culture and 3D brain organoid differentiation or maintenance, ideally including forebrain or other region-specific models.
Must have hands-on iPSC cell culture experience; brain organoid experience is ideal.
Experience maintaining neural stem or progenitor cells and strong aseptic technique.
Hands-on glial lineage induction experience with at least one of astrocytes, microglia, or oligodendrocytes.
Careful experimental execution, clear documentation, and the ability to recognize and troubleshoot culture variability.

Additional experience we value

Inhibitory neuron induction; single-cell library preparation using 10x Genomics, Parse Biosciences, or Fluent BioSciences workflows; experience with using high-content imagers like Molcular Device’s ImageXpress; and exposure to laboratory automation.

On-site amenities and contract terms

On-site amenities include delivered lunch, snacks, and complimentary access to a state-of-the-art gym. The contract duration, pay rate, and eligibility for insurance or retirement benefits should be stated once the engagement terms are set.

Responsibilities

Perform functional testing, preventative maintenance, calibration and repair of basic to complex biomedical equipment throughout the hospital and off-site locations in accordance with all agency regulations and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability (HIPPA). Respond to requests for service from users, troubleshoot equipment issues, and perform corrective action as necessary.

Perform preventative maintenance or repair services on specialized equipment based on certifications that may include but not limited to: sterilizers, ventilators, ultrasound, and anesthesia machines. Collaborate with Leaders and vendors to schedule preventative maintenance, repairs and warranty service for specialized equipment and oversee contracted service representatives for quality assurance. Secure authorization for high cost equipment parts and/or repairs.

Maintain documentation in the hospital's Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to align with policies and procedures for the Clinical Engineering program. Track service agreement terms, warranties, recalls and end of life/service and make recommendations for equipment replacement timing or service agreement renewals.

Report and/or make recommendations to Supervisor regarding preventative maintenance procedures and schedules, service agreement terms, operational improvements and incident investigations.

Provide or schedule in-service education for clinical users in the proper operation, safety and routine care of existing clincal engineering equipment. Track trends for user errors and equipment damage to provide in-service education and to report issues and outcomes to the Safety Committee. Provide training to back-up BMET staff as assigned by Supervisor. Track, respond to and communicate details surrounding product recalls.

Provide initial inspection, testing and/or calibration on incoming equipment for installation following manufacturer manuals and applicable policies and procedures utilizing hand tools, power tools or measuring devices. Collaborate with Leaders to provide in-service education to clinical staff and deploy new equipment to the clinical unit.

Purchase or requisition service parts and spares for corrective maintenance or inventory stock replacement. Suggest items for one time or stock purchases. Investigate alternative part sources for cost savings, quality improvement or faster delivery.

Collaborate with Information Services department to ensure HIPPA compliance and connectivity of biomedical devices for new and existing equipment.

Collaborate with Director of Materials Management and other department Leaders on equipment planning and pre-purchase evaluations of new equipment. Perform duties to remove assets from service including: clearing HIPPA data, clean equipment, and coordinate with Director of Materials Management to return equipment to the manufacturer, sell or dispose.

Perform other duties as assigned and provide on-call emergency services as scheduled. Maintain job knowledge and proficiency by participating in continuing education, studying manuals and reading technical publications.

High school diploma required; Associate or Bachelor Degree in Biomedical Engineering preferred, or 3 years requisite industry experience

Experience:
3 years of basic and critical medical equipment service experience required in a healthcare or military setting

Licenses & Certifications:
BMET Program certification required (AAMI certification desired); Manufacturer training in biomedical equipment modalities desired

Required Skills & Knowledge:
Proficiency in analyzing, troubleshooting and resolving equipment repairs, and the proper use of diagnostic tools, test equipment and software is critical. Knowledge of biomedical equipment and maintenance and corrective repair regulatory standards. Possess strong customer service skills to include professional communication and collaborative problem-solving within all levels of the organization and 3rd party vendors. Ability to utilize Microsoft Office products and CMMS software. Exhibit effective time management and ability to manage rapid changing priorities with a positive attitude.

Job Description

Remote Finance subject matter experts needed to train AI; 10 hrs per week recommended starting point, more hours available if desired.

Our client is seeking experienced finance professionals to evaluate how frontier AI models handle real-world finance work, including valuation and modeling, credit analysis, investment memos, FP&A, and treasury and risk decisions.

You will design realistic tasks drawn from your own professional experience. The goal is to create tasks a competent finance professional would complete correctly, but an AI model currently gets wrong.

This is a fully remote, flexible, self-directed role where clear written reasoning matters as much as technical depth.

Responsibilities

Design realistic finance tasks based on your day-to-day work, including the scenario, a prompt written the way you would brief a trusted colleague, and supporting files you author yourself (financial statements, models, data extracts, term sheets, board or IC materials, correspondence).
Run tasks through frontier AI models and evaluate the resulting deliverables against the standard you would hold a colleague to.
Compare two model outputs generated from identical prompts and files, determine which performed better, and document where each fell short.
Write detailed grading rubrics specifying what a correct deliverable must contain, including the right assumptions, calculations, risks flagged, and recommendation, and explain in writing why a response passes or fails each criterion.
Identify and document concrete failures with evidence, such as broken model logic, unsupported assumptions, misread financials, fabricated or ignored source files, unit and scaling errors, missed risks, and misinterpretation of the request.
Contribute across valuation and modeling, credit, FP&A, markets, treasury, and risk, and review and refine tasks built by other experts.

Qualifications

5-7 + years of hands-on experience in corporate or investment finance preferred.
Bachelor's degree (completed or in progress) or higher in finance, economics, business, or a quantitative field.
Depth in at least one of the following areas: equity or fixed income research; portfolio management or trading; corporate finance and FP&A; credit analysis and underwriting; investment banking, M&A, or corporate development; treasury and liquidity; market, credit, or liquidity risk; wealth management; or insurance, actuarial, or underwriting.
Working knowledge of several adjacent areas, enough to understand how those workflows run and to assess work outside your primary specialty.
Ability to build and audit models at a practitioner level, not only consume their outputs.
CFA, CPA, FRM, or securities licenses are welcome but not required

General Requirements

Ability to turn real-world experience into realistic test scenarios.
Full professional or native English fluency, with strong writing skills and the ability to clearly explain why a result is wrong, not just that it is.
Strong attention to detail. You can quickly get oriented in unfamiliar files, verify claims against the underlying numbers, and work independently from incomplete instructions or feedback.
Familiarity with AI tools and the judgment to spot a plausible but incorrect answer.
Comfortable with cloud file tools (e.g., Google Workspace), installing desktop apps, and everyday file handling.
Available at least 10 hours per week and based in the United States, Canada, or the United Kingdom.

Compensation and Benefits

$40-$125 per hour (USD), paid via PayPal on a regular schedule
Fully remote contract position
Flexible hours--you set your own schedule
Access to AI tools provided through the project (no personal subscription required)
Compensation for every completed stage of work
Support through platform instructions, onboarding materials, a dedicated Slack channel, and office hours

Hiring Process

Apply and create an account through the link provided by your recruiter.
Complete a skills assessment (approximately 3-4 hours, unpaid). The assessment evaluates domain fit, careful reading, and your ability to judge AI output against a professional standard. All work must be your own. Submissions produced with AI tools will be rejected, and this is the most common reason candidates do not pass.
Assessment review. If you pass, you'll complete onboarding, begin paid projects in your field, and complete a short training project covering how tasks, files, and rubrics are built.
Propose a task from your professional experience, including the scenario, prompt, files you'll build, and where you expect the model to fail. An expert reviewer will provide written feedback.
Build and run your task. Once your proposal is accepted, you'll build the full task and run it against frontier models. All completed tasks go through expert review, and experienced contributors may be invited to review others' work.

The Research Compliance and Security Data Analyst will report to the Associate Vice Provost for Research Policy and Compliance and will manage technical solutions associated with the Research Compliance and Security requirements. Research Assistant I

Leon Root Motion Analysis Laboratory (LRMALab)

Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Harness & Evaluation: Python, TypeScript & LLM Agents | San Jose, CA (On-site) | Up to $350K + Equity
jobs.description:
"Listen to the technology; find out what it's telling you." - Carver Mead, the Caltech professor who taught a generation of engineers how to design a chip.

Sixty years of silicon progress, and the machines still can't tell us where they hurt. A droid in a film gets to whistle indignantly when something is broken. Real hardware just fails a test at 3am and leaves an engineer scrolling waveforms until sunrise.

That is the gap this role sits in. Our client builds AI agents that work on hardware engineering problems - the design, debug and verification grind that eats the schedule of every chip team on earth. The agents are already in production with paying customers. Your job is to make them genuinely good.

This role is based in San Jose, California, five days on-site. Relocation support is available.

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY BE DOING

Breaking the agents on purpose. Finding the failure modes, then building evaluations that measure performance, reliability and efficiency honestly. Not vibes, and not a demo that works once.

Building new agent capability. Tool interfaces, context management, memory, and multi-step or multi-agent orchestration. The harness itself - the thing that decides whether a clever model becomes a useful product.

Reading traces like an investigator. Digging through experiment results for the real bottleneck, and knowing the difference between a genuine improvement and benchmark noise.

Sitting with customers. Hardware engineers and domain experts will describe what is broken in their own language. You translate, build the fix, and own it end to end.

Turning experiments into software. Research that works in a notebook is a starting point, not a deliverable. You make it maintainable, tested and production grade.

THE SCORECARD

Dealbreakers

Real depth across LLM agents, orchestration, tool interfaces, memory, tracing, ML inference and transformer architectures. Systems you have run at scale, with large data and complicated tooling. Recommender systems, LLM gateways and infrastructure plumbing, side projects and straightforward RAG chatbots are not clearing this bar. Agents have to be the day job.
The ability to sit in front of customers, understand what they actually need, and deliver the technical answer yourself. This is scored as a dealbreaker, not a bonus.

Baseline

8 to 15 years as a software engineer, with serious time on large-scale agent systems. The bar is staff-plus.
Time at a rigorous technology company (think Applied Intuition, Palantir, Tesla) or at a serious AI startup (Fireworks, Harvey, strong Y Combinator companies).
A CS, EE or similar degree from a top university.
Production software engineering in Python and TypeScript. Both, properly.
Self-directed and ambitious, with strong ownership, creativity and product judgement.

Nice to have

Experience or interest in electronic design automation (EDA), semiconductor domains, RTL, or hardware-software systems. Not required, but it is the single clearest differentiator in this pipeline.

What will stop you

US citizens and Green Card holders only. No sponsorship and no visa transfer, so O-1, OPT and H-1B are non-starters.
Under a year in your current role is flagged as a trait to avoid.

COMPENSATION

Base: $250,000 to $350,000, with negotiating room for the right person.
Equity: competitive, on top of base.
Location: San Jose, California, five days on-site, relocation support available.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here, or email keiran@bigwavedigital.com.au with a short note on an agent system you have shipped to production: what you owned across tools, memory and orchestration, and how you knew it was actually working.

If you are close but not an exact match on the scorecard, apply anyway and tell me where you think the gap is.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Amazon has been serving customers since 1995, continually working to make shopping and delivery more convenient, reliable, and seamless. Teams across the company collaborate to improve operations and deliver for customers. At Amazon fulfillment centers, safety is a shared responsibility. Employees follow site safety requirements, wear reflective vests, and have access to hearing protection. The work environment is casual while meeting safety standards; noise and temperatures may vary.

About The Role

Amazon.com Services LLC is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) department at its Hollister, California location. This role partners with ICQA and Inbound and Outbound operations teams to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, investigate defects, and help maintain compliance with ICQA-related SOX requirements. The analyst will turn operational data into clear, actionable insights that support root cause identification and process improvement. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, and a focus on measurable business impact.

The schedule is Monday through Friday, DE0T0900. The role may also require flexibility to work weekends, nights, holidays, or overtime based on business needs.

Qualifications

Applicants must have a high school diploma or equivalent, be at least 18 years old, and be authorized to work in the United States. Candidates need at least one year of experience with computers and Microsoft Office, including Excel skills such as VLOOKUPs and pivot tables. Experience writing VBA and using Excel macros is required, as is expertise in SQL, Tableau, and Python. Applicants should also demonstrate experience extracting and analyzing data to identify root causes and support process improvement across a network. One or more years of Microsoft Office experience is required; two or more years is preferred. A data analytics certificate, relevant training, or equivalent experience is preferred.

This position involves the physical demands of fulfillment center work. Employees may need to lift up to 49 pounds, stand or walk for shifts of up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, with or without reasonable accommodation. Work may involve secure mezzanines up to 40 feet high or powered equipment. Candidates must be able to work 40 hours per week and additional overtime as required.

Responsibilities

Develop data collection processes and data management systems, and maintain data integrity with a target of zero errors. Design queries, compile information, and create reports using Microsoft Access and Excel. Chart and graph data for reporting, conduct in-depth research into defect trends, and perform data collection, entry, mining, and problem solving as needed. Present findings in clear, standardized reports that are accessible to operational stakeholders. Help leadership interpret data trends and use insights to guide decisions and process improvements. Respond to priority requests from senior leadership and provide backup support for ICQA Process Assistant duties.

Relocation assistance is not provided.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in data and technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Lead** **AI and Data Science Engineer II** **- Marketing Measurement,** you will have the opportunity to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.  
  
**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  
  
As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer, you will provide technical and analytical leadership for marketing measurement initiatives. You will guide teams in designing rigorous measurement approaches, turning findings into investment recommendations, and improving the quality and consistency of analytics delivery.  

* Lead the design and evaluation of experimental and quasi-experimental analyses to measure marketing effectiveness and incremental impact.
* Set measurement approaches for geo-based test-and-control studies, paid media, and platform ecosystems such as Google and YouTube.
* Guide the application of causal inference, incrementality measurement, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and A/B testing.
* Translate measurement results into clear recommendations on marketing strategy and investment allocation.
* Establish and promote standards for data validation, analytical quality, documentation, and communicating assumptions and limitations.
* Review analytical work and provide technical direction, coaching, and feedback to team members.
* Lead client workstreams, coordinate across business and technical teams, and manage priorities and delivery risks.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, business-friendly language; escalate material issues to engagement management.
* Identify opportunities to improve measurement processes, workflows, and outcomes.
* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management
* Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines

**The Team**  
  
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, AI, networks, and cloud infrastructure. AI & Data teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms while delivering scalable, high-value outcomes tailored to their business needs.

* Strong experience with MMM, causal inference, incrementality measurement, geo-based test-and-control design, experiment design, and A/B testing.

* Proven ability to guide teams and communicate recommendations to senior business and technical stakeholders.
