jobs.title: Robotics Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Location: San Francisco, California — on-site**

**About Artificial Analysis**
-----------------------------

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers, and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI; they are actively shaping the frontier.

Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times, and The Economist.

We are a team of 50+, on track to double by year end, backed by Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Andrew Ng, Adam D’Angelo, Clem Delangue, and other industry leaders.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The physical world is where the next generation of AI models will compete. We’re developing our robotics benchmarks to set the industry’s reference point: testing how AI models perform on physical robots and in simulation, and building the analysis that helps the industry understand them.

As a Robotics Research Assistant, you’ll work closely with our robotics researchers and engineers to run benchmarks and keep our robots built, calibrated, tested, and running. You’ll help build and maintain hardware, run our task suite, and set up new simulation environments as we add them.

This is a hands-on lab and benchmark-operations role. It suits a recent graduate or early-career candidate with substantial practical hardware experience who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and carefully running experiments. Expect to spend much of the day setting up, resetting, and monitoring trials.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Build and maintain an evolving suite of hardware.** Power, wire, and health-check hardware so each station is ready to run. Work efficiently to understand unfamiliar hardware and incorporate it into our fleet.
* **Run the task suite and read the results.** Set up task scenes, run startup and shutdown checks, and monitor trials on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Protect result quality.** Check that recordings and logs are complete and linked to the right task, model, and configuration. Record interventions and distinguish model failures from equipment, setup, or simulation faults.
* **Maintain the hardware.** Assemble hardware, route cables, mount fixtures and cameras, calibrate equipment, manage spare parts, and make the small mechanical fixes that keep a fleet running.
* **Keep the lab ready.** Carry out routine checks and maintenance, organize tools and spares, and follow lab safety procedures.
* **Improve how the lab runs.** Keep operating instructions current, flag recurring problems, and, where your skills allow, contribute fixtures, 3D-printed parts, or scripts.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or early-career background in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, with substantial hands-on hardware experience from labs, projects, internships, or similar practical work. We do not require two years of professional experience for this posting.
* Evidence that you have built, operated, maintained, or troubleshot robots, lab equipment, or electromechanical systems yourself.
* Practical troubleshooting: you can investigate a fault, test likely causes with appropriate tools, and explain what you learned.
* Careful execution of multi-step procedures, with strong attention to detail and reliable records.
* The ability to develop toward independently running a full day of trials after training, resolving routine problems, and recognizing when to ask for help.
* Clear communication and teamwork with researchers and engineers.
* Confidence picking up unfamiliar tools and software workflows.
* 3D printing experience, including through university or personal projects.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* ROS 2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or another simulator you’ve debugged rather than just launched.
* Experience running benchmark or test campaigns where the count and ordering of trials matter.

**Growing With Us**
-------------------

Recent graduates are welcome to apply. We are a small, growing team working on one of the most interesting problems in AI. You do not need to tick every box. If you are curious and keen to learn, we will support you to develop your practical skills and take on more responsibility.

**Why Artificial Analysis?**
----------------------------

* **Shape how AI gets built.** Leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will help the industry understand how AI performs in the physical world.
* **Build expertise in frontier AI and robotics.** Work closely with researchers and engineers evaluating AI models on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Join at a defining moment.** We’re 50+ people, on track to double by year end, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, team, and strategy as we scale.
* Competitive compensation.

jobs.description:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Emerging ML is the data science and machine learning team inside Capital One’s Applied Research organization. We focus on research and development of new technologies within the domain of Artificial Intelligence with a focus on Embeddings and Foundation Models. We partner closely with our product and engineering teams to connect emerging technologies with business critical use cases across Capital One’s lines of business.

As part of Emerging ML, you will work on things like:

Conducting research into self supervised learning, transformer models, and representation learning
Building customer behavioral models (using transaction, clickstream, and other data) that identify trends, patterns, and relationships related to product usage
Refining integration patterns for encoder and decoder models for downstream use cases to connect Applied Research products and business use cases

Role Description

This is an individual contributor position. In Emerging ML, you will work at all phases of the data science lifecycle, including:

Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation and validation, and partner with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 50+ million customers.
Partner closely with a variety of business and product teams across Capital One to conduct the experiments that guide improvements to customer experiences and business outcomes in domains like marketing, servicing and fraud prevention.
Write software (Python, Scala, e.g.) to collect, explore, visualize and analyze numerical and textual data (billions of customer transactions, clicks, payments, etc.) using tools like Spark and AWS.

The Ideal candidate will be:

Curious and creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions, and you love pushing hard to find the answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences.
Technical: You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions from concept to production using open source tools and modern cloud computing platforms. You are not afraid of petabytes of data.
Statistically-minded. You have built models, validated them and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series analysis and deep learning.
Customer and product oriented. You share our passion for changing banking for good.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics

At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning
At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

jobs.title: Senior CAD Designer
jobs.description:
**What we're building**
-----------------------

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.  
  
Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We're now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we're extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

As Arc's Senior CAD Designer, you will own the CAD backbone of our vessels: the models, the drawing packages, and the standards the rest of Engineering builds against. You'll be our resident NX and Teamcenter expert, creating production-intent CAD across disciplines, releasing drawing packages a vendor can quote without a phone call, and aligning every engineering team on the same best practices and source of truth.

We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Creating production-intent CAD in NX across disciplines including solid and surface modeling, sheet metal, assembly & mechanisms, weldments, piping and plumbing routing for hull and deck structures, mechanical systems, and powertrain interfaces.
* Checking drawings and leading workflows to release designs across Engineering
* Owning large assemblies, the boat-level eBOM, and mass properties, with a clean, scalable assembly architecture and configuration structure
* Releasing fully dimensioned drawing packages to manufacturing and suppliers, applying GD&T per ASME Y14.5 and running tolerance stack-ups on critical interfaces
* Serving as Arc's resident NX and Teamcenter expert: developing CAD standards, templates, naming conventions, revision control, and shared libraries to align all engineering teams on best practices
* Supporting and improving our Teamcenter environment, including workflows, eBOM configuration, troubleshooting, and training engineers, and growing into administration and backend setup
* Partnering with manufacturing and supply chain on DFM to catch problems while they're still pixels
* Supporting prototype builds on the floor and folding what you learn back into the models

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related Engineering field, or equivalent professional experience
* 5+ years of mechanical design and drafting, with a track record of releasing drawings to production
* Demonstrated expertise in CAD (NX required) across multiple disciplines. SolidWorks or CATIA experience alone is not sufficient.
* A generalist who is comfortable across disciplines, rather than a specialist in one area such as surfacing or sheet metal
* Demonstrated Teamcenter experience, including workflows
* Experience developing CAD standards or best practices and training other engineers
* Strong command of GD&T per ASME Y14.5, with experience releasing parts to vendors across machining, fabrication, composites, or molding
* Thrives with incomplete requirements and fast-changing designs
* Communicates clearly with engineers, technicians, and suppliers, and can align multiple teams on shared standards

**Bonus Qualifications**
------------------------

* 10+ years of design experience
* Teamcenter administration and backend setup experience
* Partnering with industrial designers to turn sketches into Class A surfaces
* Building CAD standards and PDM structure from scratch at an early-stage company
* Marine hardware experience preferred; automotive, aerospace, or EV also relevant
* Background in composite structures or large weldment design
* Experience with high-voltage packaging
* Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace
* Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You're always welcome to reach out even if you don't meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

**What we offer**
-----------------

The base salary for this role is P3: $150,000 P4: $175,000 annually.

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.  
  
Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

* **Healthcare benefits** — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision
* **Parental leave** — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents
* **Generous time off** — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure
* **Income protection** — Life and disability insurance for all employees
* **Retirement savings** —Traditional and Roth 401(k) access
* **Water fund** — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose
* **Professional development** — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend
* **Safety Support-** Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe
* **Captain training** — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family
* **Office perks** — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite
* **Relocation assistance** — Available depending on role eligibility.

**Our values**
--------------

We move with urgency and build with care.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Science
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, advancing diagnostics in oncology, women's health, and organ health to support better patient care. As a **Data Science Manager** in R&D Operations, you will lead a team of data scientists to design and implement data solutions to accelerate R&D at Natera. You will take ownership of operational data workflows, establish scalable processes and SOPs, and apply ML and/or AI expertise to enable informed decision-making and drive efficiency. You will work closely with our Data Engineering Manager and Data Analytics Manager to deliver integrated, reliable data solutions across the team.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct, mentor, and develop a team of data scientists, including hiring, performance management, and career development
* Set the technical direction for the data science team and advance its ML/AI capabilities
* Own the data science roadmap for R&D Operations, define success metrics, and report progress and status to R&D Operations and executive stakeholders
* Translate pain points and opportunities surfaced by data analytics into solutions–process changes, algorithms, or new tools–and drive their implementation to deliver measurable process improvement, championing efficiency gains in turnaround time and cost per activity across R&D Operations
* Own the sample governance process end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and accountability, and manage the associated stakeholder relationships
* Develop and oversee machine learning models, optimization strategies, and AI solutions to forecast demand, optimize resource allocation, and automate operational processes
* Lead the development of new data products, as well as the training and enablement around them to grow visibility, self-service, and data-driven decision-making across R&D Operations
* Design, document, and implement processes for data governance, data integrity, and reproducibility across R&D Operations
* Partner with the Data Engineering and Data Analytics Managers and collaborate cross-functionally across R&D and supporting functions to translate business needs into governed, reliable data solutions
* Write clear, testable requirements (e.g. acceptance criteria, data contracts) and define the path from prototype to production in partnership with Data Engineering

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 7+ years of experience in data science in biotechnology, life sciences, or operations research
* Demonstrated people-management experience, including hiring, mentoring, and developing data scientists through coaching on performance and career growth
* Experience owning a data science roadmap and communicating progress to senior and executive stakeholders
* Working knowledge of a relevant scientific or operational domain–biology or life sciences strongly preferred, operations research a close second–sufficient to partner effectively with R&D Operations stakeholders
* Experience working with laboratory or operational data (e.g., laboratory informatics management system (LIMS), sample management, inventory, purchasing/procurement, or equipment operations)
* Track record of driving process improvement–identifying root causes and delivering solutions through process changes, algorithms, or new tools
* Strong background in building data processes, SOPs, and governance frameworks
* Expertise in Python (including pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch) and SQL
* Hands-on expertise in machine learning and/or AI applied to real-world problems, setting technical direction for predictive modeling and optimization solutions
* Experience taking ML models or data products from prototype to production, including monitoring and maintenance
* Experience with modern cloud data warehouse and transformation tooling (e.g. Snowflake, dbt)
* Experience partnering with peer functions such as engineering and analytics to deliver end-to-end solutions, including writing requirements or technical specifications
* Clear, direct communication skills to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations
* Strong critical thinking and a drive for learning and problem-solving

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or operations research
* Familiarity with data integrity and audit-readiness practices in a regulated (GxP/GCLP) environment

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy—verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. jobs.title: E11 Bio - Scientist I/II, Expansion Microscopy
jobs.description:
E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight-knit start-up. Read our technology roadmap.

We are seeking a mission-aligned scientist or engineer who is equally comfortable at the bench, the microscope, and with quantitative data analysis. This role combines sample preparation, advanced microscopy, quantitative image analysis, with engineering-driven technology development focused on quick iterative troubleshooting and standardizing and automating protocols. You will collaborate closely with molecular biology, imaging, and computational teams to ensure we consistently prepare high quality specimens to support our ambitious scaling goals towards whole-brain connectomics.

The role forms a critical part of our sample production pipeline and will be responsible for expansion microscopy development and iteratively improving protocols. Your work will drive two overarching outcomes: improving gel performance and improving the quality, reproducibility and scalability of sample production. This combines hands-on experimental work with defining quantitative metrics to assess mechanical and optical gel properties, image quality and pipeline throughput.

### **Responsibilities**

* Independently design, coordinate, and execute bench level experiments focused on expansion microscopy.
* Operate within our sample production pipeline to ensure a continuous flow of high-quality gels
* Iteratively optimize expansion microscopy workflows by designing, sourcing and adapting techniques and methodologies from the literature and scientific community
* Pilot variations of expansion microscopy protocols focused on optimizing signal retention for multi-round cycles of immunostaining, imaging, and signal extinction.
* Pilot methods for increasing diffusion within expanded hydrogel/tissue hybrids. Pilot commercially available devices (e.g. ultrasound or microwave) and design custom built devices (in collaboration with external vendors) to facilitate these experiments.
* Work closely with experimental and computational scientists to collaboratively design experiments, analyze experimental data, and interpret results.
* Maintain excellent laboratory notebook practices, communicate results through reports and presentations, and contribute to and assist in preparation of manuscripts, abstracts and other scientific documents.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in biology, chemistry, bioengineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience
* Strong track record of end-to-end experimental ownership.
* Experience developing methods or protocols, ideally involving hydrogel chemistry, expansion microscopy, immunohistochemistry, or tissue processing
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong record-keeping practices and attention to reproducibility.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with advanced optical microscope modalities (e.g., spinning-disc confocal or light-sheet microscopy).
* Experience designing or applying quantitative scoring systems for expansion microscopy or imaging data
* Experience with scaling expansion microscopy throughput in routine production environments
* Experience automating lab workflows (e.g., liquid handlers, microcontrollers like Arduino or Raspberry Pi, scripting in Python)

Strong engineers new to these techniques are encouraged to apply, as are creative experimentalists from outside neuroscience who have developed expansion microscopy or similar methods in other fields. We’re looking for self-starters that iterate quickly and find creative, practical solutions to complex problems. Experience working in fast paced startup-like research environments where roles span multiple technical domains is preferred.

### **In 6 months, you will have:**

* Fully onboarded into the E11 production pipeline and be consistently generating high-quality gels for imaging
* Identify and standardize expansion microscopy QC metrics (e.g, measuring mechanical or optical properties) and stage gate thresholds, and integrated their routine measurement into the pipeline
* Increased production gel yield by 50% without a reduction in quality

### **In 12 months, you will have:**

* Improved the quality, reproducibility, and scalability of the pipeline, both in throughput and in the physical sample sizes we can process (for example, by developing methods for high-quality whole-brain gelation and expansion)
* Increased the reproducibility of our protocols so that technical variability between and within samples processed in parallel is reduced by 50%
* Reduced hands-on protocol time while improving outcomes and reproducibility, for example through in-house automation development or automation partnerships.

### **We offer**

* An opportunity to help change the world and work with a world-class interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers on a field-defining moonshot
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan; parental leave.
* Generous time off + paid holidays.
* 401K matching up to 6% of base salary
* Ample healthy and energizing food including daily lunches.
* Stipend for fitness and wellness activities.

Base salary range: $100,000 - $170,000 a year

Bonus: Performance-based, up to 20% of base salary

401K match: 6%

Total potential compensation: $125,000 - $214,000

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

### **Transform the everyday with us!**

Siemens Electrification & Automation (E&A) Business Unit offers the full range of energy distribution systems and solutions for all markets and through all sales channels. We provide reliable power distribution grids of today while investing in our Future Grids portfolio to create the power distribution grid of the future. We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our team!

**This role will be based onsite in Livermore, CA.** ***Local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.*** Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

Livermore offers an excellent quality of life with top-rated schools, a pleasant climate, and easy access to both mountains and the coast. Plus, your compensation goes further here with a more attainable cost of living compared to other parts of the San Francisco Bay Area. It's the perfect blend of small-city charm and big-city access.

**We are seeking a meticulous and analytical R&D Laboratory Technician** to join our innovation team. In this role, you will work closely with technology leaders and engineers to support the design, development, and testing of new products, materials, and technologies. Your primary focus will be performing laboratory experiments, maintaining precise data logs, operating sophisticated testing equipment, and ensuring strict compliance with all laboratory safety protocols.

### **You’ll make a difference by:**

* Experiment Execution: Assist engineers in planning, setting up, and running controlled experiments, prototype trials, and product scale-ups.
* Prototype Preparation: Prepare, assemble, measure, and inspect for analytical testing.
* Data Collection & Analysis: Record experimental observations, calculate formulas, and compile test results accurately within electronic databases for documentation and use in progress reporting.
* Equipment Management: Operate, calibrate, clean, and perform routine preventative maintenance on laboratory instruments and machinery.
* Inventory Control: Monitor laboratory supply levels, track consumable resources, and coordinate with the procurement team to reorder chemicals, supplies or tools.
* Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) regulations, and proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
* Cross-Department Collaboration: Coordinate with quality control, manufacturing, and marketing teams to facilitate smooth transitions from product concepts to commercial manufacturing.

### **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical theory, Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or a closely related scientific field.
* One or more years of hands-on laboratory experience, ideally in an industrial R&D, product testing, or quality control environment.
* Proficiency in standard analytical techniques (e.g., material testing, high voltage testing techniques, or physical testing methods) and experience tracking standard test protocols like ASTM or ISO.
* Proven digital skills, including demonstrable proficiency in MS Office (Excel) or Google Sheets, alongside familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or scientific data software, and reporting.
* Excellent organizational habits, strong written communication skills for report drafting, and a natural ability to tackle technical anomalies independently or as part of a team.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, handle critical equipment, and safely lift up to 30 lbs when moving test equipment, experiments or raw materials.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Electrical testing, including AC/DC Hipot testing, thermal cycle testing, BIL lightning testing, current injection testing, or thermocouples.
* Prior work experience in a research and development testing role in a manufacturing environment.

### **About Siemens:**

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

We value your unique identity and perspective. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.description:
RDI Trials runs clinical studies for diagnostic companies. Our laboratory supports those studies by receiving, processing, testing, storing, and shipping clinical research specimens.

We are hiring a Laboratory Technician to perform hands-on laboratory work from sample receipt through final disposition. You will report to the Lab Director and work closely with our laboratory and study teams. This is a full-time, onsite position in Van Nuys, Los Angeles.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Prepare for study samples

* Complete study-specific training and review sample volumes, specimen types, stability windows, labels, and manifests.
* Prepare freezer locations and supplies before shipments arrive.

Receive and track samples

* Receive, open, and sort sample shipments.
* Accession samples, reconcile shipments against manifests, and document discrepancies.
* Keep Salesforce and freezer location records accurate and complete.

Support laboratory testing

* Assess sample integrity and track protocol-defined testing windows.
* Perform assigned research testing and sample analysis in accordance with training, approved procedures, and applicable authorization.
* Run samples, calibrators, and quality controls on automated analyzers as assigned.
* Identify assay or instrument issues and escalate promptly to the Lab Director.
* Record and transmit results and complete study data entry accurately and on time.

Store and ship specimens

* Pull and organize samples against study manifests.
* Package and stage shipments according to protocols and applicable requirements.
* Update sample tracking and storage records after shipment.

Maintain laboratory readiness

* Perform routine equipment maintenance and calibration checks.
* Maintain temperature and humidity logs and complete laboratory records.
* Prepare study kits and track supplies, reagents, and consumables.
* Coordinate with vendors and obtain pricing for laboratory materials as requested.
* Identify risks and process improvements, communicate problems early, and follow issues through to resolution.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Samples are received, processed, tested, stored, and shipped accurately and on time. Records are complete and ready for review. Quality concerns and timeline risks are identified early, and the study team can rely on the laboratory to complete its commitments.

 **Requirements**

* Ability to follow study protocols, laboratory SOPs, and training requirements accurately.
* Careful sample handling, labeling, recordkeeping, and data entry.
* Ability to organize work around sample stability windows and study deadlines.
* Clear communication and prompt escalation of discrepancies, quality concerns, and conflicting instructions.
* Willingness to support routine laboratory work, equipment care, supplies, and study kit preparation.
* Ability to learn and use our laboratory information and sample tracking systems.
* Ability to work full time onsite in Van Nuys, Los Angeles.

Please describe your relevant laboratory experience, the instruments and specimen types you have worked with, and any experience supporting clinical research or mass-spectrometry studies.

Long-term growth through the RDI Operator Studio

jobs.description:
**About Phykion**

Phykion is reimagining aviation fuel. We cultivate hyper-productive microalgae to produce a scalable, low-carbon oil that drops directly into the HEFA pathway — the most commercially established route to sustainable aviation fuel. Our platform is built on three breakthroughs: a field-proven algae host with 5+ years of outdoor cultivation, strain engineering trait stacking that has delivered a 10x gain in oil productivity to date, and an outdoor cultivation process on non-arable land fed by seawater and CO2. We are scaling this validated technology into demonstration production, paving the way for commercial supply of low-carbon oil by the end of the decade. As part of that scale-up, we are re-opening our pilot facility near Calipatria, California, and building the small team that will bring the site back online and run it.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Laboratory Technician to join our production and laboratory team at the Calipatria pilot facility. Reporting to the Production & Laboratory Shift Lead and ultimately to the Algae Production Lead, the Laboratory Technician runs the analytical measurements that support cultivation decisions, prepares reagents and media, maintains seed trains and strains, and partners with the field production team to collect samples and keep sensor networks running. This role sits at the intersection of lab and field — if you want to work on real-world algae biology at scale rather than at the bench alone, this is that role.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Run routine laboratory measurements that support production decisions — optical density, dry weight, nutrient and pH analysis, microscopy, and contamination screening.
* Prepare reagents and media; maintain seed trains; support strain handling and routine upkeep of the lab's algal collections.
* Operate and maintain lab equipment and instrumentation (balances, spectrophotometers, microscopes, pH meters) safely; keep work areas clean and organized.
* Collect field samples and calibrate and maintain sensor networks across the production train in partnership with the Production Technicians.
* Enter data into databases and dashboards cleanly and on time; review for anomalies and flag deviations early.
* Support experiments and scale-up trials in partnership with R&D; help translate laboratory findings into production practice.
* Follow SOPs; participate in SOP updates and continuous improvement.
* Maintain a strong safety culture — proper PPE, chemical handling, SDS use, and clean-work practices.
* Rotate shifts as the operating schedule requires.

**Requirements and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a related life or physical science is preferred; Associate's degree with directly relevant laboratory experience may be acceptable.
* 1–2 years of laboratory experience in a research, production, agricultural, or technical setting is desirable; experience in algae cultivation, aquaculture, greenhouse operations, or bioprocessing is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with standard laboratory measurements and instrumentation (microscopy, spectrophotometry, pH meters, balances).
* Working knowledge of lab safety practices — PPE, chemical handling, SDS use, and clean-work discipline.
* Comfort with written SOPs, digital data entry, and MS Office or similar productivity tools.
* Comfortable moving between the lab and outdoor field conditions in the same day.
* Able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs, climb ladders, kneel, stoop, and bend as the work requires.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is strongly preferred given the Calipatria site and workforce.
* Authorization to work in the United States is required.

**Work Location and Schedule**

On-site at our pilot facility near Calipatria, CA. Schedule includes nights, weekends, and overtime as the operating schedule requires.

**Compensation**

Hourly pay range: $22 – $30 per hour, depending on experience and background. Compensation also includes participation in Phykion's stock option program, offering meaningful equity upside at a seed-stage company with significant near-term growth ahead. We offer comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), generous vacation and PTO, and wellness days.

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant, Full-time, Variable shift
jobs.description:
Nestled on the Central California Coast, Adventist Health Sierra Vista has been providing care to our community since 1959. Our 162-bed acute care facility includes a Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit and county designated trauma center. San Luis Obispo offers the excitement of a lively community while being a fifteen-minute drive from the serenity of Avila Beach, known for their natural hot springs, and Pismo Beach, known for their sand dunes and eucalyptus trees. Featuring a charming downtown, comfortable coastal weather, idyllic views, and an active lifestyle San Luis Obispo offers much to be had.

Job Summary:

Collects blood specimens, as well as receives, handles and processes specimens for Laboratory testing. Receives, sorts and accessions specimens, assigning to appropriate pre-analytic and analytic workflow. Completes computerized tasks related to patient registration and/or test order entry, specimen collection, receiving and processing. Performs basic post-analytic tasks, including distributing reports, storing and/or retrieving specimens. Completes quality-related tasks such as documentation of work, maintaining a clean, stocked and safe work area, and monitoring pending work, as well as escalating priority work. Operates and/or uses basic pre-analytic lab equipment. Adheres to all local/state/federal regulations, codes, policies and procedures to ensure privacy and safety while delivering optimal patient care. This position is represented by SEIU.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required
* Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
* Experience in Phlebotomy in acute care environment: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) license: Required

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

* Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

Essential Functions:

* Collects blood specimens for a variety of Laboratory tests using age-appropriate techniques; handles/transports Lab specimens and provides post-phlebotomy care to patients. Receives specimens for testing; assesses specimens upon receipt according to established criteria to determine acceptability and takes action according to protocol including escalating to licensed or certified personnel for direction. Handles and processes a variety of specimen types to prepare them for analysis; adheres to protocols to maintain specimen integrity at all times.
* Completes computerized tasks as appropriate for affiliate to ensure complete patient registration and/or test order entry into the lab information system, as well as generation of collection lists and/or labels. Prepares and/or packages specimens for transport to another Adventist Health or outside reference laboratory and may complete computer steps necessary for processing referred specimens.
* Maintains an adequate inventory of supplies in work area and/or on phlebotomy cart. Maintains required records by completing basic documentation of pre-analytic and post-analytic work, as well as quality-related tasks. Participates in managing the laboratory workflow by performing duties such as monitoring pending work, escalating priority work, locating specimens, and coordinating specimen recollections.
* Verbally communicates released/reported results. Routes, distributes and retransmits released/reported results. Stores and retrieves specimens.
* Receives incoming calls for the laboratory and assists the caller as appropriate or transfers these calls to the appropriate laboratory section or person. Communicates with customer to clarify ambiguous, unclear or duplicate test orders.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
  
  
Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

jobs.description:
The Research Associate position with the UCLA Agile Visual Analytics Lab (AVAL) is an exciting opportunity for an applied researcher to contribute to the lab’s mission by supporting complex, multifaceted evaluation and research projects through data collection, data management, analysis, and the development and dissemination of reporting products. The position is designed for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative research environment and is interested in strengthening and applying their experience across the research and evaluation lifecycle. The position is particularly well suited for someone who enjoys combining applied research methods, technology, collaboration, and effective communication to help turn data into useful and actionable information. The ideal candidate is a highly organized and intellectually curious research professional with strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, excellent written and verbal communication abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams. Knowledge of utilization-focused evaluation, participatory research, human services systems, and visual design principles for communicating data in a clear, accurate, engaging, and equity-aware manner will be especially valuable.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Applied Cell Line Development & Customer Programs
jobs.description:
Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first-of-its-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate to help advance our mammalian cell line development and protein production capabilities. At Prolific, we use light to control the expression of biotherapeutic proteins, with the goal of increasing titer and improving quality attributes. In this role, you will play a key part in generating and characterizing cell lines that support both internal research and customer programs. The ideal candidate enjoys hands-on laboratory work, takes pride in delivering consistent, high-quality results, and is eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment. You’ll collaborate with scientists and engineers across multiple disciplines, with opportunities to expand your technical expertise, take on increasing ownership, and contribute directly to Prolific’s success. This role is based on-site in our headquarters in Emeryville, CA.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive workflows using mammalian cell culture, primarily working with suspension HEK and suspension CHO
* Generate stable cell lines via transfection (ie electroporation) and selection as well as serving as the primary technical owner of many genetically distinct cell lines at once
* Handle protein production workflows at different scales - deep well plates and shake flasks, potentially including small scale bioreactors such as the Ambr system
* Execute downstream readouts such as cell counting (Celleca, nucleocounter), metabolite measurements (Nova / CEDEX), Octet BLI, flow cytometry
* Perform single cell isolation using methods such as FACS, cell deposition, or Beacon
* Execute plasmid cloning and molecular biology techniques including PCR and ddPCR
* Conduct experiments independently, collect and analyze data in a timely manner, maintain detailed documentation in electronic lab notebooks, and data visualization and presentation in team meetings

### **Requirements:**

Candidates will be considered at the Research Associate I, Research Associate II, and Senior Research Associate levels based on their experience, technical proficiency, and demonstrated independence.
* Proficient in mammalian cell culture, preferably with experience in cell line development, and are well versed in sterile technique, transfection, and clone isolation
* Comfortable with readouts such as cell counting, metabolite measurement, Octet BLI and flow cytometry
* Comfortable with developing and proposing experimental plans, conducting experiments, and troubleshooting analytical techniques and methodologies
* Proficient in precisely following protocols, designing and executing experiments independently, and managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting
* Self-starter who’s committed to team science and effective independent work

* Excitement for working in a fast-paced startup environment and comfort with evolving project scopes and shifting priorities

jobs.description:
Merge Labs is a frontier research lab with the mission of bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency and experience. We’re pursuing this goal by developingfundamentally new approaches to brain-computer interfaces that interact with the brain at high bandwidth, integrate with advanced AI, and are ultimately safe and accessible for anyone to use.

**About the team:**

Our Bio team designs, builds, and characterizes the biotechnologies that form the foundation of next-generation brain-computer interfaces. We combine molecular engineering, synthetic biology, neuroscience, and advanced physical methods such as ultrasound to establish less invasive, high-bandwidth connections with neurons. We develop and validate our core molecular technologies in close collaboration with engineers, data scientists, and in vivo researchers.

**About the role:**

We are seeking a Research Associate to help develop and characterize neuronal models for ultrasound-based molecular actuation . You will establish and maintain neuronal culture systems, introduce engineered constructs, and evaluate their expression, localization, and function. Working closely with molecular biology, neuroscience, and in vivo teams, you will generate reproducible data that guide actuator development and optimization. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong neuronal culture skills who enjoys troubleshooting experiments and developing new methods.

**In this role, you will:**

* Establish, maintain, and characterize neuronal cell culture systems, including primary, stem cell-derived, or brain slice models.
* Perform transfections and viral transductions to introduce engineered constructs into cells.
* Execute microscopy and cell-based assays to assess construct expression, localization, and function.
* Collaborate with molecular biology, neuroscience, and in vivo teams to design experiments, interpret results, and inform iterative tool optimization.
* Troubleshoot experiments and contribute to protocol development, optimization, and standardization.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, culture histories, and sample metadata, and communicate results clearly across teams.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* A BS or MS in Bioengineering, Neuroscience, Cell Biology, or a related discipline, with hands-on laboratory experience.
* Experience with one or more neuronal systems, including primary neurons, iPSC-derived neurons, acute or organotypic brain slice cultures.
* Experience with transfection, viral transduction, microscopy, or cell-based assays.
* A systematic approach to troubleshooting and strong attention to experimental quality, reproducibility, and documentation.
* A collaborative, organized approach to laboratory work and enthusiasm for tackling foundational neurotechnology problems in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary team.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with protein or genetic circuit engineering.

jobs.description:
**Job ID** 17138 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Academic / Research **Date posted** 11/06/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Merchant lab seeks a Research Associate with and interest in cancer biology and tumor immunology. Studies in the lab make use of mouse models to examine the tumor immunology, with correlation in human patient samples. The studies are part of an NIH funded project aiming to increase our understanding of resistance of non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma (NHL) to chemotherapy and immunotherapy. In addition to studying resistance mechanisms of NHL to chemotherapy and immunotherapy, the project will examine the utility of CAR T-cells in the treatment of NHL. The results from these studies will be used to design clinical trials to improve outcomes for patients with NHL.

Studies of the tumor microenvironment will be enabled using high dimensional flow cytometry, single cell RNA-sequencing, and imaging mass cytometry. Imaging mass cytometry allows for highly multiplexed (35+ markers) imaging of immune and tumor cells, with spatial information and subcellular resolution making it the ideal technology for studying stem cells and immune cells in their cellular niches within the bone marrow. Imaging mass cytometry can be applied to all tissue types including cell lines, organoids, frozen section and FFPE fixed archival tissue.

The applicant will have the opportunity to work with a diverse team, including other Research Associates, Medical Doctors, residents, graduate students, and post-doctoral students. The applicant will also have the opportunity to present data at the weekly Merchant Lab meeting. Additionally, the applicant will have the opportunity to help write papers, attend national scientific meetings, and present data at national scientific meetings.
  
  
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Breeding, genotyping, tumor injections, treatments and tissue harvesting in mice.
* Apply standard molecular and cellular biology methods (RT-PCR, Western blotting, cell culture and transduction, expression profiling) to profile the tumor microenvironment of NHL.
* Uses imaging mass cytometry to study the tumor microenvironment and cell changes in animal models of NHL and in patient samples.
* Using flow cytometry to study the tumor microenvironment and cell changes in animal models of NHL and in patient samples.
* Maintains computer database with relevant information.
* Performs lab maintenance duties, including glassware cleaning and sterilization.

jobs.description:

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC is seeking a highly motivated temporary part-time Civil/Structural Engineer for our growing transportation practice in Fresno, CA.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic to work with other engineers, project managers, and other technical staff assisting with planning, designing, and overseeing civil engineering projects, such as the design of roadways, retaining walls/sound walls, culverts, and bridges, including hydraulic modeling.

Responsibilities

Assist Project Managers in the production of project plans, specifications, reports and cost estimates.

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with other employees, clients, and public agencies.

Qualifications

B.S. degree in Civil Engineering.
Experience in highway, bridge and drainage design.

Experience using computer assisted engineering and design software to prepare engineering and design documents (examples include software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, and GIS).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Assistant
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Laboratory Assistant at Providence Mission Hospital in Mission Viejo, CA. This position is full-time and will work 8-hour, Day shifts.

Providence Mission Hospital in Mission Viejo has received Magnet designation in 2012, 2017, 2021 and are in the process of earning our fourth designation in 2025! This is a prestigious designation from the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC), which recognizes organizations that provide the highest-quality care. Only eight percent of hospitals nationwide have achieved Magnet designation. We are also recognized as one of the best regional hospitals in 18 types of care by U.S. News & World Report, including orthopedic and gastroenterological care. Our hospital is also honored with awards for cardiac surgery, gastrointestinal surgery, and excellence in women's services by Healthgrades and Newsweek.

The Senior Laboratory Assistant is responsible for the collections and processing of blood specimens, providing assessment and care for neonate, pediatric, adult, and geriatric in-patients, emergency room patients, and patients from other hospital services as needed. He/she will assist as necessary with outpatient specimen collection and processing. The inoculation of microbiology specimens onto primary media and the processing of specimens for referral testing are also responsibilities of the position. He/she is proficient in required competencies.

Providence caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Mission Hospital Regional Medical Center and thrive in our culture of patient-focused, whole-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.

Required Qualifications

California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I License upon hire, Or
California Certified Phlebotomy Technician II License upon hire

1 year Laboratory phlebotomy experience.

Our best-in-class benefits are uniquely designed to support you and your family in staying well, growing professionally, and achieving financial security. We take care of you, so you can focus on delivering our Mission of caring for everyone, especially the most vulnerable in our communities.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise - Healthcare Life Sciences (HLS)
jobs.description:
About The Team

Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster.

About The Role

As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations within the Healthcare and Life Sciences segment (HLS), helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. You will work across clinical, operational, administrative and research workflows, translating security, privacy and governance requirements into practical deployment decisions. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria.
Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.
Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution.
Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback.
Partner with customer security, privacy, clinical and business teams to design responsible AI deployments, including data handling, access controls, evaluation, human oversight and monitoring.
Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

About The Role

As a Physical Design & CAD Engineer
, you will serve as a Technical Lead developing Astera Labs’ next-generation connectivity ASICs for cloud and AI infrastructure.

This role combines Physical Design CAD methodology development with hands-on place-and-route (PNR) implementation. You will develop and optimize automated design flows for advanced process nodes while contributing to block-level physical design, timing closure, and GDSII signoff.

You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to improve design efficiency, automation, and silicon implementation.

What You'll Do

Develop and maintain Physical Design CAD flows and methodologies for advanced process nodes.
Build automation frameworks using Python and Tcl to support synthesis through signoff.
Perform hands-on Physical Design and PNR, including floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and timing closure.
Develop and optimize EDA tool flows for timing analysis, extraction, EM/IR, and physical verification.
Support block-level implementation from synthesis through GDSII signoff.
Improve design quality, automation, and flow efficiency.
Collaborate with design, verification, and engineering teams to support ASIC development and tapeout.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
5+ years of experience in ASIC Physical Design, CAD methodology, or design automation.
Strong understanding of physical design implementation and RTL-to-GDSII methodologies.
Experience developing or maintaining Physical Design CAD flows.
Hands-on experience with PNR, timing closure, and physical design signoff.
Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting.
Experience with Cadence and/or Synopsys physical design tools.
Experience with advanced semiconductor process nodes (7nm or below).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with 3nm or more advanced process technologies.
Experience building automated CAD flows from synthesis through signoff.
Familiarity with Cadence Innovus, Tempus, Genus, Synopsys ICC2, Fusion Compiler, and PrimeTime.
Experience with EM/IR analysis, DRC/LVS, ECO, and timing signoff methodologies.
Experience with block-level ownership through tapeout.
Experience developing scalable CAD methodologies and automation frameworks.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $160,000–$200,000 USD. Your salary will be determined based on your experience and the pay of employees in similar positions.

Experience with Bioconductor packages and Shiny

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, Global Healthcare & Life Sciences Industries
jobs.description:
Description

Drive transformation for leading Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations while shaping the future of patient care, drug discovery, and clinical innovation through AWS cloud and AI solutions.

Partner with senior leaders at global HCLS enterprises to accelerate their cloud adoption journey, delivering measurable business outcomes and strategic value.

About The Role

Customer Solutions Managers (CSMs) at AWS are obsessed with accelerating customer cloud adoption and driving measurable value from cloud investments. As a CSM in Healthcare & Life Sciences, you'll partner with senior leaders and engineering teams at global organizations to strategize and manage their end-to-end cloud and AI transformation journeys.

We help Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations adopt advanced cloud and AI solutions while migrating existing workloads to the cloud. Together with customers, we shape and execute strategies to build mindshare and broaden the use of AWS offerings across their enterprises.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.

You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful migration to AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities

You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solution Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution

2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Customer Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale migrations, GenAI, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.

3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.

4/Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS.

These interconnected focus areas will enable CSMs to effectively drive cloud adoption, pursue strategic growth opportunities, and empower customer success - all of which are critical to achieving the Automotive & Manufacturing IBU’s objectives. By aligning CSM activities, goals, and opportunities under these focus areas, the Automotive & Manufacturing CSM team can ensure a disciplined, customer-centric approach that maximizes business impact and revenue realization for AWS.

CSMs play a critical role supporting account teams/customers throughout the sales process, and the customer's cloud transformation journey, whilst consistently demonstrating measurable value to the customer regardless of engagement model.

CSMs are able to effectively coordinate cross-functional resources, drive disciplined project delivery, and quantify the tangible business benefits that customers realize through their cloud transformation initiatives. This holistic approach to customer engagement, coupled with the CSM's deep understanding of the Automotive & Manufacturing Industry and AWS capabilities; positions CSMs as trusted advisors who can guide customers through every stage of their cloud journey - from initial strategy and planning to migration, modernization, and ongoing optimization.

This position requires 15% - 30% travel across the calendar year to the customer.

Skills & Attributes

Exceptional ability to lead through influence across diverse stakeholder groups

Critical thinking and self-motivation with proven ability to navigate ambiguity

Data-driven decision maker who uses metrics to measure success and drive improvements

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with ability to tailor messaging to different audiences

Innovative mindset with passion for solving complex customer challenges

Travel 15-30% as needed, primarily for customer facing events.

About The Team

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

The HCLS Industries team at AWS is committed to helping customers enable their transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their business and industry. Our team speaks the language of our customers, focusing on business outcomes and industry use cases in everything we do — whether building products and solutions, selling, delivering, or partnering.

At AWS, we value critical thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to deal with ambiguity. We celebrate innovation, encourage data-driven decision making, and create an environment where diverse perspectives drive better outcomes.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the 8 description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups build a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys.
