jobs.title: Research Technician - Bacterial Community Development & Regulated Cell Death
jobs.description:
The Mashruwala Laboratory at the Stowers Institute for Medical Research invites applications for a Research Technician. The laboratory studies bacterial communities through a developmental biology lens, asking how molecular events within genetically identical bacterial cells generate organized behaviors and spatial patterns across a collective. We are particularly interested in regulated cell death, collective cell-fate decisions, and cell-cell communication as routes to discovering general principles of bacterial community development.
The successful candidate will join a collaborative research team and contribute directly to ongoing projects in bacterial community biology.
The position will involve hands-on experimentation. Responsibilities and scientific ownership will be tailored to the individual and can grow substantially with experience and demonstrated independence.

Role and responsibilities

Research technicians are active scientific contributors to the laboratory. Depending on experience, interests, and project needs, responsibilities can include:
Conducting experiments using bacterial genetics, molecular biology, microscopy, phenotypic assays, and related approaches.
Preparing media and reagents; maintaining bacterial strains, plasmids, and laboratory stocks; and helping sustain reliable experimental workflows.
Collecting, organizing, and analyzing quantitative experimental data while maintaining careful and reproducible research records.
Learning, troubleshooting, and optimizing experimental protocols and, with experience, helping develop new methods.
Contributing to experimental planning, interpretation of results, lab discussions, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate.
Participating in shared laboratory organization and routine tasks that keep the research environment safe, efficient, and collaborative.

Research, mentoring and professional development environment

We combine bacterial genetics, molecular biology, advanced microscopy, quantitative image analysis, computational approaches, phenotypic analysis, and small-scale laboratory automation. Technicians can gain experience across multiple approaches as their projects and interests develop.
At Stowers, research technicians work in a highly collaborative environment with direct access to Ph.D.-level scientific partners in Technology Centers spanning advanced microscopy, genomics, proteomics, computational biology, and related areas.
The Mashruwala Laboratory receives recurring intramural support from the Stowers Institute, providing flexibility to pursue unexpected findings and ambitious long-term questions. Our research is also supported by the Edward Mallinckrodt, Jr. Foundation.
Mentoring is tailored to each researcher’s background and goals and can include experimental design, quantitative reasoning, data analysis, scientific writing and presentations, project organization, and career development. Technicians who demonstrate readiness can take ownership of project components/ projects.

Who should apply

We welcome applicants from diverse scientific backgrounds who are excited by fundamental biological questions and by research that crosses traditional disciplinary boundaries. Prior experience with Vibrio cholerae or bacterial regulated cell death is not required; we particularly welcome applicants who bring complementary expertise.
A bachelor's degree in microbiology, molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, biophysics, computational biology, or a related field. Candidates with a master's degree are encouraged to apply.
Strong hands-on research experience is welcome.
Experience in at least one relevant area, such as microbial genetics, molecular biology, biochemistry, microscopy, quantitative analysis, computation, or genomics. Experience in every area is not expected.
Careful organization, attention to detail, reliable record-keeping, and strong follow-through.
Scientific curiosity, persistence, and a willingness to learn new approaches and troubleshoot difficult problems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Select publications

Mashruwala AA, Qin B, Bassler BL. Quorum-sensing- and type VI secretion-mediated spatiotemporal cell death drives genetic diversity in Vibrio cholerae. Cell (2022).
Mashruwala AA, Bassler BL. Quorum sensing orchestrates parallel cell death pathways in Vibrio cholerae via Type 6 secretion-dependent and -independent mechanisms. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (2024).

Application

Applicants should submit the materials below. We are interested in learning about your research experience, what you contributed to prior work, what you hope to learn in this position, and where you would like the experience to take you next.
A 1-2 page cover letter describing your interest in working with us, your relevant research experience, and your longer-term career goals.
A current CV or resume.
Contact information for three references.
Pdf’s of most recent two publications.

Please combine materials into a single PDF labeled LastName_Technician_2026.pdf and send it to AMashruwala@stowers.org and careers@stowers.org.

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.

Careers at Stowers : https://www.stowers.org/careers

jobs.description:
Are you fascinated by the bizarre world of small, wiggly, often regenerative invertebrates? The Stowers Institute for Medical Research is seeking a Research Technician
to join the Hall Lab
.
Our lab is motivated by the simple premise that we shouldn’t be limited to studying biology only in established “model” organisms. We are developing a suite of molecular and imaging tools to enable genetic engineering in diverse emerging model organisms
, with the goal of understanding how stem cells support regeneration across the tree of life.

Roles & Responsibilities

The selected candidate will work closely with the PI to support the lab’s research efforts by:
Developing and refining techniques to maintain and expand an array of emerging model invertebrates (with a strong emphasis on flatworms).
Contributing to molecular cloning that support transgenesis and gene editing strategy development.
Performing experiments to characterize regeneration, life history traits, and phenotype variation across species.
Maintaining thorough documentation (protocols, experimental records, colony/line tracking) and contributing to lab organization and best practices.

The ideal candidate is curious, creative, and resilient in the face of experimental setbacks. They work independently when needed, communicate clearly, and consistently incorporate feedback to improve.

What You’ll Be Doing

Animal husbandry to maintain several species of emerging model flatworms and related invertebrates.
Working with the Invertebrate Culture Facility to develop and implement more automated, standardized husbandry workflows.
Characterizing life-cycle traits and regenerative capabilities across diverse flatworm species (including phenotyping with immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization, and performing genetic perturbations with CRISPR and RNAi).
Performing molecular cloning using techniques such as bacterial transformation, minipreps, PCR, gel electrophoresis, restriction digestion, Golden Gate assembly, and Gibson assembly.

What We Offer

Close mentorship and support to help you meet your scientific and professional goals.
The opportunity to work with unusual and exciting emerging model organisms in the field of regenerative biology.
The opportunity to work closely with our fantastic technology centers while gaining important leadership skills.
Professional development opportunities (lab meetings, institute seminars, and conference attendance as appropriate).
Competitive compensation and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 403(b)), and relocation assistance as applicable.
Campus perks including café access, and fitness facilities.

Minimum Qualifications

BS in a relevant field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Synthetic Biology, Biophysics, Chemical Biology, Ecology, Microbiology, or related discipline). Candidates with a Master's degree are encouraged to apply.
3+ years of laboratory experience preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with molecular biology and/or genetics (cloning, PCR, gel electrophoresis, etc.).
Comfort with careful organization and recordkeeping (tracking cloning projects, animal lines, and experimental details).
Familiarity with sequence/plasmid design tools (e.g., Geneious, Benchling, SnapGene).
Imaging experience (widefield fluorescence, confocal, or similar).
Strong attention to detail and observational skill (e.g., recognizing “happy worms,” regeneration phenotypes, and subtle health changes).
A love and excitement for the organisms we work with.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Algen is an AI-native precision medicine company harnessing the power of CRISPR and functional genomics to transform drug discovery and development. A spin-out from the laboratory of Nobel Laureate Professor Jennifer Doudna, Algen was founded at the forefront of gene-editing innovation. We combine cutting-edge CRISPR technologies with advanced AI approaches to systematically modulate disease biology at scale and accelerate the path to effective treatments. Join us in redefining what's possible in AI-powered drug discovery.

Job Description

As an Agentic AI Engineer (Life Science), you’ll build the software that lets an AI agent plan a scientific analysis, choose tools and recover when a step fails. You’ll work with biologists and chemists to define what a successful analysis looks like, then use those criteria to decide which changes to ship. The work includes bringing the latest advances and original ideas into production. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering execution with a quantitative mindset and an interest in AI agents for scientific discovery.

Responsibilities

Advance the agent harness by bringing the latest research and open-source developments into production and experimenting with new approaches to multi-agent coordination, model routing, memory, planning, and tool use.
Work with biologists and chemists to turn real research questions into test cases. Agree on what evidence an answer needs and record the steps a scientist would need to check it.
Compare changes against a baseline on representative tasks. Measure scientific correctness, completion rate, latency and cost before deciding whether to release a change.
Make long-running analyses resilient. Run code in a sandbox with scoped tool access, save progress and let interrupted jobs resume without repeating completed work.
Trace production failures from the agent’s decision through its tool calls and outputs. Reproduce the failure, fix it and add a test that catches it on the next release.

MUST HAVE:
2+ years of industry experience building production software, with hands-on ownership of a backend service, infrastructure component or full-stack feature.
MUST HAVE:
Familiarity with LLM APIs, tool calling, agent runtimes, or workflow orchestration.
MUST HAVE:
Research or production experience building an LLM-powered agent that calls tools or coordinates a workflow. You can explain a design choice you made and how you tested it.
MUST HAVE:
Experience using data to judge a system change. You can design a repeatable comparison, investigate inconsistent results and explain the tradeoffs to colleagues.
Ability to take an engineering problem from design through testing, deployment and debugging, and to write code that teammates can maintain.
Ability to move between research questions, data analysis, system design, and production implementation.
Experience or strong interest in AI for science, scientific agents, computational research, or automated scientific discovery.
Experience building modern web applications (e.g. React, TypeScript, FastAPI, or similar frameworks).
Ability to move fast, own features end-to-end, and operate with high autonomy.
High standards for code quality, maintainability, and engineering excellence. .

Preferred

Experience designing benchmarks for LLMs, reviewing outputs with domain experts or replaying past runs to test for regressions.
Experience with durable workflows, task queues, sandboxed code execution or tools for inspecting distributed jobs.
Experience with LLM post-training, including fine-tuning models for tool use or scientific tasks
Experience developing agent systems for scientific discovery, particularly self-evolving agents.
Research or graduate-level experience in machine learning, computational biology or another quantitative field.

Document corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from established performance specifications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
jobs.description:
About Crunchbase

Crunchbase is a predictive solution that provides intelligence on private companies, powered by the unique combination of live private company data, AI, and market activity from over 80 million users. We predict private market movements that matter to help investors, dealmakers, and analysts make the right decisions.

We are committed to fostering a positive, diverse, and inclusive culture by hiring for potential and embracing individuals with diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. We value transparency and openness, believing that an inclusive environment strengthens our teams and enhances our products.

About The Role

The Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
owns Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer: proprietary data and intelligence generated from foundational data using AI and machine learning.

The primary charter is to identify high-value opportunities for new model-derived data, validate their value with customers, and take successful products from experimentation through scaled adoption.

Success Is Measured By Three Outcomes

New differentiated data: Create proprietary intelligence that Crunchbase could not practically produce through collection alone.
Higher customer value: Help customers discover, understand, evaluate, and prioritize their private market jobs more effectively.
Revenue and adoption: Turn valuable AI data into measurable usage, retention, expansion, and monetization opportunities.

What You’ll Do

AI & Data Science Product Strategy

Own the strategy and roadmap for Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer.
Identify high-value opportunities for new predictions, classifications, signals, and insights that improve customer decisions.
Build a differentiated portfolio of AI data products rather than isolated AI features.
Partner with Foundational Data to determine when customer needs are best addressed through collected, acquired, inferred, predicted, or generated data.

Customer Discovery & Product Development

Work directly with customers to identify where new or better data can materially improve their workflows and decisions.
Rapidly test new AI data concepts, validate customer value, and scale successful products.
Define how model-derived data, including confidence and uncertainty, should be presented to customers.
Partner with Design, Engineering, and Data Science to deliver AI data across Crunchbase products, APIs, MCP, and data delivery experiences.

Quality & Product Economics

Define quality standards and evaluation frameworks for model-derived data in partnership with Data Science.
Determine when an AI data product is sufficiently reliable for scaled customer use.
Balance customer value, coverage, accuracy, freshness, and generation cost.
Monitor product and data performance and continuously improve quality based on customer feedback and observed outcomes.

Adoption & Monetization

Drive adoption of AI data products across Crunchbase’s customer experiences and distribution channels.
Partner with Go-to-Market on positioning, customer education, and launch strategy.
Partner with Pricing and Packaging and Sales to identify monetization opportunities.
Measure adoption, retention, expansion, revenue, and customer outcomes to determine which products to scale, improve, or retire.

What We’re Looking For

Strong product judgment across customer discovery, strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and tradeoffs.
Strong understanding of data products and how customers derive value from proprietary data and insights.
Practical understanding of modern machine learning and AI capabilities and limitations.
Working knowledge of applied data science and machine learning.
Ability to translate product requirements for Data Science and Engineering teams.
Familiarity with model evaluation concepts such as precision, recall, confidence, and model drift.
Ability to reason about probabilistic and imperfect data and define appropriate quality thresholds.
Strong analytical skills and ability to balance customer value, quality, coverage, cost, and speed.
Excellent customer discovery, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Education and Experience

3+ years of Product Management, Data Product Management, AI/ML Product Management, or comparable experience.
Experience owning customer-facing data science products from problem definition through launch and ongoing monitoring.
Experience partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience taking products from customer discovery and experimentation through scaled adoption.
Ability to define quality criteria that reflect customer needs and make informed quality and coverage tradeoffs.
Experience with B2B SaaS, data products, APIs, intelligence platforms, or commercializing differentiated data preferred.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Crunchbase launches differentiated AI data products that customers value and competitors cannot easily replicate.
AI creates valuable intelligence and coverage that would be impractical to produce through traditional data collection alone.
Customers adopt these products because they improve real workflows and decisions.
AI data products contribute measurably to adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue while meeting appropriate quality and trust standards.

Non-Goals

This is not an internal AI tooling or general AI feature role.
This is not ownership of foundational data collection, sourcing, or operations.
This is not ML research or data generation for its own sake. AI data must solve meaningful customer problems and create measurable value.

Salary range: $160,000 - $190,000

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare "win win" — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. 5+ years

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
jobs.description:
About Crunchbase

Crunchbase is a predictive solution that provides intelligence on private companies, powered by the unique combination of live private company data, AI, and market activity from over 80 million users. We predict private market movements that matter to help investors, dealmakers, and analysts make the right decisions.

We are committed to fostering a positive, diverse, and inclusive culture by hiring for potential and embracing individuals with diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. We value transparency and openness, believing that an inclusive environment strengthens our teams and enhances our products.

About The Role

The Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
owns Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer: proprietary data and intelligence generated from foundational data using AI and machine learning.

The primary charter is to identify high-value opportunities for new model-derived data, validate their value with customers, and take successful products from experimentation through scaled adoption.

Success Is Measured By Three Outcomes

New differentiated data: Create proprietary intelligence that Crunchbase could not practically produce through collection alone.
Higher customer value: Help customers discover, understand, evaluate, and prioritize their private market jobs more effectively.
Revenue and adoption: Turn valuable AI data into measurable usage, retention, expansion, and monetization opportunities.

What You’ll Do

AI & Data Science Product Strategy

Own the strategy and roadmap for Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer.
Identify high-value opportunities for new predictions, classifications, signals, and insights that improve customer decisions.
Build a differentiated portfolio of AI data products rather than isolated AI features.
Partner with Foundational Data to determine when customer needs are best addressed through collected, acquired, inferred, predicted, or generated data.

Customer Discovery & Product Development

Work directly with customers to identify where new or better data can materially improve their workflows and decisions.
Rapidly test new AI data concepts, validate customer value, and scale successful products.
Define how model-derived data, including confidence and uncertainty, should be presented to customers.
Partner with Design, Engineering, and Data Science to deliver AI data across Crunchbase products, APIs, MCP, and data delivery experiences.

Quality & Product Economics

Define quality standards and evaluation frameworks for model-derived data in partnership with Data Science.
Determine when an AI data product is sufficiently reliable for scaled customer use.
Balance customer value, coverage, accuracy, freshness, and generation cost.
Monitor product and data performance and continuously improve quality based on customer feedback and observed outcomes.

Adoption & Monetization

Drive adoption of AI data products across Crunchbase’s customer experiences and distribution channels.
Partner with Go-to-Market on positioning, customer education, and launch strategy.
Partner with Pricing and Packaging and Sales to identify monetization opportunities.
Measure adoption, retention, expansion, revenue, and customer outcomes to determine which products to scale, improve, or retire.

What We’re Looking For

Strong product judgment across customer discovery, strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and tradeoffs.
Strong understanding of data products and how customers derive value from proprietary data and insights.
Practical understanding of modern machine learning and AI capabilities and limitations.
Working knowledge of applied data science and machine learning.
Ability to translate product requirements for Data Science and Engineering teams.
Familiarity with model evaluation concepts such as precision, recall, confidence, and model drift.
Ability to reason about probabilistic and imperfect data and define appropriate quality thresholds.
Strong analytical skills and ability to balance customer value, quality, coverage, cost, and speed.
Excellent customer discovery, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Education and Experience

3+ years of Product Management, Data Product Management, AI/ML Product Management, or comparable experience.
Experience owning customer-facing data science products from problem definition through launch and ongoing monitoring.
Experience partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience taking products from customer discovery and experimentation through scaled adoption.
Ability to define quality criteria that reflect customer needs and make informed quality and coverage tradeoffs.
Experience with B2B SaaS, data products, APIs, intelligence platforms, or commercializing differentiated data preferred.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Crunchbase launches differentiated AI data products that customers value and competitors cannot easily replicate.
AI creates valuable intelligence and coverage that would be impractical to produce through traditional data collection alone.
Customers adopt these products because they improve real workflows and decisions.
AI data products contribute measurably to adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue while meeting appropriate quality and trust standards.

Non-Goals

This is not an internal AI tooling or general AI feature role.
This is not ownership of foundational data collection, sourcing, or operations.
This is not ML research or data generation for its own sake. AI data must solve meaningful customer problems and create measurable value.

Salary range: $160,000 - $190,000

jobs.title: Research Associate 2 (Temp)
jobs.description:
About Truvian

Want to join a fast-paced, innovative company that is transforming the future of blood testing? Truvian is a healthcare technology company operating at the intersection of diagnostics and consumer technology. We have developed an automated benchtop diagnostic platform that delivers laboratory-quality results in minutes across a broad range of health tests.

Our proprietary, FDA-cleared technology is designed to make blood testing more accessible, convenient, and affordable by providing comprehensive results from a single small blood sample in minutes throughout a broad range of locations. We are continuing to advance our technology’s capabilities to further redefine point-of-care testing and bring high-quality healthcare closer to where patients need it most.

To us, our work at Truvian is more than a job – It’s a mission. We are a culture dedicated to discovery and empowerment. We are trailblazers on the path to put health information where it belongs - in the hands of the individual. We are partners in the belief that talented people, working as a team, can make every day an adventure. Come join us as we realize our vision to make routine health testing convenient, affordable, and actionable for today’s connected consumers!

Job Summary

Truvian is seeking a detail-oriented Research Associate to support optimization, verification and validation activities on Truvian’s automated diagnostic platform. This position is onsite and temporary, approximately 3 to 6 months.
This role will work both independently and as a member in a team under the supervision of senior team members to execute studies following established protocols, document experimental details, analyze data and summarize results.

This role supports cross-functional across various R&D functions including assay development, engineering, manufacturing, clinical development, quality and regulatory. The Research Associate will follow GLP and established SOPs and maintain compliance with Truvian’s quality system and design-control procedures.

This role will report to the Director, Assay Development.

Location and Work Arrangements

Location: San Diego, CA (Onsite)

This role requires regular onsite work. We welcome applications from qualified candidates; however, relocation assistance is not provided for this position. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of the office.

Visa Sponsorship

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Truvian does not currently provide visa sponsorship or support employment-based immigration petitions for this role.

Work Schedule

This position offers multiple shift and schedule opportunities. Available shifts may include First Shift and Swing Shift, with workweek schedules of Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday, or Wednesday–Sunday or an alternative workweek schedule of four 10-hour days, Sunday through Wednesday. Final shift and schedule assignments will be based on position availability and business needs.

Here’s Why You’ll Love This Job

You will directly contribute to the development and validation of innovative diagnostic products intended to expand access to actionable health information.
You will work with a collaborative, multidisciplinary team of assay scientists, chemists, engineers, data scientists, quality professionals, and manufacturing partners.
You will gain hands-on experience across the product development lifecycle, from design and optimization through verification, validation, regulatory submission, and product support.
You will thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where thoughtful experimentation, rigorous documentation, and practical problem-solving make an immediate impact.
You’ll have great perks such as:
Generous Benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision/EAP/Paid Life Insurance/LTD/401K),
Flexible vacation
Kombucha and cold brew on tap, craft coffee, a variety of healthy snacks
Onsite gym
Farm to table onsite restaurant including a 30% discount

What You Will Do

Broadly, this role is responsible for laboratory execution, data analysis, documentation, and cross-functional support for product verification and validation activities at Truvian.

This Will Require

Following established procedures and protocols to support optimization, verification and validation activities on Truvian’s automated diagnostic platform under Truvian’s design-control process.
Planning and owning the execution of assigned V&V protocols under the guidance of a supervisor or senior team member.
Performing reagent and/or sample preparations to support V&V activities.
Documenting and analyzing data using appropriate software and tools; identifying trends, anomalies, and potential sources of variability; and communicating findings to project teams and leadership.
Support troubleshooting and root-cause investigations with guidance from technical leads and management.
Document work accurately and contemporaneously following GLP and GDP in data systems, protocols, reports, work instructions, and other controlled records.
Contribute to protocol and report preparation for product development, design verification, design validation, manufacturing transfer, and regulatory submissions.
Partner with assay development, engineering, software, data science, quality, regulatory, operations, and manufacturing teams to meet project milestones and product-development timelines.
Maintain laboratory readiness, including equipment care, inventory monitoring, material traceability, and compliance with environmental health and safety requirements.
Maintain compliance with company policies, the quality management system, design controls, Good Documentation Practices, and applicable GLP requirements.
Perform other duties as assigned to support program and business needs.

What You Will Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

A bachelor’s degree in biology, chemistry, biochemistry, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 2 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience in assay development, product development, verification and validation, or a regulated diagnostics environment.
Hands-on experience with formulation, reagent preparation, biological sample preparation strongly preferred.
Experience working under design controls and within a regulated quality system for complex assays or integrated diagnostic systems.
Working knowledge of Good Documentation Practices and applicable GMP and GLP principles.
Experience executing controlled protocols, recording deviations, analyzing data, and preparing clear technical summaries or reports.
Familiarity with FDA-regulated medical devices and the 510(k) submission process is preferred.
Proficiency with standard assay laboratory equipment, including pipettes, balances, centrifuges, incubators, and plate readers or similar instrumentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with statistical analysis or data-visualization software is preferred.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple experiments and priorities while meeting established timelines.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary, fast-paced start-up environment.
A solution-oriented approach, sound laboratory judgment, and the ability to escalate risks, unexpected results, or compliance concerns promptly.

SUPERVISORY ROLE

No direct supervisory responsibility; may provide training or technical guidance to junior team members.

Compensation

$73,000 to $84,000

The salary range for this position represents the anticipated range for qualified candidates. Compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, education, training, certifications, internal equity, market data, and business needs. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined based on these factors and the requirements of the role.

Physical Demands And Abilities

Regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle small laboratory components, pipettes, samples, and equipment; reach with hands and arms; and communicate effectively.
Frequently required to sit or stand for extended periods and perform repetitive laboratory tasks requiring fine motor control.
Ability to lift and move laboratory supplies and equipment weighing up to 5 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Specific vision abilities include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
Work may involve human blood or other potentially infectious materials, chemicals, and biological reagents and requires consistent use of required personal protective equipment and exposure-control practices.

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit a cover letter along with their resume. The cover letter is an opportunity to highlight how your experience in assay and/or panel architecture aligns with our mission, your approach to technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration, and how your expertise has driven innovation in diagnostic product development and complex assay systems.

Truvian is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Truvian prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision-making, or any other legally protected status.

This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, transfers, leaves of absence, disciplinary actions, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment. Truvian is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants and employees with sincerely held religious beliefs, practices, or observances, in accordance with applicable.

In billions of syringes and in every second car worldwide, Datwyler components make an important contribution to the safety of patients and drivers. The high-tech company focuses on high-quality, system-critical elastomer components and holds leading positions in attractive global markets such as healthcare, mobility, connectivity, general industry and food & beverage. With over 25 production sites on four continents, sales in more than 100 countries and over 8,000 employees, the company, headquartered in Switzerland, generates annual sales of more than CHF 1,000 million.

Our employees are the heart of Datwyler - we treat each other with respect, trust and appreciation. We have strong roots and values that have been well established in our 100-year corporate history. Become part of our great team as a Lab Technician.

General Duties

Prepares standard and non-standard rubber test specimens, conditions them and tests them on a variety of testing machines and equipment.

Specific Duties

Molds standard and nonstandard test specimens
Performs all standard laboratory tests
Determines finished part conformance to customer and industry specifications
Determines compound conformance to customer and industry specifications
Completes special testing projects assigned by chemist and R & D manager
Makes sample for customers as requested by sales and customer service departments
Uses laboratory mixing, performing and molding equipment to make test trial formulations
Follows safety rules

Experience Required

One year in a laboratory job experience preferred

Education Required

High school diploma or equivalent

Special Skills Required

Good math skills and use of calculator
Good organizational skills needed to complete multiple test concurrently
Ability to use standard measuring tools like micrometers
Ability to read and understand technical instructions and specifications
Some clerical skill for filing records
Must read, write and speak English
Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel

Physical Requirements

Stands on tile floor up to 6 hours a day
Digital dexterity for handling and testing small specimens
Good hand-to-eye coordination and excellent mental focus required to use rubber mill
Good close vision needed to examine specimens for flaws
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds to chest height

Other Requirements

This position requires the use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee

What we offer:

$21-$23 per hour
Vacation, and Flexible Time Off
Matching 5% 401K with Roth option
Medical, Dental, Vision and other auxiliary benefit options
Company paid Life Insurance and optional Voluntary Life Insurance
Development training and opportunities for growth
Paid Holidays

Be yourself at Datwyler

We are convinced that people make the difference. At Datwyler, you will experience diversity and a wide range of career opportunities that only an international company can provide. Together, we are increasing our agility, accelerating digitalization and fostering sustainability. For motivated and talented employees, we offer interesting development opportunities with training and assignments in a global environment. With us, you can contribute with all of your creativity and all your ideas.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Our client, an innovative diagnostics company, is looking for a hands-on Research Associate / Laboratory Technician to join its R&D team. You'll support the development of novel diagnostic technologies, with a broad mix of molecular biology, nucleic acid extraction, cell culture, and electrochemical assay work.

This is a bench-focused role for someone dependable, organised, and detail-oriented who enjoys running experiments under the guidance of experienced scientists. Electrochemistry experience isn't required, as full training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

Perform DNA and cell-free DNA (cfDNA) extraction, purification, quantification, and sample preparation
Operate and maintain automated nucleic acid extraction systems (e.g. KingFisher or similar)
Support the evaluation of extraction kits and the optimisation of experimental conditions
Run nucleic acid QC using TapeStation, Bioanalyzer, Qubit, or comparable systems
Maintain mammalian cell cultures (passaging, expansion, harvesting, cryopreservation)
Prepare biological samples, reagents, buffers, and control materials
Assist with electrochemical assay experiments, including sample prep, electrode handling, and data collection (training provided)
Keep accurate records in electronic lab notebooks and follow SOPs and quality practices
Help with general lab operations, including inventory and equipment maintenance
Collaborate with scientists to meet project timelines

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, or a related field, or
equivalent hands-on lab experience
Hands-on experience in a molecular biology or biotech lab environment
Solid grounding in core lab techniques (pipetting, centrifugation, sample and reagent preparation)
Practical experience with mammalian cell culture or nucleic acid extraction, ideally both
Familiarity with SOPs and accurate experimental documentation
Strong attention to detail and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Willingness to work full-time on-site in the lab

Desirable

Industry lab experience (biotech, pharma, diagnostics, or CRO)
Experience with Thermo Fisher KingFisher platforms and magnetic bead-based extraction kits
Experience extracting DNA or cfDNA from blood, plasma, or other specimens
Experience with TapeStation, Bioanalyzer, Qubit, or similar instruments
Aseptic technique and cell line maintenance
Exposure to electrochemistry or biosensors (beneficial, not essential)

jobs.title: Sector Leader - Life Science
jobs.description:
Life Science Sector Leader

HED is looking to add an experienced person to our Sector Leadership team. The person filling this position will work alongside the National Science and Technology team, and be responsible for spearheading the design and business strategy for cutting-edge biotech facilities that enable innovation in drug development, biologics, and advanced therapies.

About HED

We are a team that is full of ideas, experience, creativity, passionate opinions, insatiable curiosity, uncompromising integrity, commitment, and skill. Our culture is about aspiration, embracing change and challenges, listening to (and learning from) each other, encouraging continual learning, and inspiring collective growth. As an inclusive, integrated architecture and engineering practice, we value the diversity of perspectives, experiences, abilities, and expertise that advance both the work we do, and the world we share.

Position Overview

This role blends technical expertise with visionary leadership to create environments that support research, manufacturing, and compliance in a rapidly evolving industry. The Life Science Sector Leader is responsible for driving the strategic vision, growth, and operational excellence of the Life Sciences design practice within the organization. This role combines leadership, business development, and technical expertise to deliver innovative, compliant, and sustainable design solutions for clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device sectors. This will be a hybrid role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the practice’s strategic plan aligned with corporate goals.
Establish design standards, best practices, and quality benchmarks for life science projects.
Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes to ensure compliance and innovation.
Develop and implement a design vision that aligns with the biotech company’s mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs.
Establish best practices for facility design that optimize flexibility, scalability, and sustainability for biotech operations.
Stay ahead of emerging trends in cell and gene therapy, biologics manufacturing, and regulatory compliance.

Business Development & Client Engagement

Partner with internal stakeholders and external collaborators to deliver world-class biotech facilities.
Lead design proposals for new labs, pilot plants, and GMP manufacturing spaces tailored to biotech needs.
Represent the company at biotech industry forums and thought leadership events.
Build and maintain strong client relationships to expand market share in the life sciences sector.
Collaborate with business development teams to identify opportunities and lead proposal efforts.
Represent the practice at industry conferences, events, and thought leadership forums.

Market Strategy & Growth

Develop and execute a comprehensive market strategy with the Science and Technology team for the life sciences sector aligned with corporate objectives.
Identify emerging trends, technologies, and regulatory changes to position the company as an industry leader.
Define target markets, service offerings, and go-to-market strategies to drive revenue growth

Technical Excellence & Project Delivery

Oversee design execution for complex biotech facilities, ensuring compliance with GMP, FDA, EMA, and global standards.
Integrate advanced technologies such as modular cleanrooms, single-use systems, and digital design tools (BIM).
Ensure designs support innovation, operational efficiency, and rapid scale-up for clinical and commercial production.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to design teams across architecture, engineering, and process disciplines.
Ensure projects meet client expectations for functionality, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness.

Team Leadership & Development

Build a High-Performing Team:
Recruit top talent with expertise in biotech facility design, including architects, engineers, and process specialists.

Mentorship & Career Growth:
Provide structured mentorship programs and individualized development plans to help team members advance their technical and leadership skills.

Foster Collaboration:
Create an environment that encourages cross-functional teamwork between design, operations, and regulatory teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Culture of Innovation:
Promote a culture that values creativity, problem-solving, and continuous improvement, ensuring the team stays ahead of biotech industry trends.

Performance Management:
Set clear goals, KPIs, and accountability measures for team members, and conduct regular performance reviews to drive excellence.

Training & Upskilling:
Implement ongoing training programs focused on GMP compliance, emerging biotech technologies, and digital design tools (e.g., BIM, Revit).

Resource Planning:
Ensure optimal allocation of resources across projects, balancing workload and maintaining efficiency.

Leadership Development:
Identify and groom future leaders within the practice to support succession planning and long-term growth.

Sector Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as the internal advocate for the life sciences sector, ensuring alignment across design, engineering, and delivery teams.
Collaborate with business leaders, practice leaders and project managers to deliver integrated solutions that meet client expectations.
Provide market insights and guidance to inform project strategies and innovation initiatives.

Financial & Operational Performance

Set and monitor sector performance metrics, including revenue, profitability, and market share.
Develop annual business plans and budgets for the sector.
Ensure compliance with corporate policies and industry regulations.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience in life sciences facility design, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Deep knowledge of GMP, FDA, EMA, and other regulatory requirements.
Proven track record in business development and client relationship management.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
Exceptional business development, client relationship, and strategic planning skills.

Experience with advanced technologies such as modular design, cleanroom systems, and sustainability practices.

Ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams in a matrix organization

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

Candidates for this role will own the day-to-day management, readiness, organization, and growth of Hivemind's Hardware-in-the-Loop and engineering laboratories. This is a highly hands-on position with direct accountability for lab operations while also building, maintaining, configuring, and troubleshooting the systems that enable software development and integration testing. We are looking for someone with relevant defense, aerospace, aviation, robotics, or comparable technical experience who brings strong asset discipline, practical technical judgment, excellent organization, and a service-oriented approach to supporting engineering teams across multiple programs.

Own daily operations and technical readiness for HIL and infrastructure laboratories, ensuring systems, workspaces, tools, documentation, and shared resources are available and ready for engineering use
Build, install, configure, inspect, and maintain HIL racks, test benches, compute systems, network equipment, storage, power distribution, simulation hardware, flight hardware, and supporting lab infrastructure
Own and maintain accurate asset control for lab and program equipment, including receiving, tagging, serial-number tracking, location, custody, configuration, calibration, maintenance, spares, and disposition records
Manage lab schedules, equipment reservations, maintenance windows, integration priorities, and competing cross-program demands in coordination with software, hardware, systems, test, and program teams
Perform wiring and fabrication tasks such as cable assembly, connector installation, crimping, soldering, continuity checks, cable routing, rack assembly, panel modification, bracket installation, and minor mechanical rework using approved procedures
Read, apply, and update wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, rack elevations, mechanical and installation drawings, cable and port maps, bills of material, work instructions, and interface-control documentation
Support software development by provisioning and restoring development and test environments, imaging computers, installing approved software, managing configurations, collecting logs, and assisting with automated lab workflows
Diagnose and resolve lab issues across power, wiring, compute, networking, software, instrumentation, and mechanical interfaces using appropriate test equipment, logs, drawings, and structured troubleshooting methods
Manage procurement coordination, incoming inspection, shipping and receiving, vendor repair activity, consumables, tool control, calibration, equipment staging, and capacity planning for lab growth and program execution
Establish, maintain, and enforce lab standards for safety, access, cybersecurity, export control, electrostatic-discharge protection, foreign-object-debris prevention, cleanliness, labeling, and configuration management
Own and maintain lab operating procedures, build records, maintenance logs, configuration baselines, status dashboards, issue trackers, and work instructions that provide traceability and support knowledge sharing
Support customer integration events, demonstrations, operational exercises, and evaluations by preparing representative lab environments, reproducing field issues, and incorporating approved updates into HIL configurations and test infrastructure

Typically requires 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting engineering laboratories, integration and test facilities, avionics, mission systems, electronics, IT infrastructure, industrial equipment, or comparable technical operations. A four-year engineering degree is not required. Relevant demonstrated experience, military service, vocational training, or technical certifications are acceptable pathways to qualification.
Hands-on experience operating or supporting engineering laboratories, integration facilities, test environments, maintenance operations, or mission systems in the defense, aerospace, aviation, robotics, manufacturing, or another mission-critical industry
Demonstrated experience assembling, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electro-mechanical equipment, test infrastructure, computing systems, electronics, or avionics hardware
Experience maintaining accountable assets, serialized hardware, inventory, tools, calibration, spares, shipping and receiving, maintenance history, or configuration records
Strong planning and organizational skills with demonstrated ability to own shared lab operations and coordinate schedules, equipment availability, maintenance activities, priorities, and dependencies across multiple teams or programs
Ability to read and work from wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, mechanical and installation drawings, rack layouts, bills of material, work instructions, and technical manuals
Competence with wiring, cable and connector work, fabrication, hand tools, digital multimeters, continuity testing, rack integration, and safe electro-mechanical troubleshooting
Comfort working with Windows- and Linux-based computers, installing and configuring software, collecting logs, documenting technical work, and communicating clearly with software and hardware engineers
Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance

A degree in engineering technology; an associate degree in electronics technology, information technology, avionics, or a related technical discipline; equivalent military or vocational training; or relevant demonstrated experience
Experience supporting HIL, SIL, VIL, avionics, flight-system, robotics, or systems-integration laboratories
Familiarity with Python, Bash, PowerShell, or another scripting language for asset records, health checks, configuration, data collection, reporting, or routine lab workflows
Experience supporting software-development or continuous-integration teams, including environment provisioning, software deployment, source control, build systems, automated testing, or test orchestration

jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory QA & Regulatory Specialist (Individual Contributor)
jobs.description:
SeqMatic is a fast-growing biotechnology services company specializing in next-generation sequencing (NGS) assays and located in the San Francisco South Bay Area. We are dedicated to translating cutting-edge genomic research into high-impact, clinical-grade genomic insights. As we advance our clinical pipelines, we are seeking an agile, highly motivated individual to serve as our foundational compliance expert, helping us build and scale our high-complexity molecular testing operations from scratch.

Job Summary

We are looking for a unique "unicorn" candidate—a Clinical Laboratory QA & Regulatory Specialist who thrives at the intersection of hands-on execution and high-level strategy. This is a full-time, in-house individual contributor role based directly in our Fremont, California laboratory. Instead of simply maintaining an existing corporate compliance program, you will actively architect, write, and scale the quality and regulatory frameworks for novel NGS-based Laboratory Developed Tests (LDTs). If you are tired of being a small cog in a massive reference testing facility and want the broad ownership of building a clinical lab's compliance infrastructure from the ground up, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Establish Compliance Infrastructure: Lead initial facility registrations and programmatic requirements to secure and maintain CLIA certification, CAP accreditation, and California state clinical laboratory licenses from the ground up.
LDT Validation Documentation: Author, organize, and compile comprehensive analytical and clinical validation packages for high-complexity NGS assays, ensuring compliance with CLIA/CAP guidelines and state frameworks.
Navigate Evolving FDA Frameworks: Interpret, strategize, and execute compliance workflows matching the FDA’s multi-phase oversight framework for Laboratory Developed Tests, including adverse event reporting, corrections, and future premarket expectations.
Own and Mature the QMS: Design, implement, and maintain a lean, scalable Quality Management System (QMS). Responsibilities include writing core SOPs, managing document control, overseeing proficiency testing (PT), coordinating training logs, and tracking CAPAs and non-conformances.
Bioinformatics & LIMS Collaboration: Partner closely with our customers and our in-house computational biology teams to document and validate clinical bioinformatics pipelines, data integrity protocols, variant filtering parameters, and LIMS workflows.
Inspection Readiness: Act as the primary technical point of contact for external audits, California CDPH inspections, and laboratory audits.

Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics, or a closely related life science discipline.
Experience: 3+ years of direct experience managing regulatory affairs, quality assurance, or high-complexity clinical operations within an active CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited molecular diagnostics laboratory.
Technical Domain Expertise: Proven, hands-on familiarity with next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows, wet lab platforms (e.g., Illumina), genomic data integrity standards, and clinical variant classification (ACMG/AMP guidelines).
LDT Regulatory Acumen: Thorough operational understanding of 42 CFR Part 493 (CLIA), CAP general and molecular checklists, California clinical laboratory laws, and the implications of the FDA’s Final Rule on LDT oversight.
Startup Mentality: Proven capability to build processes where none exist. Must be completely self-directed, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and eager to physically write the protocols and SOPs rather than delegating them.
Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and technical writing skills; able to translate highly complex legal and regulatory mandates into actionable items for scientists and engineers.

jobs.title: Staff Business Data Analyst - Quality Management System
jobs.description:
Overview

The Staff Business Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for the analytical engine of defect reduction across the Expert Network. You own the measurement system that decides what gets fixed: you design defect detection and quantification approaches, build and analyze defect funnels, isolate root causes in large operational datasets, size the customer impact of candidate fixes, and validate — statistically, not anecdotally — that improvement initiatives actually moved resolution, quality, and customer friction outcomes.

This is an analytics role with a quality mission. You will apply descriptive, diagnostic, and causal analysis to one of the richest operational datasets anywhere — AI-scored conversation data covering ~100% of customer interactions — and translate it into a prioritized, defensible improvement roadmap. The Expert Network operates as a scaled contact center environment spanning multiple BPO vendor partner sites, and this role requires real fluency in how contact center operations run: queues, routing, transfers, handle patterns, and the operating rhythms that shape customer outcomes. Structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis) are tools in your kit for driving the fixes your analysis identifies; the analysis itself is the craft. You will operate as a single-threaded owner for specific defect domains and hold cross-functional partners — service delivery, training, partner management, product, and platform teams — accountable for their share of the quality outcome using evidence they cannot argue with.

Responsibilities

Analytics Strategy & Defect Measurement
Design the measurement approach for assigned defect domains: define the defect, the opportunity base, and the DPMO (Defects Per Million Opportunities) instrumentation so every defect rate ladders directly to a customer outcome metric
Build and maintain defect funnels — quantifying defect volume, severity, and contribution to outcome degradation — and evolve the defect taxonomy as the operating environment changes (new categories, refined severity weights, expanded coverage)
Prioritize the defect backlog analytically: rank initiatives by modeled customer impact, and defend the ranking with data when it is contested
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the quality measurement architecture itself — ensuring we measure the right things, validating that our measures stay true, and pressure-testing quality markers against outcome data
Analysis, Root Cause & Outcome Validation
Analyze resolution, quality, sentiment, and customer friction signals across large operational datasets (SQL and Python/R against conversation-level and journey-level data) to identify defects and isolate root causes — moving from symptom to verified cause, not plausible narrative
Design the leading-indicator instrumentation beneath each outcome metric and monitor it for signal, drift, and regression
Validate initiative impact with appropriate rigor: pre/post analysis with controls, cohort comparison, or causal methods where the stakes demand them — and say clearly when the needle did not move and why
Partner with analytics and data science teams to evaluate, adopt, and improve AI-native quality measurement (conversation scoring, resolution scoring, customer distress detection) — including validating AI-scored metrics against human-labeled ground truth
Design and operate human in the loop (HITL) quality processes: calibration sessions, human review sampling, and ground truth labeling workflows that keep AI scoring aligned to human judgment, with clear accuracy gates before any measure goes live
From Insight to Improvement — Driving the Fix
Own the operating loop for assigned defect domains: defect detected → root cause verified → initiative launched → outcome validated → loop closed
Deploy structured improvement methods — root cause analysis, Kaizen and rapid improvement events, value stream mapping, standard work — as the delivery mechanism for what the analysis has prioritized
Translate analytical findings into technical solutions and roadmap commitments in partnership with systems and platform teams
Drive adoption and change management for the fixes, and embed the measurement disciplines (daily management, leader standard work) that keep improvements from decaying
Hold dependencies — product, platform, routing, back-office — accountable for their share of customer friction using quantified evidence and structured escalation
Data Visualization, Insights & Executive Communication
Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting that surface defect signals, track outcome metrics, and support leadership decisions — designed for action, not decoration
Present defect reduction progress and outcome movement in leadership operating mechanisms (daily huddles; weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews) with clear data storytelling for both operational and executive audiences
Communicate uncomfortable findings credibly: when the data contradicts the prevailing narrative, make the case with rigor and land it with senior stakeholders
Own the communications that accompany measurement change: release notes, rebaseline narratives, FAQs, and stakeholder briefings that explain what changed, why it changed, and what it means for the numbers leaders watch
Apply structured change management to metric rollouts and platform changes, sequencing communication, training, and adoption support so changes land without disruption or misinterpretation
AI-Native Analytics
Use modern AI tools — LLM-based assistants and agentic workflows — as a core part of the analytical workflow, accelerating defect detection, root cause analysis, and prioritization from weeks to days
Design and iterate AI-assisted workflows across the defect reduction loop, from automated signal identification to outcome tracking and reporting
Build repeatable AI-assisted playbooks for defect identification and root cause analysis that the whole team can run — making the analytical craft scalable rather than dependent on individuals
Practice responsible AI: ensure AI scoring is explainable, monitored for bias and drift, validated against human judgment, and governed with clear human oversight and escalation paths when automated measurement gets it wrong
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities relevant to quality analytics and proactively apply them to customer outcomes

Qualifications

Required

Strong hands-on analytical skills: SQL proficiency and working fluency in Python or R for analysis of large operational datasets; solid grounding in applied statistics (distributions, hypothesis testing, control charts, confidence in what a metric movement does and does not prove)
Demonstrated experience turning operational data into prioritized, quantified improvement roadmaps — and validating whether the improvements worked
Experience with defect- or rate-based measurement frameworks (DPMO or equivalent) and translating process-level defects into outcome-level impact
Experience working in, or strong working familiarity with, the contact center environment, including scaled service operations, BPO or vendor partner delivery models, and the metrics and operating cadences of contact center work
Strong communication and change management skills, with demonstrated experience landing measurement or process changes across large stakeholder groups without disruption or misinterpretation
Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and analytical products that drive leadership decisions, including with AI-powered tools
Working knowledge of structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis) and experience using them to drive fixes from analytical findings
Experience driving accountability in matrixed organizations without direct authority over execution teams
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent professional experience in operational analytics

Preferred

Experience with causal inference or experimentation methods (A/B testing, difference-in-differences, treatment-effect estimation)
Experience with Conversation Intelligence, speech/text analytics, or AI-based quality measurement systems (conversation scoring, resolution scoring)
Knowledge of back-office work management concepts — case management, work item tracking, SLA design outside live-interaction contexts
Fintech or financial services industry experience is a plus
Experience with human in the loop (HITL) evaluation programs, calibration, or ground truth labeling operations for AI scored measurement
Familiarity with responsible AI principles, including explainability, bias monitoring, and human oversight of automated decision systems
High-technology or software industry background
Change management training (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter, or equivalent)

Experience That Will Set You Up for Success

7+ years in operational analytics, quality analytics, or continuous improvement roles where the deliverable was a measurable business outcome, not a report
Owning a metric or defect domain end-to-end: instrumentation, analysis, initiative prioritization, and outcome validation — with the experience of explaining results both when the needle moved and when it did not
Working with analytics and data science teams as a peer — including designing or materially influencing the measurement frameworks you rely on
Presenting contested findings to senior stakeholders and facilitating alignment when the status quo has defenders
Driving change in dynamic environments where the operating model is evolving and business-as-usual inertia is real

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer – CAD Infrastructure Team
jobs.description:
Company

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > CPU Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm's CAD Infrastructure team develops and operates mission-critical engineering platforms used by thousands of engineers across CPU, DSP, AI, SoC, Physical Design, Verification, and Software organizations. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and scale modern web applications, automation platforms, data services, and AI-enabled solutions that improve engineering productivity across the company.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack—from intuitive front-end user experiences to highly scalable backend services, cloud-native infrastructure, data platforms, and AI-driven workflows.

You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, technical program managers, DevOps engineers, and infrastructure architects to deliver tools that are used daily by Qualcomm's engineering community.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade full stack applications used across engineering organizations.
Build modern web UIs using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Express, or similar technologies.
Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
Build and optimize large-scale data platforms leveraging SQL and NoSQL databases.
Develop automation workflows for engineering productivity, infrastructure management, analytics, and reporting.
Partner with infrastructure teams to deploy and operate applications in Kubernetes and containerized environments.
Build dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools.
Integrate AI/ML and LLM technologies into internal engineering workflows where applicable.
Drive software architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and best practices.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering excellence across the team.
Troubleshoot performance, scalability, reliability, and security issues in production environments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business and engineering requirements into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong experience building and deploying full stack web applications.
Expert-level programming skills in Python.
Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.
Experience developing modern front-end applications using React.
Experience building REST APIs and microservices.
Strong understanding of software design patterns, object-oriented programming, and distributed systems.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
Experience working in Linux environments.
Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting EDA, CAD, semiconductor design, verification, or high-performance computing environments.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, or cloud-native platforms.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar technologies.
Experience building data analytics and reporting solutions.
Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Splunk, or observability platforms.
Experience with LSF, Slurm, or distributed job scheduling systems.
Experience developing AI/LLM-powered applications and integrations.
Experience with authentication frameworks such as OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, or Active Directory.
Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.

Redux / Zustand

Material UI / AG Grid
Modern UI/UX design principles

What Success Looks Like

Deliver highly scalable platforms used by thousands of engineers.
Increase engineering productivity through automation and self-service solutions.
Improve reliability, performance, and observability of critical infrastructure services.
Lead architectural decisions for next-generation CAD infrastructure platforms.
Mentor engineers and elevate engineering standards across the organization.

Why Qualcomm CAD Infrastructure?

Join a team responsible for building the platforms that enable Qualcomm's world-class semiconductor and AI products. Your work will directly impact engineering efficiency, design productivity, and innovation across multiple generations of Snapdragon and other leading technologies.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR

Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

jobs.title: CAD Drafter
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Why We're Here

We are looking for a CAD Drafter to support our mechanical design and configuration management efforts. This role keeps our engineering data accurate and release-ready — maintaining complex assemblies and their derivative configurations, turning engineering direction into clean drawings, and keeping the engineering Bill of Materials aligned with configuration management board decisions. You will work day to day with design engineering, performance engineering, and sourcing to make sure design intent is captured correctly and new components make it into production on schedule.

What You'll Do

Maintain complex assemblies and derivative configurations of those assemblies
Conduct interference studies prior to release of assemblies
Update drawings based on direction from design and performance engineers
Place new components in assemblies
Update engineering Bill of Materials based on decisions of configuration management board
Coordinate with sourcing, design engineering, and configuration management on the cut in dates of new components and assemblies

Required Qualifications

Experience with CAD in Siemens NX.
Experience working in Siemens Teamcenter
Proficient in mechanical drawings, ASME Y14.5 GD&T.
Good mechanical intuition - excellent at understanding how components interact in larger mechanical systems
Excellent attention to detail.
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in aerospace industry
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or relevant
Experience in mechanical design of components from early conceptual phase into production
Detailed assembly stackup development.
Experience working in high volume manufacturing environment

US Salary Range

$99,000—$130,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.
