jobs.title: Staff Business Data Analyst - Quality Management System
jobs.description:
Overview

The Staff Business Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for the analytical engine of defect reduction across the Expert Network. You own the measurement system that decides what gets fixed: you design defect detection and quantification approaches, build and analyze defect funnels, isolate root causes in large operational datasets, size the customer impact of candidate fixes, and validate — statistically, not anecdotally — that improvement initiatives actually moved resolution, quality, and customer friction outcomes.

This is an analytics role with a quality mission. You will apply descriptive, diagnostic, and causal analysis to one of the richest operational datasets anywhere — AI-scored conversation data covering ~100% of customer interactions — and translate it into a prioritized, defensible improvement roadmap. The Expert Network operates as a scaled contact center environment spanning multiple BPO vendor partner sites, and this role requires real fluency in how contact center operations run: queues, routing, transfers, handle patterns, and the operating rhythms that shape customer outcomes. Structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis) are tools in your kit for driving the fixes your analysis identifies; the analysis itself is the craft. You will operate as a single-threaded owner for specific defect domains and hold cross-functional partners — service delivery, training, partner management, product, and platform teams — accountable for their share of the quality outcome using evidence they cannot argue with.

Responsibilities

Analytics Strategy & Defect Measurement
Design the measurement approach for assigned defect domains: define the defect, the opportunity base, and the DPMO (Defects Per Million Opportunities) instrumentation so every defect rate ladders directly to a customer outcome metric
Build and maintain defect funnels — quantifying defect volume, severity, and contribution to outcome degradation — and evolve the defect taxonomy as the operating environment changes (new categories, refined severity weights, expanded coverage)
Prioritize the defect backlog analytically: rank initiatives by modeled customer impact, and defend the ranking with data when it is contested
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the quality measurement architecture itself — ensuring we measure the right things, validating that our measures stay true, and pressure-testing quality markers against outcome data
Analysis, Root Cause & Outcome Validation
Analyze resolution, quality, sentiment, and customer friction signals across large operational datasets (SQL and Python/R against conversation-level and journey-level data) to identify defects and isolate root causes — moving from symptom to verified cause, not plausible narrative
Design the leading-indicator instrumentation beneath each outcome metric and monitor it for signal, drift, and regression
Validate initiative impact with appropriate rigor: pre/post analysis with controls, cohort comparison, or causal methods where the stakes demand them — and say clearly when the needle did not move and why
Partner with analytics and data science teams to evaluate, adopt, and improve AI-native quality measurement (conversation scoring, resolution scoring, customer distress detection) — including validating AI-scored metrics against human-labeled ground truth
Design and operate human in the loop (HITL) quality processes: calibration sessions, human review sampling, and ground truth labeling workflows that keep AI scoring aligned to human judgment, with clear accuracy gates before any measure goes live
From Insight to Improvement — Driving the Fix
Own the operating loop for assigned defect domains: defect detected → root cause verified → initiative launched → outcome validated → loop closed
Deploy structured improvement methods — root cause analysis, Kaizen and rapid improvement events, value stream mapping, standard work — as the delivery mechanism for what the analysis has prioritized
Translate analytical findings into technical solutions and roadmap commitments in partnership with systems and platform teams
Drive adoption and change management for the fixes, and embed the measurement disciplines (daily management, leader standard work) that keep improvements from decaying
Hold dependencies — product, platform, routing, back-office — accountable for their share of customer friction using quantified evidence and structured escalation
Data Visualization, Insights & Executive Communication
Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting that surface defect signals, track outcome metrics, and support leadership decisions — designed for action, not decoration
Present defect reduction progress and outcome movement in leadership operating mechanisms (daily huddles; weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews) with clear data storytelling for both operational and executive audiences
Communicate uncomfortable findings credibly: when the data contradicts the prevailing narrative, make the case with rigor and land it with senior stakeholders
Own the communications that accompany measurement change: release notes, rebaseline narratives, FAQs, and stakeholder briefings that explain what changed, why it changed, and what it means for the numbers leaders watch
Apply structured change management to metric rollouts and platform changes, sequencing communication, training, and adoption support so changes land without disruption or misinterpretation
AI-Native Analytics
Use modern AI tools — LLM-based assistants and agentic workflows — as a core part of the analytical workflow, accelerating defect detection, root cause analysis, and prioritization from weeks to days
Design and iterate AI-assisted workflows across the defect reduction loop, from automated signal identification to outcome tracking and reporting
Build repeatable AI-assisted playbooks for defect identification and root cause analysis that the whole team can run — making the analytical craft scalable rather than dependent on individuals
Practice responsible AI: ensure AI scoring is explainable, monitored for bias and drift, validated against human judgment, and governed with clear human oversight and escalation paths when automated measurement gets it wrong
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities relevant to quality analytics and proactively apply them to customer outcomes

Qualifications

Required

Strong hands-on analytical skills: SQL proficiency and working fluency in Python or R for analysis of large operational datasets; solid grounding in applied statistics (distributions, hypothesis testing, control charts, confidence in what a metric movement does and does not prove)
Demonstrated experience turning operational data into prioritized, quantified improvement roadmaps — and validating whether the improvements worked
Experience with defect- or rate-based measurement frameworks (DPMO or equivalent) and translating process-level defects into outcome-level impact
Experience working in, or strong working familiarity with, the contact center environment, including scaled service operations, BPO or vendor partner delivery models, and the metrics and operating cadences of contact center work
Strong communication and change management skills, with demonstrated experience landing measurement or process changes across large stakeholder groups without disruption or misinterpretation
Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and analytical products that drive leadership decisions, including with AI-powered tools
Working knowledge of structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis) and experience using them to drive fixes from analytical findings
Experience driving accountability in matrixed organizations without direct authority over execution teams
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent professional experience in operational analytics

Preferred

Experience with causal inference or experimentation methods (A/B testing, difference-in-differences, treatment-effect estimation)
Experience with Conversation Intelligence, speech/text analytics, or AI-based quality measurement systems (conversation scoring, resolution scoring)
Knowledge of back-office work management concepts — case management, work item tracking, SLA design outside live-interaction contexts
Fintech or financial services industry experience is a plus
Experience with human in the loop (HITL) evaluation programs, calibration, or ground truth labeling operations for AI scored measurement
Familiarity with responsible AI principles, including explainability, bias monitoring, and human oversight of automated decision systems
High-technology or software industry background
Change management training (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter, or equivalent)

Experience That Will Set You Up for Success

7+ years in operational analytics, quality analytics, or continuous improvement roles where the deliverable was a measurable business outcome, not a report
Owning a metric or defect domain end-to-end: instrumentation, analysis, initiative prioritization, and outcome validation — with the experience of explaining results both when the needle moved and when it did not
Working with analytics and data science teams as a peer — including designing or materially influencing the measurement frameworks you rely on
Presenting contested findings to senior stakeholders and facilitating alignment when the status quo has defenders
Driving change in dynamic environments where the operating model is evolving and business-as-usual inertia is real

jobs.description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.  
  
Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

As a leader at Sunrun, you’ll bring our leadership principles to life by creating the experience, leading by example, and communicating well & often. You’ll lead by example to integrate AI tools into your daily routines and champion the responsible adoption of AI. Empower your team to explore these tools and build AI skills to improve efficiency and decision quality in their work. You’ll keep score to drive results, develop people to help them grow, and build a deliberate safety-focused culture where our values shine: We Love People, We Love to Create, and We Love to Run. Most importantly, you’ll attract and retain top talent to help Sunrun build the best team on the planet. Together, we run.

### **POSITION SUMMARY**

Sunrun is the undisputed leader in residential clean energy, pioneering the multi-billion-dollar solar-as-a-subscription asset class. We don’t just install solar hardware; we originate, scale, and manage a decentralized energy infrastructure network. By transforming residential roofs into networked virtual power plants and intelligent grid assets, Sunrun is fundamentally rewriting the mechanics of whole-home electrification and energy distribution. Our organization thrives on high-velocity commercial performance, disciplined operational scaling, and an unwavering commitment to maintaining the absolute best talent engine in the climate-tech sector. For executive revenue leaders, Sunrun offers the complexity of an enterprise infrastructure business paired with the agility of a high-growth platform.

We are seeking a highly technical, efficiency-minded Senior Manager of Data Science & Analytics to lead, reshape, and scale our business intelligence and analytics functions.

Currently, 20 to 30 analysts are embedded across various business units. You will serve as the single point of leadership to centralize this function, streamline the organization, and uplevel the team.

You will be responsible for defining what analytics should be built across Sunrun and how to scale them. This includes leading the rollout of Sunrun’s core Data Hub and centralized SQL layer—establishing metric definitions, governance, and scoring standardizations across the entire company.

The ideal candidate brings experience from leading Tech environments (e.g., Meta, Stripe, fast-scaling consumer tech startups) where data directly drives revenue, customer impact, and operational efficiency in fast-moving, unstructured settings.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Organizational Strategy, Centralization & Scale

* Unify & Streamline: Transition 20–30 distributed analysts across the business into a centralized, high-performing analytics org. Lead necessary org restructuring (streamlining down and upleveling capability) to build a lean, high-bar team.
* Thrive in Ambiguity: Build structure where none exists—design agile workflows, intake models, and clear prioritization frameworks to balance executive requests with scalable data products.
* Culture & Mentorship: Elevate analytical talent through hands-on technical coaching, career development, and setting a high technical bar for business intelligence.

Data Hub, SQL Layer & Metric Standardization

* Build the SQL Layer: Partner with Data Engineering on Sunrun's centralized Data Hub initiative. Own the enterprise SQL semantic layer, establishing canonical metrics, labeling standards, and standardized business definitions across all departments.
* Business Scoring & Frameworks: Design unified scoring models and frameworks across sales, consumer acquisition, and operational touchpoints to evaluate business performance accurately.
* Scalable Analytics Architecture: Architect reporting frameworks that scale—moving the company away from ad-hoc spreadsheets toward standardized, automated data products.

Business Partnership & Measurable Impact (Sales & Consumer)

* Drive Commercial Growth: Work closely with Sales, Consumer Experience, and Operations leaders to deliver actionable insights that directly move the needle on unit economics, sales funnel conversion, and customer LTV.
* Focus on Applied Analytics: Deliver practical, high-impact business analytics rather than theoretical or pure R&D data science.
* Executive Storytelling: Translate complex multidimensional data into clear executive dashboards, key performance metrics, and operational recommendations for executive leadership.

### **REQUIREMENTS (EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, CERTIFICATIONS, AND OTHER SKILLS)**

  

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Applied Data Science, with 3+ years in a team lead or management role overseeing analysts.
* Tech Background: Proven track record at Big Tech (Meta, Stripe, etc.) or high-growth tech startups known for best-in-class data cultures.
* Technical Rigor:
  + Exceptional, expert-level SQL skills and deep understanding of data warehousing architecture (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).
  + Hands-on experience

**Job Overview**

Under supervision, the Stem Cell Research Associateassists with generating and analyzing human stem cell derived products. The incumbent will perform routine maintenance of human embryonic and induced pluripotent stem cells and their differentiated progeny, using established protocols; CRISPR genome editing and routine differentiation of these cells towards a variety of human cells, using established protocols; standard molecular biology tools to transfect, lentivirally infect and electroporate cells, isolate RNA, DNA and protein from cells, and characterize gene expression by Western blot, and rt-qPCR, using standard kits and procedures. Incumbent will also assist in immunocytochemistry and fluorescence microscopy characterization of cells. Incumbent also performs molecular biology and biochemical assays as needed. Other tasks will be as assigned by the supervisor. Incumbent will also be involved with general lab organization procedures.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Theoretical and/or practical knowledge in cellular and molecular biology, immunology, stem cell or related field.
* Demonstrated experience in mammalian cell culture and aseptic/sterile technique, including media preparation, passaging, and cryopreservation.
* Demonstrated experience with human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) culture under feeder-free conditions.
* Demonstrated experience with immunofluorescence, flow cytometry, and fluorescence microscopy.
* Experience in molecular and cellular biology including: RNA/DNA isolation, PCR, gel electrophoresis, Real-time PCR, and genetic manipulations techniques such as CRISPR/Cas9-mediated technology.
* Experience performing repetitive and specialized laboratory experimental procedures and following experimental protocols.
* Excellent organization skills, sufficient to multi-task in an extremely fast-paced environment with constant changing priorities. Skill to plan and organize work assignments in an efficient and productive manner.
* Ability to quickly learn new laboratory procedures and adapt lessons from one learning episode to similar situations. Ability to maintain a high level of motivation to contribute to cutting edge research, and seek and learn new experimental methods as required.
* Demonstrated skill in the preparation of reagents and maintenance of laboratory stocks.
* Demonstrated ability to keep clear, detailed, accurate and organized data records.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a research team.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with directed differentiation and/or 3D organoid culture,including Matrigel/ECM handling and air-liquid interface culture.
* Experience reprogramming somatic cells (e.g., PBMC and skin fibroblast) into iPSCs using established Sendai virus or episomal methods.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Data Science / Modeling & Informatics
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
Our multi-disciplinary Research and Development organization combines state-of-the-art resources with world-class expertise in therapeutic discovery and development. We are inspired by the belief that a research-driven enterprise dedicated to scientific excellence can create medicines and vaccines that save and improve lives. Grounded in a culture of respect, invention, and collaboration, our organization offers a dynamic environment where you can build on a proud legacy of scientific breakthroughs while advancing your career.
  
  
Modeling and Informatics (M&I) is an inclusive group of approximately 50 computational chemists and data scientists within our global Discovery Chemistry organization. With a strong track record of pipeline impact, we apply cutting-edge capabilities in structure-based modeling and predictive science to advance drug design and development worldwide. With an unbiased approach to drug modalities, in-house access to the newest screening techniques, and world-class medicinal chemistry, we have a wealth of opportunities to impact our pipeline and ultimately save and improve patient lives.
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional, highly motivated computational scientist to join our Research Laboratories in South San Francisco, California. The ideal candidate combines strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills with deep expertise across AI/ML, computer science, biophysics, and computational chemistry, alongside a passion for applying innovative methods to complex scientific challenges. This role focuses on building algorithms, tools, and workflows that integrate predictive modeling, agentic scientific reasoning, and physics-based insight. The successful candidate will contribute to next-generation systems that reason across miltiple data sources, critically evaluate molecular hypotheses, and continuously learn from experimental feedback throughout the Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Develop novel AI/ML algorithms and computational methods for representation, prediction, generation, reasoning, and decision-making, including methods that can serve as components of AI co-scientist and autonomous molecular-design systems.
* Rigorously evaluate AI/ML methods against appropriate computational and experimental benchmarks, with an emphasis on scientific validity, uncertainty, robustness, appropriate baselines, failure modes, and prospective utility.
* Develop and apply modern deep-learning approaches for molecular discovery that combine machine learning with physical and biophysical understanding of molecular systems, including molecular interactions, conformational energetics, thermodynamics, kinetics, solvation, molecular recognition, and structure-function relationships.
* Develop agentic workflows that integrate predictive models, scientific tools, experimental data, simulations, structural information, SAR, and scientific literature to generate and critically evaluate molecular hypotheses.
* Collaborate directly with medicinal and computational chemistry project teams to apply AI/ML and computational approaches to molecular design, SAR interpretation, hypothesis generation, and experimental prioritization.
* Build reproducible scientific methods and workflows, pilot new approaches on active drug-discovery programs, and collaborate with colleagues to deploy successful methods across computational environments and integrate them into broader discovery platforms.
* Conduct innovative research in computational chemistry, computer science, biophysical chemistry, and molecular modeling relevant to drug discovery, and contribute to the internal and external scientific community through publications and presentations.
* Mentor scientists and help expand organizational capabilities in data-driven molecular design, computational methodology, and scientific reasoning.

**NOTE:** This role involves in-person collaborations and is an on-site position located at our research laboratories in South San Francisco, CA. This is NOT a remote role.
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
**Education:**

jobs.title: Project Environmental Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

APTIM is seeking a **Project Environmental Data Analyst** that will work exclusively on a Key Client National Account to manage client and vendor data sets presented in various formats and turn them into reliable datasets, project databases, and useful Power BI Dashboards. The Environmental Data Analyst will work with project managers and technical specialists to understand reporting needs, recommend meaningful metrics and trend analyses, evaluate data workflows, and independently build and maintain tools from initial requirements through ongoing use. The successful candidate will have advanced Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to deliver accurate, understandable information that supports client reporting and project decisions. Environmental data and AI experience are valued but are not required.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**

* Partner with project managers and technical specialists to define reporting objectives, identify relevant metrics and trends, and translate project questions into practical data tools and dashboards.
* Demonstrate expertise in data management, automation, and interactive business intelligence to transform multiple streams of raw data into automated reporting formats.
* Combine, clean, standardize, and reconcile data across multiple Microsoft Excel workbooks, client data exports, vendor reports, and project databases; resolve inconsistent identifiers, formats, dates, units, duplicate records, and missing information.
* Analyze datasets across sites, reporting periods, and data sources to identify trends, discrepancies, exceptions, and opportunities for improvement; explain findings and data limitations to the project team.
* Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query transformations, data models, relationships, DAX measures, filters, and clear visualizations tailored to client needs.
* Evaluate existing data collection and reporting workflows; develop repeatable Excel and Power Query processes that reduce manual work and improve consistency and timeliness.
* Build and maintain project databases and structured datasets, including tables, unique identifiers, relationships, validation rules, and data dictionaries that support reliable analysis and reporting.
* Validate calculations and dashboard results against source records; document reconciliation checks, assumptions, and unresolved exceptions, and coordinate technical interpretation with environmental specialists.
* Own ongoing tool maintenance, including data refreshes, troubleshooting, updates, and change testing to ensure accuracy.
* Manage assigned data deliverables across the program's datasets, estimate effort, meet agreed schedules, and communicate priorities and issues with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, data management, and support of tools used by project teams or clients.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, data validation, Power Query, and combining and reconciling data across workbooks.
* Demonstrated Power BI development experience including data preparation, relational modeling, DAX calculations, report design, publishing, and maintaining refresh processes in Power BI Service.
* Ability to translate loosely defined reporting needs into working solutions, organize concurrent assignments, document methods, and explain results clearly to nontechnical users.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with environmental or EHS data, such as hazardous waste, stormwater, inspection findings, compliance tracking, or sustainability metrics; experience supporting consulting or client project delivery.
* SQL querying skills and experience with database platforms or environmental data management systems.
* Experience with Power Automate, VBA, Python, or similar tools to automate data preparation and reporting.
* Project management experience, including coordinating with cross-functional teams, managing schedules and deliverables, communicating risks and priorities, and supporting account managers to deliver successful client project execution.
* Experience applying AI tools to data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, or workflow automation, with validation of outputs and appropriate protection of client information.

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

What you can expect from APTIM:

* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development

Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

jobs.title: Medical Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**WE ARE HIRING!**

Do you have experience working in a medical laboratory or clinical setting? Are you detail-oriented and committed to maintaining high standards for accuracy, safety, and patient care? Are you interested in working at a community health clinic with great benefits?

If you can answer **YES!** to the questions above, this might be the job for you! Read on to learn more...

WHAT WOULD I BE DOING AT THIS JOB?

American Indian Health & Services is looking for a **Medical Lab Technician** to join our growing public health primary care outpatient clinic. This position performs routine medical laboratory testing that supports the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease and assists with the operation of a moderate-complexity medical laboratory.

**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt, Hourly  
**Status:** Full Time, On-site  
**Schedule:** Monday-Friday; during clinic hours  
**Pay:** $35 - $42 per hour  
**Reports To:** Medical Clinic Supervisor

Please note that this is the current salary range for the position. Starting pay rates are determined based on years of experience and internal equity.

The essential functions of the job include:

* Performing routine technical laboratory functions.
* Reporting test results to providers and/or nurses in accordance with clinic protocols.
* Supporting quality control in specimen collection, ensuring appropriate sampling, and maintaining accurate records.
* Setting up, maintaining, calibrating, cleaning, and testing the sterility of medical laboratory equipment.
* Maintaining laboratory equipment and supplies.
* Monitoring supply inventory, anticipating laboratory needs, and partnering with the Finance Department to procure and order necessary supplies.
* Complying with laboratory policies and OSHA requirements related to safety, cleanliness, and infection control.
* Participating in quality management and improvement meetings and projects.
* Developing and maintaining quality management measures for the laboratory.
* Maintaining a general understanding of laboratory tests performed in the clinic, including their purpose and the basic interpretation of normal and abnormal result ranges.
* Under the guidance of a provider and in accordance with clinic protocols, communicating positive and negative test results to patients.
* Performing routine medical assistant duties as needed.
* Performing other duties as assigned.

WHAT KIND OF EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERIENCE DO I NEED?

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Two years of medical laboratory or medical assistant experience.
* Two years of laboratory technician or phlebotomy experience.
* Certified Laboratory Technician or Certified Phlebotomist preferred.
* Knowledge of medical laboratory principles, standards, applications, and tests.
* Knowledge of laboratory safety, cleanliness, and infection-control requirements.
* Knowledge of laboratory equipment use and maintenance.
* Ability to perform work accurately and thoroughly.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency using computers and electronic medical records.
* Ability to maintain patient, employee, and organizational confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, anticipate problems, and identify solutions.
* Ability to remain flexible, collaborate as part of a team, and complete assignments in stressful situations.
* Spanish bilingual skills preferred, but not required.

PHYSICAL AND WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

This position regularly requires the employee to use their hands, reach with their hands and arms, and communicate verbally. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit and may occasionally be required to stoop or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. The position also requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

The employee may be exposed to infectious substances, hazardous chemicals, hazardous waste, and moving equipment. These risks are minimized through compliance with established safety policies and procedures. The noise level in the work environment is generally moderate.

Clinic employees may be required to remain at or report to work during public health incidents or emergencies. This may require a non-traditional schedule or duties outside the employee’s normal assignment during the incident or emergency.

We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Medical Lab Technician who is committed to quality, safety, teamwork, and serving patients in a community health setting.

jobs.title: PT Laboratory Technician, Limited Term
jobs.description:
The Lab Technician is a non-exempt, part-time staff position that reports to the Principal Investigator (PI)/Assistant Professor of Pharmacy Rinker Campus. This assignment is limited-term and may be considered for renewal based on available funding.
  
  
The PI is looking for a research technician with experience in molecular biology, cell culture, and laboratory mouse work, to participate in an NIH-funded project. The successful candidate will conduct in vivo experiments in mouse models, analyze mouse tissue at a molecular level, and present data. The candidate will need to be methodical when carrying out duties and generate reports to submit to the laboratory PI.
  
  
The job is on-site at Chapman University School of Pharmacy, in Irvine, California.
  
  
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Responsibilities

* Perform mouse handling, tattooing, tail sampling, and genotyping.
* Determine mouse body temperature (rectal thermometry).
* Mouse blood collection, mouse behavior analysis, mouse organ dissection, thyroidectomy and mouse brain sectioning.
* Perform laboratory experiments in line with standard testing procedures.
* Perform histology sample preparation and confocal microscopy.
* Perform PCR, Western blot, and other techniques of molecular biology as needed.
* Maintain mammalian cell lines. Perform bacterial transformation and plasmid purification.
* Conduct laboratory experiments and procedures using established protocols, and assist with troubleshooting technical issues under the guidance provided by the PI.
* Assist with refining and optimizing laboratory procedures and workflows based on experimental observations and outcomes.
* Compile, organize, and summarize experimental data for review and discussion with the PI and research team.
* Help with lab supplies ordering and with lab maintenance.
* Set up, operate, clean, sterilize, maintain, and calibrate laboratory equipment.
* Procure, receive, label, and/or maintain chemicals or laboratory supplies.
* Ensure that safety guidelines are always adhered to in the laboratory.
* Organize and store all chemical substances, fluids, and compressed gases according to safety instructions

Required Qualifications

* Proven experience working in a laboratory.
* Proven practical experience with techniques of molecular biology.
* Proven experience working with rodents and genotyping rodents
* Working experience with cell lines and/or primary culture
* Proficient in research methods, testing, and data collection, analysis, evaluation, report writing, independent discretion, and judgment. Comfortable handling potentially dangerous substances (flammable liquids, biohazards, etc.)
* Ability to work autonomously and in a timely manner to meet deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Desired Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related field
* Experience in Western blot, transfection, transformation.
* Experience in histology, confocal microscopy, mouse behavior analysis, mouse body temperature (rectal thermometry).

Special Instructions to Applicants

Our products are designed to detect minimal residual disease (MRD) and recurrence at the earliest timepoints, enable selection of targeted therapies based on ultra-comprehensive genomic profiling, and enhance biomarker strategy for drug development. **Shift Available:**

  

* Tues-Sat 10pm - 6:30am

Training hours may be different from your shift schedule. The PM and 3rd shift would be eligible for an additional shift premium.

**Summary:**

A Lead Clinical Lab Scientist performs and reports on clinical laboratory testing that aids physicians in diagnosing and treating patients. A key part of the role is helping supervise team members and ensuring that all laboratory procedures are followed for specimen handling, next-generation sequencing (NGS) processes, test analyses, and the accurate maintenance of patient records.  
  
In our lab, we foster a positive, friendly, and team-based environment. We all pitch in to achieve our common goals and support each other. You'll work in a dynamic atmosphere, with opportunities to gain hands-on experience at multiple benches, including extractions, library preparation, and sequencing. You'll also partner with our lab assistants to coordinate pre-analytical and post-analytical tasks.

* + Extractions
  + Library Preparation
  + Enrichments

* Execute LIMS entry and review signoffs.
* Select, implement, and evaluate quality control materials for statistical process control of laboratory assays.
* Troubleshoot assays and equipment when quality control materials fail to perform as expected.

* Identify and correct problems that may negatively affect test performance or result reporting. If a problem cannot be immediately corrected, notify a supervisor, clinical consultant, or director.

jobs.title: Clinical Lab Scientist Supervisor 2
jobs.description:
Job Function Summary:

Involves testing on clinical specimens for information about the health of a patient, for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease. Disciplines include chemistry, blood banking, hematology, microbiology, immunology, cytology, histology, pathology and cytogenetics. May include highly technical sub- specialty areas such as enzyme assay, steroid assay, radioimmunoassay, toxicology, electrophoresis, rheumatology, tissue typing, and virology.

This position supervises employees in a high volume, highly technical subspeciality laboratory – the mohs lab. The scope of responsibilities for this individual includes both administrative and technical duties. The individual oversees the daily operations of the laboratory including: processing, embedding, sectioning, staining, and preparation of tissue specimen into slides. Exemplary attention to detail and the ability to multi-task is a must. Success in this position requires a firm understanding of workflow management to maximize the efficiency of the staff and laboratory processes. The individual acts as a technical resource for all staff personnel and must have a breadth of knowledge regarding the processes involved in receiving and handling of tissue specimens for histological examination. Furthermore, the incumbent must possess the technical skill to perform, demonstrate to and train laboratory staff in the histological preparation of tissue specimens according to all standard operating procedures established by the department and accrediting organizations. The individual will supervise staff at 3 main locations: Mt. Zion Derm, BOPC, and Bayfront. The individual in this role will also collaborate with other department nurse managers to oversee lab licensure and compliance for other dermatology clinic sites that roll up through the department’s leadership. Flexibility to orient and work at all UCSF Health ambulatory locations is a requirement for this role.

  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in a natural science and/or equivalent experience/training
* At least 5 years of work experience in a mohs lab or a related field (pathology lab) with at least 3 years as a mohs technician, processing tissue specimens in a high-volume laboratory or academic medical center environment or combination thereof
* At least two years of experience as a mohs lab supervisor
* Experience with successfully completing lab licensure and accreditation surveys
* Experience performing complex laboratory procedures following established protocols
* Strong interpersonal skills to create and maintain a climate for effective communication and collaboartive decision making. Able to convey information with authority, handle highly sensitive matters, and interact with high level contacts from other departments/organizations
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to explain technical specialty concepts thoroughly
* Strong leadership, fiscal, and operations management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, management, and staff from all disciplines
* Ability to create and maintain a goal-oriented climate of teamwork, collaboration, and consistent achievement of objectives
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to quickly analyze problems, determine the appropriate level of intervention, and develop and apply effective solutions
* Highly devleoped personal organizational skills
* Proven ability to organize staff and tasks, manage mulitple priorities/projects through completion and on schedule, oversee multiple locations, and delegate work functions in an efficient and effective manner in a complex and challenging environment
* Flexibility to adjust to constantly changing priorities
* Strong knowledge of human resources management policies, with the ability to train, monitor, evaluate, and document human resources issues and performance
* Demonstrated knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements as it pertains to labs and processing tissue specimens, as well as related legislative, accreditation, licensing, and compliance environments
* Maintains current knowledge of laboratory concepts, new methodologies, relevant industry/regulatory compliance, accreditation requirements, medical center health and safety guidelines, and advances in the field of specimen processing, automation, and procedures
* Strong knowledge of quality assurance methods and ability to apply principles to design quality systems
* Ability to use laboratory applications/clinical softwares/databases/dashboards. Skills to perform data checks using queries, visual review, and other appropriate means to verify data accuracy
  

PREFERRED QUALIFOIICATIONS

* Experience in large academic medical setting and ambulatory care
* Experience using EMR-EPIC/APeX
  

REQUIRED LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS

* ASCP Histotechnologist

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. **POSITION: SCRIBE/CLINICAL RESEARCH ASSISTANT**

**DEPARTMENT: HEMOPHILIA TREATMENT CENTER**

**REPORTS TO:** HTC Director, Hemophilia Treatment Center

**FLSA STATUS:** Non-exempt

**About the Role**

Join the Hemophilia Treatment Center at Luskin Orthopaedic Institute for Children as a Scribe/Clinical Research Assistant, a role that splits your time between two connected worlds: clinical documentation and clinical research.

About half your time will be spent supporting HTC physicians with the administrative side of patient care, including documenting in the electronic medical record. The other half will be spent supporting research coordination within the HTC. You will be part of the clinical care team, working closely with medical assistants, residents and attending physicians, under the supervision of the HTC Director, clinical staff and the Research Coordinator.

**What you Will do**

**Clinical Documentation (about 50% of your time)**

* Document history and physical findings in the electronic medical record.
* Follow up on laboratory and x-ray results and page consults.
* Assist with patient admissions, transfers and discharges.
* Assist with chart auditing, both real-time and retrospective: review physicians' charts and procedure notes for completeness and return incomplete charts to physicians.

**Clinical Research Support (about 50% of your time)**

* Assist with study coordination, including participant scheduling and completion of protocol-required procedures.
* Collect and report data accurately and promptly in line with applicable laws, institutional policies and study protocols.
* Complete case report forms, maintain source documentation and resolve queries.
* Participate in and help manage monitoring visits.
* Handle study drug accountability.
* Collect, process and ship specimens.
* Enter clinic data into secure databases in a timely, organized way, and keep IRB applications up to date.
* Help ensure the coordinator attends pertinent clinics and obtains the paperwork and measurements needed for patients who qualify for the physicians' studies.
* Stay current with the literature on your projects' topics and propose new areas of investigation when relevant.

Other duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a science-related field from a regionally accredited institution.
* Prior scribe experience.
* Detailed knowledge of medical terminology, with the ability to distinguish different exams and diagnoses and to read patient chart entries accurately.
* Demonstrated ability to record information accurately and on time in the EMR, study records and research data forms.
* Demonstrated knowledge of good clinical practices (GCP) for clinical research as defined by the FDA.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the research process for clinical trials and studies, including IRB procedures and data management.
* Prior experience with various methods of data collection.
* Proficiency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and basic database software, including prior experience with Windows programs, particularly Excel and Access.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Interpersonal skills to work professionally with patients, families/guardians, physicians, administrators, colleagues and sponsor representatives.
* Ability to handle confidential material with strict confidentiality.
* Ability to proofread very detailed material, organize and track multiple records and requests, and follow through on time.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and to perform under pressure, frequent interruptions and distractions.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule that includes evenings and weekends.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of E/M codes and the documentation level required for each billing level.
* Cerner and EPIC EMR experience.

Full time position: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm

jobs.title: Clinical Research Assistant- Chico
jobs.description:
Come and join our team! We are a local growing private medical practice specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of patients with diseases of the retina and vitreous. We are looking for individuals who would like to establish a career in healthcare working with nationally recognized physicians. We provide on the job training giving you the ability to grow and advance your skills along with gaining innovative knowledge. Established in 1977, we have locations all over Northern California including Sacramento, Grass Valley, Roseville, Stockton, Modesto, Merced, Fairfield, Elk Grove, Folsom, Yuba City and Chico. Our physicians are nationally known, and we continue to be on the leading edge of retina care by utilizing the latest equipment and both participating in and designing new clinical trials to advance the state of care for retinal diseases. Join 250+ other team members working for our nationally recognized retina specialty practice in a fast paced, high volume medical office. We are currently participating in several trials at two of our office locations and have a growing clinical research department.

The research assistant is primarily responsible for assisting in research patient visits according to ICH-GCP guidelines and according to the IRB-approved study protocol and/or manual of procedures. Day-to-day activities may include all or some of the essential functions listed below, depending upon individual experience / knowledge and the needs of the organization which are subject to change from time to time.

  

We seek a full-time clinical research assistant to support our clinical research department. Although you must be able to work independently, you will be working directly with physicians, patients, research coordinators, clinical and business office staff and with pharmaceutical sponsor representatives to correctly and efficiently execute clinical research protocols. Collaboration and being a team player are essential to the success of this role.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and schedule subject visits within study/subject specific windows per protocol guidelines.
* Prepare visit-specific documentation and charts for Clinical Research Coordinator
* Observe Coordinator in patient care and management
* Assist Coordinator in monitoring subject flow and assist in subject care and management
* Observe, assist, collect and record all necessary data for follow up
* Transcribe subject study information from source documents to the Electronic Case Report Forms
* Administer all mandatory questionnaires to study subjects
* Set up, prepare subject, and conduct electrocardiograms (ECG) on subjects as required per study protocol

Design challenging, realistic software engineering tasks based on professional experience, including scenarios, specifications, codebases, tests, logs, API contracts, and design notes.

Built on a strong foundation of collaboration and a people-first culture, RSI is known for being easy to work with and delivering results through long-term partnerships.

RSI is part of a family of companies unified by purpose to deliver safe, reliable solutions to our clients’ unique challenges. We are committed to providing technically superior service, adding value at every stage, and leaving things better than we found them.

Job Summary:

This office and field position requires advanced knowledge in the areas of science and/or engineering obtained through specialized intellectual instruction and requires the ability to work independently on assignments requiring the consistent exercise of discretion and judgment to analyze, interpret or make deductions based on varying facts or circumstances. This position is primarily responsible for supporting the planning, selection, coordination and implementation of scientific and engineering services to fully address the scope of work on construction projects in accordance with Company standards, regulatory criteria, and contractual obligations. This position also supports the preparation and implementation of parts of a design, specifications, shop drawings, submittals, and RFIs under the supervision of experienced engineers.

Requirements And Education:

Independently or as part of a team, prepare engineering calculations, review drawings and specifications as well as reports and plans
Analyze and interpret construction, site, and material data
Perform cross-disciplinary safety/quality, project controls, procurement and contracts, and estimating duties as assigned
Report to the site and conduct field construction, engineering, and other miscellaneous field support services
Maintain budget and schedule for assigned tasks
Apply industry standards of practice for designs and specifications, adhering to regulatory codes, building codes, national/ local standards, and company policies and SOPs
As directed, report to the field to perform and/or inspect or observe fieldwork, and review work of personnel, subcontractors and consultants to ensure compliance with approved plans and acceptable tolerances
Complete related documentation (field reports, logs, meeting minutes, online submittal sites), in a timely and accurate manner
Complete engineering calculations in determination of site conditions and in support of design and specifications
Coordinates all aspects of civil engineering reports, submittals, designs and specifications with the client
Help select and procure subcontractors and materials – including preparing scopes of work
Maintain submittal log, inventory logs, and RFI logs
Support development of change logs and modification to cost proposals

Requirements And Education:

This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Management or related field from an accredited institution; a minimum of 48 hours of engineering, science (i.e., physics) and higher mathematics (calculus, differential and integral calculus, linear algebra, statistics) course work is required.
Equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted for this requirement.
A minimum of 2-4 years of experience required; two years or more of progressively responsible experience performing civil design and construction, field engineering support, or quality control on civil upgrade projects.
HAZWOPER 40 Hour Certification with current 8 Hour Refresher preferred.
Engineer-in-training professional certification preferred or ability to obtain during tenure in this position

Preferred Experience:

Able to apply basic knowledge of general scientific and engineering principles and analytical tools, as directed
Able to apply education of civil processes, design and construction technologies as directed
Implement Federal environmental regulations, DoD guidelines, OSHA standards, and Safety protocols, building codes/ standards, and FAR, as directed
Communicate effectively by written and verbal means
Perform multiple concurrent tasks and meet timelines, as directed
Work well independently and in team settings
Competent using Microsoft Office products, email systems, and Windows (specifically the analytical functions in Excel). Familiarity or experience with Primavera P6 is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Python
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As Senior Software Engineer for a new product within Veeva, you will be a founding member of a team building our next major AI-driven platform — one that will transform how Life Sciences companies manage safety, regulatory, and clinical development.

You will influence and help grow a codebase and engineering organization from the ground up, wearing multiple hats across the engineering organization. The team will be AI-first in two meaningful ways: using AI to drive engineering productivity and strong engineering discipline, and building a product that applies AI in genuinely innovative ways to problems that matter.

Within your first year, you will have live customers on the platform and a thriving, growing team behind it - directly accelerating how customers bring life-saving products to market.

What You'll Do

Full Feature Ownership: Own all stages of feature implementation, from design and development through deployment, production support, and maintenance. Daily code contribution using AI assistance for productivity
Drive Solutions: Collaborate with Product Management and Development on technical design and problem-solving to deliver great code
Rapid Problem Solving: Quickly analyze complex problems, identifying knowns and unknowns, to accelerate the path to robust solutions
Develop Best Practices: Define, promote, and mentor on engineering best practices and coding standards, including the latest approaches to AI assisted engineering
Expert Code Review: Provide comprehensive code reviews for engineers of all experience levels
Strategic Mentorship: Develop the skills of engineering talent through structured mentorship

Requirements

Seasoned Software Engineer: 5+ years of proven software development expertise (Production level Python development required)
Enterprise SaaS Leader: Extensive experience developing high-scale enterprise SaaS cloud applications
Scalability Expert: Proven track record of architecting and building high-volume products at scale
Open Source Proficiency: Hands-on development experience with current open-source tools and technologies, including Python, Git, FastAPI, Pydantic
Fast-Paced Adaptability: Highly driven and flexible, enjoys a fast-paced start-up environment, and believes in having fun along the way
Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor and elevate team performance, fostering growth and excellence
High work ethic: Veeva is a hard-working company
High integrity and honesty: Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company. We expect that from all employees
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills: Engineering is not all about the code, it’s also about communication
Applicants must have the unrestricted right to work in the United States. Veeva will not provide sponsorship at this time

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A technical/coding skills exercise
A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders

Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program

Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope Of The Role

The Business Development Representative will play a critical role in expanding Innodata’s Healthcare and Life Sciences business by identifying organizations investing in AI, reaching the right decision makers, and converting those conversations

The Business Development Representative, Healthcare & Life Sciences
will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying new business opportunities across the healthcare and life sciences ecosystem. This role will focus on building pipeline with health systems, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical technology organizations, payers, digital health companies, and other organizations investing in AI and data transformation.

The BDR will work closely with Innodata’s AI leadership to identify high-potential accounts, engage relevant technical and business decision makers, qualify opportunities, and transition qualified prospects into pilots and commercial engagements.

This role requires strong prospecting and communication skills combined with the ability to develop a working understanding of healthcare AI use cases, clinical and life sciences data, model development, and emerging agentic AI applications.

This role is approximately 70% outbound prospecting, account development, client-facing activity, and 30% account research & planning.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Business Development

Identify and source prospective customers across healthcare and life sciences, including health systems, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, medical technology organizations, payers, and digital health companies.
Research target accounts to identify AI initiatives, strategic priorities, organizational changes, funding, product launches, and other potential business triggers.
Identify and engage relevant decision makers across AI, data science, machine learning, clinical operations, R&D, medical affairs, technology, product, and digital transformation organizations.
Develop highly targeted outbound campaigns using email, LinkedIn, industry events, conferences, and other prospecting channels.
Conduct discovery calls to understand customer requirements, timelines, technical challenges, and potential commercial opportunities.
Support the transition of qualified opportunities into pilots, proof-of-concept programs, and larger commercial engagements.
Coordinate prospect meetings, follow-ups, presentations, demonstrations, and technical discussions with Innodata subject matter experts.

The BDR should have sufficient domain fluency to connect these capabilities to healthcare and life sciences use cases such as clinical AI assistants, medical documentation, patient engagement, medical imaging, clinical trials, drug development, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, regulatory workflows, and enterprise AI applications.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You Have

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
2–5 years of experience in business development, technology sales, healthcare technology, life sciences, AI, data services, or a related field.
Demonstrated success generating pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting.
A consultative approach to business development focused on understanding customer problems rather than simply pitching products.
Understanding of healthcare and life sciences workflows such as clinical operations, medical imaging, clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, drug development, patient engagement, or enterprise healthcare operations.
Familiarity with healthcare and life sciences data, including clinical records, medical imaging, scientific literature, real-world data, or other multimodal medical datasets.

The expected salary range for this position is $70,000 – $85,000 USD per year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
jobs.description:
About Crunchbase

Crunchbase is a predictive solution that provides intelligence on private companies, powered by the unique combination of live private company data, AI, and market activity from over 80 million users. We predict private market movements that matter to help investors, dealmakers, and analysts make the right decisions.

We are committed to fostering a positive, diverse, and inclusive culture by hiring for potential and embracing individuals with diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. We value transparency and openness, believing that an inclusive environment strengthens our teams and enhances our products.

About The Role

The Senior Product Manager, AI & Data Science Products
owns Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer: proprietary data and intelligence generated from foundational data using AI and machine learning.

The primary charter is to identify high-value opportunities for new model-derived data, validate their value with customers, and take successful products from experimentation through scaled adoption.

Success Is Measured By Three Outcomes

New differentiated data: Create proprietary intelligence that Crunchbase could not practically produce through collection alone.
Higher customer value: Help customers discover, understand, evaluate, and prioritize their private market jobs more effectively.
Revenue and adoption: Turn valuable AI data into measurable usage, retention, expansion, and monetization opportunities.

What You’ll Do

AI & Data Science Product Strategy

Own the strategy and roadmap for Crunchbase’s customer-facing AI data layer.
Identify high-value opportunities for new predictions, classifications, signals, and insights that improve customer decisions.
Build a differentiated portfolio of AI data products rather than isolated AI features.
Partner with Foundational Data to determine when customer needs are best addressed through collected, acquired, inferred, predicted, or generated data.

Customer Discovery & Product Development

Work directly with customers to identify where new or better data can materially improve their workflows and decisions.
Rapidly test new AI data concepts, validate customer value, and scale successful products.
Define how model-derived data, including confidence and uncertainty, should be presented to customers.
Partner with Design, Engineering, and Data Science to deliver AI data across Crunchbase products, APIs, MCP, and data delivery experiences.

Quality & Product Economics

Define quality standards and evaluation frameworks for model-derived data in partnership with Data Science.
Determine when an AI data product is sufficiently reliable for scaled customer use.
Balance customer value, coverage, accuracy, freshness, and generation cost.
Monitor product and data performance and continuously improve quality based on customer feedback and observed outcomes.

Adoption & Monetization

Drive adoption of AI data products across Crunchbase’s customer experiences and distribution channels.
Partner with Go-to-Market on positioning, customer education, and launch strategy.
Partner with Pricing and Packaging and Sales to identify monetization opportunities.
Measure adoption, retention, expansion, revenue, and customer outcomes to determine which products to scale, improve, or retire.

What We’re Looking For

Strong product judgment across customer discovery, strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and tradeoffs.
Strong understanding of data products and how customers derive value from proprietary data and insights.
Practical understanding of modern machine learning and AI capabilities and limitations.
Working knowledge of applied data science and machine learning.
Ability to translate product requirements for Data Science and Engineering teams.
Familiarity with model evaluation concepts such as precision, recall, confidence, and model drift.
Ability to reason about probabilistic and imperfect data and define appropriate quality thresholds.
Strong analytical skills and ability to balance customer value, quality, coverage, cost, and speed.
Excellent customer discovery, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Education and Experience

3+ years of Product Management, Data Product Management, AI/ML Product Management, or comparable experience.
Experience owning customer-facing data science products from problem definition through launch and ongoing monitoring.
Experience partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience taking products from customer discovery and experimentation through scaled adoption.
Ability to define quality criteria that reflect customer needs and make informed quality and coverage tradeoffs.
Experience with B2B SaaS, data products, APIs, intelligence platforms, or commercializing differentiated data preferred.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Crunchbase launches differentiated AI data products that customers value and competitors cannot easily replicate.
AI creates valuable intelligence and coverage that would be impractical to produce through traditional data collection alone.
Customers adopt these products because they improve real workflows and decisions.
AI data products contribute measurably to adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue while meeting appropriate quality and trust standards.

Non-Goals

This is not an internal AI tooling or general AI feature role.
This is not ownership of foundational data collection, sourcing, or operations.
This is not ML research or data generation for its own sake. AI data must solve meaningful customer problems and create measurable value.

Salary range: $160,000 - $190,000

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:
The Senior Data Analyst turns clinical, financial and operational data into insight that leaders use to improve patient outcomes, cost and efficiency. The role bridges EHR, ERP and the data platforms, owning complex analyses, enterprise reporting and dashboard delivery from request to adoption. The analyst also mentors junior analysts and sets standards for data quality and governance.

Essential Functions Include But Not Limited To

Lead complex analyses across clinical, revenue cycle, supply chain, workforce and finance domains, and present findings and recommendations to directors and executives.
Build and maintain KPI frameworks for quality, length of stay, readmissions, throughput, labor productivity and cost per case.
Support value-based care, population health and regulatory reporting (CMS, Joint Commission, state agencies).
Write and optimize SQL against Epic Clarity and Caboodle to extract encounter, order, charge and outcome data.
Build and validate Epic reporting content (Reporting Workbench, Radar dashboards, SlicerDicer) in partnership with Epic analysts.
Translate Epic workflow and documentation changes into downstream reporting impacts.
Integrate Oracle ERP data (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, HCM) with clinical data for cost, margin and spend analysis.
Develop reports using Oracle BI Publisher, OTBI and Oracle Analytics, and reconcile results with Finance.
Design, publish and govern Power BI datasets, semantic models and dashboards, including DAX measures, row-level security and refresh schedules.
Develop data pipelines and models in SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse or Microsoft Fabric.
Automate recurring work with Power Query, Power Automate and advanced Excel.

Job Title: Lab Technician
Job Description

The Lab Technician supports applications development by preparing samples, performing analytical tests, recording data and observations, and summarizing experimental results. This role focuses on die bonding applications, process optimization, and failure analysis while ensuring consistent quality and repeatability in a lab environment.

Responsibilities

Prepare samples for applications development and testing in accordance with established procedures.
Perform analytical tests on samples, accurately record data and observations, and prepare clear summaries of experiments.
Conduct die bonding applications using both manual and automated methods, following defined process parameters.
Troubleshoot basic process issues, implement corrective actions where appropriate, and escalate complex problems promptly.
Perform parameter optimization to improve process performance, yield, and repeatability.
Assist with failure analysis to identify root causes and contribute to corrective and preventive actions.
Handle microscopic components safely and precisely using microscopes, tweezers, vacuum tools, and other fine instruments.
Maintain thorough process documentation, including test conditions, results, and any deviations from standard procedures.
Support basic troubleshooting activities and help maintain consistent process control and product quality.
Log process data using computer applications and ensure data integrity and accuracy.
Collaborate effectively with team members, follow instructions, and communicate findings and issues clearly.
Adhere to lab safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized work area.

Essential Skills

Minimum of 1+ years of industry experience in a related field.
Technical certification or degree in a related field such as chemistry, materials science, or a similar discipline.
Experience in one or more of the following areas: materials testing, working with metals, quality control, or lab operations.
Hands-on experience with sample preparation and basic laboratory techniques.
Ability to handle microscopic components using microscopes, tweezers, and vacuum tools with fine motor skills.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to log and manage process data.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment, follow detailed instructions, and communicate clearly.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on process control, documentation, and maintaining quality standards.
Good time management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic lab setting.
Physical ability to stand, reach, use fine tools, and occasionally lift small weights or handle assemblies.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Background in chemistry, sample preparation, and working with metals.
Experience with materials testing and quality control processes.
Familiarity with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus.
Comfort working with analytical testing methods and process optimization activities.
Ability to perform basic troubleshooting of lab processes and equipment.
Demonstrated commitment to maintaining repeatability, yield, and consistent process outcomes.

Work Environment

This position is based in a laboratory environment that emphasizes precision, safety, and collaboration. You will work with microscopes, fine tools such as tweezers and vacuum instruments, and computer systems for data logging and analysis. The culture combines the feel of a small, close-knit team with strong financial backing, fostering a supportive atmosphere where colleagues are cooperative and helpful. The role involves standing, reaching, and handling small assemblies and microscopic components, with a focus on maintaining an organized, clean, and well-documented workspace.
