jobs.title: Research Associate I/II – Microbiology & Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Sarmal, Inc. is a San Diego–based biotechnology company developing next-generation genomics and molecular detection platforms. Our work integrates molecular biology, chemistry, and advanced systems engineering to enable faster, more precise, and more accessible genomic insights.

We are a highly collaborative, R&D-driven team operating in a fast-paced, early-stage environment. Our scientists and engineers work across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges and translate innovation into scalable, real-world applications.

At Sarmal, we value scientific rigor, curiosity, and a builder mindset. We are looking for individuals who are energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and excited to help bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

About The Job

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate to join our R&D team developing innovative diagnostic technologies. The successful candidate will support the development, optimization, and analytical evaluation of molecular and microbiological assays for diagnostic applications.

This role will involve hands-on laboratory research, including microbial culture, nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, sample preparation, and analysis of biological specimens. The ideal candidate will have strong microbiology and molecular biology skills, excellent experimental judgment, and an interest in translating laboratory technologies into reliable, scalable diagnostic products.

Key Responsibilities

Perform microbiological workflows, including aerobic and anaerobic culture, microbial identification, dilution series preparation, enumeration, Gram staining, and microorganism characterization.
Perform molecular biology techniques including DNA/RNA extraction, qPCR, nucleic acid purification and quantification/quality assessment using methods such as Qubit, NanoDrop, qPCR-based quantification, or equivalent methods.
Develop and optimize sample preparation and nucleic acid extraction workflows for clinical or biological specimens, including host/background depletion, microbial lysis, enrichment/concentration, nucleic acid purification, and recovery.
Design, execute, and optimize experiments supporting the development of molecular and microbiological diagnostic assays.
Prepare and characterize biological samples, controls, standards, and reference materials used in assay development.
Generate, organize, and analyze experimental data, and communicate results to project teams.
Maintain detailed laboratory records and ensure experimental work is performed according to established protocols and quality practices.
Contribute to the development and optimization of standard operating procedures (SOPs), protocols, and assay documentation.
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, automation teams, and other R&D team members to integrate sample preparation and biological assays with diagnostic platforms and technologies.
Support technology transfer, assay verification/validation, and scale-up activities as projects progress toward product development.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Hands-on laboratory experience in microbiology including aseptic technique, culture, isolation, Gram staining, identification, enumeration, and characterization of microorganisms, including aerobic and anaerobic organisms.
Experience with molecular biology techniques such as DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and nucleic acid purification. Experience with nucleic acid quantification and quality assessment using methods such as Qubit, NanoDrop, qPCR-based quantification, or equivalent methods.
Experience developing, optimizing, or troubleshooting sample preparation and nucleic acid extraction workflows from biological or clinical sample matrices.
Experience with the safe handling and culture of microorganisms in a BSL-2 laboratory environment.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate and thorough laboratory documentation.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary R&D team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience culturing and characterizing clinically relevant bacterial and/or fungal organisms, including aerobic and anaerobic organisms.
Experience with nucleic acid extraction from complex biological matrices, particularly whole blood or other clinical specimen types.
Experience with PCR, qPCR, multiplex PCR, isothermal amplification, or other nucleic acid amplification technologies.

Nice To Have But Not Required

Experience preparing microbial dilution series.
Familiarity generating contrived or mock clinical samples by spiking microorganisms into relevant biological matrices.
Experience with automated or semi-automated nucleic acid extraction platforms, such as KingFisher or comparable magnetic bead-based extraction systems.
Experience evaluating sample preparation or assay performance, including microbial/nucleic acid recovery, analytical sensitivity, reproducibility, matrix effects, and inhibition.

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related discipline.

Benefits & Perks

Sarmal offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Company-paid life insurance
401(k) retirement plan
Generous paid time off
Access to additional voluntary benefits, employee perks, and discount programs
We are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and providing a strong foundation for both professional and personal success.

$72,000 - $85,000 a year

California Pay Transparency Statement.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $72,000 – $85,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skill set, and internal equity considerations.

EEO Statement

Sarmal is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Sarmal is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and consider all qualified candidates in accordance with applicable laws.

Why Join Sarmal

Work on cutting-edge genomics and molecular detection technologies
Collaborate with a deeply technical, cross-functional team
Contribute to foundational platform development at an early stage
Have visibility into and impact on core technical and strategic decisions
Help shape the infrastructure, culture, and future direction of the company

Closing Statement

Join us in advancing the next generation of genomic technologies and shaping the future of precision health.

Support staff and campus partners in building data literacy and comfort using evidence to inform planning and continuous improvement.

Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

Cedars-Sinai Medical Center has been named to the Honor Roll in U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Hospitals 2025-2026” rankings. Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

The Smidt Heart Institute reflects Cedars-Sinai's steadfast dedication to heart disease and research innovation giving patients access to the highest level of care. Year after year, thousands of people trust their hearts to Smidt Heart Institute at Cedars-Sinai. Our cardiologists, cardiac surgeons and specialized care teams treat the full spectrum of heart disease and disorders, while our investigators continue to advance the field with groundbreaking, life-saving research. From genetic counseling and targeted drug therapies to an increasing array of minimally invasive procedures, Cedars-Sinai continues to stand at the forefront of technology, innovation and discovery improving patient outcomes.

Dr. Alessandra Ciullo’s laboratory at Cedars-Sinai’s renowned Smidt Heart Institute conducts innovative cardiovascular research focused on developing next-generation therapies for heart disease. The lab investigates extracellular vesicles, small noncoding RNAs, cardiac regeneration, and disease mechanisms, including arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. Joining Dr. Ciullo’s team offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful, translational research within a leading center for cardiovascular discovery and patient care.

What will you be doing in this role?

The Smidt Heart Institute at Cedars-Sinai is looking for a Research Associate II to join the laboratory of Dr. Alessandra Ciullo. The Research Associate II will provide technical support related to the preparation and analysis of laboratory specimens and conduct laboratory research under the direction of Dr. Ciullo and her research staff studying extracellular vesicles and small non-coding RNA.

Working under direct supervision, the Research Associate II performs routine and increasingly complex laboratory tasks and procedures. The Research Associate II principal duties will include animal colony management, animal treatment and dosing, and generally assisting with smaller experiments or projects as necessary, RNA isolation and qPCR, immunohistochemistry, microscopy, western blots, keeping notes, ordering reagents and maintaining records. Ideal candidate would be an independent, science and detail-oriented individual with mammalian tissue culture experience.

The individual will be expected to function efficiently as an individual and cooperatively with a team of faculty, research scientists and associates. Excellent written and oral communication and coordination of experiments and preparation of data for publication will be expected.

Participation in laboratory meetings, keeping laboratory notebooks, performing calculations, tabulating data, summarizing methods and results of related experiments will be required. In addition, the individual will order supplies and maintain inventories, prepare chemical solutions and culture media, maintain general lab cleanliness and perform other work-related duties as assigned. Duties will include but are not limited to:

Responsibilities:

Conducting routine production of biologic product(s) including media preparation, cell culture, cell counting, formulation, centrifugation and freezing;
Contributes to general maintenance of the laboratory, equipment and supplies.
Assist with animal husbandry
Participate in experimental designs, in vitro and in vivo data collection and evaluation.
Demonstrated ability to use sterile technique.
Performs a variety of increasingly complex experimental protocols and procedures and assist in the design of new complex or unusual protocols and techniques.

Meticulous lab bookkeeping.
Good communication skills
Preforming a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures to support the objectives of one or more laboratory research projects.
Assists in the operation of specialized equipment and machinery
Keeps accurate and detailed project records of experiments and results
Observes and follows safety standards and procedures.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's Degree in a Science or related field is required.

Experience and Skills:

At least one (1) year of research laboratory experience in the area of specialization is required. Familiar with routine laboratory procedures, experimental protocols, and overall lab organization.
Excellent organization and problem-solving skills, meticulous, and self-motivated with the ability to multitask.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Client Insights
jobs.description:
**About RK Media**

RK Media is a dynamic organization representing Christian non-profit ministries who use radio, television, podcasts and digital media to reach their audience. As a full-service agency, we serve our ministry partners through the production of top-quality Bible teaching, talk and inspirational broadcasts and podcasts that include strategic fundraising campaigns and promotions. We also serve as the direct liaison between non-profit ministries, the radio stations and other outlets that carry their programs.

RK Media offers a fast-paced, collaborative work environment with potential for both personal and professional growth. We value individuals who wish to make a direct impact in the mission of Christian non-profit ministries through the media industry. We believe that when team members find value and meaning in their work, they experience success and significance. Learn more at rkmedia.co.

**The role**

We're hiring a data analyst who loves digging into numbers, telling the story behind the numbers, and wants to help ministries understand what's working.

Most of your time (~ 75%) goes to analysis: building and owning reporting for our ministry partners, managing our internal data, and creating cross-ministry benchmarks. The rest (~ 25%) is working with the people behind the requests. That means joining ministry partner calls when needed, finding out *why* someone is asking for a report, and coming back with more than they asked for.

This is a role for a self-starter. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, solves problems without waiting to be told exactly what to do, brings a "yes, and" attitude, and keeps everyone clear on expectations.

**What you'll do**

**Reporting and analysis (about 70%)**

* Take over and improve RK's current reporting for ministry partners, including monthly financial reports, station data requests, and social media analytics reports.
* Turn one-off client reports into a consistent RK reporting service that partners can rely on.
* Fully own RK's cross-ministry benchmarks, with feedback from senior leadership: what "good" looks like by channel, and how each ministry compares.
* Build those benchmarks into partner reports, so every ministry understands their experience in a broader context.
* Manage and organize RK's internal data: understand what data we have, where it lives, and how to keep it clean and usable.
* Present data-backed recommendations across various channels.
* *As recurring reporting is automated, expect more of your time to shift toward analysis and projects across RK*

**Client insight (about 20%)**

* Join client calls as needed alongside the Media Services team.
* Dig past the direct request: understand what led to it and where the ministry is headed.
* Support the account lead in assessing how a report furthers a ministry’s impact.

**Other (about 10%)**

* Take part in internal team meetings, planning sessions, and company-wide meetings.
* Keep building your skills through training, new tools, and learning the ministry media landscape, with RK’s support.
* As reporting becomes more automated, take on data projects for other RK teams, such as campaign performance analysis for Digital Marketing, station and affiliate data for Station Relations, or operational and financial analysis for leadership.
* Help find other manual processes across RK that could be simplified or automated.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll work mainly with the Media Services team, which includes Station Relations and Digital Marketing. Over time there's room to grow into work with all of our teams.

**What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days**

* You know our ministry partners, their goals, and the reports we provide each of them.
* You've taken over the current reporting process, including the quarterly social media reports.
* You've mapped what data RK has, where it lives, who owns it, and how it's collected.
* You've joined client calls with the Media Services team and built working relationships with the account leads.

**By 6 months**

* You've recommended how to elevate RK's reporting, and we've agreed on a plan.
* You've proposed a standard set of metrics and a consistent report format across ministries.
* You've set up how client data is organized and protected, so cross-ministry benchmarking can be done responsibly.
* Account leads bring you into client conversations because your recommendations go beyond the original request.

**By 1 year**

* Standardized reporting with benchmarks is running as a new service for our ministry partners, allowing them to see how their experience fits within a larger ministry context.
* RK's data and reporting processes are documented and repeatable.
* You’ve elevated reporting both internally and for our clients.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, marketing analytics, reporting, or a similar role.
* Well versed in using AI tools, such as Claude, in your daily work.
* Comfortable in Excel: pivot tables, lookups, and cleaning and combining messy data. You genuinely enjoy working in spreadsheets.
* A track record of presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Clear, concise writing — you can explain what the data means and what to do about it.
* Initiative: you find answers and solve problems without needing step-by-step direction.
* Strong communication and people skills, including asking good questions and setting clear expectations.
* Sound judgment with confidential information.
* A general understanding of Christian denominational and theological differences, and empathy for the mission of non-profit ministries.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree, or trade school or certificate training, in a related field.
* Experience with nonprofit fundraising, direct response, media buying, or donor data.
* Familiarity with radio, podcast, or social media metrics.
* Experience with SQL, or with a BI too

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The QC Lab Technician is responsible for supporting the day-to-day lab functions and completing routine procedures under the direction of the Quality Control Supervisor.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supports all laboratory functions carried out by the Scientists in the QC laboratory, including but not limited to: Sample collection (raw materials from quarantine, finished good QC samples, retention samples, finished goods for retest purposes).
* Prepares the necessary sample preparation to assist in testing, including preparing solutions.
* Conduct the following QC Analysis: pH, Conductivity, Osmolality, Density and Top Spread Sterility testing.
* Testing materials or products that have various biosafety levels.
* Conducts Calibration & Temperature checks of Fridges, Freezers, and Incubators.
* Performs cleaning of all glassware and sterilizing components for routine testing (autoclaved materials, etc.).
* Disposes of samples once testing is completed.
* Aids in retention sample storage handles and drops off hazardous materials in the hazardous waste drop off location.
* Collaborates with manager, team lead and team members daily to meet testing deadlines.
* Follows all Standard Operating Procedures for assigned tasks and area.
* Responsible for maintaining appropriate training schedule as it pertains to their primary occupational duties.
* Maintains accurate inventory of materials.
* Accurately records all completion data into the appropriate database, and / or appropriately completes all necessary paperwork.
* Learns new procedures and accepts new assignments within reasonable timeframes, to be agreed upon by the employee and supervisor
* Recognizes and resolves problems; troubleshoots malfunctions in procedures and uses alternative methods if available
* Coordinates efforts of effective work activities that contribute to company needs
* Demonstrates good judgment in handling situations not covered by written or verbal instructions

Requirements:

**EDUCATION**

High school level chemistry or biology and / or applicable lab experience preferred

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / EXPERIENCE**

* A minimum of 1 years lab experience preferred
* Background in Chemistry, Biology or related science preferred
* Good human relations and oral/written communication skills
* Ability to perform mathematical calculations on basic dilutions and conversions
* Ability to handle multiple projects concurrently
* Ability to stand on feet for a total of 8-10 hours daily
* Must be able to carry, lift, push and pull up to 40 pounds
* Effective communication skills by conveying necessary information accurately, listening effectively

**Benefits**:

From performance bonuses that give every member of our team a chance to share in our success to health insurance and retirement savings programs to our generous PTO policy, we’re invested in our associates. Our benefits include:

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
* 401(k) retirement plans with a 4% employer match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Teknova wellness program

Do you want to help build future generations of processors that will enable the next remarkable Apple innovation? If so, we invite you to consider joining our team. We are seeking an engineer with a passion for hardware and strong CAD flow development and collaboration skills. You will develop, maintain, and enhance AMS (Analog/Mixed-Signal) simulation methodology and tools for our analog, RF, interconnect, PMIC, and memory design teams. You will gain hands-on experience in circuit analysis, pre and post-layout simulation, RTL simulation, behavioral modeling, analog+digital co-simulation, logic equivalency checks, and signoff. You will enable design engineers to efficiently drive and interact with their mixed-signal simulations and design verification workflows, delivering validated IP in cutting-edge silicon. The successful candidate will thrive in dynamic, multi-disciplinary environments and demonstrate a hands-on, enthusiastic, and self-motivated approach. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional value to users and paying meticulous attention to detail, this role may be the perfect fit for you. Your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions of Apple customers by delivering state-of-the-art processors across the diverse range of Apple products.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a member of our CAD team, you will architect, develop, maintain and enhance AMS (Analog/Mixed-Signal) simulation methodology and solutions for our analog, RF, and mixed-signal designs. The role requires you to work with different technology nodes and provide flows/methodologies for the different tool sets. You will be collaborating closely with design teams. You will drive and coordinate efforts to develop and validate AMS/co-simulation flows, providing ease of use, speeding up design validation, and ensuring functional silicon.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field +0 years of experience
* Experience in Python, Perl, or TCL programming
* Experience using mixed-signal co-simulation tools

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience with industry-standard AMS tools including Cadence (Xcelium, Verisium/Indago, SimVision, AMS Designer), Synopsys (VCS, Verdi), or Siemens (Questa, Symphony)
* Familiarity with analog simulation tools such as Cadence Spectre, Synopsys PrimeSim/HSPICE/Finesim, or Siemens AFS
* Ability to identify and address simulation accuracy, speed, and capacity issues
* Experience with mixed-signal simulation implementation including discipline resolution, binding, IE setup, Connect Modules, AMSD blocks, wreal, TCL probes, real number modeling, UDNs, etc.
* Understanding of behavioral and functional circuit description languages including SystemVerilog, VerilogA, Verilog, Verilog-AMS, VHDL
* Familiarity with applying LLMs/AI agents to CAD software development, test generation, and debugging
* Understanding of custom IC designs and transistor description formats (SPICE, DSPF, schematics)
* Fundamentals in object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, system architecture, command-line and GUI interaction, testing/coverage, and revision control
* Familiarity with Virtuoso Schematic Editor, PDK content, CDF properties, hierarchy editor, SKILL code, netlisting, and Analog Design Environment (ADE)
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Demonstrated commitment to quality and productivity

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $123,700 and $186,900, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Medical Laboratory Technician is responsible for performing moderately complex and complex laboratory tests, as defined by CLIA, in hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, microbiology, and serology. California excludes MLT’s from microscopic testing and blood bank testing. Professional application of the principles, theories, techniques, and quality controls of laboratory science is used. This position reports to the lead clinical laboratory scientist, laboratory manager/supervisor, and/or the administrative director of Laboratory services. Actively and consistently contributes to department operations and communications, behaves in a manner consistent with the mission, vision, and values of Pipeline Health, upholding standards of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, Thank you) patient communication.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

**Essential Functions:**

* Follows the hospital’s policies and procedures and documents their review.
* Ensure all daily Quality Controls, QC, (or as required, Levy-Jennings and Westgard Rules) is acceptable before releasing patient results.
* Performs and documents all maintenance, temperatures, specimen rejection and troubleshooting, and conforms to schedules and completion of work, leaves little for the next shift.
* Performs blood smear reviews, except for manual leukocyte differentials.
* Performs urinalysis microscopy.
* Performs blood typing of moderate complexity, such as automated ABO/Rh testing and antibody screen.
* Maintains the inventory of supplies and reagents.
* Participates in the laboratories in-service and competency assessment programs.
* Help train and orient new team members.
* Uses clear, concise, professional communication with coworkers, patients, all customers internal and external.
* Uses AIDET in interactions with patients and family members.
* Acts with a sense of urgency when performing tasks.
* Basic unit/department maintenance such as keeping files, drawers, cabinets free from unnecessary clutter.
* Reports on any equipment and or environmental issues for repair.
* Abides by HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) regulations.
* Speaks up to stop the line and escalates potential safety events if necessary.
* Completes and attends monthly training assigned.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Behavioral Standards:**

* Treats everyone as their customer; utilizes scripting and other tools to ensure consistency in customer service; Expresses recognition and shows appreciation to others; fully utilizes AIDET principles; responds quickly to handle requests, complaints, and questions; displays a positive attitude.
* Demonstrates the highest level of professionalism, passion and care when interacting with patients, families, physicians, and hospital staff members.
* Using a lens of equity in all aspects of patient care delivery, education, and research to promote policies and practices to allow opportunities for all to thrive and reach their potential, embracing ingenuity to service our customers.

**Communication/Knowledge:**

* Wears nametag properly; follows dress code policy; answers phone correctly and promptly; is prepared for meetings; meets deadlines; does not participate in gossip; acts ethically and treats others with respect; respects customer’s and co-worker’s time; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and co-workers.

**Collaboration/Teamwork:**

* Attends staff meetings; follows HIPAA guidelines; follows patient rights policy; complies with the compliance program; demonstrates knowledge of role in a disaster; demonstrates knowledge of fire and fire drill procedures; working knowledge of hospital emergency codes; always utilizes standard precautions in the clinical setting; safely manages the environment of care by demonstrating a working knowledge of the requirements of the: Life Safety program, Utilities Management program, Hazardous Materials program, Emergency Preparedness program, Safety Management program, Medical Equipment Management program, Security Management program.

**Qualifications/Experience:**

* Requires a minimum of six (6) months MLT experience in at least two sections of any accredited hospital clinical laboratory.
* Critical thinking, service excellence and good interpersonal communication skills, ability to read/comprehend written instructions, strong organizational skills, ability to follow verbal instructions, and PC (computer) skills.
* A capacity to learn, synthesize, make critical judgments, work independently, place patients and families first, and collaborate with the team members who are recognized leaders within healthcare.

**Education:**

* Associates Degree or 60 semester or equivalent quarter units in chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science with specific course requirements:

o 36 semester or equivalent quarter units in physical or biological sciences.

o 6 semester or equivalent quarter units in chemistry.

o 6 semester or equivalent quarter units in biology.

  

***All foreign degrees must be accompanied by a confirmation letter certifying that your education is US equivalent.***

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Required

* MLT Med Lab Technician

Preferred

* WPV Tier I

Equal Opportunity Employer

**About the Company:**

For over a decade, we've remained steadfast in our commitment to core values of excellence, integrity, and respect for people. Our team of professionals collaborates tirelessly to pioneer advancements in manufacturing, distribution, and quality control, ensuring a holistic approach to healthcare. Through vertical integration of the pharmaceutical supply chain, cutting-edge technology, and unwavering dedication to excellence, we continually strive to redefine medication accessibility and affordability. We prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and robust training and development opportunities. By investing in our workforce and fostering a culture of growth and support, we empower our team to drive innovation and make a positive impact in the healthcare industry. At Nivagen, our mission is clear: to make a meaningful difference in people's lives by delivering high-quality, affordable medications while upholding the highest standards of integrity and excellence.

**Job Location:**

Nivagen Pharmaceuticals Inc., Sacramento, CA

3900 Duckhorn Dr, Sacramento, CA 95834

**About the Job:**

Job Title: **Laboratory Technician - Analytical Method Development**

Nivagen Pharmaceuticals is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Laboratory Technician to support the Analytical Research & Development team in analytical method development, method validation, stability testing, and routine laboratory activities. The successful candidate will assist scientists and chemists in performing analytical testing, maintaining laboratory equipment, preparing solutions and samples, and ensuring compliance with GMP and laboratory safety requirements.This position provides an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in pharmaceutical analytical chemistry and hands-on experience with advanced analytical instrumentation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in the execution of analytical method development and validation activities for pharmaceutical drug substances and drug products.

* Prepare reagents, mobile phases, standards, and sample solutions according to approved procedures.

* Perform analytical testing using HPLC, UPLC, UV-Vis spectrophotometers, dissolution systems, pH meters, balances, and other laboratory instruments.

* Support troubleshooting and optimization of analytical methods under the guidance of senior scientists.

* Maintain accurate laboratory notebooks, worksheets, and electronic data records.

* Assist with stability studies, sample management, and laboratory inventory control.

* Perform routine instrument maintenance, calibration, and qualification activities.

* Ensure compliance with GMP, GDP, data integrity, laboratory safety, and company procedures.

* Participate in laboratory investigations, deviations, and corrective actions as assigned.

* Maintain laboratory cleanliness and organization to support inspection readiness.

**Qualifications**:

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

**Experience:**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, contract laboratory, or academic laboratory environment.

* Internship or laboratory coursework experience will be considered for entry-level candidates.

**Technical Skills:**

* Basic understanding of analytical chemistry principles.

* Familiarity with HPLC, UPLC, UV-Vis, FTIR, dissolution, or related analytical techniques is preferred.

* Knowledge of laboratory documentation practices and data recording.

* Experience with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

* Familiarity with GMP regulations is a plus.

**Required Competencies:**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Ability to follow written procedures and work instructions accurately.

* Good communication and teamwork skills.

* Ability to handle multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.

* Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to stand for extended periods while performing laboratory activities.

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds.

* Ability to work safely with chemicals and laboratory equipment.

**Requirements:**

* Must live or willing to move to Sacramento Metropolitan Region (Approx. 40 miles' radius)

**Benefits:**

* Pay range $25 to $28 an hour
* Yearly bonus and stock options eligibility
* Benefits: Nivagen offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being
* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Paid time off plan

**Additional Information:**

Nivagen to afford equal opportunity for employment to all individuals regardless of race, color, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, history of disability, ancestry, citizenship status, political affiliation, religion, gender, transgender, gender identity, marital status, status as a parent, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information or other factors prohibited by law, and to prohibit harassment or retaliation based on any of these factors.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
About the Role
  
We are seeking a Lab Technician to support the daily operation of a high-throughput sample preparation laboratory. You will prepare samples, operate laboratory equipment, maintain accurate records, and help ensure consistent, high-quality sample production.
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on laboratory work, follows detailed procedures with precision, and takes pride in producing reproducible results. You will work closely with scientists and engineers to develop standardized workflows for preparing thousands of unique inorganic and organometallic compounds for advanced materials characterization.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
Prepare samples by weighing, mixing, grinding, diluting, and pressing powders according to standardized protocols.
  
Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, including analytical balances, mixers, grinders, pellet presses, and related instrumentation.
  
Maintain complete sample traceability using laboratory databases, barcoding, and electronic records.
  
Label, organize, and package samples for measurement.
  
Perform routine quality control checks to verify sample consistency, pellet quality, and preparation accuracy.
  
Maintain organized inventories of chemicals, consumables, and laboratory supplies.
  
Follow chemical safety procedures for handling air-sensitive, moisture-sensitive, and hazardous materials.
  
Document laboratory procedures and contribute to the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  
Identify opportunities to improve sample preparation workflows, laboratory organization, and operational efficiency.
  
Troubleshoot routine laboratory equipment and communicate issues promptly to the engineering and scientific teams.
  
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have
  
A bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent laboratory experience.
  
Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.
  
Experience following detailed SOPs while maintaining consistent, reproducible work.
  
Comfort performing repetitive laboratory tasks with a high degree of precision.
  
Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  
Good written and verbal communication skills.
  
Experience with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar laboratory data management tools.
  
A collaborative attitude and willingness to support a fast-paced research environment.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience handling inorganic, organometallic, or air-sensitive compounds.
  
Experience with powder handling, precision weighing, or sample preparation.
  
Familiarity with analytical balances, laboratory presses, grinders, or other sample preparation equipment.
  
Experience working in analytical chemistry, materials science, semiconductor, battery, catalysis, or research laboratories.
  
Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or electronic laboratory documentation.
  
Experience supporting quality control or laboratory operations.
  
  
Required experience:
  
1 year of exp with Bachelor's degree with chemistry background if degree is not there then atleast 2 or 3 years.
  
  
Top 3 requirements to hire:
  
Chemistry Lab exp to do protocols, detailed oriented.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Successful candidates will:
  
Produce reproducible, high-quality samples with minimal errors.
  
Maintain excellent documentation and complete sample traceability.
  
Follow laboratory protocols consistently while identifying opportunities for incremental improvements.
  
Help establish a reliable, scalable sample preparation workflow capable of supporting thousands of unique compounds.
  
  
Notes:
  
Onsite
  
Shift timing/schedule: Flexible they can start from 7AM to 9AM, M-F

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Robotics Lab Technician

**Number of Roles:** 1

**Location:** Santa Clara, CA (onsite 5x/week)

**Duration:** 1 year

**Job Description**

**Robotics Lab Technician**. This role is part of Strategic Resourcing services and is a contract role. The candidate will be supporting a customer and will be employed by one of preferred partners. The partner will provide full compensation and benefit information prior to employment with the partner.

**What will you be doing?**

**Position Overview:**  
The Robotics Lab Technician will provide hands-on lab support for hardware development and prototype systems in Santa Clara, CA. This is a one-year contract role (approximately 2,000 hours) and is onsite five days per week. The technician will assemble and deploy bench, rack, and data center systems; support prototype and fixture development; collect lab data; and perform mechanical rework and rapid prototyping activities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assemble, build, and install benchtop development platforms and large server systems in bench and rack labs.

* Ability to work onsite in Santa Clara, California, five days per week.

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 3 months (w/ potential for extension)

The UCSF Department of Neurology is seeking a Laboratory Assistant to provide hands-on support for routine laboratory operations and organization. This part-time position will assist with cleaning, labeling, and organizing microscope slides; washing laboratory dishes; stocking supplies; managing waste and lab coats; de-icing freezers; maintaining organized laboratory areas; and preparing basic chemical solutions and buffers.

The Laboratory Assistant will also help change formalin, xylenes, ethanol, and sucrose solutions and perform other general laboratory duties as needed. The position requires someone who is conscientious, dependable, organized, and able to adapt priorities based on the laboratory’s operational needs.

The position is 50% FTE, approximately 16–20 hours per week, with three days onsite.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Clean, label, and organize microscope slides.
* Wash and properly put away laboratory dishes.
* Stock and organize laboratory supplies.
* Support waste and lab coat management.
* De-ice laboratory freezers.
* Maintain laboratory inventory and organized work areas.
* Clean laboratory areas as needed.
* Prepare basic chemical solutions and buffers.
* Change formalin, xylenes, ethanol, and sucrose solutions.
* Adjust priorities and provide general laboratory support based on operational needs.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma (GED), plus one year of laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge and abilities essential to successfully performing assigned laboratory duties, such as taring and weighing chemicals on a balance.
* Good basic math skills.
* Conscientious and dependable.
Good communication skills.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Two years of college, including coursework in the natural, physical, or social sciences.
* Science background.

jobs.title: Hardware Electrical Rework Lab Technician
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Join the Sensing Hardware team and you’ll help us create a personal, physical connection for millions of customers around the world. Together, our team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their Apple devices!
  
  
Description
  
  
Apple’s Sensing, Power, and Haptics team, which supports hardware development across all product lines, is looking for a EE Rework Technician who will be responsible for for executing high-precision electrical rework, assembly, and modifications on complex R&D prototypes and test fixtures. Beyond your exceptional technical soldering capabilities, you will be a cornerstone of our lab operations team. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration and a team-oriented attitude. You will actively manage an incoming request pipelines, maintain specialized lab equipment, enforce safety protocols, and advise engineers and other lab users. If you are a self-motivated technical expert who thrives in a dynamic, high-impact environment, we want you on our team.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 8+ year minimum related experience required in high-precision electronic circuit board manual assembly and rework in an R&D lab, hardware development, or production-support setting.
* Proven ability to hand-solder and rework BGA, LGA, QFN IC modules, and passives down to 01005 size under a microscope, including mounting ultra-fine jumper wires, installing micro-coax cables, and manually cutting/modifying delicate PCB traces.
* Expert-level operation of rework equipment (soldering irons, hot air guns, hot plates, reflow/rework stations) paired with proficiency in benchtop EE test equipment (DMMs, DC power supplies, etc.) to verify and troubleshoot rework for functional integrity; functional fluency reading circuit diagrams and PCB layouts.
* Experience using digital job submission/tracking systems to intake, prioritize, and document engineering requests, along with strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage engineer expectations and explain technical tradeoffs.
* Uncompromising commitment to lab safety and housekeeping, familiarity with basic chemical hazards (solvents, fluxes, epoxy), and physical capability to work in a lab environment, including lifting up to 20 lbs.
* Proficiency with digital productivity tools (spreadsheets, presentations, workflow management) and a willingness to learn new skills.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Navigate ECAD software (Allegro/Altium/KiCad/etc.) to examine board design files (layout/ODB++),
* Experience operating and interpreting 2D/3D X-Ray equipment to inspect BGA/LGA solder joints for voiding and assembly defects.
* Experience operating automated/semi-automated rework stations for BGA re-balling and SMD placement such an Ersa HR550 or similar.
* Experience operating wire bonding equipment (wedge and/or ball bonding), with any level of automation, for microelectronic assemblies.
* Experience with running characterization and FA measurements such at TDR, DK, utilizing a probe station when necessary.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate
jobs.description:
Slingshot Biosciences is a fast-growing life sciences company with a platform technology and paradigm-shifting mission to make precision-engineered cell mimics the gold standard for all cell-based assay controls. We are transforming cell-based applications with the most robust, scalable, and reproducible controls available, including TruCytes™ Biomarker controls, SpectraComp® compensation controls, ViaComp® cell health controls, and FlowCytes® instrument controls.

Our TruCytes cell mimics precisely replicate real cells' optical and biochemical properties - without the sourcing, quality, or cost challenges of traditional controls. Trusted in cell-based applications across cell therapy, drug development, and diagnostics, they empower process and analytical development, quality control, potency assessments, multi-site validations, clinical research studies, and assay development and validation.

Slingshot is seeking motivated, creative team members who think outside the box. We empower employees to own their work, contribute ideas quickly, and improve processes. Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions for cell-based applications!

**Manufacturing Associate**

Emeryville, California, United States, Operations, Full Time, On site

**Location**: 100% onsite in Emeryville, CA.

This role reports to the Manager, Manufacturing & Technology Transfer.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **ERP, Fulfillment & Logistics:** Maintain ERP data integrity within NetSuite, including item masters, lead times, and inventory dashboards. Oversee end-to-end domestic and international logistics by managing freight forwarders and 3PLs to balance transit speed and landed costs while ensuring customs and trade compliance.
* **Inventory & Space Management:** Direct comprehensive inventory management and physical upkeep across R&D and production laboratory spaces. Establish replenishment parameters (Min/Max, Reorder Points), manage surplus and shelf life, oversee incoming shipments with accurate logging and QC distribution, and coordinate lab custodial standards.
* **Procurement & Sourcing:** Lead procurement initiatives by identifying, evaluating, and onboarding secondary suppliers for critical path materials. Consolidate spot purchases into master supply agreements to secure volume pricing, and enforce standard procurement workflows from timely PO creation through 3-way invoice matching and stale PO closures.
* **Product Manufacturing:** Support production efforts with hands-on benchwork as needed to meet production schedules. Execute batch records, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Maintain documentation standards and quality specifications required by the Quality Management System.
* **Administrative Support & Logistics:** Maintain office space inventory, incoming mail and package distribution. Oversee end-to-end domestic and international order fulfillment and logistics, coordinating pick, pack, and ship workflows.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Must have hands-on experience maintaining ERP systems (preferably NetSuite) and building operational dashboards for inventory, purchasing, and supply chain metrics.
* B.S. in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field with 3+ years of experience managing laboratory operations, inventory, or materials in a regulated biotech or production environment.
* Hands-on laboratory and production execution experience (e.g., reagent preparation, cell handling, or assay workflows and operation of automated liquid handlers).
* Demonstrated vendor management expertise with proven ability to negotiate contracts, establish blanket purchase orders, and build secondary sourcing pipelines.
* Nice to have - working knowledge of laboratory EHS regulations, chemical hygiene standards, hazardous waste management, and equipment calibration oversight. Ability to routinely lift up to 30 lbs and handle cold-storage materials.

**Impact of This Role**
-----------------------

* Drive transformative working capital efficiency and operational stability by securing reliable supply chains and resolving inbound pipeline risks, material shortages, and customs/logistics delays before they disrupt operations.
* Establish a scalable, highly visible procurement and inventory infrastructure that directly empowers our R&D and manufacturing teams to innovate and reliably deliver precision-engineered cell mimics.

  

**Salary and Benefits:**

The base salary range for this full-time position is between $90,000 - $110,000, depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**About Slingshot:**

Our north star is to make healthcare more accessible around the world. We are doing this by advancing cell biology to develop innovative solutions for human health.

At Slingshot, we value diversity and believe that a variety of backgrounds and experiences leads to more innovative ideas and a better understanding of our customers. Passion is at the core of our values, and employees are encouraged to pursue their passions in their work and contribute to the company's overall mission.

Slingshot Biosciences is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For U.S.-based roles, this includes completion of required employment eligibility verification. Engagement Overview

This role focuses on accelerating the performance, portability, and numerical correctness of cutting-edge machine learning workloads on Google TPUs
. You will work across high-level ML frameworks, compiler/runtime systems, distributed execution environments, and low-level custom kernels to eliminate hardware bottlenecks and implement ultra-efficient workloads.
The ideal candidate operates seamlessly between model-level math and hardware-aware execution: inspecting GPU-oriented implementations, analyzing their exact semantics, translating them into TPU-compatible forms, and rigorously validating both numerical correctness and execution speed.
Key Responsibilities
Kernel Development & Porting:
Develop and optimize high-performance custom kernels and critical ML operations for TPU execution. Translate CUDA and Triton kernel behaviors into standard PyTorch or JAX implementations that compile efficiently via OpenXLA/XLA.
Workload Profiling & Diagnostics:
Profile distributed training and inference workloads to identify compute, memory, communication, compilation, and data-movement bottlenecks.
Full-Stack Debugging:
Debug correctness and performance issues across ML frameworks, compiler/runtime layers, distributed execution topologies, and accelerator kernels.
Adversarial Agent Benchmarking & Task Formulation:
Design authentic, production-derived engineering challenges from modern open-weight architectures (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) to stress-test and evaluate baseline frontier models (e.g., Gemini 3.7 Flash, Claude Code), establishing ground-truth solutions and rigorous evaluation rubrics for autonomous agents.
Hardware-Aware Strategy:
Design TPU-friendly tiling, sharding, reduction, data-movement, and mixed-precision strategies for standard and custom ML operations.
Correctness & Gradient Validation:
Validate numerical equivalence, gradient correctness, masking/indexing behavior, and edge cases between source GPU implementations and TPU-targeted implementations.
Benchmark Architecture:
Build and maintain diagnostic workflows and reproducible microbenchmarks to measure latency, throughput, utilization, memory usage, communication overhead, and performance regressions.
Frontier Model Optimization:
Analyze transformer and LLM workloads—including attention variants, MoE, KV-cache, quantized matmuls, and distributed training/serving patterns—to capture performance gains.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Collaborate with ML systems, compiler, infrastructure, and model engineers to translate workload requirements into efficient accelerator implementations.

Minimum Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Systems Programming:
Strong programming proficiency in Python and at least one systems language ( C++, CUDA, or Pallas
).
Accelerator Frameworks:
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing ML accelerator code using JAX/Pallas, PyTorch-XLA, or OpenXLA
.
Distributed ML:
Practical understanding of distributed machine learning concepts.

Preferred Qualifications
Advanced Degree:
Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.
TPU Hardware Knowledge:
In-depth knowledge of TPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and hardware performance characteristics.
GPU-to-TPU Translation:
Proven experience converting CUDA or Triton implementations to standard PyTorch or JAX APIs for TPU execution while maintaining numerical and gradient semantics.
Distributed Collectives & Parallelism:
Strong background in distributed ML techniques, including data, tensor, sequence, and expert parallelism; multidimensional sharding; and collective communications (all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter, all-to-all).
Frontier Model Profiling:
Experience extracting, profiling, and optimizing kernels from frontier open-weight models (e.g., DeepSeek V3/V4, Qwen 2.5/3.8, Kimi K2.5).
Numerical Stability & Precision:
Deep experience debugging numerical correctness issues involving bf16/fp32 accumulation, quantization scaling, softmax/log-sum-exp stability, masking, and backward-pass gradient behavior.
High-Performance ML Stacks:
Experience with performance-oriented open-source systems such as vLLM, FlashAttention, JAX/Flax, PyTorch/XLA, or equivalent kernel libraries.

Experience designing reproducible microbenchmarks, performance regression test suites, and profiling tools for accelerator workloads.

The Chattree Lab in UC San Diego's Department of Neurosciences studies how brain cell types and circuits contribute to movement and cognition in Parkinson's disease and related neurological disorders, with the goal of developing more precise therapies. Led by Gaurav Chattree, MD, a movement-disorders neurologist and physician-scientist, the lab combines mouse behavior, optical imaging, targeted circuit manipulation, and molecular analysis of brain tissue.

Under the PI's supervision, the Laboratory Assistant I assists with established mouse behavioral, surgical, imaging, histological, and molecular procedures and supports day-to-day laboratory operations. As an early lab member, the assistant helps establish organized records, inventories, and experimental workflows. Training will be provided in lab-specific techniques, with responsibilities matched to demonstrated skills. Applicants do not need experience in every method. The role includes close interaction with the PI, discussion of research findings, and mentorship connecting circuit neuroscience with questions arising in clinical neurology.

* Willingness to learn laboratory techniques under supervision and work with mice in accordance with approved protocols and animal-welfare requirements.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions, carry out established procedures carefully, and maintain accurate records and notebooks.
* Organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage samples, supplies, and experimental schedules.

* Basic computer skills for recording data, organizing files, and using spreadsheets; willingness to learn laboratory software and safe equipment handling.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with laboratory organization, inventory, reagent preparation, equipment maintenance, or research-protocol documentation.
* **Prior experience with mouse handling strongly preferred**, colony maintenance, genotyping, or behavioral experiments. Candidates with strong potential who require additional training will also be considered.
* Experience assisting with stereotaxic surgery, viral injections, cranial windows, or postoperative animal care.
* Experience with histology, immunostaining, fluorescence microscopy, or in situ hybridization.
* Experience with calcium imaging, two-photon microscopy, or basic analysis of imaging or behavioral data, including Python or MATLAB.

======================

* Must be willing to work with mice and biological materials under approved protocols and complete required animal-research and laboratory safety training.

**About Glide**

GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization

**Position Summary**:

The Lab Technician executes all Health Empowerment & Access Team (HEAT) testing, phlebotomy, and laboratory services for HIV, HCV, and STIs for participants referred to GLIDE’s low-barrier prevention programs. This position performs high-volume phlebotomy, CLIA-waived and moderate complexity testing, quality assurance on lab tests, and specimen processing and transport to off-site laboratories.The role serves as an HIV/HCV/STI test counselor, providing one-on-one risk reduction counseling, sexual health education, and referrals to healthcare and social support services. The technician also supports clinical research activities including specimen collection, processing, documentation, and delivery in compliance with Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and regulatory protocols. This position requires an understanding of how trauma and social determinants of health impact participant engagement. The job involves direct participant contact with diverse, high-risk individuals with complex needs, as well as substantial community outreach including street and neighborhood settings. Regular and predictable on-site attendance is required.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Perform high-volume phlebotomy (venipuncture) for STI testing, RNA confirmatory testing, and research specimens.

* Perform blood draw collections regularly for STI testing and RNA confirmatory testing with all clients testing reactive for HIV or Hep C in community-based settings.

* Organize and store samples in accordance with all safety and other requirements of personnel and integrity of samples.
* Maintain daily records, temperature logs, and equipment logs.
* Maintain quality controls and perform quality assurance on all testing supplies and equipment.
* Educate, empower, and support clients to make informed decisions regarding their utilization of relevant services to achieve their safety, health and wellness goals.
* Provide in-house and external referrals to clients as needed.
* Conduct street and community outreach in settings where clients gather and/or live to provide testing services.

* Adhere to professional boundaries and standards. Understand and follow basic ethics, values and principles of clinical regulatory practices.
* Adhere to all laws and requirements regarding HIPAA, confidentiality, child/adult protective services, contractual agreements, etc.
* Assist Testing Manager in promoting testing services, linkages to care, and prevention education.
* Assist with other HEAT Programs activities, including syringe access services (SAS) and other provision of safer use supplies, street outreach, and community-based pop-up events.

* Current California State Phlebotomy Technician I (CPT-1) certification or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.

* Experience working with people who use drugs (PWUD) and people living with HIV/HCV.

The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Titus Family Department of Clinical Pharmacy, is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to support ongoing studies in immunogenomics, cancer genomics and therapeutics.

We are a translational genomics and experimental therapeutics lab focused on identifying and investigating novel therapeutic targets in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and developing new therapeutic strategies. We seek a highly motivated, detail-oriented individual to perform molecular, cellular, and in vivo experiments and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory.

* Assist with preclinical studies in leukemia mouse models, including colony maintenance, dosing, monitoring, and tissue collection
* Perform basic data analysis and assist with bioinformatic workflows under the guidance of senior lab members
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, sample databases, and inventory; order supplies and reagents

* Prepare figures and summaries of results for lab meetings and contribute to manuscripts under the direction of the Principal Investigator

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology, or a related field
* Hands-on laboratory experience with routine molecular biology and cell culture techniques
* Excellent organizational, record-keeping, and communication skills

* Master’s degree or 1–2 years of research laboratory experience
* Experience with flow cytometry, NGS sample preparation, or high-throughput assays

**Company Description**

Eurofins EAG Laboratories has over 40 years experience in engineering and materials testing services. Our parent company, Eurofins Scientific, is a multi-billion-dollar global leader in engineering and scientific services operating over 950 labs in 60 countries with 65,000 employees with a portfolio of over 200,000 validated analytical methods.

At EAG, curiosity fuels everything we do. Every analysis, every test, and every question asked in our labs helps unlock what materials and products are capable of—and what the world can build next. If you’re energized by materials science, analytical chemistry, engineering rigor, and solving problems that matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our scientists and engineers support industries ranging from semiconductors and advanced electronics to pharmaceuticals, medical devices, energy systems, and consumer products. Using advanced techniques in analytical chemistry, microscopy, surface analysis, and engineering sciences, we help clients solve complex challenges across the product lifecycle.

What sets EAG apart isn’t just our world‑class instrumentation—it’s our people. We’re problem solvers, collaborators, and lifelong learners who value precision, curiosity, and impact. Here, your work directly influences the safety, reliability, and performance of products used around the globe.

**Imagine the possibilities. Let’s explore them together.**

 **Job Description**

We are seeking experienced **Scientists** who are passionate about hands-on analysis, advanced characterization techniques, and delivering impactful results for clients across a wide range of industries.

Join our Advanced Microscopy team and play a key role in solving complex materials and semiconductor challenges using cutting-edge **Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)**.

In this production focused role, you'll spend significant time operating state-of-the-art TEM instrumentation, analyzing advanced materials, and providing high-quality, site specific insights that drive critical client decisions. The ideal candidate is a technically strong contributor who thrives in a fast-paced laboratory environment, enjoys working directly with sophisticated tools, and takes pride in delivering accurate, timely results while meeting client expectations.

The TEM Scientist will be responsible for:

* Partnering with team members to provide high quality analysis service to clients.
* Operating TEM tools to obtain TEM/STEM images, SAED, EDS and EELS data from samples.
* Developing TEM analysis protocols/techniques to meet clients’ requests.
* Creating summary reports to capture the project objectives, analysis data and interpretation of the results.

A typical day would involve-

* Operating the TEM tools (FEI or JEOL electron microscopes) and collecting TEM/STEM images based on customers' requests.
* Performing elemental analysis such as EDS/EELS (collecting/process the data and creating the reports).
* Engaging in discussions with customers to solve their questions and concerns.

**Work Schedule: \*5pm-2am, Tuesdays to Saturdays OR Sundays to Thursdays**

* 10% shift differential will apply

**Lab locations:** Milpitas or Sunnyvale, CA

 **Qualifications**  

* **Minimum 3+ years hands-on TEM operation experience** (general electron microscopy or broader materials characterization experience will not meet this requirement)
* Independent operation of **TEM/STEM instrumentation**
* Hands-on **SAED technique** (Selected Area Electron Diffraction)
* Hands-on **EDS** (Energy Dispersive Xray Spectroscopy) **and EELS** (Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy) **techniques for acquisition, processing, and interpretation**
* **4D-STEM** technique experience
* Demonstrated understanding of **TEM operating principles**
* Experience developing **TEM-specific analysis protocols/techniques**
* Experience producing reports that interpret TEM results

**What would set you apart:**

* **FEI/Thermo Fisher and/or JEOL** instrument experience
* Preferred experience with **semiconductor chips and wafer samples**

  
**Additional Information**

**Compensation is aligned with market standards for the region and tailored to individual qualifications and experience.**

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to continuously operate a personal computer or lab equipment for extended periods of time (4 or more hours).
* Ability to operate a keyboard and other lab equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead.
* Ability to communicate clearly and understandably ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting.
* Ability to handle small and fragile devices with tweezers and /or fingers.
* Require close distance visual acuity with or without correction (Glasses, Contacts, etc.).
* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 80% of the time.

The essential physical and mental requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**What It’s Like to Work Here**

* **Teamwork:** Be inspired by your leaders, be encouraged by your teammates and be supported in all parts of your journey while you work with us.
* **Learning & Development:** Take on career development programs and goal setting to create big possibilities for your career and life. Develop within the company; be mentored and grown as a leader.

jobs.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

  

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

  

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Research Associate, Biomarker Operations supports the execution of biomarker and biospecimen activities across oncology clinical trials, with a particular focus on Multiple Myeloma and hematologic malignancies. This role partners closely with Translational Medicine, Clinical Operations, study teams, and external laboratory partners to coordinate sample collection, tracking, shipment, testing, and data reconciliation activities. The successful candidate will help ensure high-quality biomarker operations throughout the clinical trial lifecycle by managing biospecimen workflows, supporting vendor relationships, maintaining study documentation, and contributing to study startup and execution activities.

  

The individual will also leverage AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven technologies to streamline workflows, enhance operational efficiency, improve reporting and sample oversight, and support data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate has experience in oncology clinical research, strong organizational and project coordination skills, digital and AI fluency, and a passion for advancing translational science through operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The Research Associate, Biomarker Operations supports the execution of biomarker and biospecimen activities across global oncology clinical trials, with a primary focus on Multiple Myeloma and hematologic malignancies. This role partners closely with Translational Medicine, Clinical Operations, Clinical Study Teams, and external laboratory vendors to coordinate sample collection, tracking, shipment, testing, and data reconciliation activities.

  

The successful candidate will contribute to the execution of high-quality biomarker operations throughout the clinical trial lifecycle by managing complex biospecimen workflows, supporting laboratory vendors, maintaining study documentation, and enabling study startup and ongoing trial execution. In addition, this individual will leverage AI-enabled, automation, and digital technologies to enhance sample management, optimize operational workflows, support vendor oversight, improve reporting capabilities, and generate actionable insights that inform study decisions.

As part of an evolving AI-first operating model, this role will be expected to utilize tools such as Microsoft Copilot, advanced analytics platforms, workflow automation solutions, and data visualization technologies to streamline routine tasks, increase operational efficiency, improve data quality, identify risks proactively, and accelerate decision-making across biomarker programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Biospecimen & Sample Management**

* Support end-to-end biospecimen operations for global oncology clinical trials.
* Track specimen collection, processing, shipment, receipt, testing, and storage activities.
* Reconcile sample inventories and support resolution of sample-related queries and discrepancies.
* Monitor sample shipments and coordinate issue resolution with sites, laboratories, and vendors.
* Maintain specimen tracking databases and study-specific sample management tools.
* Ensure accurate documentation and chain-of-custody records throughout the study lifecycle.

**Study Support**

* Assist with the development and review of laboratory manuals, collection guidelines, and sample handling instructions.
* Support protocol and Schedule of Assessments reviews to identify biomarker collection and testing requirements.
* Participate in study startup activities, including laboratory vendor setup, sample logistics planning, and site training support.
* Contribute to study team meetings and biomarker operational discussions.
* Support implementation of biomarker strategies and sample management plans across multiple studies.

**Vendor Coordination**

* Serve as an operational point of contact for central laboratories, specialty testing laboratories, and biorepositories.
* Coordinate sample transfers and testing requests with vendors.
* Track laboratory deliverables, sample status, and turnaround timelines.
* Identify, communicate, and escalate operational risks and issues in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with vendors to ensure compliance with study requirements and timelines.

**Data, Documentation & Reporting**

* Support biomarker data reconciliation activities.
* Maintain study documentation, sample transfer records, operational trackers, and status reports.
* Assist with generation of sample metrics, dashboards, and study updates.
* Ensure documentation complies with SOPs, GCP requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.

**AI-Enabled Operations & Innovation**

* Leverage AI-powered tools and digital solutions to support study planning, sample tracking, vendor oversight, and operational reporting.
* Utilize automation and data-driven insights to improve biomarker workflow efficiency and proactively identify operational risks.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and performance reports to support clinical trial execution and decision-making.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

We are comprised of a 353-bed hospital, three medical office buildings, residency programs, comprehensive cancer care and a vast scope of services located in the Los Angeles area. Los Angeles is known for its art, rich culture, numerous sports teams and world-renowned dining. There is something for everyone in this culturally diverse city.

Job Summary:

Prioritizes and performs a wide variety of clinical laboratory tests on various biological specimens. Reviews, evaluates, documents and reports results. Preserves confidentiality of patients and follows lab safety and maintenance protocols. Trains and supervises trainees, laboratory assistants and clerks as needed.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* Bachelor’s Degree in medical technology, clinical laboratory science, biological sciences, chemical sciences or allied health technologies or equivalent: Required
* Clinical laboratory experience: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license in state of employment: Required in CA
* Current certification from American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or National Credentialing Agency for Labs (NCA): Preferred

Essential Functions:

* Employs positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing. Performs proper specimen collection (including phlebotomy procedures as necessary), labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage. Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
* Prioritizes lab orders according to type (STAT, ASAP, routine and timed studies) and performs various testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) following prescribed quality assurance policies and procedures. Performs, evaluates and documents quality control checks. Reviews testing results evaluating validity of test results in comparison to anticipated results indicated per procedure manual.
* Reviews and evaluates the validity and accuracy of test results, recognizing the interdependency of tests, the physiological conditions affecting results, patient age and normal values, controls, linearity errors, instrument codes, delta checks and more. Correlates test results with diagnoses and questions incompatible results. Thoroughly documents and communicates test results, expediting all critical values and results to appropriate clinicians.
