jobs.title: Sr. Bioinformatics Scientist, MRD
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Position Overview

The Senior Bioinformatics Scientist will serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert within the Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) program, working collaboratively with senior scientists and leaders on complex Research and Development projects. In this role, you will participate in or lead the planning of projects and analyses, and often act as the bioinformatics lead responsible for successful project execution. You will independently determine methods and procedures for new assignments, make detailed observations, analyze data, interpret results, and provide insights that shape the next steps and direction of the project. Your work will center on developing novel methods to identify and integrate genomic and epigenetic biomarkers that improve the sensitivity and specificity of MRD assays, contributing end-to-end across the data science workflow : collecting public datasets, curating internal data, forming hypotheses, building and validating models, and exploring machine learning and AI-based approaches. You will also research new technologies, contribute ideas and concepts to improve or develop processes, and help establish methods and workflows that advance product development toward diagnostic assay products.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following :

Technical leadership : Serve as bioinformatics lead and subject matter expert on one or more complex R&D projects, including those supporting diagnostic assay product development, and lead or participate in project and analysis planning.
Analysis and interpretation : Independently analyze experimental data across several product or technology areas, interpret results, identify trends, problems, and discrepancies, and recommend next steps and project direction.
Complex problem solving : Tackle problems of extremely complex scope where intangible variables must be evaluated, applying independent judgment to define methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria.
Method and study design : Independently develop methods, procedures, and development plans for new studies, and give technical input on project planning and experimental design.
Data and computational management : Manage bench-generated data and bioinformatics outputs in HPC or cloud computing environments, selecting and applying the right methods and technologies.
Data quality : Evaluate the impact of nonconforming data on products or processes and address trends in study data.
Innovation and IP : Track industry and technology developments, propose new techniques, lead process improvements, and contribute to the intellectual property portfolio.
Communication and presentation : Present and defend scientific findings at data, group, project, and departmental meetings, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, including functional managers and the clinical lab.
Documentation and compliance : Prepare and approve technical procedures, protocols, and reports, support abstracts, conferences, and publications, and follow legal, ISO, QSR, and Quality Management System requirements.
Mentorship and collaboration : Train and mentor research associates and junior scientists, foster a trusting, collaborative team environment, and manage multiple projects with shifting priorities.
Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
Ability to travel 5% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.

Minimum Qualifications

Ph.D. in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field; or Master’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 4 years of experience in lieu of a Ph.D.; or Bachelor’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 6 years of experience in lieu of Ph.D.
5+ years of industry or academia experience in bioinformatics.
3+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
Extensive experience in Linux-based HPC or cloud computing environments and associated tools.
Ability to write custom code in at least three programming or scripting languages.
Technical expert in the area of molecular biology and/or biochemistry and/or next-generation sequencing (NGS) and genomics.
Knowledge of product/assay research, design, or development.
Working knowledge of statistical and mathematical methods in biology/genetics
Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.
Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
Previous experience as a project lead for a team of scientists.
1+ years of direct people leadership and management experience.
Previous industry experience in product development or technical support.
Background containing a substantial amount of bioinformatics work including troubleshooting.
Previous experience working in a molecular diagnostics/clinical laboratory setting.

jobs.description:
How to apply

Apply through the form below. It takes about 10 minutes. Along with your CV, it asks for:
a short message on why Abstract, why now and why you
one example of how you use AI at work

We read every application ourselves and reply within a week.
You will only be considered if you apply through the link below: https://abstractbio.notion.site/abstract-bio-careers
TLDR

We are building the biological inputs factory that will unlock AI for biology, starting from DNA, the first building block of every biomolecule. Demand for our first DNA product outran our capacity within months of launch, and we are now scaling 10x. As our Bioinformatics Engineer, you will own the sequencing data that tells us whether every molecule we make is right: the pipelines that QC each order, the analyses that show where our chemistry makes errors, and the tools that feed those answers back to R&D and production. The best candidate has 3-5 years working hands-on with sequencing data, ideally nanopore, ideally at a company that makes DNA. They are AI-native and scrappy, ship a working pipeline this week rather than a perfect one next quarter, and care about the molecule behind the reads. This is a sequencing-data role, not protein design or structural modelling. Your role will evolve with time; you should be excited by that and step up when needed. THIS IS NOT A 9 TO 5.

Story and mission

The Bessemer process made steel cheap and set off the Second Industrial Revolution. AI is now doing the same to biological design, and cloud labs and robots are doing it to testing. That pushes the bottleneck to the build step: the physical inputs. Every protein and every RNA starts as DNA, and DNA is still expensive. With current suppliers, the DNA to test one therapeutic antibody design costs around $100 per data point; a good antibody needs thousands of them, and a good antibody model needs millions. Abstract Bio is building the factory for those inputs, starting from DNA, the first building block.
We brought a DNA product, 4-10x cheaper than incumbents, to market within 6 months of founding the company. With a team of three and word of mouth alone, demand quickly outran our capacity, so we are now building for true scale. This means a 10x larger production platform, adding long and plasmid DNA, and starting the first R&D on RNA and proteins.
You cannot sell DNA you have not verified, and at 10x the volume you cannot verify it by eye. Every order needs to be sequenced, analysed and passed or failed automatically, and every failure needs to teach us something about our process. Building that is the job of the Bioinformatics Engineer. Our North Star is to be the biological inputs factory that gives scientists any biomolecule, on demand: the missing part of the stack that will unlock AI for biology.
Role description

We are turning DNA into a commodity, and a commodity wins on cost and reliability. Sequencing is how we prove reliability in production and get insights from R&D experiments. As our Bioinformatics Engineer, you make that measurement fast, automatic and cheap, and you turn the data behind it into insight that improves our process.
You are hands-on. You write the pipelines, read the alignments and look at the raw signal when the numbers do not add up. You work across R&D and production. When production needs to QC more orders, you build the pipeline that calls each one pass or fail without a human. When R&D changes the molecular biology, you show them exactly where the errors moved.
You are AI-native. Our lab will be built so that software can read it, and you are one of the people who make that true. You use AI to write and review code every day, and you build the tools and agents that let the rest of the team ask questions of our sequencing data.
You are scrappy. Off-the-shelf tools were built for genomes, not for millions of short synthetic molecules or a plate of plasmids. You will adapt the open-source tool, write your own when it does not exist.
You report to the founders and work side by side with the production and R&D teams. This is a ground-floor role: as we scale and add more data and software people, you will have the chance to grow into leading bioinformatics for a multi-site factory.
What you will do

Build the QC pipeline. Sequence-verify every order, from short DNA to long and plasmid DNA, with automated pass/fail calls and clear reports for customers.
Find where the errors come from. Characterise synthesis and assembly errors and tie them back to the method, the sequence and the run.
Close the loop with R&D. Turn error profiles into design rules.
Make sequencing cheap. Choose platforms, multiplexing and read depth so QC costs as little per base-pair as possible.
Connect the data. Wire sequencing results into our order and production data, and build the dashboards and agents that let anyone in the lab query them.

What you will need to succeed

Sequencing data. 3-5 years hands-on with sequencing reads (alignment, error calling, QC), in industry or a PhD.
AI-native. Solid Python, at home in a terminal, and you've built an AI tool people use.
Production pipelines. Nextflow, Snakemake or similar, running unattended.
Molecular biology sense. You can tell a chemistry error from a sequencing artefact.
Fast and calm. You ship the fix this week and explain results in plain language.

Nice-to-haves

Nanopore data, especially its error modes.
Time at a company that makes DNA.
Long-read or plasmid verification.
Bench time prepping sequencing libraries.

If you've read this far, start your motivation message with the word "Q30".

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

Overview

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead BI and Data Science product management for Merchandising, Planning, Inventory, and Store Operations. This leader will own the product strategy and roadmap for the intelligence products that help DSG teams plan assortments, manage inventory, optimize seasonal decisions, operate stores, and understand performance across the business.

The portfolio includes certified reporting, operational dashboards, planning and merchandising data products consumed through insights experiences, self-service analytics, and applied data science capabilities such as forecasting, optimization, recommendations, and decision support. This leader will partner across Merchandising, Planning, Stores, Supply Chain, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, Architecture, and business leadership to translate complex operational needs into scalable products that improve speed, quality, and consistency of decision-making.

This is a hands-on product leadership role. The GPM will lead BI product managers, manage third-party PM capacity, establish portfolio discipline, and shape the future team structure as DSG expands its in-house product capability in this space.

Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of how DSG modernizes decision-making across merchandising and store operations. The leader will help move teams from fragmented reports, manual analysis, and reactive planning toward trusted reporting, governed metrics, self-service insights, and model-enabled recommendations that improve planning quality, inventory productivity, store execution, and athlete experience.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-impact intelligence portfolio at the intersection of retail operations, merchandising, planning, inventory, and applied AI. The role has direct visibility into how DSG makes some of its most important business decisions and will shape the products, operating model, and team structure that modernize decision-making across stores and merchandising.

Key Responsibilities

Own the portfolio strategy and roadmap for BI, reporting, analytics, decision support, and applied data science across Merchandising, Planning, Inventory, and Store Operations.
Lead store operations intelligence for senior store vice presidents, field leaders, store managers, store captains, and operational teams.
Lead merchandising and planning intelligence for merchants, planners, buyers, inventory optimization teams, and seasonal or pre-season planning workflows.
Partner with the Data Products GPM to connect trusted domain data foundations to BI, analytics, decision-support, and applied data science products.
Define where data science should change decisions by identifying high-value opportunities for forecasting, optimization, recommendations, and model-enabled workflows.
Translate ambiguous business asks into clear product problems, measurable outcomes, user workflows, prioritized roadmaps, and delivery plans.
Modernize the reporting ecosystem by moving teams from fragmented dashboards, manual reconciliation, and one-off reporting toward certified metrics, semantic-layer alignment, self-service analytics, and scalable insights products.
Establish clear portfolio governance including intake, prioritization, roadmap reviews, dependency management, release planning, adoption planning, and post-launch value tracking.
Lead and develop product talent including in-house BI PMs and third-party PM resources, with consistent standards for product thinking, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and delivery accountability.
Measure business impact through outcomes such as decision quality, planning cycle time, forecast accuracy, inventory productivity, store execution, adoption, reduced manual effort, and operational ROI.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in product management, data product management, analytics product management, BI product leadership, data science product management, or related technical product roles.
Experience leading product portfolios in merchandising, retail, stores, supply chain, inventory, planning, marketplace, finance, or operations-heavy environments.
Strong product leadership across BI, analytics, metrics, reporting modernization, semantic layers, data products, and/or applied ML.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity in highly matrixed organizations with senior business and technology stakeholders.
Experience managing product managers, contractors, consultants, third-party PMs, or cross-functional delivery partners.
Technical fluency in data platforms, BI tools, analytics engineering, data governance, experimentation, forecasting, optimization, and ML-enabled decision systems.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between executive business needs, user workflows, data constraints, technical tradeoffs, and delivery roadmaps.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required. Advanced degree in business, computer science, engineering, analytics, data science, or a related discipline preferred.

In this role, you will work with customers and team members to understand requirements, develop data structures, validate information, and support the delivery of useful analyses and reports. You will investigate data and system issues, conduct product analysis, and help resolve problems through careful review and clear communication.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working with relational database management systems, data warehousing concepts, SQL, and Cognos tools. This position requires the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team. Candidates must currently hold a Secret security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required for a Secret clearance at this location.

Qualifications

A high school diploma is required; a bachelor’s degree is highly desired. Candidates should have at least five years of relevant experience and demonstrate strong analytical skills involving relational databases and data warehousing. Experience using the Cognos Tool Suite to create dashboards and reports, along with the ability to write and analyze SQL queries, is important for success in this position.

Qualified candidates will bring knowledge of mathematical reasoning and the communication skills needed to support customers, gather requirements, and validate results. Strong interpersonal skills, good judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability are essential. Candidates should be able to organize their work, exercise initiative, and contribute in both independent and collaborative settings. Experience with security assessment tools such as Nessus, and with implementing and testing security controls, is also required. Familiarity with analytical tools and evaluation techniques is desirable. Knowledge of government accounting is preferred, with Department of Defense accounting experience especially valued.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain data structures and tables that support analysis, reporting, and customer needs. jobs.description:
Staff Research Associate, Linguistics (9613C) #89726 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Department of Linguistics, within the Social Sciences Division of the College of Letters and Science, is highly regarded in the linguistics community. Our faculty and students have close contacts with other departments and programs on campus, including Anthropology, Cognitive Science, Computer Science, Education, Native American Studies, Philosophy, Psychology, and many language and literature departments. We are home to several laboratories and a language archive. The department consists of 25 faculty members, including emeritae, approximately 35 graduate students, and 100+ undergraduate majors. We also host postdocs, visiting scholars, researchers, and 6 staff FTE.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Staff Research Associate supports the UC Berkeley site of a multi-site, NIH-funded research project (R01DC021849; lead site: Northwestern University) examining pragmatic language and social communication in autism across two typologically distinct languages, English and Mandarin Chinese. The Berkeley site, directed by the Principal Investigator (Prof. Alan Yu, Department of Linguistics), is responsible for enrolling and testing Mandarin-speaking participants.
  
  
Under close technical supervision by the PI and the postdoctoral researcher, the position exists to carry out participant recruitment and data collection with Mandarin-speaking autistic individuals, their family members, and non-autistic comparison participants, and to ensure that all assessments, language samples, and neurophysiological (EEG) data collected at Berkeley are obtained, managed, and transferred according to the shared multi-site protocol so that they can be combined with data collected at Northwestern University.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 13, 2026. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Participant Testing and Data Collection - 50%
  
  
Under close technical supervision and following established procedures, administers the study's standardized testing battery, primarily in Mandarin and in English where required, to autistic individuals, their family members, and non-autistic comparison participants, including minors. The battery includes clinical-behavioral characterization measures, cognitive IQ and standardized language tests, narrative and conversational language elicitation tasks, electroencephalography EEG experiments, and questionnaires.
  
Obtains informed consent and assent; prepares testing rooms, materials, and equipment; fits EEG caps and electrodes, monitors signal quality, and runs computerized experiments; audio- and video-records sessions; and scores assessments according to test manuals and study protocol after training to study standards.
  
**End Result:** Complete, valid, protocol-consistent data from every session that are comparable with data collected at the lead site, and a safe, respectful, and well-paced experience for each participant and family.
  
  
Recruitment, Screening, and Scheduling - 25%
  
  
Conducts outreach to Mandarin-speaking families through community organizations, autism service providers, parent networks, and occasional community events; responds to inquiries; and conducts eligibility screening by phone or online in Mandarin and English.
  
Schedules research visits, including visits involving multiple members of the same family; sends reminders and visit instructions; and maintains an accurate recruitment and enrollment tracking log.
  
**End Result:** Steady enrollment that meets site recruitment targets, with accurate and up-to-date records of participant contact, eligibility, and visit status.
  
  
Data Management and Quality Control - 15%
  
  
Enters and verifies assessment and questionnaire data in secure study databases; organizes, labels, and de-identifies audio, video, and EEG files; performs initial quality checks on collected data; and transfers data to the lead site through approved secure platforms.
  
**End Result:** An accurate, secure, and analysis-ready Berkeley site dataset that is fully aligned with the multi-site data structure.
  
  
Regulatory Compliance and Project Coordination - 10%
  
  
Maintains IRB documentation, consent records, and protocol training logs; documents and reports protocol deviations to the PI; attends regular meetings with the Northwestern research team; prepares progress summaries for the PI; and maintains testing equipment and supply inventory.
  
**End result:** Site operations that remain in compliance with IRB-approved procedures and University policy and stay closely aligned with lead-site procedures and timelines.

jobs.title: Research Lab Technician II - Data Analysis
jobs.description:
The USC Alfred E. Mann School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Titus Family Department of Clinical Pharmacy, is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to support ongoing studies in immunogenomics, cancer genomics and therapeutics.

We are a translational genomics and experimental therapeutics lab focused on identifying and investigating novel therapeutic targets in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and developing new therapeutic strategies. We seek a highly motivated, detail-oriented individual to perform molecular, cellular, and in vivo experiments and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Process and run quality control on next-generation sequencing data (e.g., RNA-seq, whole-exome/genome sequencing, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, single-cell sequencing) using established pipelines
* Perform downstream analyses, including differential expression, variant calling and annotation, pathway enrichment, and clustering, under the guidance of the Principal Investigator and senior lab members
* Analyze data from high-throughput drug screens, flow cytometry, and preclinical mouse studies; perform basic statistical analyses
* Mine public ‘omics’ resources (e.g., TCGA, BeatAML, GEO, DepMap) to support target discovery and validation
* Maintain, document, and update analysis pipelines and scripts using version control
* Organize and manage lab datasets, sample metadata, and clinical annotations in compliance with IRB and data security requirements
* Run jobs on USC’s high-performance computing cluster and manage data storage
* Prepare figures, tables, and summaries of results for lab meetings, presentations, and manuscripts

**Minimum Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology, or a related field
* Hands-on laboratory experience with routine molecular biology and cell culture techniques
* Excellent organizational, record-keeping, and communication skills
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Master’s degree or 1–2 years of research laboratory experience
* Experience with flow cytometry, NGS sample preparation, or high-throughput assays
* Experience with mouse handling and in vivo studies
* Familiarity with basic data analysis tools (e.g., R, Python, GraphPad Prism) or interest in learning bioinformatics
* Background in cancer biology or hematologic malignancies

**Applicants should attach the following:**

  

* Cover letter describing research experience and interests
* Résumé or CV
* Names and contact information for two to three references

The hourly rate range for this position is $25.71 - $28.32. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

  
Minimum Education: Associate's degree, Specialized/technical training, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education Minimum Experience: 2 years Minimum Field of Expertise: Working knowledge of laboratory equipment and research protocols. Knowledge of computer analysis techniques and ability to provide routine analysis and interpretation of research data.

jobs.description:
RiboForge | Los Angeles, California | On-Site | Full-Time

About RiboForge

RiboForge is a stealth biotechnology company based in Los Angeles. We are building a team with deep expertise in structural biology and X-ray crystallography and are seeking motivated researchers to support our experimental work.

About the Role

We are seeking a Research Assistant whose primary focus will be hands-on crystal harvesting and preparation of samples for X-ray diffraction studies
.

Most of your bench work will center on identifying and fishing crystals under a microscope, mounting them in loops, performing cryoprotection and flash-freezing, and maintaining organized cryogenic sample storage. Your work will directly support the quality and throughput of RiboForge’s crystallographic screening efforts.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys precise microscope work, handles delicate samples carefully, and maintains consistency across repeated harvesting sessions. You will work closely with our scientists to improve harvesting workflows and prepare crystals for diffraction experiments.

Key Responsibilities

Harvest crystals:
Identify, select, and fish protein or nucleic acid crystals from crystallization drops under a microscope using appropriate loops and mounting tools.
Prepare crystals for diffraction:
Carry out cryoprotection, mounting, flash-freezing, and cryogenic storage according to established protocols.
Maintain sample traceability:
Accurately label and track harvested crystals, recording crystallization conditions, sample identities, storage locations, and handling observations.
Improve harvesting consistency:
Work with scientists to troubleshoot crystal damage, sample loss, and variability during harvesting and freezing.
Support crystallization experiments:
Set up crystallization screens, monitor crystal growth, and assist with optimization of conditions.
Prepare reagents and samples:
Make buffers, stock solutions, and cryoprotectants using accurate micropipetting and appropriate sample-handling techniques.
Document and communicate results:
Maintain complete experimental records and coordinate sample preparation with the team’s diffraction schedules.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on experience harvesting protein or nucleic acid crystals for X-ray crystallography, including fishing crystals under a microscope, mounting, and freezing.
Careful technique when manipulating small, fragile crystals and working with small sample volumes.
Patience and sustained attention to detail during repeated microscope-based tasks.
Basic wet lab proficiency, including micropipetting and preparation of buffers, stock solutions, and dilutions.
Strong organizational skills and a consistent approach to sample labeling, tracking, and experimental documentation.
Clear communication and the ability to follow protocols, recognize problems, and work collaboratively to resolve them.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience handling protein or nucleic acid crystals and using appropriate techniques to preserve sample integrity.
Familiarity with crystallization screening, optimization, and cryoprotectant selection.
Experience preparing cryogenic sample inventories or organizing samples for synchrotron diffraction experiments.
A bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, structural biology, chemistry, or a related field is a plus, but is not required.

Experience harvesting protein crystals is relevant and welcome; prior RNA crystallography experience is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits

Anticipated full-time compensation is $70,000 per year, with flexibility to increase based on experience and qualifications. Part-time compensation and benefits eligibility will be discussed based on the position and schedule. Health coverage and benefits are included for full-time positions. Relocation assistance may be considered based on the candidate’s qualifications and circumstances.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, cover letter, and references to careers@riboforge.com
with the subject line “Research Assistant – X-ray Crystallography & Crystal Harvesting.”

In your application email, include two to three sentences describing your hands-on experience with crystal harvesting
, including the types of crystals you have worked with and your experience fishing, mounting, and freezing them.

Please also indicate whether you are interested in a part-time position, full-time position, or either
, along with your availability.

**About Quilter**
=================

At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal.

No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there:

* Curiosity

* Conviction

* Rigor

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work directly with our go-to-market team and customers to turn integration blockers into production fixes and features. Our File I/O team connects Quilter with tools including Altium, KiCad, Cadence Allegro, and Siemens Xpedition, preserving design intent as files move into Quilter and results return to the customer’s CAD workflow.

You’ll work primarily in Python on parsers, exporters, design models, diagnostics, and workflow automation. This role suits someone who enjoys jumping into ambiguous technical problems, collaborating directly with customers, and seeing their engineering work make an immediate difference. You’ll contribute to broader improvements in CAD coverage and fidelity as well as resolving urgent blockers.

You’ll also help build workflows using LLMs and agents to investigate failures, find recurring patterns, and automate repetitive integration work, with reliable checks on the results.

**Location:** This is a hybrid role based out of our Long Beach, CA office, with regular in-person collaboration alongside our go-to-market team.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Investigate and resolve customer blockers.** Work with customers and GTM to reproduce failures, inspect design data and logs, and identify the cause. Fix File I/O issues and coordinate with partner teams when a problem crosses system boundaries.
* **Ship integration features and fixes.** Own Python changes from design through rollout, including parsers, exporters, and shared representations of boards, schematics, and constraints. Make sound implementation tradeoffs and contribute through code reviews.
* **Verify the complete design workflow.** Turn representative customer cases into acceptance checks and regression tests. Validate that design information survives import and that exported results remain usable in the customer’s native CAD tool.
* **Turn recurring problems into better tooling.** Improve diagnostics and error messages, automate reproductions, and build agentic investigation workflows. Use evaluations and feedback loops to make troubleshooting faster and more reliable.
* **Connect customers’ existing workflows to Quilter.** Build reusable scripts and integrations for design-data preparation and handoffs. Use repeated customer needs to identify capabilities worth supporting in the shared product.
* **Work closely with GTM and engineering.** Help the team prioritize urgent blockers and larger improvements, agree on scope and commitments, and explain findings clearly. Pair with customers, demonstrate fixes, and document workflows they can use independently.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Deep production Python experience, with ownership of maintainable software from design through testing and rollout.
* Experience working directly with customers, partners, or technical users to understand a workflow, diagnose integration problems, and deliver working software.
* Strong debugging skills across unfamiliar code, files, and structured data. You can isolate causes and test hypotheses with incomplete information.
* Clear communication and sound judgment under time pressure. You explain uncertainty, coordinate priorities and dependencies, and follow through on both immediate fixes and lasting improvements.
* Practical experience with LLMs and agentic workflows, including evaluating results and improving the tools and feedback loops around them.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

These are useful backgrounds, not a checklist—we don’t expect any one candidate to bring all of them.

* Hands-on familiarity with PCB design workflows and ECAD tools.
* Experience with parsers, proprietary file formats, vendor APIs, or CAD scripting.
* Experience in customer or integration engineering, including troubleshooting in environments with restricted access to systems or design data.
* Experience building regression corpora, diagnostic tools, or agent harnesses and evals.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Customer blockers turn into verified production improvements. More designs move successfully through import, Quilter, and native export; recurring failures decrease, and the tests, diagnostics, and workflow tools you build help the whole team resolve the next issue faster.

**Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Join an award-winning team of dedicated professionals committed to our core values of quality, compassion and community! Encino Hospital Medical Center, a member of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, offers incredible opportunities to expand your horizons and be part of a community dedicated to making a difference.  
  
Encino Hospital Medical Center is a 150-bed state-of-the-art hospital located in Encino, California. Its multi-disciplinary staff consists of 330 physicians and 520 professional support staff. Encino Hospital Medical Center serves a diverse population and incorporates elements of urban and suburban medicine in a caring environment. It offers a wide array of inpatient and outpatient services. The hospital is consistently at the forefront in providing innovative and integrated healthcare. For more information, visit: www.encinomed.org

  
Responsibilities:

The Laboratory Assistant will follow the guidelines set by CLIA, and the California Business and Professions Code Sections 1212 and 1269. Unlicensed laboratory personnel (“aides”) are limited to pre-analytical and supportive functions only and may not read, record, result, verify, or interpret any laboratory test. They may not perform any test involving the quantitative measurement of specimens or reagents, conduct mathematical calculations related to test results, perform instrument calibration, or monitor or interpret quality control data used to assess test system performance. Unlicensed personnel shall not participate in any phase of testing that involves result generation, interpretation, verification, or reporting.

All duties must be performed under the direct and constant supervision of a physician and surgeon or a licensed laboratory professional, as defined by California regulations.

Unlicensed laboratory personnel may perform approved activities including specimen collection (patient preparation, labeling, handling, processing, preservation, transportation, and storage), assisting licensed personnel, preparing and storing reagents and culture media, assisting with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (without calibration or performance verification), and supporting quality control procedures (without interpretation of results). Specimen collection involving venipuncture or skin puncture may only be performed if the individual holds appropriate California phlebotomy certification (e.g., CPT I or CPT II) or other qualifying license, as required by law.

This individual: 1) Performs computer entry, filing, telephone communication, and other clerical duties. 2) Demonstrates professional telephone etiquette and greets patients and visitors courteously. 3) Possesses effective verbal and written communication skills. 4) Demonstrates knowledge of laboratory test terminology. 5) Demonstrates knowledge of phlebotomy practices; performs venipuncture or skin puncture only if appropriately certified per California law. 6) Processes specimens across laboratory departments including pathology, microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry, and blood bank limited to pre-analytical activities (e.g., specimen handling and centrifugation only in immunohematology). 7) Prepares and processes specimens for reference laboratories. 8) Stocks and orders routine supplies. 9) Maintains cleanliness and organization of storage areas, equipment, centrifuges, and collection sites. 10) Processes and places specimens on laboratory instruments for automated analysis only, without performing test setup, calibration, validation, or result review. 11) With documented training, may assist with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (excluding calibration and performance verification), assist in quality control procedures (without interpreting results), and perform permitted microbiology support tasks such as primary culture inoculation, slide staining, and subculturing. 12) Performs additional duties assigned by department leadership, including clerical support, communication tasks, specimen transport, and interdepartmental deliveries. 13) Assists Pathology with pre-analytical and clerical tasks only, including specimen receipt, accessioning, labeling, transport, and storage, under direct supervision and within regulatory limitations. 14) Functions as a runner to support laboratory workflow and specimen movement as needed.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING**

  

* HS Diploma or equivalent required.
* Active California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I or II license required for individuals performing phlebotomy.
* Current BCLS (AHA) certificate upon hire and maintain current preferred.
* BLS certification within forty-five days of hire and maintained current, according to hospital requirement.
* Minimum of 1 year clinical laboratory experience performing similar job functions preferred.

Pay Transparency:

Encino Hospital Medical Center offers competitive compensation and the current compensation range for this role is $23.00 to $35.91. Benefits may vary based on collective bargaining agreement requirements and/or the employment status. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure.

**Who we are:**

At Gladstone Institutes, every role contributes to discoveries that have the potential to transform lives.

  

Gladstone is a world-renowned independent, nonprofit biomedical research organization dedicated to solving some of the most challenging diseases affecting humanity. Our scientists are leaders in neuroscience, cardiovascular disease, immunology, stem cell biology, and emerging areas of biomedical innovation. Located in San Francisco's vibrant Mission Bay research hub, Gladstone brings together exceptional researchers, clinicians, and professionals who share a common goal: improving human health through science.

  

With approximately 600 employees, we offer the agility of an independent institute combined with the impact of a globally recognized research organization. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are encouraged to grow professionally while contributing to work that truly matters.

  

**About the Role:**

  

The laboratory of Benoit Bruneau at the Gladstone Institutes ( http://bruneaulab.gladstone.org ) is searching for a Research Associate (RA) to help us study the regulation of genes during heart development, using mouse models in vivo and stem cells in vitro. We are looking for candidates who are strongly motivated, work well in a team, and who could start July-August 2024. There is a potential for one or two publications within a two-year time period. Candidates with plans for graduate school, medical school or dental school are encouraged to apply.

**What You Will Do:**

  

We are looking for a research associate whose primary role will focus on culturing induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) and performing molecular biology techniques to understand gene expression regulation during in vitro cardiac differentiation.

  

* iPSC culture: maintain and expand iPSC lines, including routine passaging, freezing, and thawing of cells
* Differentiation protocols: use differentiation protocols to generate cardiomyocytes, ensuring consistency and reproducibility, and checking differentiation efficiency by flow cytometry
* Molecular biology techniques: perform molecular biology techniques such as PCR, RT-qPCR, and western blotting to analyze gene expression and protein levels
* Use sequencing techniques such as RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, and ATAC-seq to investigate gene regulation and epigenetic changes in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
* Analyze experimental and sequencing data, and interpret results
* Updates records and log books and assists in maintaining lab records and inventory
Assist in lab management functions including ordering reagents, organizing laboratory inventory  

**What You Will Need:**

* Associate's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong work ethic
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to multitask
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team setting.  

**What Is Preferred:**

* BA/BS in Biological sciences and at least 6 months practical experience in a research laboratory (preferred)
* iPSC or cell culture
* Flow cytometry
* Molecular biology skills such as PCR, western blotting, RT-qPCR
* Lab management (ordering, restocking, database maintenance)
* Additional Skills
* R or python programming (or equivalent)
* Experience with next-generation sequencing, e.g., RNA-seq, ChIP-seq
* CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing
Proficiency in Excel, Word, ImageJ Fiji, Photoshop and Illustrator

$28.91/hr. ($60,147) - $33.32/hr. ($69,307)

* *Compensation* –competitive salary. Title and salary will be commensurate with education and experience.

jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit’s Identity Data Science Team is looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist who is a creative problem solver with a passion to deliver advanced data-driven solutions. You will work alongside other Data Scientists, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Architects, and Program Managers to evolve Intuit’s Identity capabilities within Intuit’s Platform. As a key member of the data science team, you will have a strong track record of combining advanced analytical skills with exceptional business and entrepreneurial acumen. You will also have an ownership mindset with a strong willingness to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.

This is an exciting time to join the Identity Data Science Team at Intuit as we are building many new cutting-edge capabilities. These include a next-generation Verified Identity Network, password-less authentication powered through passkeys, Generative AI experiences, modern and sophisticated fraud prevention, centralized user and account management, and much more. Data is central to Intuit’s decision-making process, and data scientists are a critical component to evangelize data-driven decisions as we transform and scale Identity capabilities to power Intuit’s future growth.

Responsibilities

Partner with cross functional teams to drive data-backed decisions and actionable insights
Use a hypothesis-driven approach to drive design, implementation, and analysis of A/B experiments. Then provide executive level recommendations on next steps based on the test results and insights
Communicate analytical findings and recommendations in a clear and concise way to non-technical audiences, both in writing and through oral presentations
Provide guidance and thought leadership to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data to support business goals
Ensure data collection and data processing is optimized to provide crystal-clear visibility into the impact and value of new initiatives and product releases
Identify opportunities for developing new data sources, and provide technical leadership around making those data sources high-quality and broadly available
Pursue data quality, troubleshoot data anomalies, validate data accuracy, and drive issues to resolution
Share responsibility for owning and maintaining the data science backlog, connecting directly with partners and stakeholders to communicate and align on priorities

Qualifications

5+ years of experience working in web, marketing, product, analytics, or other related data science fields with a strong knowledge of statistics
Exceptional SQL skills and experience working with granular web and native clickstream data
Highly proficient in Tableau, Qliksense, Quicksight or similar software
Exceptional ability to take initiative, be a self-starter, and solve problems
Outstanding communications skills with the ability to influence decision makers and build consensus with stakeholder teams
Proactive and inquisitive learner who seeks out and capitalizes on opportunities for change that enhance the business, rather than reacting to circumstances
Strong organizational skills, time management, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines
Love for mentoring and guiding others on best practices. Passionate about the advancement of the whole team

Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr. Scientist Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Proteomics

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Letschange the world.

Amgen is seeking a hands-on bioinformatician to develop computational tools and data infrastructure to support the Discovery Proteomics Group. The successful candidate will combine strong scientific expertise in proteomics, bioinformatics, and drug discovery with software engineering skills to understand experimental and discovery needs and translate them into fit-for-purpose computational solutions. In this vital role, they will conduct statistical analysis, data ingestion, database and tool development, and computational pipeline implementation for proteomics data to support biomarker discovery, target evaluation, experimental design, and mechanism-of-action studies. The successful candidate will join the Discovery Proteomics group at our South San Francisco campus.

This role will enable Amgens preclinical pipeline through the delivery of innovative technologies and technical expertise. Responsibilities will include the development and implementation of data analysis, management, and visualization strategies for complex datasets generated by mass spectrometry and other technologies. The successful candidate will be expected to work closely with scientists from different functions and therapeutic areas, deliver and present analysis results to key stakeholders, collaborate across both genomic and proteomic platforms for data integration and mining, and utilize available external resources where appropriate.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What We Are Building

Domino Data Lab is looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with some of our most strategic enterprise customers.

You will own a focused portfolio of large, complex customers, with responsibility for the long-term health, retention, and growth of each account. That means understanding how customers are using Domino today, where we can deliver additional value, and how to expand our presence across business units, use cases, and executive stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner of the customer's business. You should be comfortable building executive relationships, engaging directly with technical practitioners, developing multi-year account strategies, and working across Domino to ensure we deliver on our commitments.

This role requires a balance of technical curiosity, strategic thinking, commercial execution, and customer advocacy. We expect our Account Managers to bring their own judgment and experience while maintaining the discipline required to consistently grow and retain our most important customers.

What Your Impact Will Be

Own the commercial performance, retention, and expansion of a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise customers.

Engage directly with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and technical practitioners to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities where Domino can deliver additional value.
Understand how customers are using Domino, where they are realizing value, and what is required to expand adoption across the enterprise.
Proactively identify and develop expansion opportunities across new business units, use cases, and stakeholders.
Own renewal strategy and commercial negotiations, balancing customer outcomes with long-term account growth.
Lead complex expansion opportunities from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close.
Partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, and Deal Desk to coordinate customer engagement and execution.
Maintain clear account plans, qualified pipeline, accurate forecasts, and visibility into risks and opportunities across your portfolio.
Serve as the commercial point of accountability for your customers, ensuring Domino operates as a coordinated, strategic partner.

What We Look For In This Role

5+ years of experience selling complex enterprise technology solutions, including ownership and growth of existing customer relationships.
Demonstrated success retaining and expanding large enterprise customers, including closing seven-figure software transactions.
A track record of building multi-year account strategies and creating expansion opportunities rather than relying on existing demand.
Experience navigating complex organizations, developing executive relationships, and expanding across multiple business units.
Technical fluency and curiosity, with the ability to engage credibly with data scientists, engineers, and technical stakeholders, ask informed questions, and understand how technology fits into their workflows. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable going beyond a high-level product conversation.
Strong commercial judgment and experience leading enterprise renewals, negotiations, and expansion opportunities.
The ability to understand customer adoption, business priorities, and outcomes and translate them into opportunities for growth.
A disciplined approach to account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline management, and forecasting.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver customer outcomes and execute account strategies.
Strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating with both autonomy and accountability.
Experience with data, analytics, AI, infrastructure, cloud, or other technically complex enterprise platforms is valuable.
Experience selling into highly regulated industries, including Life Sciences and Financial Services, is a plus.

Domino partners with some of the world's most sophisticated enterprises as they build, scale, and govern AI and data science.

The opportunity in this role is bigger than managing existing customers. You will own relationships that are central to Domino's long-term success, help customers realize greater value from their investment, and expand our presence across some of the world's most complex organizations.

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership.

About Us

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting opportunity at MSK: Join the Andy Minn Lab
as a Research Technician!

The Minn Lab
studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms that shape anti-tumor immunity and cancer immunotherapy resistance, with the goal of translating these discoveries into new therapeutic strategies.

We are seeking a motivated Research Technician with relevant laboratory experience to support studies in tumor immunology, functional genomics, and therapeutic resistance. Working closely with Marco Vincenzo Russo, Scientific Research Lead
, and the Minn Lab research team, the technician will support molecular and cellular experiments and in vivo tumor studies.

Role Overview

Cell and Molecular Biology: Maintain cancer cell lines and perform DNA/RNA preparation, PCR, cloning, lentiviral transduction, and generation of engineered cell lines.
Functional Genomics: Support CRISPR screening and validation studies focused on immunotherapy resistance.
Animal Studies: Perform tumor implantation, treatments, monitoring, tissue collection, and tumor processing.
Flow Cytometry and Genomics: Prepare samples for flow cytometry, cell sorting, sequencing, and single-cell studies.
Research Support: Maintain accurate records, organize data, prepare reagents, and support ongoing experiments.

Key Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, immunology, cancer biology, or a related field.
2–4 years of relevant laboratory experience preferred.
Strong experience with mammalian cell culture and molecular biology.
Experience with CRISPR/gene editing, lentiviral transduction, flow cytometry, or next-generation sequencing is a plus.
Experience with mouse models is strongly preferred.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and record keeping.
Ability to independently follow established protocols.
Scientific curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques.
Ability to manage multiple experiments and work collaboratively.
Adaptable, proactive, and eager to take on new challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.

From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About The Role

Marketing at Envoy runs on a mix of product-led signups, inbound demand and outbound motions across several products. You'll be the person who tells us which of those actually create pipeline and revenue — and you'll build the data foundation that makes the answer trustworthy.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll write production SQL and dbt models, not just query tables someone else built. You'll sit with Marketing and RevOps leadership as their analytical partner, and with the Data team as a builder who ships to the warehouse.

This is an onsite position that requires at least 5 days a week (Monday - Friday) in our San Francisco HQ office.

You will

You'll work like a forward-deployed engineer embedded in Marketing: sit with the team, find the problem, and ship the data product that solves it — on AWS, in production, end to end.

Own the marketing data platform on AWS. Build and run marketing pipelines across Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda and Iceberg tables, with infrastructure defined in Terraform and deployed through GitHub Actions.
Model the funnel in dbt. Ship tested staging, intermediate and mart models for lead → MQL → SQL → opportunity → closed-won, plus semantic models others self-serve from.
Build attribution as a product. Design multi-touch attribution across web, paid, events, email and outbound, run it as scheduled jobs in Airflow, and expose it through governed tables and APIs.
Ship internal apps, not just dashboards. Build lightweight tools Marketing uses daily — campaign ROI explorers, lead-routing consoles, self-serve query apps — on AWS Amplify, Lambda and API Gateway with Cognito/Okta auth.
Build serverless data APIs. Expose warehouse metrics to apps, Slack and AI agents through Lambda-backed endpoints and MCP servers, with least-privilege IAM.
Close the loop with reverse ETL. Sync scores, segments and product signals from the warehouse back into Salesforce, Marketo and Outreach so Sales and Marketing act on them.
Engineer the event lake. Join Segment product events in S3/Iceberg to CRM records to measure product-qualified leads and PLG conversion at scale.
Build lead scoring and intent models. Turn product usage, firmographic and job-change signals into scores in Python or Databricks, then deploy and monitor them in production.
Run experiments and measure spend. Design A/B and holdout tests, and report CAC, payback and channel ROI with Finance.
Use AI to move faster. Build with Claude Code and LLM tooling to prototype apps, generate models and automate analysis, with the rigor to verify the output.
Keep it reliable. Own source freshness, data tests, CI checks, cost and monitoring so a broken pipeline never reaches a board deck.

You have

5+ years in analytics, with at least 2 focused on marketing, growth or go-to-market analytics at a B2B SaaS company.
Expert SQL: window functions, CTE-first style, query performance on a columnar warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake or BigQuery), and the judgment to spot a fan-out join before it reaches a dashboard.
Production dbt experience: you've built layered models, written tests, and shipped through code review and CI.
Fluency in Python for analysis and statistics (pandas, statsmodels or similar), including experiment design and causal inference basics.
Deep familiarity with marketing and sales data: Salesforce objects (leads, contacts, campaigns, opportunities), marketing automation (Marketo or HubSpot), web and product event tracking (Segment or similar).
Working knowledge of attribution approaches and their trade-offs, plus funnel and cohort analysis.
Comfort with Git, pull requests and the command line.
A track record of influencing decisions: you can explain a model's assumptions to a CMO in two sentences and defend them under questioning.

Nice to have

Experience with Airflow or another orchestrator, and with ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Estuary.
Semantic layer or metrics-layer experience (dbt Semantic Layer, Omni, Looker).
Data lake experience: Iceberg, Spectrum, Athena or Spark.
Lead scoring, propensity or marketing-mix modeling.
Exposure to sales engagement and revenue intelligence data (Outreach, Gong) or job-change signals.
Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analytics work, with the rigor to check their output.

About the Company

Scientific Games is a global provider of lottery games, sports betting, and technology, partnering with government lotteries around the world. The company develops backend systems, retail and digital solutions, and entertainment experiences for the lottery industry. Its work also includes data analytics and iLottery, with a focus on innovation, performance, and security.

About the Role

Scientific Games is seeking a Data Analyst to turn business data into reliable analysis that helps internal teams and lottery customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed operating decisions.

The position covers reporting, dashboard development, exploratory analysis, and recurring analytical workflows. The analyst will work with business partners, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to define analytical needs, prepare and validate data, and build reusable solutions using cloud-based platforms such as Databricks. Strong SQL skills are important, along with practical experience or exposure to Python, version control, and workflow automation.

Key Responsibilities

Create and maintain reports, dashboards, notebooks, visualizations, and analytical workflows that support revenue growth, cost reduction, operational performance, and customer success.
Use cloud-based data platforms, particularly Databricks, SQL, notebooks, governed datasets, and reusable workflows.
Translate business questions into analytical approaches, data requirements, success measures, and practical recommendations for internal teams and external lottery customers.
Build dashboards, reporting assets, and self-service data products using appropriate visualization tools.
Use GitHub or similar version control tools to manage analytical code, notebooks, documentation, peer feedback, and project history.
Automate recurring analysis, data preparation, quality checks, and distribution processes where practical.
Work with data engineering and business teams to improve data collection, transformation logic, metric definitions, and shared datasets.
Review data quality, reconcile differences between sources, document assumptions, and communicate limitations, confidence levels, and recommended next steps.
Develop studies, research reports, executive dashboards, sales enablement tools, and exploratory visualizations that identify useful insights and business growth opportunities.
Identify process improvements and develop solutions that reduce rework, improve confidence in data, and make future analysis easier to repeat.
Manage multiple analytics tasks and projects while maintaining clear documentation and reliable analytical practices.
Collaborate effectively in a remote environment through written updates, shared documentation, and collaboration tools.
Travel occasionally to lottery and corporate locations as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, applied statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field.
At least three years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, reporting, analytics engineering, data science, or a closely related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, data validation, and working with information from multiple sources.
Hands-on experience, coursework, certification, or practical exposure to Databricks or comparable cloud analytics platforms, including notebook-based analysis, lakehouse concepts, Spark SQL, or PySpark.
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics environments in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including shared workspaces, governed datasets, and scalable computing environments.
Experience with Python or a similar programming language for analysis, data preparation, automation, or reproducible workflows.
Familiarity with GitHub or similar version control tools, including commits, branches, pull requests or review workflows, and project documentation.
Ability to design effective dashboards and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma, or comparable business intelligence tools.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to collect, organize, analyze, interpret, and communicate significant amounts of information accurately.
Ability to explain analytical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear language for business teams, executives, and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in data science, applied statistics, analytics, or a related field.
Experience contributing to reusable data models, metric layers, feature datasets, or certified analytical tables that support multiple business uses.
Experience automating recurring reporting or analytics workflows through scheduled jobs, orchestration tools, notebooks, scripts, or CI-style validation.
Working knowledge of data quality practices, testing methods, data lineage, documentation, and governance in modern analytics environments.
Experience with Alteryx, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar transformation and orchestration tools.
Familiarity with forecasting, segmentation, regression, classification, or other statistical methods used in business analysis.
Experience supporting sales, operations, gaming, lottery, retail, or other transaction-intensive business areas.
Tableau experience is helpful, although the role is not tied to a specific visualization platform or version.

Technical Skills & Working Approach

Ability to develop analytical work that is reusable, maintainable, auditable, and scalable.
Ability to balance speed with reliability by documenting assumptions, validating results, and creating repeatable workflows.
Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, business partners, executives, and customer stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively, seek feedback, and contribute to shared analytical standards.
Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and adapt to changing business needs.
Willingness and ability to learn new tools, programming languages, platforms, and analytical methods as needed.

The position regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, using hands, and operating a computer. Overview

Join an award-winning team of dedicated professionals committed to our core values of quality, compassion and community! Encino Hospital Medical Center, a member of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, offers incredible opportunities to expand your horizons and be part of a community dedicated to making a difference.

Encino Hospital Medical Center is a 150-bed state-of-the-art hospital located in Encino, California. Its multi-disciplinary staff consists of 330 physicians and 520 professional support staff. Encino Hospital Medical Center serves a diverse population and incorporates elements of urban and suburban medicine in a caring environment. It offers a wide array of inpatient and outpatient services. The hospital is consistently at the forefront in providing innovative and integrated healthcare. For more information, visit: www.encinomed.org

Responsibilities

The Laboratory Assistant will follow the guidelines set by CLIA, and the California Business and Professions Code Sections 1212 and 1269. Unlicensed laboratory personnel (“aides”) are limited to pre-analytical and supportive functions only and may not read, record, result, verify, or interpret any laboratory test. They may not perform any test involving the quantitative measurement of specimens or reagents, conduct mathematical calculations related to test results, perform instrument calibration, or monitor or interpret quality control data used to assess test system performance. Unlicensed personnel shall not participate in any phase of testing that involves result generation, interpretation, verification, or reporting.

All duties must be performed under the direct and constant supervision of a physician and surgeon or a licensed laboratory professional, as defined by California regulations.

Unlicensed laboratory personnel may perform approved activities including specimen collection (patient preparation, labeling, handling, processing, preservation, transportation, and storage), assisting licensed personnel, preparing and storing reagents and culture media, assisting with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (without calibration or performance verification), and supporting quality control procedures (without interpretation of results). Specimen collection involving venipuncture or skin puncture may only be performed if the individual holds appropriate California phlebotomy certification (e.g., CPT I or CPT II) or other qualifying license, as required by law.

This individual: 1) Performs computer entry, filing, telephone communication, and other clerical duties. 2) Demonstrates professional telephone etiquette and greets patients and visitors courteously. 3) Possesses effective verbal and written communication skills. 4) Demonstrates knowledge of laboratory test terminology. 5) Demonstrates knowledge of phlebotomy practices; performs venipuncture or skin puncture only if appropriately certified per California law. 6) Processes specimens across laboratory departments including pathology, microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry, and blood bank limited to pre-analytical activities (e.g., specimen handling and centrifugation only in immunohematology). 7) Prepares and processes specimens for reference laboratories. 8) Stocks and orders routine supplies. 9) Maintains cleanliness and organization of storage areas, equipment, centrifuges, and collection sites. 10) Processes and places specimens on laboratory instruments for automated analysis only, without performing test setup, calibration, validation, or result review. 11) With documented training, may assist with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (excluding calibration and performance verification), assist in quality control procedures (without interpreting results), and perform permitted microbiology support tasks such as primary culture inoculation, slide staining, and subculturing. 12) Performs additional duties assigned by department leadership, including clerical support, communication tasks, specimen transport, and interdepartmental deliveries. 13) Assists Pathology with pre-analytical and clerical tasks only, including specimen receipt, accessioning, labeling, transport, and storage, under direct supervision and within regulatory limitations. 14) Functions as a runner to support laboratory workflow and specimen movement as needed.

Qualifications

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING

HS Diploma or equivalent required.
Active California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I or II license required for individuals performing phlebotomy.
Current BCLS (AHA) certificate upon hire and maintain current preferred.
BLS certification within forty-five days of hire and maintained current, according to hospital requirement.
Minimum of 1 year clinical laboratory experience performing similar job functions preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Dr. Hsin-Jung Yang and their research group as a Postdoctoral Scientist!

The Biomedical Imaging Research Institute (BIRI) is an interdisciplinary research program dedicated to developing and applying state‑of-the-art imaging technologies to today’s most pressing translational research and clinical questions. Our team collaborates closely with physicians and leading imaging researchers worldwide, uniting technical and clinical expertise in cardiology, neurology and oncology. We prioritize educating and training future imaging leaders.

The mission of the Yang Lab is to develop advanced imaging solutions for pathological activities in the heart and noninvasively detect, diagnose and monitor cardiovascular diseases. The team has developed cutting-edge MRI technologies, which include a needleless method for myocardial ischemia detection named cardiac fMRI (cfMRI). cfMRI utilizes oxygenation-sensitive MRI signal and controlled coronary artery stimulations to detect impaired coronary artery function without ionizing radiation, exogenous contrast agents and pharmacological stress agents. The needleless approach provides millions of patients with potential myocardial ischemic diseases a minimum risk solution for examining their coronary circulation without the potential harm from the standard clinical exams. To learn more, please visit Yang Lab | Cedars-Sinai.

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

Working independently but in close cooperation and consultation with Dr. Yang and other Research Scientists, the Postdoctoral Scientist will perform routine and complex laboratory procedures throughout the training period.

BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.

Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997.
