If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

The Prenatal
Reporting Clinical Laboratory Scientist (RCLS) contractor
is responsible for performing high-complexity clinical laboratory data analysis, reviewing and interpreting molecular diagnostic and sequencing results, and ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and timely reporting of patient results in accordance with established laboratory procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

The RCLS independently executes validated bioinformatics pipelines, evaluates analytical results and quality control metrics, troubleshoots, and reviews and releases clinical laboratory reports within established authorization and reporting procedures. For complex or unusual results requiring additional evaluation, the RCLS collaborates with Bioinformatics, the Laboratory Directors, and other appropriate clinical personnel to ensure accurate interpretation and reporting.

In addition to routine clinical reporting responsibilities, the RCLS is expected to demonstrate technical leadership by exercising sound scientific judgment, independently investigating complex analytical issues, providing technical guidance to colleagues, supporting personnel training, and identifying opportunities for continuous process improvement. The RCLS may also participate in additional technical leadership activities and cross-functional initiatives as assigned by laboratory leadership.

The RCLS collaborates closely with Laboratory Operations, Bioinformatics, Quality Assurance Management, Genetic Counselors, the Laboratory Directors and other cross-functional teams to support accurate clinical reporting, resolve technical challenges, and maintain efficient laboratory workflows.

The nature of this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced clinical laboratory environment. The successful candidate must demonstrate initiative, accountability, adaptability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. This role is a hybrid work arrangement requiring approximately 60% on-site presence at the Union City and/or Menlo Park offices (three days per week on-site and two days per week remote).

Responsibilities

Analysis and Reporting (70%)

Clinical Genomic Data Analysis and Interpretation

Execute established and validated bioinformatics pipelines to process and analyze molecular diagnostic data from patient samples.
Independently review and interpret clinical genomic data, including sequencing results, bioinformatics outputs, and associated quality control metrics, to ensure results meet established quality standards and reporting criteria.
Identify, investigate, and troubleshoot analytical discrepancies, unusual findings, and potential data quality issues, collaborating with Bioinformatics and other appropriate technical teams to resolve complex issues as needed.
Independently manage daily sample analysis priorities, monitor analytical workflows, and proactively communicate technical issues or concerns that may impact reporting accuracy or turnaround times.

Clinical Reporting and Quality Review

Independently review, verify, and release clinical laboratory reports in accordance with established procedures, documented personnel authorization, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Collaborate with other RCLSs, Bioinformatics, Genetic Counselors, Laboratory Directors, and other appropriate clinical personnel to evaluate complex findings, resolve reporting discrepancies, and obtain additional review or approval when necessary.
Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of clinical reports while managing daily reporting priorities and maintaining established quality standards and turnaround time expectations.
Maintain accurate documentation of analytical reviews, quality assessments, investigations, and reporting decisions in accordance with established laboratory procedures.
Communicate reporting concerns and unresolved issues promptly to appropriate personnel, supporting continuity of reporting operations and timely resolution of sample-specific issues.

Technical Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Operational Support (30%)

Technical Leadership and Training

Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and sound scientific judgment when performing clinical data analysis and reporting responsibilities.
Independently investigate complex analytical discrepancies, troubleshoot technical issues, and identify appropriate solutions or escalation pathways.
Serve as a technical resource for other Reporting CLS personnel by sharing knowledge, providing guidance, and supporting consistent application of established analytical and reporting procedures.
Assist with training, onboarding, and mentoring Reporting CLS personnel and other clinical laboratory staff as appropriate.
Promote technical competency, reporting consistency, and adherence to established laboratory procedures and quality standards.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, workflow efficiency, and overall laboratory performance.
Participate in additional technical leadership activities, such as coordinating technical investigations, supporting validation projects, or contributing to workflow improvements, as assigned by laboratory leadership.

Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

Perform and support quality control and quality assurance activities to maintain the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of clinical laboratory testing and reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), College of American Pathologists (CAP), California state regulations, and established laboratory policies and procedures.
Identify, document, and investigate quality-related issues, including analytical discrepancies, nonconforming results, and deviations from established procedures.
Collaborate with Quality Management and laboratory leadership to support root cause investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
Maintain accurate documentation and records in accordance with established quality management and regulatory requirements.

Process Improvement and Workflow Optimization

Identify and recommend opportunities to optimize analytical workflows, improve reporting accuracy, enhance operational efficiency, and promote cost-effective laboratory practices.
Collaborate with Laboratory Operations, Bioinformatics, Genetic Counselors, and Process Engineering teams to support the development, validation, implementation, and optimization of new or updated laboratory tests, analytical methodologies, and reporting workflows.
Assist with technology transfer and implementation of validated methodologies from Process Engineering into the clinical laboratory.
Support the evaluation and implementation of improvements to laboratory data management and reporting systems.
Maintain and update reporting procedures, technical documentation, and workflow resources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compatibility with established laboratory processes.
Participate in investigations of recurring analytical or workflow issues and contribute to the development and implementation of appropriate solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Operational Support

Collaborate with Laboratory Operations, Bioinformatics, Genetic Counseling, Client Services, Quality Assurance Management, and Process Engineering to investigate and resolve sample-specific and workflow-related issues.
Communicate analytical findings, technical concerns, and recommended solutions clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.
Serve as a technical point of contact for cross-functional teams when addressing clinical reporting questions or troubleshooting analytical issues, as appropriate.
Support laboratory leadership with reporting priorities, operational coordination, and project deliverables as needed.
Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that improve laboratory efficiency, reporting reliability, and overall operational performance.

Qualifications

Must possess an active and valid CLS or Clinical Genetic Molecular Biologist Scientist (CGMBS) license issued by the state of California pursuant to Division 2, Chapter 3 of the California Business and Professions Code or to practice medicine, osteopathy or podiatry pursuant to Division 2, Chapter 5 of the California Business and Professions Code appropriate to the specialty they are performing
Bachelor's degree or higher in Biomedical Laboratory Sciences, Clinical Laboratory Science, Molecular Biology, Genetics, or a related scientific discipline, consistent with applicable licensure requirements.
At least one year of clinical laboratory experience or equivalent experience in a high-complexity, high-volume molecular diagnostic clinical laboratory environment.
Working knowledge of molecular biology principles, clinical laboratory testing methodologies, and applicable local, state, and federal laboratory regulations.
Demonstrated experience with sequencing data analysis, including evaluation and interpretation of next-generation sequencing (NGS) results and associated analytical quality control metrics in accordance with validated laboratory procedures.
Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex laboratory data, investigate discrepancies, and troubleshoot issues affecting test performance or reporting accuracy.
Familiarity with bioinformatics analysis outputs and their application to clinical molecular diagnostic reporting.
Strong computer skills and the ability to effectively use laboratory data management systems and analytical software. Proficiency with commonly used workplace and collaboration tools, including Atlassian Suite, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and organizational and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to accurate and reliable clinical reporting.
Ability to independently manage reporting responsibilities, prioritize competing demands, and adapt to changing operational needs while maintaining quality and turnaround time expectations.
Demonstrated initiative and accountability in investigating technical issues, identifying solutions, and exercising appropriate judgment regarding consultation and escalation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Receptiveness to feedback and commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and process improvement.

Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Title Lab Technician:

Position Overview

We are seeking an inquisitive and motivated Junior Lab Technician to support our testing and prototyping operations. In this role, you will assist engineering teams with the day-to-day setup, maintenance, debugging, and verification of hardware and software environments. This is a hands-on position ideal for an early-career technician, recent graduate, or self-taught builder passionate about embedded hardware, Linux environments, and robotics or autonomous platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Lab & Bench Setup: Assemble, wire, and configure test benches, sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and single-board computers (SBCs).

System Testing & Flashing: Flash operating system images and firmware onto embedded devices; assist with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) tests.

Linux Environment Support: Boot, configure, and maintain Linux-based development machines and edge devices (setting up network interfaces, permissions, and packages).

Autonomous Hardware Support: Mount, calibrate, and verify sensors (e.g., LiDAR, cameras, IMUs, GPS) used across autonomous and robotic test rigs.

Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Use standard lab equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and software log utilities to isolate hardware, wiring, and communication faults.

Inventory & Safety: Maintain lab equipment inventory, organize test rigs, and enforce lab safety protocols (ESD protection, battery handling, power supplies).

Required & Preferred SkillsCore Qualifications

Associate degree, trade school certification, or equivalent practical experience in Electronics, Robotics, Computer Engineering Technology, or a related field.

Familiarity with basic electronic prototyping, wiring, crimping, and reading basic schematics or pinout diagrams.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to log and document test procedures clearly.

Highly Regarded Skills (Expanded)

Linux Systems & Command-Line Operations

Practical comfort navigating the Linux terminal (e.g., Ubuntu/Debian flavors).

Managing services (systemctl), reading system logs (journalctl, dmesg), and basic shell scripting (bash) for automating repetitive setup routines.

Basic networking configuration (SSH, static IP setup, ping/traceroute, Wi-Fi/Ethernet interfaces) for remote device access.

Embedded Systems & Microcontrollers

Practical experience working with SBCs (Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson) and microcontroller platforms (ESP32, STM32, Arduino).

Understanding of low-level communication protocols: UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN bus.

Experience with firmware updates, image flashing tools (e.g., balenaEtcher, dd), and serial debugging tools (minicom, screen, PuTTY).

Autonomous & Robotic Platforms

Exposure to the sensor hardware that enables autonomy (cameras, ultrasonic sensors, LiDAR, IMU, wheel encoders).

Basic familiarity with robotics middleware or architectures (e.g., ROS/ROS 2, ArduPilot, PX4) is a significant plus.

Experience troubleshooting physical moving systems, motor controllers, servo actuation, and battery management systems (LiPo/Li-ion safety).

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Manager, Data Science, Payments & Subscriptions

San Diego, CA

remote considered* (flex mode)

About The Team

The Direct to Consumer (D2C) Data Science organization brings together Data Science, Data Engineering, and ML Engineering to support PlayStation’s digital business across commerce, subscriptions, payments, lifecycle experiences, and player-facing services. We partner closely with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and operations teams to turn experimentation, forecasting, modeling, and trustworthy measurement into better decisions and better player experiences.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Science Manager to lead a focused team improving how players pay, subscribe, and recover from payment failures. You will own the team’s scientific roadmap, develop data scientists, and partner with product, engineering, finance, marketing, and operations to turn ambiguous business questions into clear recommendations supported by trustworthy evidence.

This is a technically engaged first-line management role. You will review experiment designs, metrics, models, analytical code, and recommendations; help the team reason through uncertainty and business tradeoffs; and contribute directly to selected complex problems. Success means building a team that can independently deliver rigorous work, guide decisions, and improve payment and subscription outcomes.

The initial portfolio includes payment method performance, payment acceptance, routing and retry strategies, subscription recovery, and measurement of experiments and lifecycle interventions. You will help partners understand incremental value, customer friction, processing and operational costs, and risk guardrails. Over time, the scope may expand across adjacent D2C business areas as team priorities evolve.

What you'll be doing:

Lead, hire, onboard, and develop a team of data scientists supporting a defined commerce, payments, subscriptions, and lifecycle portfolio.
Own the team’s roadmap, intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and stakeholder alignment. Make ownership and tradeoffs clear so the team can deliver on its most important commitments.
Partner with business and technical leaders to define the decisions to be made, hypotheses, success metrics, measurement plans, and recommendations for action.
Guide experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, and modeling work that improves payment and subscription decisions. Evaluate business value alongside customer experience, costs, and risk guardrails.
Review experiment designs, analytical code, data quality, metric definitions, model assumptions, uncertainty, and recommendations. Contribute directly to selected high-priority or technically complex problems.
Coach data scientists to strengthen scientific judgment, stakeholder influence, and communication. Build independent ownership through delegation, constructive review, and clear expectations.
Set practical standards for reproducible analysis, documentation, reusable workflows, and communication of results. Partner with Data Engineering and ML Engineering to address data and implementation dependencies.
Communicate recommendations, expected impact, confidence, limitations, and next actions so partners can make informed decisions and evaluate outcomes.

What we're looking for:

6+ years of industry experience in data science, applied statistics, machine learning, or a related quantitative field, including work in experimentation, causal inference, measurement, or model development.
2+ years of people management experience, or equivalent experience in formal technical leadership with a strong track record of mentoring, coaching, and driving outcomes through other data scientists or machine learning practitioners.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Education -Washington, DC
jobs.description:
U.S. News & World Report is a multifaceted digital media company dedicated to helping citizens, consumers, business leaders and policy officials make important decisions in their lives. We publish independent reporting, rankings, data journalism and advice that has earned the trust of our readers and users for 90 years. Our platforms on usnews.com include Education, Health, Money, Travel, Cars, News, Real Estate, Careers and Insurance.
We reach millions of people monthly during moments when they are most in need of expert advice and motivated to act on that advice directly on our platforms. Our signature franchises include our “Best” series of consumer guides on colleges, graduate schools, hospitals, diets, cars, financial services and more. These guides provide an easy-to-digest list for consumers to better understand and compare when making their decisions. We continue to publish annual guides of the authoritative Best Colleges and Best Hospitals rankings on our website and in print. And our U.S. News Live flagship conferences highlight important national conversations such as Healthcare of Tomorrow and the the U.S. News Future of Higher Education Forum
We believe in having a broad range of talent and backgrounds at U.S. News. We strive to maintain a welcoming and inclusive workplace where everyone is given an opportunity to succeed and contribute to their fullest.

Your Role in Helping Us Shape the Future

As a Data Analyst on our Education team, you will be a guardian of the data integrity that defines our world-renowned rankings. You will work within a specialized, collaborative team to transform raw data into the insights that help millions of students and families make informed life decisions.

Your contributions will follow the academic data cycle:

Data Architecture & Logic: You will spend significant time developing, refining, and executing code to process complex datasets for our signature education rankings. You will eventually contribute to ongoing refinement and validation of ranking methodologies to ensure analytical defensibility and consistency year over year.
Process Optimization & Automation: You will contribute to ongoing efforts to streamline data workflows, including automation of survey universe creation and improvements to production efficiency across ranking calculations and outputs.
Quality Assurance: You will perform rigorous audits of peer-developed code, data inputs and programming outputs, ensuring every data point meets our standards for accuracy.
Anomaly Detection & Validation: You will help enhance processes for identifying outliers, structural shifts, and unexpected model behavior, including exploring automated and AI-assisted methods for anomaly detection and validation.
Collaborative Problem Solving: You will partner with our technical, product and editorial teams to assist with website and guidebook presentation of school rankings and data, methodologies, and editorial content.

Are You Up to the Challenge?

We are seeking a meticulous analyst who brings both technical proficiency and an evaluative mindset to our education research. To excel in this role, you should possess:
Analytical Rigor: A keen eye for detail and the ability to maintain high levels of accuracy while managing large, complex datasets.
Effective Communication: The skill to translate technical data findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A Commitment to Excellence: A proactive approach to identifying data inconsistencies and a dedication to the prestige of the U.S. News brand.
An Interest in Innovation: Valuing the opportunity to contribute to the development and evolution of ranking methodologies.

You should definitely have:

Statistical Programming: At least three years of professional experience using statistical programming to ingest, merge, clean, validate, and analyze large datasets..
Version Control: Experience using version-control systems such as Git and using ticket-management systems to document and track work.
Data Quality: Demonstrated ability to identify anomalies, validate analytical outputs, document work, and maintain accuracy across complex processes.
Educational Background: A bachelor’s degree with coursework in a quantitative field (e.g., statistical economics, data science, or a related social science).

It would be nice if you had:

Experience with Stata is preferred. Much of our existing codebase is written in Stata,, so the successful applicant should be comfortable learning or working in Stata.
Technical Versatility: Familiarity with additional analytical tools or data visualization platforms is helpful. Experience with Python and AI-assisted tools to support data analysis, coding or quality assurance is a plus.
Domain Expertise: Professional or academic experience in K-12 or Higher Education data is helpful but not required.

What it’s like to work with us:

Talent is our best asset!
We invest in people with passion and potential who understand U.S. News’ dedication to our consumers.
Entrepreneurial, mission-driven culture with core values of quality and integrity
Focus on fostering personal and professional growth
Competitive benefits including paid vacation time, medical, tuition reimbursement, and training
Collaborative Work Environment : Fun, diverse, inclusive and ambitious co-workers

Turo is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Analytics team in San Francisco, partnering directly with the Global Owned Media team. In this role, you’ll turn customer data into practical measurement frameworks that help us market smarter and more efficiently. You will bring strong analytical rigor and commercial judgment to deepen customer engagement, evaluate promotional spend, and guide how we invest across our marketing portfolio.

What You Will Do

Lead High-Impact Analysis: Take on our most important business questions and drive them from initial hypothesis to concrete recommendation. You’ll dig into complex data, isolate what matters, and deliver clear takeaways that guide business decisions.
Drive Experimentation: Partner with marketing teams to design, run, and analyze A/B tests and holdout groups. You’ll measure true incremental lift, uncover how customers respond to promos and incentives, and help shape a testing roadmap focused on the highest-upside opportunities.
Build Smarter Segmentation: Turn behavioral and transactional data into clear audience segments. You’ll guide personalized targeting and ensure messages reach users at the moments that drive the highest engagement and return.
Shape Customer Data Infrastructure: Partner with MarTech, Engineering, and Product teams to define CDP tracking requirements, new user attributes, and data pipelines. You will help design the underlying data structures needed to power advanced lifecycle and personalization initiatives.
Measure Retention & Lifetime Value: Analyze repeat behavior, churn, and long-term customer value. Your findings will guide budget allocation across segments and channels to drive sustainable growth.
Communicate Insights & Align Teams: Translate technical analysis into straightforward recommendations for leadership. You’ll partner across Marketing, Business, Product, and Finance so everyone is aligned on how we measure marketing impact.

Your profile

Experimentation track record: Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and incrementality lift studies.

jobs.title: Staff Research Associate 2 - Pediatric Nephrology (Part-Time/Limited)
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a Part-Time, Limited Appointment position**

This position is in the Department of Pediatrics, Division of Pediatric Nephrology. The purpose of the position is to support research on the discovery of small molecule modulators of ion transporters/channels important in human diseases, including kidney diseases (kidney stones, kidney failure, hypertension), digestive disorders (diarrhea, constipation, motility disorders), pulmonary diseases (asthma, cystic fibrosis), cardiovascular diseases (hypertension) and others.

The Staff Research Associate (SRA) is expected to perform in vitro electrophysiology in cells and tissues (Ussing Chamber), cell culture (maintaining and preparing cell lines for experiments), measurement of ion transport in cells (via fluorescence using plate reader), preparation of buffers and solutions for experiments, molecular biology (PCR, animal genotyping, Western blot), staining techniques for tissues and cells (immunofluorescence, light microscopy etc.), animal experiments (handling, anesthesia, injections, blood-urine-stool collections, colony maintenance, breeding, euthanasia, tissue harvesting, simple surgery), analysis of ions, biomarkers, chemical compounds and metabolites by ion chromatography and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry. The SRA is going to perform the above mentioned work under supervision of the PI and will be trained by the PI for the above mentioned work.

jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready.

Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants.

What You'll Build

The Data and Applied Science team will build the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following:

Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets.
Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers.
Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows.
Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes.
Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement.
Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems.
Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets.
Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields.
10+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills.
10+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.
Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support.
Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products.
Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets.
Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs.
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases.
Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches.
Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption.
Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption.
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations.
Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence.

Preferred Qualification

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding.
Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas.
Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures.
Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards, map application-specific schemas to shared ontologies using declarative mapping standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks and canonical business entity models across complex application landscapes.

Where You Belong

Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team defining how enterprise AI actually works on a global scale. You'll work alongside curious engineers, thoughtful product minds, and applied researchers all focused on building AI that customers can trust in the highest-stakes business processes. There's room to grow into new technical spaces, ship real impact, and shape SAP's AI future. If you value learning, real ownership, and building foundational infrastructure that matters, you'll feel at home here.

Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Prepares and maintains detailed records, logs and summary reports of all procedures and results including graphs, scientific calculations, and statistical analysis charting.
May be responsible for tissue & cell culture activities.
May be responsible for animal husbandry, genotyping, surgeries, post-operative care, behavioral testing, sectioning and histology.

Participates in planning and carrying out experiments. Assists in preparing research protocols.
Conducts library research and literature searches using various computer systems. Assists in editing scientific publications, abstracts and posters.
Maintains inventory of supplies, equipment and/or reagents. May order supplies/equipment/reagents as authorized or ensure that needs are escalated appropriately. Receives supply orders and confirms accuracy of delivery. May assist with cost control.
Ensures that facilities and equipment are in optimal and proper working condition. Coordinates preventative maintenance and repairs as needed. May perform minor repairs if qualified and as needed. May advise on upgrades for performance enhancements.

Bachelor's Degree

Experience

Some bench lab related experience.

Minimum two-year commitment due to a substantial training effort associated with the position

Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to pay close attention to detail.

Licenses and Certifications

Standard laboratory conditions.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in therapeutic antibodies to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in antibody design and engineering who has taken antibodies through the whole process, from target selection and lead optimization to candidate selection and IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll drive antibody programs end to end and pressure-test AI-designed antibodies against the bar a real drug candidate has to clear.

This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Key responsibilities**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Python Fullstack Lead with deep expertise in Python, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, and microservices. The candidate must have in-depth expertise in at least one major cloud platform — AWS, Azure, or GCP and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, resilient, secure, and production-ready architectures. The candidate should also have hands-on experience with React and TypeScript to guide front-end architecture and its integration with backend services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design cloud-native microservices using Python, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD), appropriate service boundaries, and loosely coupled architectures.

* Define HLD/LLD, API contracts, service interactions, data ownership, integration patterns, and architecture standards.

* Design REST/gRPC APIs, API gateways, authentication/authorization, versioning, rate limiting, idempotency, and backward compatibility.

* Design event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Kafka or cloud-native messaging services; address ordering, retries, duplicate messages, DLQs, replay, and eventual consistency.

* Apply distributed-systems patterns including Saga, CQRS, Outbox, Circuit Breaker, Retry/Backoff, Bulkhead, and distributed caching.

* Design highly available and scalable solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, serverless and managed cloud services.

* Ensure application and infrastructure security using IAM/RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, secrets management, encryption

* Define front-end architecture standards for React and TypeScript applications, including component design, state management, and integration with backend microservices via REST/GraphQL APIs or Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers.

* Ideal candidate should have worked on an eCommerce domain and have basic ideas on composable package components in eCommerce like headless CMS, headless search etc and have hands on experience integrating them via backend services.

Technical Requirements

* Python 3.x, FastAPI/Flask/Django, asyncio, concurrency, type hints, testing, profiling and performance optimization.

* Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, including hooks, state management (e.g., Redux, React Query), component-based architecture, front-end performance optimization, and testing.

* Expert-level knowledge of AWS OR Azure OR GCP (AWS will be preferred), including compute, containers/Kubernetes, API Gateways, networking, IAM/security, databases, messaging, storage, monitoring and serverless capabilities.

* Strong understanding of designing and implementing event driven architecture using a cloud provider leveraging patterns like fan out (Eventbridge, SNS, SQS / Kinesis in case of AWS) with proper message / data redundancy and fall back mechanisms.

* Strong SQL and database design skills with PostgreSQL/MySQL/Oracle plus experience with NoSQL technologies such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Cassandra or equivalent.

* Experience working with AI tools would be a plus

* Experience with retail/e-commerce, high-volume transaction processing, multi-region architectures.

* Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems, scalability, resilience, security and production operations

Crawford & Associates, Inc. is a geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, and construction materials testing firm founded in 2012, now with over 85 employees across nine offices in California and Washington State. Guided by a mission of long-term client partnerships, reliable advice, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and growth, Crawford's team of professional engineers, geologists, and specialists delivers creative solutions and responsive service on projects ranging from transportation and bridges to water/wastewater, schools, and commercial development.

**JOB SUMMARY**

This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to manage testing processes effectively.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Advanced Testing Procedures***

* Conduct complex tests on construction materials, including concrete, soil, asphalt, and aggregates, ensuring adherence to ASTM, AASHTO, and other relevant standards.
* Interpret test results and evaluate data to ensure compliance with project specifications.

***Supervision and Training***

* Mentor and train junior technicians in testing methods, safety protocols, and quality control procedures.
* Provide leadership and support to the team, ensuring efficient workflows and collaboration.

***Quality Assurance and Compliance***

* Implement and uphold quality control measures to guarantee the accuracy and reliability of test results.
* Participate in internal audits and quality assurance programs to identify areas for improvement.

***Documentation and Reporting***

* Prepare detailed reports summarizing testing procedures, results, and recommendations for clients and project managers.
* Maintain accurate records of all tests conducted, ensuring data integrity and compliance with laboratory standards.

***Equipment Management***

* Operate and maintain laboratory testing equipment, performing routine calibrations and troubleshooting as necessary.
* Assist in the procurement and evaluation of new testing equipment and technology.

***Client Interaction***

* Communicate effectively with clients and project stakeholders, addressing inquiries and providing insights on test results.
* Collaborate with engineers and project managers to understand testing requirements and specifications.

***Safety and Compliance***

* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations in all laboratory and field activities.
* Promote a culture of safety through training and adherence to safety protocols.

***Continuous Improvement***

* Stay updated on industry trends, new testing methods, and advancements in materials science.
* Recommend process improvements and innovations to enhance laboratory operations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** Associate or bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, materials science, or a related field preferred; relevant certifications preferred.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of experience in construction materials testing, with a focus on advanced testing techniques.
* **Certifications:** Relevant certifications (e.g., ACI, NICET, Caltrans) are highly desirable.

**SKILLS**

* In-depth knowledge of construction materials testing methods and industry standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in information management systems and data analysis software.
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Primarily based in a laboratory setting, with occasional fieldwork required for material sampling and inspections.
* May involve standing for extended periods and lifting moderate weights

jobs.title: Research Associate – Probes Enrichment and DNA Methylation
jobs.description:
**Department:**

R&D

  

**Location:**

Irvine, CA

  

**Job Summary:**

Zymo Research is seeking a Research Associate to join the Epigenetics Technology group and support next-generation sequencing (NGS) assay development for DNA methylation and cancer research, including probe enrichment and library preparation for methylation and genetic variant analysis.

Working with project scientists, the associate will apply molecular biology and enzymatic techniques to feasibility studies, optimization, and validation using cell-free DNA (cfDNA), formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue DNA, and reference materials.

Join us in making a meaningful impact!

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Execute planned experiments for probe enrichment, DNA methylation, and cancer assay development (variants/SNPs). Prepare reagents and controls and contribute to experimental planning and troubleshooting with project scientists.
* Perform and optimize probe enrichment assays, including hybridization, capture, washing, recovery, and amplification as applicable. Assess enrichment efficiency, specificity, reproducibility, and recovery.
* Prepare NGS libraries using enzymatic processing, adapter incorporation, amplification, and purification. Measure DNA concentration, fragment size, and library yield; investigate artifacts and failed reactions.
* Perform end point PCR, qPCR/ddPCR, and other quantitative assays to assess DNA quality, enrichment, conversion, and recovery. Support primer and probe evaluation.
* Conduct enzyme-based experiments using polymerases, ligases, nucleases, and other nucleic acid-modifying enzymes. Vary conditions systematically and record results to support optimization.
* Process low-input samples with careful tracking and contamination control. Support validation using methylation and variant/SNPs standards, defined mixtures, and appropriate cancer and non-cancer specimens.
* Maintain complete laboratory records, summarize results, and flag unexpected findings. Help update SOPs, manage reagents and inventory, and contribute to other projects requiring relevant skills.

**Supervisory Responsibilities and Core Competencies**

* No formal supervisory responsibilities. May help train colleagues on established procedures once proficient. Key competencies include accuracy, reproducibility, organization, practical problem-solving, clear communication, and teamwork.

**Education and Experience**

* Master/Bachelor’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, biotechnology, or a related field, with relevant hands-on laboratory experience.
* Demonstrated experience performing NGS library preparation and probe-based target enrichment assays, including routine optimization, quality control, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to execute multi-step protocols accurately, organize experiments, and maintain traceable laboratory records.

**Required Scientific and Technical Skills**

* Strong practical molecular biology skills, including nucleic acid handling (DNA/RNA), accurate pipetting, PCR and qPCR, enzymatic reactions, purification, and DNA and library quality control.
* Working knowledge of enzymology and the effects of enzyme concentration, substrate quality, incubation conditions, titrations, and buffer composition on assay performance.
* Ability to perform and troubleshoot probe-based target enrichment workflows and understand how hybridization conditions, washing, and amplification affect recovery and specificity.
* Ability to analyze experimental results using spreadsheets and basic statistics, summarize data clearly, and communicate with scientists and bioinformatics colleagues.
* Attention to detail, reliable sample and reagent management, good laboratory practices, and the ability to manage several experiments and priorities with appropriate guidance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with DNA methylation assays, bisulfite/enzymatic conversion chemistry, cancer research, low-input cfDNA or FFPE samples, and exome capture.
* Experience with digital PCR, UMI-based libraries, automated liquid handling, or assay transfer into routine workflows.
* Experience supporting NGS methods development, evaluating enzyme performance, or interpreting sequencing quality metrics such as on-target fraction, coverage, duplication, and conversion efficiency.
  

**About Us:**

Since its inception in 1994, Zymo Research has been proudly serving the scientific community by providing innovative, reliable, and high-quality research tools and products. Whether it's DNA, RNA, epigenetics, microbiomics, protein, or yeast-based research, our philosophy remains the same: To provide the highest quality products in the industry while ensuring they are both simple to use and reliable in their performance.

Recognized as a *Top Workplace* by the Orange County Register in 2021, 2022, and named a *Top Workplace USA* in 2023, Zymo Research continues to be a vibrant community where employees thrive, feel connected, and are inspired by their work. If you are passionate about contributing to scientific advancement and want to be part of an exceptional team in a dynamic, growing company, we'd love to hear from you!

**Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:**

The estimated base compensation range for this position is $64,480-$72,384 (~$28-35 per hour) at the time of posting. Actual compensation details will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if applicable, and is based on several factors we believe fairly and accurately impact compensation, including geographic location, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and other job permitted factors.

Zymo Research also offers competitive benefits and perks including:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance Coverages
* EAP Sessions
* Vacation Time plus Company Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Generous 401(K) with matching
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Complimentary fruit, snacks, and beverages

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate I
jobs.description:
Capricor Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CAPR) is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing transformative cell and exosome-based therapies for rare diseases. At the forefront of our innovation is Deramiocel
( CAP-1002 ), our lead cell therapy in late-stage development for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. We are also harnessing our proprietary StealthX™ exosome platform to unlock new possibilities in targeted delivery and vaccinology. Every program reflects our commitment to pushing the boundaries of science and delivering life-changing treatments to patients and families who need them most.

As a Manufacturing Associate I, you’ll be a vital part of Capricor’s efforts in delivering therapies for patients in need. Supporting critical clinical trials and exosome development, you’ll perform meticulous production tasks and documentation to uphold our quality and compliance standards. This role places you in a cleanroom environment, where precision and attention to GMP standards are essential. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that each production step is performed with accuracy, ultimately contributing to Capricor’s therapeutic success.

Responsibilities

Perform routine manufacturing tasks, including media preparation, cell culture, cell counting, formulation, centrifugation, and freezing
Complete and ensure timely, accurate documentation in compliance with GMP standards across batch records, forms, and protocols
Mentor fellow team members on cGMP documentation protocols to ensure the highest standards
Plan, collect, analyze, and report on production data, maintaining comprehensive records and observations
Author, revise, and maintain SOPs through Capricor’s document change system
Oversee inventory, material transfers, and cleanroom procedures to support efficient GMP operations
Prepare technical summaries, protocols, and reports to ensure full documentation of production activities
Lead moderate-complexity CAPAs and assist with deviations and investigations to maintain quality assurance
Take on special projects in manufacturing and development as required

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biological Sciences, or a related field
1-3 years of experience in a cGMP/cGTP manufacturing environment
Solid laboratory experience in mammalian tissue culture, along with expertise in aseptic techniques
Working knowledge of regulatory standards in biopharmaceutical or tissue banking industries
Strong organizational skills and acute attention to detail within a fast-paced, dynamic setting
Basic molecular biology and flow cytometry skills are a plus
Adaptability to work schedules that may include weekends or holidays as needed.

This position follows an AWS/Panama 2-2-3 schedule
, which is a rotating shift pattern designed to provide consistent coverage and extended time off.

Schedule Details:

12-hour shifts

Week 1: Work Monday & Tuesday
, off Wednesday & Thursday
, work Friday-Sunday

Week 2: Off Monday & Tuesday
, work Wednesday & Thursday
, off Friday-Sunday

This creates a repeating cycle of 2 days on, 2 days off, 3 days on
, then the reverse the following week.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Bioinformatics
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic.

The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch.

You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next.

We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way.

The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time.

What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on.

This is a chance to shape how AI is put to work in biological research, on problems that matter for human health and scientific understanding. If building software that scientists trust is the work you want to do, we want to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build, and maintain biology software in genomics and structural biology (libraries, command-line tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks) for use by researchers and AI agents, inside Anthropic and externally
* Own the path from research code to public release, including testing, validation against reference data and established tools, benchmarking, documentation, and packaging, and make the call on when something is ready to ship
* Maintain what we release: triage issues, review outside contributions, and manage breaking changes
* Represent the team in the biology community through conferences, workshops, tutorials, and direct work with researchers and maintainers, and turn what you learn about their needs into priorities for the team
* Partner with the team's computational and experimental scientists to turn research code into well-tested, reusable software
* Lead the technical direction of the projects you own through design review, code review, and mentoring, and, depending on your interests and the team's needs, lead a small team
* Build with Claude and AI coding agents as your default way of working, hold agent-written code to the same standard as your own, and set the team's practices for reviewing and validating it

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Have built, released, and maintained biology software that researchers outside your own group use, with evidence of adoption you can point to (for example public repositories, package downloads, citations, or use in other groups' pipelines)
* Have deep working expertise in genomics or structural biology, including the data types, file formats, standard tools, and common failure modes of at least one of these fields
* Are proficient in Python and comfortable working with large datasets in Linux and cloud or cluster computing environments
* Practice rigorous testing and release engineering: unit and integration tests, continuous integration, validation against reference data, packaging, and versioning
* Use AI coding tools as a central part of how you build software, and can show how you verify the correctness and performance of code you did not write by hand
* Have led a technical project with multiple contributors, setting direction and reviewing others' work while continuing to write code yourself
* Can explain technical work clearly to both biologists and engineers, in writing (documentation, tutorials) and in person (talks, workshops)

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Depth in both genomics and structural biology
* A record as the creator or a core maintainer of a widely used open-source tool in computational biology
* Experience managing or formally leading a team of engineers or scientists
* A graduate degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Proficiency in a systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and experience with performance work on large biological datasets
* Experience building software in other areas of computational biology, such as phylogen

The Data Analyst is an individual contributor who has moved beyond supervised execution and is developing the independence, analytical depth, and stakeholder skills needed to progress to Senior level. * Support ad-hoc analysis for internal stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, and Account Management, providing interpretive framing alongside data outputs rather than data retrieval alone

* Support A/B test experiments under the guidance of the Senior DA — including data preparation, metric tracking, and results summaries — building toward independent experimental design at Senior level

**Google Analytics & Data Collection**

* Develop LookML including dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations — ensuring all work is documented and consistent with team standards

**Cal Poly Pomona Enterprises Employment Services**

  

**ANNOUNCEMENT OF POSITION VACANCY**

  

**SUMMARY**: Graduate Research Assistant - Food Bioprocessing and Smart Manufacturing The Department of Nutrition and Food Science is seeking two motivated graduate students to join a collaborative research program led by Dr. Mohammad Zarei. The positions are supported through the NSF Center for Research Advancement in Smart Manufacturing (CREST-RASM) and connect hands-on food-science experimentation with process monitoring, data analysis, modeling, and digital-twin validation. Students will work with food science and engineering collaborators and contribute to publishable research in sustainable food manufacturing. Current projects include the valorization of tomato seed meal, sorghum distillers dried grains with solubles (DDGS), and California alfalfa through enzymatic hydrolysis and fermentation. These are representative projects rather than the limits of the appointment. Depending on project needs and student interests, assignments may also involve alternative and plant proteins, agricultural and food by-product biorefineries, extrusion processing, bioactive peptides, sustainable packaging and bioplastics, functional foods, downstream processing, cultivated-food applications, and AI-assisted process optimization

  

**RESEARCH AREAS AND POTENTIAL ASSIGNMENTS**

* Food bioprocessing and biorefinery systems: protein extraction, concentration, enzymatic hydrolysis, fermentation, separation, and recovery.

* Alternative proteins and value-added ingredients: plant proteins, protein hydrolysates, bioactive peptides, functional ingredients, and applications in food or feed.

* Smart food manufacturing: real-time monitoring, sensor data, experimental design, process optimization, and validation of data-driven or digital-twin models.

* Food process engineering and sustainable materials: extrusion, ingredient functionality, texture and rheology, bioplastics, and sustainable packaging when relevant to active projects.

  

**SOME OF THE THINGS THAT YOU WILL GET TO DO (this is just a small sampling of work variety):**

* Ability to work safely and carefully in a laboratory, follow protocols, maintain accurate records, and manage multiple research tasks.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively with an interdisciplinary team.

* Availability to work approximately 10 hours per week, including scheduled laboratory blocks required for experiments.

  

**PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with protein extraction, enzymatic hydrolysis, microbial fermentation, bioreactors, extrusion, membrane separation, or food-product analysis.

* Familiarity with experimental design, statistics, data visualization, or software such as Excel, JMP, R, Python, MATLAB, or comparable tools.

* Interest in sustainable food processing, smart manufacturing, sensors, automation, artificial intelligence, or digital-twin applications.

jobs.description:
Howmet Fastening Systems (HFS) is a business unit of Howmet Aerospace, headquartered in Torrance, California. We hold the number one global position in aerospace fastening systems, and we’re the North American leader in commercial transportation fasteners. Our high-tech, multi-material fastening systems are found nose to tail on aircraft and aerospace engines. Our products are also critical components of industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, and construction and industrial equipment.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Chemical Laboratory Technician to support and maintain chemical process controls for aerospace surface treatment operations.

The Chemical Lab Technician will be responsible for sampling, testing, analyzing, documenting, and monitoring chemical solutions used in processes such as anodizing, passivation, cleaning, etching, conversion coating, and other chemical finishing operations.

The technician will perform routine laboratory analysis of process tanks, verify that chemical concentrations and operating parameters remain within established specifications, identify out-of-control conditions, and work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Production to maintain stable and compliant chemical processes.

This position requires strong attention to detail, disciplined laboratory practices, accurate documentation, and strict adherence to chemical safety requirements.

jobs.title: Research Associate II, R&D
jobs.description:
**About Mission Bio**

Based in South San Francisco, Mission Bio is the leader in single cell, multi-omics solutions for precision medicine. Our mission is to empower researchers and clinicians to eradicate cancer, and our Tapestri® Platform is at the center of that effort. As the industry’s first high throughput single cell, multi-omics solution, Tapestri is trusted by leading academic medical centers, cancer institutes, and biopharma companies to advance research and accelerate the development of curative therapies, including the future of cell and gene therapy.

We are entering an exciting growth phase focused on innovation, deeper commercial partnerships, and broader clinical adoption. Our expanded tri-omics capabilities now combine targeted gene expression and genotyping in a single assay, opening up new opportunities across oncology and therapeutic development.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a highly motivated individual to join the Research and Development (R&D) team as a Research Associate II. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving successful completion of novel custom multi-omics single-cell projects in coordination with Bioinformatics and R&D teams. The position will be critical in generating analytical and experimental data for Mission Bio’s customers across diverse applications in cell and gene therapy, drug, and biomarker development.

  

This position will report to the R&D Team Lead.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Prepare, handle, and/or culture human cell lines and primary cells for testing on Mission Bio’s single-cell Tapestri platform.
* Execute experiments following complex plans and protocols on the Tapestri platform, including downstream NGS library preparation and sequencing.

* Plan and coordinate with team members to troubleshoot protocols and optimize workflows.
* Prepare written protocols for new processes and/or update existing protocols.

**Essential Skills, Education, and Experience:**

* At least 2 years of hands-on lab experience. Industry experience is preferred.

jobs.description:
**Department:**

R&D

  

**Location:**

Irvine, CA

  

**Job Summary:**

Zymo Research is seeking a Bioinformatics Scientist to join the Epigenetics Technology team and lead computational development for epigenomics and molecular assay research. The scientist will curate datasets, discover and evaluate candidate methylation biomarkers, develop statistical models, and build reproducible analysis pipelines in close collaboration with experimental scientists.

This role combines epigenomics, statistical modeling, and software development. The scientist will guide computational strategy, define analytical performance criteria, and support targeted assay development, independent validation, and transfer into scalable research products.

Join us in making a meaningful impact!

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Own the computational roadmap for assigned research and assay development projects, defining deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, data needs, and technical risks. Coordinate priorities and dependencies with experimental scientists and support bioinformatics teams.
* Curate public and internal epigenomic datasets (methylation, hydroxymethylation). Document sample provenance, quality, relevant metadata, assay platform, genome build, and usage permissions; maintain versioned datasets with clear inclusion and quality criteria.
* Discover and prioritize candidate molecular markers and differentially methylated regions. Evaluate specificity, biological variability, common sequence variants, repetitive regions, assay compatibility, and stability across relevant sample and biological conditions.
* Develop and benchmark statistical models for molecular profiling and epigenetic biomarker analysis. Evaluate feature selection, model assumptions, uncertainty and performance supported by the available data.
* Contribute to other projects requiring relevant scientific and technical expertise.

**Pipeline Development and Validation**

* Build reproducible pipelines for methylation sequencing and relevant reference array datasets, covering quality control, alignment, methylation quantification, filtering, annotation, and reporting. Evaluate conversion efficiency, mapping ambiguity, duplicates, coverage, and batch effects using controls appropriate to each assay.
* Co-design targeted methylation panels with the assay team. Perform in silico assessment of primers, probes, and hybridization capture baits for sequence specificity, common variants, conversion-related sequence changes, and cross-hybridization; use empirical enrichment and coverage data to refine panel design.
* Benchmark analytical methods using reference standards, simulations, and independent sample sets. Separate model development, marker selection, and validation by biological source; assess bias, error, agreement, reproducibility, and robustness.
* Assess robustness to sequencing depth, missing data, DNA input, dataset selection, platform differences, batch effects, and relevant biological variation. Use validated harmonization approaches and prevent information leakage across development and validation datasets.
* Define quantitative reporting metrics, calibration approaches, quality thresholds, and validated reporting ranges. Document uncertainty, investigate unexpected results, and communicate analytical limitations.
* Implement automated quality checks, failure flags, versioned reports, and traceable software releases. Use code review, tests, workflow automation, and documented environments to support reproducibility and technical transfer; communicate model limitations clearly to scientific and product teams.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Provide technical guidance and code review for collaborating scientists and junior bioinformatics staff. Maintain clear analysis documentation, contribute to publications and invention disclosures, and support product and customer-facing technical discussions as needed for relevant projects.

**Education and Experience:**

* Ph.D. in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, genomics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated independent ownership of substantial computational research or product development projects.
* Strong experience analyzing DNA (hydroxy)methylation or epigenomic data, including sequencing-based quantification, quality control, and biological interpretation.
* Experience with statistical modeling, biomarker discovery, or closely related quantitative methods, including rigorous study design, feature selection, and independent model validation.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Python and R, Linux or Unix, statistical analysis, and scientific visualization. Experience building maintainable analysis code with version control, automated tests, and documented workflows.
* Experience processing Illumina sequencing data, managing large genomic datasets, and developing scalable workflows using high-performance or cloud computing environments.
* Experience with epigenomic biomarker discovery, dataset curation, method benchmarking, or statistical model optimization.

jobs.title: Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) Undergraduate Research Associate - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

The Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) was established at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) in 1996 to bring together experts from the science, technology, and policy communities to address pressing national security challenges. For over 20 years, CGSR has engaged diverse perspectives on topics important to national security, deterrence, diplomacy, dual-use technology, arms control, nonproliferation, space, cyber, biosecurity, and energy security.

We have openings in Summer 2027 for undergraduate students to engage in practical research on global security topics. Students will work with CGSR over the duration of three to four months as a research associate (RA). RAs will engage in practical research to further their educational and career goals, while also supporting the development of strategies for national security and LLNL’s mission focus areas. Examples of relevant fields of research include nuclear deterrence, arms control, nonproliferation, emerging technologies, cybersecurity, space, biological & chemical security, and energy security.

Stanford University’s Center for International Security and Cooperation (CISAC) is one of the nation’s leading interdisciplinary, university-based research and training centers addressing critical international security issues.
