As part of the global team you'll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate II/Sr. Clinical Research Associate I you'll conduct remote or onsite monitoring visits to assess regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You'll manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and monitoring environments (i.e. FSO, FSP, Government, etc). Acting as a site process specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigator sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix

What You'll Do:

Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root Functions cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.

Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).

Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.

Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections. Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience Requirements:

Bachelor's a life sciences related field or a Registered Nurse Certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification

Required: Minimum of 1 year of oncology monitoring experience, OR minimum of 2 years of standard monitoring experience with relevant prior clinical experience (e.g., MD, RN, Study Coordinator).
Preferred: Ideally candidates will have up to 2 years of monitoring experience, though more experienced candidates can be considered if needed

Therapeutic areas preferred-> Oncology - Respiratory (COPD, asthma, nasal polyps, etc.) & Cardiovascular.

Valid driver's license where applicable.

Candidates must live within 60 miles of the nearest major airport. 60- 80% travel is expected.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, including a drug screening.

Progressive and/or more extensive job duties and responsibilities may be expected with increasing CRA leveling.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Effective clinical monitoring skills
Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
Ability to manages Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
Effective interpersonal skills
Strong attention to detail
Effective organizational and time management skills
Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
Ability to work in a team or independently as required
Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
Good English language and grammar skills
Good presentation skills

Working Conditions and Environment:

Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals.
May also include extended overnight stays.
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.
Must be able to comply with specific sponsor/client/site requirements, even if not required by Thermo Fisher Scientific (e.g., disclosure of vaccination status, or other personal information). On some occasions, this information may be required to be provided directly to sponsor/client/site.

Compensation And Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
True Classic is hiring a Senior Data Analyst (AI-Native)
to source and validate the data that feeds our forecasting and inventory planning, audit what those tools produce, and use AI to make them leaner over time. The goal is planning decisions made on data we can trust, so we hold the right inventory in the right place and avoid both excess and stockouts.

All of True Classic's roles are global and omni-channel, leading designated areas of accountability across all product categories, countries, and different sales & marketing channels. This means you will have the opportunity to impact our operations worldwide, ensuring a cohesive strategy that aligns with our overall business objectives and drives success across various markets and platforms.

Areas of Accountability

Input Sourcing & Data Quality

Bring together data and information spread across multiple systems and communication platforms into one reliable source for planning.
Make sure those sources stay connected and consistent, so every team works from the same accurate data.

Output Audit & Approval

Audit forecasts, purchase plans, inventory transfers and reporting against their sources on a weekly cadence.
Catch stale data, unit mismatches, totals that don't reconcile and results that don't fit history.
Rate each output as acceptable, acceptable with caveats, or not acceptable, and explain why.
Report findings with the conclusion first, followed by what was checked and what needs attention.

Tool Improvement & Automation

Use AI to streamline, automate and strengthen planning tools and reports.
Build recurring checks into the tools so audits run automatically going forward.
Automate routine, repetitive work such as transfers, warehouse coordination and data hygiene.
Automate routine updates to partner teams.
Keep planning processes documented and repeatable.
Partner with IT to integrate the planning tools into the company's merchandising and operating systems.

Cross Functional Collaboration

Planning: Deliver audited, decision-ready data for purchasing, allocation and inventory decisions.
Merchandising: Validate product, assortment and pricing data.
Sourcing & Production: Confirm purchase order, lead-time and vendor data.
Warehousing & Logistics Partners: Reconcile inventory, receipts and transfers across warehouses.
eCommerce, Marketplaces & Wholesale: Validate sales, promotion and order data for each channel.
Finance: Make sure planning numbers reconcile with the financial view.

Qualifications

4+ years in data analysis, audit or QA, validating and reconciling data across multiple sources.
Expert, hands-on use of AI tools to find, clean, audit and improve data, with your own AI workflow across email, chat, documents and data tools.
Self-sufficient: finds scattered information without direction and can explain why a source is trustworthy.
Skeptical by default: checks results against source and spots what looks wrong, even when it looks polished.
Decisive: makes a clear call on data quality and stands behind it.
Clear, concise communicator who leads with the answer and states assumptions.
Comfortable working with large operational data sets.
Coding experience (Python, SQL) is not required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Claude is highly preferred.
Experience in planning, inventory, supply chain, retail or e-commerce.
AI workflows or automations you built yourself and can walk through live.
Experience with NetSuite, Shopify or warehouse and 3PL data.
Familiarity with Python or SQL.

Workplace Arrangement

Hybrid (3x per week in office) based in Calabasas, CA.

jobs.description:
Department

SOM KC Neurology

Nucifora Research

Position Title

Research Assistant - Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center (ADRC) (Nucifora Lab)

Job Family Group

Professional Staff

Job Description Summary

The laboratory of Dr. Leslie Nucifora is seeking a Research Assistant to support research investigating the molecular mechanisms underlying psychosis in neuropsychiatric disorders, including Alzheimer’s disease and schizophrenia.

The research assistant will contribute to laboratory studies using human biospecimens, cell culture models, and biochemical and cell biological techniques. Responsibilities will include biospecimen processing and management, cell culture maintenance, laboratory experimentation, data collection and analysis, and support for research publications. The position offers an opportunity to contribute to translational neuroscience research while developing technical expertise in molecular and cellular approaches to understanding neuropsychiatric disorders.

Job Description

Job Duties

Perform clinical and research laboratory experiments independently or under supervision, following established protocols and procedures.
Apply foundational knowledge in the biological sciences to learn and implement laboratory techniques and methods relevant to ongoing research projects.
Process and handle biological specimens using established procedures, including centrifugation, pipetting, sample preparation, and sample tracking.
Operate basic laboratory instruments and analytical equipment in accordance with established protocols.
Assist with the organization, tracking, and long-term storage of biospecimens, including postmortem human tissue, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), and fibroblasts.
Maintain accurate inventories of biospecimens and laboratory materials, ensuring appropriate documentation and traceability of samples and associated experimental data.
Collect, organize, enter, and maintain research data in electronic databases.
Perform basic data analysis and contribute to the preparation of figures, results, and other materials for scientific manuscripts and publications.
Assist in developing and updating study-related manuals of procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Nucifora Lab activities.
Support the training of laboratory personnel in routine laboratory techniques, standard procedures, and equipment operation.
Develop troubleshooting and problem-solving skills through progressive training and increasing familiarity with research objectives and experimental methods.
Collaborate with laboratory members to coordinate and complete study activities and provide support for additional research tasks as needed.
Perform routine laboratory maintenance, monitor and replenish supplies, assist with ordering laboratory materials, and maintain clean and organized workspaces and equipment.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. It is only a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks, duties, and assignments. jobs.description:
Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich RE, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

About the role
Sentra is hiring its first US Classification Data Analyst to be the go-to expert on data classification for our US customers. You will join the Solutions Architecture team, reporting to the Director of Solutions Architecture, and work closely with our R&D Data Analysts team in Israel.

Classification is what customers judge us on during proofs of value (PoVs) and renewals: do our results match their data? You will make sure the answer is yes. You will own classification requests for US PoVs, validate results before customer calls, tune classifiers using proven procedures, and bring the hard problems to R&D with everything they need to solve them.
This is a high-impact role at a fast-growing startup. You will help build the US classification function from the ground up, and your scope will grow as you take on more of the work.

What you'll do
Be the first point of contact for classification requests from US customers and PoVs, working with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, TAMs, Support and Customer Success.
Own classification on PoV engagements: validate results before customer calls and join those calls as the classification expert in the room.
Tune classification using approved procedures: add and remove keywords, build customer-specific regex and dictionary classes, run re-analysis, review customer-built classes and manage allowlists.
Find false positives and false negatives before customers do, and explain clearly why something was classified the way it was and what will change.
Escalate complex issues to the R&D Data Analysts team with a complete, well-written handoff they can act on without a follow-up call.
Track every request and its outcome, and turn that data into insight on volume, trends, and where we can improve.
Proactively look across PoVs to spot what is working, what is not, and what needs to change in our classification, our process, or our runbooks.
Keep our runbooks current: report gaps, propose fixes, and update instructions as the product evolves.

What you'll bring
3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (support engineering, solutions engineering, TAM, data analyst or similar) at a SaaS or security company.
Startup experience. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
A proactive mindset. You look for problems and improvements before they become customer issues.
Working SQL. You can write and adapt queries in Athena or a similar engine.
Regular expressions. You can read, write, and test patterns and explain their false positive behavior.
Git and code literacy. You understand how Git and pull requests work and can read and follow code, such as a Python script. You do not need to be a developer, and using AI tools like Claude to help write code is welcome, as long as you understand what the code does.
Clear, structured communication. You can explain technical results to a customer and write a handoff that a teammate can act on without a call.
Location East Coast

Nice to have
Familiarity with data classification, DLP or DSPM concepts (PII, PCI, PHI, data classes, false positive rates).
Exposure to cloud data stores such as S3, Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft 365, and how sensitive data shows up in them.

Job Description:

As a User Acquisition Data Analyst on the Mobile Growth Marketing team, you'll step into an established analytics function and keep it running during a team member's leave. Your focus is continuity: delivering the recurring reporting and forecasting cadence that the UA, Finance, and leadership teams rely on, running ad-hoc deep dives that guide campaign and creative optimization, and keeping dashboards and data pipelines healthy. As capacity allows, you'll also take on new dashboard and data-model development.
This is a hands-on role for an analyst who can ramp quickly, operate independently in a live UA environment, and pick up an existing cadence without heavy onboarding.

What Your Impact Will Be
Own the recurring UA reporting cadence
— daily performance monitoring, the weekly UA performance review, weekly budget pacing for Finance, and the monthly UA committee report — covering cost, CPI, installs, retention, and revenue, split by channel, platform, and geo.
Turn report outputs into decisions

Maintain data integrity and dashboards

Build as capacity allows

What We're Looking For
3-5 years in marketing analytics or data science supporting mobile user acquisition
Advanced SQL (ideally BigQuery), with the ability to work independently in a live data environment from day one
Strong dashboarding and data-visualization skills in Tableau, Looker Studio, and/or Mixpanel

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril’s Air and Ground Deterrence (AGD) Division develops integrated robotic systems designed to provide multi-domain situational awareness and force protection across land, sea, and air. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly detect and identify potential threats. close the kill chain against a broad range of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) threats.

Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the multidisciplinary Sentry Hardware team within AGD serves as the key system integrator of the Anduril Sentry Family of Systems (FoS). About The Job

The Sentry Engineering team builds hardware products and systems that leverage artificial intelligence to provide highly accurate, persistent autonomous awareness across land, sea and air. With an AI-enabled edge processing and a variety of radars and sensors with continuous 360 pan / tilt capability, Sentry can autonomously identify, detect, and track objects of interest to bring increased awareness to borders, military bases, oil and gas pipelines, airports and other critical infrastructure.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. 1168384_RR00126348 Job ID: 1168384_RR00126348

NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.

For more information, go to med.nyu.edu , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opening for a Senior Data Analyst within the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicine, Research Division. In this role, the successful candidate will work under the direction of Principal Investigator and Medical Director for Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Dr. Ula Hwang. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting data management and analyses using clinical, administrative, and operational data, and for planning, designing, and implementing statistical analyses. This will include working with large national and multicenter research network databases, including electronic health record (EHR) and claims data. The individual in this position will support multiple projects in day-to-day activities, including preliminary data analysis, data visualization, predictive and machine learning analytics, causal inference analyses, and results dissemination. All research and programming code must be regularly documented and archived per best practices. Other responsibilities will include coordinating and participating in regular meetings that pertain to data preparation, management, analyses and ongoing research projects. The analyst will communicate information and data in written and verbal form to colleagues as well as project and senior management teams. A successful applicant will be a strong communicator, be curious, inquisitive and resourceful, have a high degree of professional maturity and commitment to excellence, and be able to work autonomously and comfortably on a health services research team in an academic medical center environment.

Job Responsibilities

Demonstrates knowledge of the organizations Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.

Maintains, cleans, and constructs analytic datasets and research cohorts from electronic health record (EHR) databases and other sources in support of research protocols and projects. Ensures that data are compiled, analyzed, and presented appropriately, and performs reviews to ensure data accuracy and completeness.

Ensures compliance with HIPAA, IRB protocols, and data use agreements.

Leads knowledge sharing and training of research staff in data extraction, data preparation, data standardization approaches using SQL, Epic Clarity and Caboodle databases, common data models including OMOP, PCORnet, data platforms such as Databricks, and NIA LINKAGE CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.

Oversees and manages multicenter research data infrastructure both locally and nationally.

Manages and analyzes large datasets, such as HCUP and CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims using high-performance computing environments.

Contributes to grant proposal and study design development, including initial stages of research project development (e.g., research questions, hypotheses, and statistical analysis plans) and grant writing to secure funding.

Performs coding, debugging and other tasks in support of data analyses.

Troubleshoots data or software problems and rapidly resolves issues that occur.

Under the supervision of research faculty, analyzes, develops, and interprets scientific results. Maintains clear documentation of analyses, including well-documented, version-controlled and reproducible code and analytic workflows. Presents findings to the research team and collaborators.

Supports the development of publications and conference presentations, including drafting academic and non-academic publications and creating tables, figures, and other data visualizations for presentations.

May perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

To qualify you must have a Bachelors Degree and 3-5 years of experience required.

Preferred Qualifications

Masters degree in a scientific discipline such as statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science, or health economics, and at least 3-5 years of experience in a relevant setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strong quantitative skills and advanced programming skills in R, Python, SAS, and/or Stata.

Experience working with EHR clinical data and/or CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.

Ability to select and apply appropriate statistical methods for collecting, summarizing, and analyzing EHR and other large datasets.

Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.

Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative research team.

Knowledge of principles and methods of biostatistics and epidemiology, including study design, statistical analysis, and causal inference.

Experience with database queries and SQL, version control systems (e.g., Git/Github), and familiarity with healthcare coding systems and standards (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, NDC)

Abitity to function independently, demonstrate strong analytical judgment, are inquisitive, anticipatory, resourceful, enjoy critical thinking, and are able to explain methodological choices

Experience using large language models (LLMs) and other AI tools to support research, programming, or data analysis, including the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-assisted outputs.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

Who you are

Minimum Requirements

A PhD, MS, or BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering)

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

AtlasBase is a fast-growing pioneer in Molecular Computing, bridging the gap between traditional IT and biotechnology. We are redefining global IT infrastructure by driving breakthroughs in both Molecular Compute and Molecular Data Storage. By commercializing synthetic DNA-based technologies at IT scale, AtlasBase delivers ultra-high-density, low-maintenance, and carbon-conscious solutions built for the explosive growth and value of the world's data. Leveraging nature’s most durable medium, we provide a virtually permanent foundation that transforms how the world processes and secures its most critical information.

About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to join a talented team of scientists and engineers focused on solving critical challenges in molecular data storage. To help drive this innovation, we are seeking a detail-oriented, hard-working, and highly motivated Research Associate to join our Systems Integration team. This individual will help develop the company’s proprietary enzymatic DNA synthesis on semiconductor chips. The position will support reagent development, including characterization and QC, biochemical and enzyme assay development, on-chip DNA synthesis, and downstream sample processing including NGS library prep and analysis. This is a full-time bench position and the person will be expected to work closely with your supervisor and other team members to provide support for planning and execution of experiments. Above all, we are looking for a highly trainable candidate with a strong work ethic who is eager to learn and grow with the company.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Support and contribute towards the research and development of a custom high-throughput DNA synthesis platform for DNA data storage
Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot custom DNA synthesizers
Prepare and QC stock reagents and buffers for enzymatic DNA synthesis, using pH and assay-specific readouts
Operate analytical tools for assessment of quality of oligonucleotides, including HPLC, LCMS, and capillary electrophoresis
Perform NGS library prep on sample DNA oligo pools

Utilize lab management and data analysis software to document data and produce scientific presentations and reports on experimental findings

Job Description Summary:

Founded in 1824, the GW School of Medicine and Health Sciences ( SMHS ) is the 11th oldest medical school in the country and the first in the nation’s capital. Since its establishment, the school has been at the forefront of medical education, and has grown to include highly-ranked programs in the health and biomedical sciences. The Department of Pharmacology and Physiology at The George Washington University School of Medicine and Health Sciences invites applications for a Senior Research Assistant position focused on examining the pharmacodynamics of oxytocin and different long-lasting oxytocin formulations in cell culture and in-vivo preparations.

With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We are seeking a Clinical Laboratory Coordinator to join our team in the Glendale, CA Early Phase Clinical Unit (EPCU). This position serves as a key laboratory resource, ensuring biological samples are processed, handled, documented, stored, and shipped in accordance with study protocols.

You will join a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where your expertise supports operational excellence and patient focused research. About the Commercial Excellence practice

Bain's B2B Commercial Excellence practice works with clients to develop a clear go-to-market (GTM) strategy: building an in-depth understanding of market opportunity, designing effective sales coverage and capacity models to attack that opportunity, and creating an industrialized sales execution capability to ensure commercial success. .

jobs.title: QC Technician - PCBA Firmware Flashing and Functional Test
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About The Role

The QC Technician is the last check between our electronics and the field. You will flash firmware onto circuit boards every day, run functional tests, and make sure every board that leaves the bench is correctly programmed, traceable, and working.

This is a hands-on, bench-based role on the hardware production team. You will work closely with hardware and firmware engineers, follow documented procedures, and flag anything that looks off before it reaches a vehicle.

What You'll Do

Flash bootloaders, firmware, and configuration files onto PCBs and modules using programming fixtures, JTAG/SWD debuggers, USB/serial tools, and in-house scripts.
Confirm the correct firmware version and configuration is loaded on every board, matched to the build order, and run batch flashing efficiently while keeping error rates near zero.
Run functional and power-on tests after flashing, following test procedures and checklists; visually inspect boards for physical defects such as damaged components, solder issues, bent pins, and connector damage.
Use multimeters, power supplies, and basic test equipment to check voltages and continuity.
Separate passing and failing units, and tag failures clearly for engineering review. Write clear failure reports with symptoms, steps taken, and photos where useful.
Log serial numbers, firmware versions, test results, and failures in our tracking system or spreadsheets, label boards and keep inventory of programmed, tested, and failed units accurate.
Do first-level troubleshooting on failed flashes and tests: re-seat connections, check cables, retry, and swap fixtures–escalate recurring or unexplained failures to hardware and firmware engineers with enough detail to act on.
Follow ESD-safe handling and keep the bench, fixtures, and tools clean, calibrated, and organized, suggest improvements to procedures, fixtures, and scripts that cut cycle time or errors.
Help keep work instructions and checklists up to date as firmware and hardware change, and support new product introductions and engineering builds when needed.

What We're Looking For

High school diploma or equivalent; technical certificate or associate degree in electronics or a related field is a plus.
3+ year of hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing, test, QC, or a similar bench role.
Comfortable handling PCBs and small components with ESD-safe practices.
Basic use of a multimeter and bench power supply.
Comfortable on a linux computer: running programs or scripts from instructions, using a command line at an intermediate level, and entering data accurately in spreadsheets or tracking tools.
Able to follow written procedures exactly and recognize when something doesn't match them, clear written and verbal communication for logging results and reporting failures.
Reliable, consistent, and comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work.
Background in automotive, robotics, or heavy equipment electronics preferred.
IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001 certification, or working knowledge of PCB workmanship standards preferred.
Experience flashing microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar) with tools such as ST-Link, J-Link, or OpenOCD preferred.
Familiarity with Linux and running Python or shell scripts preferred.
Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or serial terminals (UART, CAN), basic soldering and rework skills, and experience with test fixtures, bed-of-nails testers, or production test stations preferred.

Physical Requirements

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. jobs.title: Expert Senior Manager, Data Sciences, Software and Data Services, Coro
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor Best Place to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

About the Commercial Excellence practice

Bain's B2B Commercial Excellence practice works with clients to develop a clear go-to-market (GTM) strategy: building an in-depth understanding of market opportunity, designing effective sales coverage and capacity models to attack that opportunity, and creating an industrialized sales execution capability to ensure commercial success. Coro's software and data solutions are an innovative and increasingly critical part of this approach. To learn more about Coro, visit https://www.coro.io/
.

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

About Coro
℠

The Coro ℠  business unit brings together Bain's proprietary suite of software-as-a-service (SaaS) and data-as-a-service (DaaS) tools, including cloud-based software, online capability assessments, and advanced analytics, focused on enabling Commercial Excellence for B2B companies.

The Impact You'll Have

Bain's Commercial Excellence work helps B2B companies turn market opportunity into booked revenue, through sharper go-to-market strategy, better sales coverage and capacity, and industrialized execution. The analytics underneath that work are what make it credible, and they are what you will own.
We are hiring an Expert Senior Manager, Data Science, to lead data science delivery and methodology across Coro's product suite. You will set the analytical approach on our most complex client engagements, lead the teams that deliver them, and make the calls on modeling design, validation, and where a bespoke analysis should become a productized capability. This is a senior, client-facing role: you will work directly with Bain partners and client executives, and you will be the person expected to defend the methodology in the room.
These capabilities power Coro's product suite, such as MoneyMap®, which builds a granular, bottoms-up view of market opportunity, and the repeatable analytics workflows behind Bain's B2B go-to-market work, across challenges such as opportunity mapping, indirect channel growth, and profitability analysis. The work spans propensity and predictive scoring, TAM and market sizing, entity resolution and data matching across third-party sources, and GenAI-driven classification and enrichment at scale. The role also includes ownership of the analytics and delivery of our pricing products, including ProfitCube.
You will also help build the capability itself, through recruiting, coaching, and raising the standard of how the team works, in keeping with Bain's apprenticeship model. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in commercial settings.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a senior member of the Coro data science team, you will:
Lead the delivery of Coro data science solutions across multiple concurrent client engagements, owning scope, methodology, quality and pace, and stepping in personally where the analytical problem warrants it
Collaborate closely with and influence Bain case teams, partners and senior client executives, framing commercial problems and translating them into analytical approaches and clear business recommendations
Develop and deploy production machine learning and analytical models that drive Coro solutions, including propensity and predictive scoring, TAM and market opportunity sizing, customer segmentation, entity resolution and data matching, and enrichment pipelines built on third-party data sources
Own the analytics and delivery of Coro's pricing products, including ProfitCube
Own the technical direction for GenAI-enabled analytical workflows, including LLM-based classification, enrichment and validation, and set the standards the team applies to prompt design, evaluation and output quality assurance
Develop Coro intellectual property and identify new opportunities for data science to extend the product suite, ensuring that repeatable analyses become re-usable frameworks, models and components rather than one-off case work
Work with Coro product managers and practice leadership to shape the roadmap, prioritize analytical features, and design the optimal approach to product delivery
Act as an expert advisor in proposal, pre-sales and pitch discussions, scoping the analytical approach, sizing the work, and supporting commercial conversations with clients
Lead and develop on-shore and off-shore delivery teams, providing coaching on problem-solving, work planning and data science techniques, and engaging constructively in the mutual feedback process
Keep abreast of new and current data science techniques and technologies, and assess where they create real advantage for our clients and our products
Share learnings and drive adoption of best demonstrated practices across the Coro and wider data science community, and work together to create a great working environment that attracts other great data scientists
Lead recruiting and onboarding of team members as needed, and identify opportunities to support the growth and scaling of the Coro business unit

ABOUT YOU

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.  Willingness to travel to client locations (expected 20-40%, potential peak of 60%).
We are looking for someone who has:
Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics or Information Sciences such as business analytics or informatics
8-10 years of experience in analytics
3+ years of experience managing data scientists
Shipped production, enterprise scale data products
Track record of leading and collaborating on strategic initiatives, and of owning client relationships or workstreams end to end
Experience in B2B commercial or go-to-market analytics
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss mathematical and machine learning technicalities with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Solid fundamental knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms such as classifiers, cluster analysis, dimension reduction, regression, sequence modeling, NLP/NLU, word and document embeddings, self-attention and transformers
Experience with entity resolution, fuzzy matching and deduplication across disparate third-party data sources
Experience with large language models, generative AI applications and prompt engineering for data classification, enrichment and analysis
Experience with MLOps, including scalable development to deployment of complex data science workflows
Experience with model explainability and interpretability techniques
Proficiency in Python and SQL required
Experience in machine learning frameworks and tools (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, pandas, NumPy) required
Experience with ETL processes, data pipeline development and relational databases at scale
Experience with large-scale distributed computing and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP
Experience with visualization platforms such as Tableau

Preferred

MBA, or PhD in a technical field
Background in consulting, professional services, or B2B analytics environments
Experience with pricing or profitability analytics in a B2B setting
Experience supporting deployment of SaaS or DaaS solutions with clients

U.S. COMPENSATION INFORMATION

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain's best in class benefits package (details listed below). 
Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:
In California, Washington state, Washington DC, New York, Illinois, Georgia, Texas and Massachusetts States, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $164,500 - $219,000; placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level

Annual discretionary performance bonus

This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation

4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date

Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.
Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck
Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays
Fully vested 401(k) company contribution
Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.

At Jacobs, we don’t settle - always looking beyond to raise the bar and deliver with excellence. We apply our expertise and knowledge as we look into the future with great optimism and focus. We don’t settle until we give our best and know that we’re making a difference.

We're looking for a Civil Engineer
to join our Advanced Manufacturing group, and you’ll have the chance to work on projects including state of the art industrial and commercial facilities. Your multi-discipline, highly interactive team will conceptualize initial civil design for land/site development, prepare grading plans, and perform earthwork and drainage/stormwater calculations. Providing erosion and sediment control plans, stormwater pollution prevention plans and support permit approval
Researching and adhering to local Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements for design and construction in any given area
Stormwater analysis and modeling in software applications, such as StormCAD, CivilStorm

PE certification

jobs.title: MCAT Coordinator/Habitability Subject Matter Expert - 30845
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 30845

Required Travel: 26 - 50%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $87,628.00 - $95,000.00

Security Clearance: Ability to Obtain

Level of Experience: Mid

This opportunity resides with Global Security (GS).
Mission Technologies’ Global Security (GS) group comprises live, virtual, constructive (LVC) solutions; fleet sustainment; nuclear and environmental; and Australia business.

As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. With advanced technologies to enable mission readiness, HII understands that preparation requires full coordination—not readiness in piece-parts.

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants and aircraft carriers—HII ensures a high state of readiness.

HII supports the Department of Energy’s national security mission through the management and operation of its sites, as well as the safe cleanup of legacy waste across the country. HII meets clients’ toughest nuclear and environmental challenges.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Summary

Join HII as we keep the world's most powerful Navy afloat! This position is to be a member of the COMNAVAIRPAC/COMNAVAIRLANT Material Condition Assist Team (MCAT) as the Coordinator / Habitability Subject Matter Expert (SME). The mission of MCAT is to train and prepare Ships Force on how to follow US Navy instructions / guidance onboard CVNs to be better prepared for assessments and inspections. This is a full-time position, located in San Diego, CA.

Essential Job Responsibilities

jobs.title: CAD Modeler
jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

US defense systems run on technical data that is often decades old: scanned paper, hand-marked prints, partial models, and drawings that were never turned into 3D models. A part that exists only on an old drawing is hard to source. That slows how fast the armed forces and our prime customers can sustain and rebuild the systems that use it. Hadrian turns that data into manufacturing-ready models and drawings, so customers can keep their systems running and Hadrian can make or procure the parts.

As a CAD Modeler, you build the 3D models and 2D drawings for naval and aerospace parts, starting from whatever the customer sends. You also build the models and drawings for each manufacturing state (M-state) of a part: the in-process configurations the factory builds and inventories on the way to the final part. Our engineers define each M-state, and you model, draw, and configure it. You own your parts from first model through release and every change after it.

What You’ll Do

Build manufacturing-ready 3D models from naval prints, aerospace drawings, partial models, and other customer documents, matching the customer's definition feature for feature.
Make the 2D drawings the factory runs on, from your models or the customer's.
Build the models and drawings for each M-state of a part.
Work out conflicting or unclear views against the rest of the drawing.
Keep PLM data correct and structured, and send your parts through the release workflow.
Carry each customer change through the customer geometry and every related M-state across the part family.
Build models that tooling, programming, and inspection teams can use as a base.
Work with manufacturing teams and turn around the model and drawing changes they need.

What We’re Looking For

3+ years building production CAD models and drawings for hardware a factory made.
Expert use of one parametric 3D CAD application, with models the next person can change. NX preferred; CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks also fit.
Experience building 3D models from complex 2D drawings with no existing model, including internal features that only show in a section view.
Reads and drafts GD&T per ASME Y14.5, weld and NDT symbols per AWS A2.4, and drawings to ASME Y14.100.
Experience releasing parts and controlling changes in a PLM system.
Asks when a drawing cannot answer a question instead of guessing.
Sets their own release schedule across many parts and switches priorities quickly.

What Will Set You Apart

Production work in Siemens NX.
Experience with naval or shipyard drawings, customer data packages, and old or hand-drawn prints.
Has modeled and drawn in-process (M-state) configurations that differ from the final customer definition.
Has run a customer change process and an internal change process at the same time.
Background in machined parts, welded assemblies, tooling, and CMM or scan inspection.
Spots when one parametric model can cover a whole family of part numbers, and builds it that way.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is 98,000 - 167,000
(actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. POSITION SUMMARY:

As a Quality Control Technician in the R&D pilot line, you will play a hands-on role in verifying and validating the quality of new product builds through inspection, auditing, and issue detection. Your focus will be on ensuring that early-stage builds meet internal and customer quality standards before scaling up production. Record, classify, and escalate quality issues in real time using the defined QMS tools.
Work closely with engineers and technicians to identify root causes and validate corrections.
Support First Article Inspections (FAI) and validate rework effectiveness.
Monitor and track key NPI quality metrics like, FPY, and build conformance.
Provide feedback on design or process issues encountered during audit and inspection.
Assist in training build operators and technicians on quality criteria and defect awareness.
Collaborate with NPI Quality Program Manager in generating Product Quality Plan documentation, including inspection checkpoints, quality control requirements, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) elements.

Basic understanding of defect categorization, rework tags, and NCR processes.

Competitive compensation

About DeLaval

DeLaval is a leading global supplier of solutions that improve the performance of farms for professional food producers. We support our customers in reducing their environmental footprint while improving food production, profitability and the well -being of the people and animals involved. We offer products, systems and services for all steps of milk production.

Our solutions are used by millions of dairy farmers around the globe every day.

At DeLaval, we prioritize our people and their safety. We pride ourselves on our culture of thinking and acting as One DeLaval. We also empower our people to Make Things Happen and encourage Setting Direction .

Learn more DeLaval, please visit us at www.delaval.com/en-us/

Key Responsibilities

Interpret drawings and specifications, including tolerances, critical-to-quality dimensions (CTQs), surface finish requirements, material grades, and fit/function requirements.
Measure and verify product dimensions using tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, and plug gauges to confirm dimensional accuracy.
Follow established sampling rules, batch sampling plans, and acceptance limits to ensure pass/fail decisions are consistent and defensible, especially when 100% inspection is not practical.
Verify visual and finish standards, including surface defects, labeling, assembly correctness, weld/solder appearance (where applicable), and packaging integrity based on defined defect criteria.
Identify recurring quality issues and document trends. Support root-cause investigations using structured problem-solving tools such as Ishikawa (Fishbone) diagrams to analyze potential causes related to people, processes, materials, and equipment.
Initiate containment activities when necessary by holding suspect lots, isolating nonconforming material, and preventing the mixing of acceptable and questionable inventory.
Accurately record measurements, test results, and pass/fail decisions, including appropriate timestamps and batch or serial number identifiers.
Maintain traceability by linking inspection results to specific lot numbers, supplier batches, machine lines, and operator shifts when applicable.
Properly document deviations, including what failed, how it failed, and actions taken to address the issue.
Manage controlled documents and ensure the use of current checklists, SOPs, test methods, and inspection plans.
Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits by maintaining complete and accurate quality records.
Perform in-process inspections by verifying dimensions and process parameters at defined intervals throughout production.
Verify calibration status and condition of measuring tools, gauges, and inspection equipment, including calibration labels and due dates.
Validate mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke) controls by ensuring sensors, fixtures, interlocks, and alarms function as intended and are not bypassed or ignored.

High School Diploma or General Educational Development (GED) is required.

jobs.title: Senior Dynatrace Observability Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description:
Senior Dynatrace Observability Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)

Location:
Remote
Senior Dynatrace Observability Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)
with extensive hands-on experience designing, implementing, configuring, and optimizing enterprise observability solutions using the Dynatrace platform.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in application performance monitoring (APM), infrastructure observability, distributed transaction tracing, automated dependency discovery, digital experience monitoring, and AI-driven root cause analysis.
This individual will be responsible for establishing comprehensive visibility across complex enterprise environments, including applications, infrastructure, databases, integrations, and third-party services. The role requires the ability to correlate performance data across multiple technology layers, identify service dependencies, troubleshoot complex issues, and translate technical findings into actionable operational insights.
The successful candidate will work collaboratively with infrastructure, application, operations, and security teams to enhance observability capabilities, improve incident investigation, and establish proactive performance monitoring practices.
Key Responsibilities

Dynatrace Platform Architecture & Implementation

Design, deploy, configure, and optimize Dynatrace observability solutions across enterprise environments.
Implement and manage Dynatrace OneAgent, ActiveGate, and associated monitoring components.
Establish monitoring strategies for applications, infrastructure, databases, and integrated services.
Configure automatic discovery, monitoring policies, tagging, and logical environment segmentation.
Implement best practices for platform scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.
Evaluate existing monitoring configurations and recommend improvements to increase visibility and effectiveness.

Application Performance Monitoring & Distributed Tracing

Implement end-to-end application performance monitoring across distributed enterprise applications.
Configure distributed tracing to provide visibility into application transactions across multiple services, APIs, databases, and integrations.
Identify application bottlenecks, service latency, transaction failures, and performance degradation.
Establish performance baselines and identify deviations from expected application behavior.
Analyze transaction flows to isolate performance issues and determine contributing components.
Support monitoring of internally developed, commercial off-the-shelf, and web-based applications.

Infrastructure Observability & Dependency Mapping

Configure monitoring for Windows and Linux servers, virtual machines, databases, and supporting infrastructure.
Implement automated application and infrastructure dependency discovery and visualization.
Leverage Dynatrace Smartscape and related capabilities to map relationships between services, processes, hosts, and applications.
Identify upstream and downstream dependencies to support incident impact analysis.
Establish visibility into resource utilization, infrastructure health, and service availability.
Maintain accurate service relationships and dependency information to support operational troubleshooting.

AI-Driven Root Cause Analysis & Incident Investigation

Leverage Dynatrace Davis AI and automated analytics capabilities to identify probable root causes of performance issues and service disruptions.
Correlate application, infrastructure, transaction, and event data to support incident investigation.
Analyze performance anomalies, service degradation, and unexpected system behavior.
Determine relationships between technical events and their impact on dependent systems and services.
Develop actionable problem detection and alerting strategies that reduce noise and accelerate incident resolution.
Support complex troubleshooting efforts involving multiple applications, infrastructure components, and external dependencies.

Business Transaction & Digital Experience Observability

Configure monitoring of critical business transactions and application workflows.
Establish visibility into transaction success rates, failures, response times, and service availability.
Implement Real User Monitoring (RUM) and Synthetic Monitoring where appropriate.
Monitor customer-facing applications and digital services to identify performance and availability issues.
Develop dashboards and reporting that connect application performance with operational and business service outcomes.
Work with stakeholders to identify critical application workflows and define appropriate monitoring requirements.

SaaS & Third-Party Integration Visibility

Evaluate and implement monitoring integrations for supported SaaS applications and third-party services.
Establish visibility into service availability, performance, and integration dependencies where technically supported.
Monitor application interactions with external APIs and services.
Correlate third-party service issues with application and business service performance.
Identify observability limitations and recommend appropriate complementary monitoring approaches.

Change Impact Analysis & Performance Validation

Establish monitoring baselines to evaluate application and infrastructure performance before and after system changes.
Analyze the impact of operating system updates, application upgrades, configuration modifications, and infrastructure changes.
Correlate deployment and change events with performance anomalies and service degradation.
Support performance validation following maintenance activities and technology deployments.
Provide objective operational data to assist with troubleshooting and change-related investigations.

Dashboards, Reporting & Operational Optimization

Design and implement dashboards for infrastructure, application, service, and transaction visibility.
Configure meaningful alerts, thresholds, and anomaly detection policies.
Develop monitoring strategies aligned with service-level indicators (SLIs) and service-level objectives (SLOs).
Utilize Dynatrace Query Language (DQL) and platform analytics to investigate performance issues.
Optimize monitoring configurations to improve data quality, visibility, and operational effectiveness.
Provide recommendations to improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

Documentation, Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer

Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure engineers, operations teams, and other technical stakeholders.
Participate in technical discovery and requirements-gathering sessions.
Develop platform architecture diagrams, monitoring standards, operational procedures, and configuration documentation.
Provide technical guidance and recommendations regarding observability best practices.
Conduct knowledge transfer sessions for engineering and operations personnel.
Assist in establishing sustainable observability practices and operational processes.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in enterprise monitoring, application performance management, or observability engineering.

3+ years of hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Dynatrace in enterprise environments.

Demonstrated expertise with Dynatrace OneAgent, ActiveGate, Smartscape, and Davis AI.

Strong experience implementing application performance monitoring and distributed transaction tracing.

Experience configuring automated application and infrastructure dependency mapping.

Strong understanding of application architectures, APIs, databases, and distributed systems.

Experience monitoring Windows and Linux infrastructure and virtualized environments.

Proven ability to troubleshoot complex performance issues spanning multiple infrastructure and application layers.

Experience configuring dashboards, alerting, anomaly detection, and performance analytics.

Working knowledge of Dynatrace Query Language (DQL) and modern Dynatrace analytics capabilities.

Experience with digital experience monitoring, including Real User Monitoring and/or Synthetic Monitoring.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Ability to independently lead technical investigations and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Dynatrace Professional certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience with Dynatrace Grail and advanced analytics.
Familiarity with business transaction monitoring and service-level observability.
Experience monitoring commercial enterprise applications and third-party integrations.
Experience with SaaS monitoring and API-based observability integrations.
Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing standards.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or other cloud environments.
Familiarity with ITSM integrations such as ServiceNow, Jira, or PagerDuty.
Experience with automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs.
Understanding of DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and incident management practices.
Familiarity with change impact analysis and performance validation methodologies.
Understanding of security and network monitoring integrations as complementary sources of operational context.

Desired Outcomes

The successful candidate will contribute to:
Improved end-to-end visibility across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
More effective identification of application and service dependencies.
Faster isolation and investigation of performance issues.
Improved correlation between technical events and business service impact.
Increased visibility into critical application transactions and user experience.
More accurate assessment of performance changes following system modifications.
Reduced reliance on manual troubleshooting and undocumented system knowledge.
Improved operational efficiency through proactive monitoring and intelligent event correlation.
Sustainable observability practices supported by documentation and knowledge transfer.
