jobs.title: Associate, Life Science
jobs.description:
Alexandria’s Life Science Team serves a highly strategic role at the intersection of Alexandria’s real estate, venture investment, thought leadership, and regional business development activities to grow and support the local innovation clusters in which we operate.

Alexandria’s Life Science Team plays a strategic role in evaluating and supporting life science companies across Alexandria’s real estate portfolio and broader innovation ecosystem. The team provides scientific, clinical, financial, and market-based insights that inform tenant underwriting, portfolio monitoring, leasing strategy, venture investment, and regional business development activities.

We are seeking an Associate to support Alexandria’s San Diego operations, with a primary focus on the scientific and financial underwriting of prospective tenants and the ongoing monitoring of existing tenants. The Associate will assess companies’ business models, development programs, financing strategies, capital positions, and key operating and value-creation milestones to identify opportunities and risks relevant to Alexandria’s real estate portfolio.

The Associate will work closely with the Leasing team throughout the tenant evaluation and leasing process, including helping prepare for tenant meetings, participating in management discussions, evaluating information provided by prospective tenants, and communicating underwriting conclusions and key areas of risk. The Associate will also interact directly with prospective and current tenants on a regular cadence to maintain an informed view of their scientific progress, operating plans, financing outlook, capital requirements, and anticipated real estate needs. The role will also support select venture investment diligence, strategic research, and business development initiatives in San Diego and, as needed, Alexandria’s other North American markets.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Conduct scientific, clinical, financial, commercial, and capital markets diligence on prospective tenants to support underwriting, leasing, and portfolio decisions.
Evaluate prospective tenants’ business models, management teams, research and development programs, intellectual property positions, competitive landscapes, financing histories, liquidity profiles, capital requirements, and anticipated development milestones.
Partner closely with the Leasing team throughout the prospective tenant evaluation process, including reviewing inbound opportunities, preparing for management meetings, identifying key diligence questions, evaluating company-provided materials, and supporting the development of an informed leasing recommendation.
Participate in meetings with prospective tenants and their management teams to assess scientific programs, business plans, financing strategies, operating assumptions, fundraising needs, and anticipated space requirements.
Prepare concise tenant underwriting assessments that clearly articulate company strengths, key risks, financing considerations, significant milestones, and potential implications for Alexandria’s real estate portfolio.
Monitor existing tenants’ scientific, clinical, operational, and financial performance through direct company engagement and review of public disclosures, financing activity, cash positions, capital requirements, clinical and regulatory developments, partnership activity, organizational changes, and other relevant indicators.
Maintain regular contact with current tenants through a structured cadence of management meetings, company updates, and other interactions to remain informed of material developments in their businesses.
Serve as a consistent internal point of contact for company-specific scientific, financial, and market intelligence concerning prospective and current tenants.

Other Responsibilities:

Collaborate cross-functionally across Alexandria’s leasing, accounting, finance, and regional leadership teams to support core business objectives and strategic initiatives.
Support Alexandria’s venture investment activities, as needed, by conducting diligence and preparing investment reports and memoranda.
Develop and maintain relationships across the San Diego life science ecosystem to strengthen market intelligence and support tenant sourcing, underwriting, monitoring, and business development efforts.

Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in a life science-related field required. Master’s or PhD a plus.
Minimum 4 years’ prior work experience (or equivalent educational experience, e.g., PhD work) within the life science industry; experience in venture investment, investment banking, consulting, and/or business development preferred.
Solid understanding of the life science and broader healthcare industry, including, but not limited to, chemistry and biology fundamentals, the drug development process, the U.S. healthcare and regulatory landscape, venture and equity financing, and human disease.
Ability to translate complex scientific and financial information into concise, actionable reporting for senior and executive-level audiences.
Strong research and analytical skills, as well as high attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and to effectively manage and organize multiple projects concurrently.
Excellent written communication skills a must, along with the ability to create concise and impactful written reports, correspondence, and responses to requests from team members and executive-level members within the Company.
Ability to communicate and collaborate with coworkers, management, and others in a courteous and professional manner.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint. Capabilities in Salesforce, Tableau, PitchBook, Evaluate Pharma, and other industry databases a plus.
Occasional travel to Alexandria’s other North American regions may be required.

The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 USD annually, plus annual discretionary bonus. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the consideration of many factors, which may include, but are not limited to, the individual’s knowledge, experience, education, qualifications, skills, and job location, as well as the Company’s compensation practices.

Alexandria wouldn’t be the company we are without our incredible people, and we are pleased to provide the following industry-leading and comprehensive benefits:

100% company-paid premiums (top-tier health, dental, and vision plan for you and your family)
Generous 401(k) profit sharing plan
Significant paid time off and holiday time
Paid parental leave
Generous rewards and recognitions
Annual Company paid time off for volunteering
Wellness and fitness incentives
Mentoring and career development opportunities
Life insurance, disability plans, and an Employee Assistance Program

Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. (NYSE: ARE), an S&P 500® company, is a best-in-class, mission-driven life science REIT making a positive and lasting impact on the world. With our founding in 1994, Alexandria pioneered the life science real estate niche. Alexandria is the preeminent and longest-tenured owner, operator, and developer of collaborative Megacampus TM ecosystems in AAA life science innovation cluster locations, including Greater Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, Research Triangle, and New York City. Alexandria has a longstanding and proven track record of developing Class A/A+ properties clustered in highly dynamic and collaborative Megacampus environments that enhance our tenants' ability to successfully recruit and retain world-class talent and inspire productivity, efficiency, creativity, and success. Alexandria also provides strategic capital to transformative life science companies through our venture capital platform, Alexandria Venture Investments. For more information, please visit www.are.com.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a CAD & Engineering Infrastructure Lead to build and own the engineering platform behind Velaura's silicon development: the compute infrastructure, EDA ecosystem, integrated RTL-to-GDS release flow, and AI-assisted workflows that every design team depends on. This role owns flow release and qualification, design-flow CI/CD pipelines, multi-vendor EDA tool deployment, and EDA licensing, procurement, and vendor strategy; domain design methodology and flow content stay with the functional teams: RTL, verification, DFT, physical design, and packaging. The ideal candidate is hands-on setting up and maintaining integrated RTL-to-GDS flow environments, understands engineering compute infrastructure and license management at scale, and has a practical view of where AI creates measurable leverage in chip development. Above all, this is someone who measures success by how productive everyone else is.

Responsibilities

Define and drive Velaura’s engineering infrastructure requirements covering compute, storage, job scheduling, security, backup, disaster recovery and cloud in partnership with stakeholders.
Lead AI adoption across engineering functions including RTL, verification, DFT, physical design, packaging, software, and CAD itself. Identify where AI-assisted workflows create measurable leverage and drive them from pilot to standard practice.
Own design-flow CI/CD pipelines including orchestration, flow-release qualification, and result/QoR dashboards
Provide the compute, capacity, and deployment support that functional regressions run on, scaling to thousands of jobs per week; teams own their regression content, triage, and pass/fail criteria, and this role makes sure the infrastructure underneath never becomes the bottleneck.
Own flow release process end to end: assemble team-owned flow content into qualified releases, regression-test before deployment, and manage versioning, cadence, and rollback — keeping handoffs from RTL through synthesis, place-and-route, and signoff consistent.
Lead the deployment, and integration of EDA tools across multiple vendors, balancing productivity, quality, flexibility, and cost.
Own EDA licensing strategy, vendor relationships, procurement, budgets, IP administration, and license compliance.
Build and operate the platform behind AI-assisted engineering—model access, agentic tooling, compute capacity, and data pipelines—with the security and IP guardrails required to apply AI to proprietary design data safely, measuring productivity impact and retiring what doesn’t pay off.

Required Qualifications

Deep understanding of the complete ASIC development lifecycle, from architecture and RTL through tapeout—enough to be a credible partner to every functional team.
Experience owning CAD and infrastructure across multiple successful SoC programs.
Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining an integrated RTL-to-GDS flow environment—tool and version management, foundry and IP collateral integration, and flow release and qualification across concurrent projects.
Strong understanding of engineering compute infrastructure: distributed scheduling (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent), storage systems, networking, cloud environments, and license management at scale.
Hands-on experience with EDA ecosystems from multiple vendors such as Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens EDA.
Strong knowledge of version control, CI/CD platforms, and the compute and storage patterns behind high-volume regression workloads, along with reproducible engineering practices.
Excellent scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl, Bash, or similar.
Experience evaluating and deploying AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, with a practical view of where they create leverage in chip development.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence senior technical leaders across disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling infrastructure in an early-stage semiconductor company.
Experience with advanced technology nodes with leading foundries.
Experience building or operating agentic AI systems, LLM-based tooling, or AI-native design automation.
Experience supporting chiplet-based designs or advanced packaging.

$200,000 - $300,000 a year

Compensation & Benefits

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

Velaura is committed to pay equity and transparency and regularly benchmarks compensation to ensure we remain competitive in the market.

Why Velaura?

Velaura is building next-generation compute technology for cloud, edge, and Physical AI. Our solutions will enable robots, autonomous systems, drones, and other intelligent machines to operate efficiently in the physical world.

This is an opportunity to help build foundational technology at a time when the industry is undergoing fundamental change. You will work alongside experienced leaders, architects, engineers, and operators who have delivered industry-defining products across mobile, cloud, semiconductor, and AI platforms. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Computational Chemistry)
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. Working alongside our bench chemists and AI researchers, you'll turn real chemistry problems and experimental data into training tasks and measure whether the models get better at them.

This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and build reinforcement learning environments for chemistry end to end, including task design, data curation, automated grading, and checks against shortcuts and data leakage
* Design and source new experimental datasets, environments, and evaluations with our bench chemists, and external research and academic partners
* Develop evaluations that measure model performance on real chemistry tasks, such as reaction outcome prediction, synthesis planning, structure elucidation, and compound design, and feed results back to research teams
* Run and analyze training experiments with AI research teams, diagnose where models fail at chemistry, and prioritize what to build next
* Ensure datasets and environments are high quality and well documented, including sources, train and test splits, and failure modes
* Communicate findings clearly to chemistry, AI research, and life sciences audiences

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, or a related field
* Deep knowledge of organic and medicinal chemistry, including reactions, synthesis, and SAR, with experimental data as your ground truth
* Strong Python skills and solid machine learning fundamentals, with hands-on experience training and evaluating models
* Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with reinforcement learning, large language models, or building evaluations and benchmarks
* Track record of supporting drug discovery programs alongside medicinal and synthetic chemists
* Experience curating chemistry datasets from the literature, patents, or lab notebooks, including reaction, ADMET, and spectroscopic data
* Cheminformatics and molecular modeling skills, for example RDKit, docking, free energy calculations, or quantum chemistry
* Hands-on synthetic or medicinal chemistry experience at the bench
* Publications, patents, or open-source software demonstrating scientific impact

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$300,000 - $320,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Support automated deployments, infrastructure as code (IaC), and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Collaborate with solution architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable AI solutions.

Required Qualifications

Strong professional software engineering experience with C#/.NET and/or Python, including backend application development, API integrations, and enterprise software architecture.
Hands-on experience developing AI agents using Microsoft Agent Framework, including tool integration, agent state, memory/context management, and workflow orchestration.
Experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including agent-to-agent coordination, graph-based workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
Strong understanding of LLM integration, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agentic AI design patterns.
Practical experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, including model integration and deployment.
Experience working with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building, integrating, and securing MCP servers.
Knowledge of Azure API Management (APIM), particularly AI gateway functionality, routing, policies, authentication, and monitoring.
Experience implementing enterprise identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, app registrations, managed identities, and/or Okta.
Familiarity with Azure-native application services, including Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure AI Search.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps practices.
Understanding of AI application observability, telemetry, evaluation, security, and responsible AI principles.
Ability to independently design, troubleshoot, and deliver complex technical solutions while contributing to shared engineering standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience with Microsoft Semantic Kernel or AutoGen, including migration or transition to Microsoft Agent Framework.
Experience integrating Microsoft Copilot Studio with custom-developed, pro-code AI agents.
Familiarity with Azure landing-zone architecture, cloud networking, and enterprise security controls.
Experience with Okta integrations for AI agents, including agent identity governance and discovery.
Experience building AI solutions in regulated industries, particularly healthcare, with awareness of HIPAA and sensitive-data protection requirements.
Experience developing reusable AI frameworks, shared agent components, and enterprise engineering standards.
Proven ability to deliver technical solutions within structured development cycles and clearly defined acceptance criteria.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer who has moved beyond basic LLM integrations, chatbots, or low-code automation and has practical experience building custom AI agents and complex, production-ready agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand the underlying architecture of agent orchestration, can develop and secure custom MCP integrations, and have experience deploying AI applications into enterprise Azure environments.

This individual should be comfortable solving complex engineering challenges, contributing to reusable platform capabilities, and working collaboratively across technical and business teams.
This is a hands-on development role, not a prompt engineering, data science, or low-code AI configuration position.

Data Analyst II, Data Migration

Job Description

Overview of Role/Job Purpose:

The Data Analyst II, Data Migration is a highly visibility role focused on migrating and onboarding utility customers to VertexOne's CIS platform. Reporting to the Data Migration Manager, this analyst extracts, profiles, maps, transforms, and validates customer data from legacy systems. They ensure data accuracy, conversion stability, and clear exceptions handling through every phase of delivery.

The role combines analytical judgement with practical automation and process improvement. This person will help improve the way we deliver migrations so that each conversion is more repeatable, efficient, and reliable. They will work closely with internal teams and utility clients during discovery, mapping, mock conversions, validation, and go-live.

The successful candidate is deeply data driven, meticulous, and able to communicate complex data issues clearly to both technical and business audiences. They will partner closely with the Data Migration Manager on delivery planning, team direction, and practical AI automation, and act as the manager's delegate when needed. This is a hands-on role for someone who is technology-curious, eager to learn, enjoys solving messy data problems, building practical expertise, and growing into team leadership within the data migration organization.

Essential Duties

Work with clients to extract, profile, and analyze source data from legacy utility CIS, billing, and metering systems, including relational databases, and flat or fixed width files.
Lead day-to-day technical direction for migration engineers, including reviewing and approving mappings, transformation logic, and validation results before they go to clients.
Create and maintain project and team weekly status reports.
Develop and maintain source to target data mappings and transformation logic in partnership with Implementation, Product, and utility client teams.
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
Execute mock conversions and production cutovers, validating record counts, balances, and business rules at each migration phase.
Own cutover readiness for assigned client migrations, including runbooks, go/no-go recommendations, and post-migration validation sign-off.
Design and implement data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and exception handling that surface issues early and ensure stability through go live.
Identify manual and repetitive migration tasks and build automated, reusable workflows using KNIME, scripting, and other automation tooling.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of migration methodology, templates, and standards to increase accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
Perform root cause analysis on data defects and conversion errors, and drive resolution with internal and client stakeholders.
Own one or more client migration streams end to end and act as interim decision-maker when the Data Migration Manager is unavailable.
Lead data and migration training sessions for clients, explaining utilities CIS data entities and relationships, including functional concepts on how they relate to each other.
Communicate migration status, data quality findings, risks, and readiness clearly to project teams, leadership, and utility clients.
Document mappings, processes, workflows, and lessons learned for internal knowledge sharing.
Uphold data governance, privacy, and security standards for sensitive customer and billing data.

Job Qualifications

4 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, data migration, ETL, or a related technical role.
Experience leading or reviewing the work of other analysts or engineers on data migration or ETL projects.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data validation queries.
Experience with utility CIS or billing platforms (e.g., SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, or similar) and utility meter or billing data.
Demonstrated experience with data mapping, data profiling, and data quality or reconciliation practices.
Experience with ETL or workflow tools (e.g., KNIME, SSIS, Talend, Alteryx, Airflow, Python).
Exceptional attention to detail and a data driven approach to problem solving and decision making.
Ability to manage multiple migration workstreams and deadlines in a fast paced, high visibility environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to business and client audiences.
Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends during production cutovers and go live events.
Coordinate with an offshore delivery team, including regular working-hour overlap.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on SQL experience with DB2 for IBM i (AS400) or other legacy mainframe data sources.
Experience with KNIME Analytics Platform.
Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language for data processing and automation.
Experience with agentic engineering, including using AI agents and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, mapping, and automation.

Experience in a SaaS organization.

**#141960 Laboratory Assistant - Anesthesiology - Hybrid**
----------------------------------------------------------

**Filing Deadline: Fri 11/6/2026**

**UC San Diego values and welcomes people from all backgrounds. If you are interested in being part of our team, possess the needed licensure and certifications, and feel that you have most of the qualifications and/or transferable skills for a job opening, we strongly encourage you to apply.**

*UCSD Layoff from Career Appointment*: Apply by 10/28/2026 for consideration with preference for rehire. All layoff applicants should contact their Employment Advisor.

*Reassignment Applicants*: Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

**This position will work a hybrid schedule which includes a combination of working both onsite in La Jolla and remote.**

**DESCRIPTION**
===============

The Department of Anesthesiology employs over 200 Academic and Staff personnel and has an annual operating budget of $83 million in annualized resources (School of Medicine and Clinical Practice Organization (CPO) between Practice Plan revenues, VA Medical Center funding, Hospital and Medical Group funding, UC Foundation, Research sources and School of Medicine funds. There are over 85 Clinical faculty, 20 Ph.D. faculty, 8 Post-Doctoral Scholars, 42 Residents, 8 Senior Clinical Fellows, 33 Certified Nurse Anesthetists, 1 Physician Assistant and five collective bargaining units represented. The Department provides Clinical Anesthesia, Critical Care and Pain Services in Hillcrest, Thornton Hospital, Shiley Eye Center, Rady Children's Hospital, Jacobs Medical Center and the VA Medical Center. The Department operates a Pain Clinic at Perlman. The Department's research programs include bench and clinical research programs located at the VA Medical Center, Medical Teaching Facility, Clinical Teaching Facility, Hillcrest, Thornton, Sanford Consortium of Regenerative Medicine facilities and the Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute.

The Department of Anesthesiology’s Brain Mechanisms of Pain and Health Laboratory is seeking a Lab Assistant to help collect data for ongoing studies examining the effects and mechanisms supporting psychedelics and mindfulness meditation on health. The Lab Assistant will assist with basic laboratory operations, organize, work with healthy and chronic pain patients assisting with psychophysical, brain imaging, and pharmacologic studies as directed. Assigned duties and responsibilities include routine laboratory maintenance, assisting with psychological and psychophysical methodologies. Lab Assistant will assist with adhering to IRB protocols, collect human data, and assist with behavioral interventions ensuring accurate collection of data.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
==========================

* Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma and one year of laboratory experience or two years of college including courses in the natural, physical or social sciences; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge of psychology, neuroscience, human biology, and pre-medicine.
* Knowledge of safe human testing procedures (CITI training; experience with IRB).
* Ability to follow written and verbal directions.
* Knowledge of personal computer programs including word processing, basic computer coding, SPSS, Word, Excel, and Unix.
* Ability to adhere to established UCSD guidelines for safety and environmental issues.
* Must be able to work effectively with human volunteers and patients.
* Requires a thorough understanding of laboratory principles including knowledge of safe laboratory process and procedures. Familiarity with specimen processing, labeling, centrifugation, and sample storage according to biosafety and regulatory standards.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to establish trust and rapport with participants and respond with sensitivity and awareness to participant needs.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to maintain accurate documentations and records.
* Demonstrates the ability to assist with participant recruitment, including prescreening and scheduling.
* Experience with data collection, entry, or database management in REDCap or similar systems.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================

* Experience with psychedelic research.
* Certified fMRI technician and/or experience working in an fMRI setting.
* Experience collecting or handling biological samples (e.g., blood, saliva, or urine) in compliance with CLIA, HIPAA, and institutional policies.
* Experience working with electroencephalogram (EEG).

**SPECIAL CONDITIONS**
======================

* Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
* Occasional evenings and weekends may be required.
* Must be willing to work with hazardous materials.

jobs.title: Senior Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN #TEAMRC

WHY WORK FOR RC ENGINEERING?

The Engineering Services Department consists of three separate sections Project Management/Project Delivery, Land Development, and Transportation, with a total of twenty-four (24) staff members that span various roles.

From its earliest days, the City of Rancho Cucamonga was dubbed the "City with a Plan" and over the past forty years, we have been creating a World Class Community. So, what does this have to do with engineering? Everything! Engineering is more than simply building and maintaining roads, it's about providing the built environment that is the context for the people and the places of our lives. As we move into our fifth decade as a City, we are continuing to build a World Class Community for our children and grandchildren to enjoy. One that takes the best parts of our past and continues growing and reimagining itself for the future. We are excited to have the opportunity to play a big part in what is coming next for our community. Whether it is through high quality design and construction of the built environment, by ensuring that our environment stays clean and sustainable, or by providing reliable utility services to residents and businesses.

What You Will Be Doing Here At Team Rc

THE POSITION

Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level? We are currently seeking a dynamic individual to join our team to fill a key management and high-level technical role. There is currently one vacancy, and depending on qualifications, the top candidate will be chosen to fill a Senior role.

The Project Management/Project Delivery Team consists of three assistant engineers, two associate engineers and one principal engineer. Reporting directly to the Principal Engineer, the Senior Engineer position offers the chance to make a significant impact and operate with a high degree of autonomy.

The Senior Civil Engineer is responsible for bringing a high level of technical expertise to assist our Associate and Assistant Engineers through complex capital projects. The ideal candidate for this role will embody a facilitation mindset and will also be well versed in a broad range of engineering skill sets related to Project Delivery, including but not limited to complex project and contract management, sound cost estimating strategies, creating economics of scale, understanding constructability, and strategic planning.

Capital Management

The Capital Management Section is responsible for the preparation and implementation of the City’s Major Projects Program (MPP). This includes the design, construction, and installation of various public improvements throughout the City. Typical projects include street improvements, storm drain construction, railroad crossing improvements, and facility construction or upgrades. The Capital Management section also manages funding programs related to the implementation of the MPP and other operational functions including Measure I 2010-2040, State Gas Tax and Road Maintenance and Repair Funding, along with State and Federal grants.

YOUR IMPACT

Notable Projects You May Work On

As Part Of The Engineering Services Team, You’ll Have The Opportunity To Be a Part Of Rewarding Projects That Make a Visible Impact In Our Community. Some Of The Exciting Projects Currently Underway At The City Of Rancho Cucamonga Include

Pavement Management Program Implementation - A city-wide assessment of pavement condition to be able to best plan for future CIP projects and improve our average Pavement Condition Index (PCI).
Active Transportation Plan and Local Roadway Safety Plan Implementation - Two separate planning efforts to set the foundation for prioritizing future infrastructure projects for both the City’s CIP and future grant applications.
City Center Boulevards Project - Oversee design and construction for this transformative project on Haven Avenue and Foothill Boulevard. This project aims to create a City Center adjacent to the City's Civic Center and planned developments along two of the City's primary corridors. The project will remove on vehicular lane to construct a frontage road with complete street elements including enhanced landscaping, street furniture, on-street parking, bicycle facilities, and transit stops.
Phase 2 Heritage Park Bridge Replacement - The reconstruction of two bridges currently servicing pedestrians, equestrians.
Etiwanda Grade Separation Project - A $125 Million investment to construct a new grade separated overcrossing along Etiwanda Avenue over the railroad tracks. Tasks will include identifying funding, closing out the right of way process, and overseeing construction.
Etiwanda Creek Bridges Project - Lead design, environmental clearance and permitting, and construction for one new culvert on Whittram Avenue and a widened culvert on Arrow Avenue.
General Plan Implementation - Reimagining of street cross-sections along our two largest corridors, and ensuring our vision is communicated to developers to achieve desired quality of life improvements for our community.

This Position Might Be Perfect For You If

You are a self-motivated leader who enjoys the flexibility of shifting between coordinating a team and detailed project management.
You have a strong background in project management and overseeing large-scale construction projects.
You are a team-player with a forward-thinking approach to strategic planning processes and a desire to check things off the list.
You enjoy sharing your knowledge with and fostering growth in members of your team.
You tend to find ways to make work processes more efficient and effective.
You are a technically proficient engineer looking to make your next career move.
You are hungry, humble, and smart.

You’ll be responsible for:

Knowing Why! Being the Best! Collaborating Earnestly! and Leaving an Inheritance!
As Senior Civil Engineer, being a technical expert and resource for the Project Management/Project Delivery Section.
Staying informed about required reporting for special funding sources, contract management and changes in codes, laws, or design techniques.
Preparing and delivering reports to various policy making bodies and committees, including City Council.
Working with other Departments, neighboring jurisdictions, and regional agencies to coordinate projects and grant applications to ensure the goals of the City are being met.

For more information regarding these positions, please visit the Senior Civil Engineer job descriptions.

RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE

Application Deadline: Thursday, August 14, 2025

Application Screening completed by Thursday, August 21, 2025

1st Panel Interview: Thursday, August 28, 2025

Tentative Department Interview: Thursday, September 4, 2025

All dates are subject to change at the discretion of the personnel officer**

ARE YOU QUALIFIED

Education And/or Experience

Graduation from an accredited college with a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and four years of progressively responsible professional experience, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities or any combination of training and experience that provides the desired knowledge and abilities.

Examples Of Acceptable Substitutions

Minimum Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, plus four (4) years of progressively responsible professional-level experience
in Civil Engineering, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities.

Substitution: A total of eight (8) years of progressively responsible professional-level experience
in Civil Engineering, including experience in directing the work of others involved in engineering project activities may substituted for the bachelor’s degree requirement.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Knowledge of engineering principles, methods and practices; project development, design and construction; techniques for reviewing designs, plans, specifications, estimates, reports and recommendations; current trends and developments, literature, and sources of information regarding municipal engineering; related laws, ordinances, rules and regulations. Ability to plan and coordinate professional and sub-professional engineering work; interpret and apply related laws, ordinances, rules, regulations and policies; prepare and present reports; perform complex professional engineering work; communicate effectively both orally and in writing; establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.

Special Requirements

Possession of a certificate of registration as a Civil Engineer issued by the California State Board of Registration for Civil and Professional Engineers. Possession of or ability to obtain an appropriate California driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record.

Questions regarding the equivalencies listed above? Please email us at careers@cityofrc.us.

WHERE DO YOU GO FROM HERE

APPLICATION PROCESS

All applicants are required to apply online at www.cityofrc.us. This position will close on Thursday, August 14, 2025 at 5:00pm

or until a sufficient number of applications have been received.

Applications must be complete and demonstrate that the minimum qualifications are met. All statements made on the application are subject to investigation and verification. Resumes may be attached to completed application form as supplemental information and will not be accepted in lieu of an official application form. Applications will be screened and the most qualified candidates who best match the needs of the City will be invited to compete further in the examination process. All candidates will be notified of their application status by email throughout the recruitment process. Candidates invited to compete in the examination process, who successfully pass the examination process, will be place on an eligibility list. The candidate on the eligibility list who most closely meets the requirements of the City may be selected to receive a final offer. The City may conclude that none of the candidates, even those who meet the minimum qualifications, are appropriate for the position.

Successful Candidates Shall Be Required To

Pass a reference and background verification. References will not be contacted until a mutual interest has been established, and
Provide proof of a valid California driver's license and be insurable; and
Degree Verification; and
Pass a pre-employment medical exam

If hired, candidate will be required to complete a verification form designated by Immigration and Naturalization Service to certify that they are eligible for employment in the United States of America and furnish proof certifying legal authorization to work in the United States.

The City of Rancho Cucamonga Participates in E-Verify. Federal law requires all employers to verify the identity and employment eligibility of all persons hired to work in the United States. In accordance, the City will provide the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security and Social Security Administration, with information from each new employee's Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. For additional information regarding E-Verify, the Federal Government's online employment eligibility verification system, please visit www.uscis.gov.

About The Role

The Business Data Analyst owns the analytical layer between data infrastructure and decision-making — turning warehouse data into dashboards, metrics, and insights that drive product, growth, and operations decisions. The role works with dbt models, SQL-first transformations, and BI tooling in a data environment built for scale.

This is a high-visibility position: the analyst partners directly with product managers, finance, and engineering leadership, and the quality of their work shapes how the business measures itself. The team values rigorous methodology over quick answers.

Design, build, and maintain executive and operational dashboards in Looker or Tableau, serving stakeholders across product, marketing, and finance

Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior, retention, funnel conversion, and unit economics using SQL and Python

jobs.title: Science Lab Technician
jobs.description:
The Science Laboratory Technician performs specialized technical work in support of undergraduate instructional laboratories across the physical sciences and related scientific disciplines. This position applies scientific principles, laboratory techniques, quantitative calculations, and technical problem-solving to prepare, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory experiments, instrumentation, and equipment.

Working in collaboration with faculty, course laboratory coordinators, and laboratory operations staff, the technician interprets experimental protocols, determines material and equipment requirements, prepares chemical solutions and reagents, evaluates equipment functionality, and resolves technical issues that affect laboratory readiness and experimental outcomes. The position requires an understanding of scientific methods, laboratory instrumentation, chemical properties, and safe laboratory practices to support consistent, reliable, and safe instructional experiences.

The technician exercises independent judgment in organizing laboratory preparation activities, adapting established procedures to available equipment and materials, identifying technical and safety concerns, and maintaining compliance with university policies and applicable regulations. The position also supports laboratory inventory and procurement, hazardous-material management, documentation, and the training and work direction of student employees.

Responsibilities

**Laboratory Preparation and Experimental Implementation**

* Interpret experimental protocols and laboratory procedures to determine the equipment, chemicals, reagents, materials, quantities, and preparation methods required for assigned experiments.
* Calculate and prepare chemical solutions, reagents, dilutions, and other laboratory materials using appropriate scientific calculations, measurement techniques, and established procedures.
* Assemble and configure experimental apparatus, laboratory stations, and materials according to established protocols and technical specifications.
* Test experimental setups and prepared materials to identify discrepancies or conditions that could affect the execution or reliability of laboratory activities.
* Apply scientific principles and systematic troubleshooting methods to resolve preparation errors, experimental setup issues, reagent discrepancies, and other technical problems.
* Determine material quantities and prepare appropriate allocations of supplies based on experimental protocols, enrollment figures, and scheduled laboratory activities.
* Develop, maintain, and revise laboratory preparation sheets, material lists, and experiment-specific technical instructions.
* Verify the identity, concentration where applicable, labeling, and readiness of prepared solutions and materials before use.
* Organize and maintain laboratory preparation areas to ensure materials and experimental setups are ready for scheduled instructional activities.
  

**Laboratory Equipment, Instrumentation, Inventory, and Procurement**

* Operate, inspect, assemble, and test laboratory equipment, scientific instruments, and apparatus to determine functionality and readiness for use.
* Perform routine preventive maintenance, operational checks, and basic calibration where applicable, following equipment specifications and established procedures.
* Diagnose routine equipment malfunctions and performance issues; determine when specialized repair or technical support is required.
* Coordinate equipment servicing and repairs with vendors, service providers, and appropriate university personnel.
* Maintain equipment records, including inventory, location, condition, maintenance, and service history, as applicable.
* Monitor laboratory supplies and consumables, assess inventory levels, anticipate replenishment needs, and identify shortages that could affect laboratory operations.
* Prepare purchase requests, place orders through university purchasing systems, communicate with vendors, coordinate receipt of materials, and monitor order status.
* Reconcile purchasing card transactions and maintain supporting procurement documentation in accordance with university procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and supply options and recommend practical, cost-conscious solutions to meet laboratory needs.
* Receive, assemble, test, and organize newly acquired equipment and materials; maintain accurate inventory records for items received.

**Laboratory Safety, Hazardous Materials, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Apply university laboratory safety policies, established procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements to assigned laboratory activities.
* Assess chemical hazards and compatibility to support appropriate chemical storage, segregation, labeling, and handling practices.
* Collect, label, segregate, store and document the disposal of hazardous laboratory waste in accordance with university procedures and applicable requirements.
* Inspect assigned laboratory areas and chemical storage locations for safety deficiencies, improper storage, labeling issues, and other potential hazards.
* Correct safety deficiencies within the scope of the position and promptly report hazards or compliance concerns requiring additional action.
* Maintain required safety and compliance records, including hazardous-waste documentation, chemical-related records, and applicable inspection documentation to prepare for EHS inspections.
* Review and update laboratory safety procedures and related documentation to support consistent practices and compliance with applicable requirements.

**Instructional Coordination, Technical Guidance, and Student Employee Oversight**

* Coordinate laboratory schedules, preparation timelines, and operational requirements with faculty, instructors, and laboratory operations staff.
* Communicate course-specific logistical needs, equipment limitations, material shortages, and scheduling conflicts to relevant personnel in a timely mann

Overview:

**JOB TITLE:** Laboratory Assistant /

**DEPARTMENT:** Medical

**REPORTS TO:** Senior Operations Manager

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The phlebotomist technician position is responsible for performing venipuncture and other specimen collection procedures to obtain samples for laboratory testing and diagnostic purposes.

Phlebotomist must ensure proper patient identification, specimen collection, labeling, processing and handling to maintain specimen integrity and patient safety. Phlebotomists will interact with patient and medical providers to deliver high-quality care and support by following laboratory procedures.

Responsibilities:

**DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensures that the critical safety process is required to properly identify every patient through two independent patient identifiers “before” drawing blood or collecting specimens. For example:
  + Asking the patient to state their full name and date of birth (D.O.B.), rather than just reading out their name & D.O.B.
  + Verifying that the patient’s stated (verbally) information perfectly matches the lab requisition order, the E.H.R. and the specimen tube labels.
* Assesses patient needs, reviewing patient history, printing the correct provider Lab Requisition order, and determining the reason(s) for drawing blood.
* Verifies and collects proper samples required for specific tests and accurately labels specimens.

jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20182328 **Category** Postdoctoral

  

Dr. Longwei Liu’s laboratory at the University of Southern California (USC) is seeking a **Postdoctoral Scholar – Research Associate**. Jointly supported by the Department of Ophthalmology at the Keck School of Medicine and the Alfred E. Mann Department of Biomedical Engineering at the Viterbi School of Engineering, the laboratory bridges engineering and medicine to develop innovative therapeutic and diagnostic technologies. In this NIH-supported position, the scholar will develop programmable biological systems to investigate cellular signaling and advance therapies for degenerative diseases and cancer.

The successful candidate will be motivated, proactive, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with strong scientific curiosity and a commitment to rigorous, reproducible research. The position offers opportunities to lead an independent project within the laboratory’s research program, collaborate across engineering and medicine, mentor trainees, and develop manuscripts and fellowship applications.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* A Ph.D degree in bioengineering, molecular or cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a closely related field by the start date.
* **At least one first-author publication** demonstrates expertise relevant to one or more of the research areas listed below.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the following areas: synthetic biology; genetic engineering; ocular biology or vision science; or cellular and molecular engineering.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to design controlled experiments, critically analyze data, troubleshoot research problems, and work independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to research integrity.
* Experience in one or more of the following: synthetic biology, genetic circuit design, genome editing, protein engineering, or cell and gene therapy.
* Proficiency in molecular cloning, mammalian cell culture, viral gene delivery, flow cytometry, or fluorescence imaging.
* Experience with retinal biology, ocular disease models, immune-cell engineering, or preclinical evaluation of therapeutic technologies.
* Strong quantitative skills in biological data analysis, image analysis, or computational modeling.
* Demonstrated ability to lead research projects, collaborate across disciplines, and mentor junior researchers.
  

  

**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Design, execute, and interpret mechanistic and translational studies; establish experimental priorities and troubleshoot independently.
* Develop and characterize molecular constructs, engineered cells, biosensors, or therapeutic proteins using techniques appropriate to the project.
* Evaluate candidate systems in relevant cell-based assays and, where applicable, preclinical animal models.
* Analyze and document results, maintain accurate research records, and apply appropriate controls and reproducible workflows.
* Prepare manuscripts, present findings at laboratory meetings and scientific conferences, and contribute to grant and fellowship applications.

jobs.description:
**Quality Control Technician**

Zamboni Company USA, Inc.

**Pay:** $25.67 – $30.00 per hour  
**Job type:** Full-time, non-exempt (hourly)  
**Schedule:** 8:00am – 4:30pm  
**Location:** On-site, Paramount, CA  
**Department:** Quality Control / Operations

**Position Summary**

The Quality Control Technician is responsible for inspecting, testing, and evaluating products and materials throughout the manufacturing process to ensure they meet Zamboni Company USA’s quality standards and specifications. This role works closely with Production, Supply Chain, Engineering and Management teams to identify defects, document findings, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and committed to maintaining a safe and compliant work environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The following duties are representative of this role.

* Inspect raw materials, in-process components, and finished products against established quality specifications and drawings.
* Perform dimensional, visual, and functional inspections using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measurement tools.
* Document inspection results accurately and completely in quality management systems and paper-based logs.
* Identify and segregate non-conforming materials; initiate nonconformance reports (NCRs) and coordinate disposition with appropriate personnel.
* Collaborate with Production and Supply Chain supervisors and operators to communicate quality findings and support corrective action.
* Monitor and verify that manufacturing processes comply with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.
* Support internal audits and assist in preparation for external quality audits.
* Maintain calibration records for inspection equipment and notify appropriate personnel when calibration is due.
* Enter, maintain, and report ISO 9001/QMS quality data, and flag trends and improvement opportunities to the supervisor.
* Assist in root cause analysis and implementation of corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs).
* Adhere to all safety policies, PPE requirements, and housekeeping standards on the production floor.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Education & Experience*

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree or vocational/technical training in a related field preferred.
* Minimum 1 year of experience (2+ years preferred) in a quality control, inspection, or manufacturing environment.
* Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings (dimensions), blueprints, and technical specifications; working knowledge of GD&T preferred.

*Knowledge, Skills & Abilities*

* Proficiency with precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges, etc.).
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify defects and inconsistencies in materials and finished goods.
* Basic computer skills; ability to enter data accurately into QMS and ERP systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document findings clearly.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced production environment.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 or similar quality management standards.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the production floor for extended periods.
* Frequent use of hands and fingers for handling tools and equipment.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally.
* Close vision and ability to distinguish colors required for inspection tasks.
* Must be able to work in a manufacturing environment with varying temperatures, noise levels, and exposure to machinery.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Zamboni Company USA, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age (40 and over), marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Pay: $25.67 - $30.00 per hour

* Are you able to read and interpret engineering drawings or blueprints?
* Are you familiar with ISO 9001 or similar quality standards?
* Are you able to work on-site in Paramount, CA, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm?

Experience:

Company Description

Job Description

The New York City (NYC) Department of Health and Mental Hygiene(DOHMH) is a public health leader serving over 8.4 million New York City residents from diverse ethnic, cultural, and economic backgrounds. The NYC Public Health Laboratory (PHL) is one of the largest local public health laboratories in the United States offering a dynamic and innovative work environment where employees contribute to the health and safety of NYC residents by providing clinical and environmental laboratory testing services. With more than 100 years of leadership in public health, a team of over 200 scientific and support staff that are committed to its mission to safeguard the health of all NYC residents by providing quality laboratory testing services that support the priorities of the NYC DOHMH and its community partners to prevent and respond to clinical and environmental public health concerns. PHL seeks a qualified candidate to serve as a Bioinformatics Scientist. This position will work primarily in PHL's Bioinformatics Unit. This position will develop and maintain analysis pipelines as well as perform bioinformatics analyses for high through put sequencing (HTS) data. It will play an integral role in genomics analysis aimed at responding to public health threats, including but not limited to COVID-19, vaccine preventable diseases, HIV, Legionella as well as respiratory, foodborne, and waterborne disease outbreaks.

Duties Will Include But Not Belimited To

Conducting bioinformatics analyses for sequencing data that support public health efforts.

Developing or improving tools related to pathogen identification, outbreak tracking, mapping drug resistance determinants, variant analysis, genome annotation and phylogenetics, genomics data visualization.

Strengthening the application of genomic tools to support public health diagnostic testing for pathogens such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis and mpox.

Conducting literature reviews and stay up to date with cutting edge scientific and epidemiological research and tools.

Participating in agencywide WGS journal club and genomic data exchange working groups.

Developing tools (e.g., dashboards) or strategies (e.g., Docker-based pipelines) to improve accessibility of bioinformatics analyses to non bioinformaticians (e.g., epidemiologists, virologists, microbiologists).

Supervising 1-2 staff in conducting research projects.

Representing the agency in meetings and conferences.

Drafting written protocols and maintain accurate records of software tools design.

Writing original manuscripts for publication based on data analyses and product development.

Maintaining quality assurance and control of HTS data generated by PHL to ensure reproducibility and accuracy of downstream bioinformatics analyses. This includes writing and designing SOPs and validation/verification protocols.

Using best practices for code development, and documentation.

Leading and participating in presentations and workshops with Quality Management (QM)at PHL to improve understanding and tracking of sequencing data and analyses quality control measures, data security and data management using resources from APHL, ASM, and others.

Preferred Skills

Strong skills in Linux command line and BASH shell scripting.

Proficient in R, Python, C, Java, or other programming languages.

Experience in SQL.

Experience in utilizing multi-core server resources, automating processes, containerization, and workflow languages.

Experience with common tools for Next Generation Sequencing Analysis (NGSA), including reference-based analysis and de novo sequencing

analysis (knowledge of open source and commercial microbial NGS analysis pipelines)and genome annotation.

Demonstrated work in public health genomics research.

A PhD degree in the biological sciences with extensive experience in the technical and administrative operations of a Clinical or Public Health Laboratory.

Strong analytical and organizational skills; Excellent oral, inter-personal and written communication skills.

a tax-deferred savings program and

Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. .

If telework is approved, you are required to work within the State of California only and if Partial Telework, also come in to the Main Office in Orange, CA, at least two (2) days per week minimum.

The Data Analyst Sr (Finance - Encounter Data) will support the data reporting responsibilities of the Encounters team within the Finance department. You will support with the maintenance of current Encounter tasks, such as monitoring and reviewing the 5010 837 files submissions. You will create and maintain Standard Query Language (SQL) queries to reconcile data for new projects, including submission testing with vendors for the outbound process with the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and to continually improve data acquisition and reporting methods. You will ensure timely, complete and accurate data submissions inbound and outbound with the Information Technology (IT) team. Together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

Your Contributions To The Team

90% - Data Support
Participates in a mission-driven culture of high-quality performance, with a member focus on customer service, consistency, dignity and accountability.
Assists the team in carrying out department responsibilities and collaborates with others to support short- and long-term goals/priorities for the department.
Supports the Encounter team with the maintenance of data through SQL tables.
Works with other departments to ensure complete and accurate data is being processed appropriately, which impacts DHCS and CMS, such as coordinating with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) on any technical assistance for Encounter Data issues for 5010 837 data submissions.
Coordinates with Claims Administration and IT teams to work on improving encounter data submissions.
Assists with reconciling data in the SQL tables through the many processes of the Encounters Submission.
Provides expertise in data analysis, including members, providers, encounters and claims data.
Prepares and reviews analytics methods to verify data integrity of claims and inbound 837 encounters.
Creates detailed business requirements for technical programs, including implementation of new processing platforms for new and existing vendors.
Interacts with existing delegated health networks to establish and maintain strong working relationships.
Stays current on the DHCS, CMS and Covered California data reporting requirements and reports on any changes that affect CalOptima Health and/or health networks.
Refers complex data integrity issues to the manager for further evaluation and action as needed.

5% - Completes other projects and duties as assigned.

3 years of experience in Medi-Cal managed care or Medicare Advantage required.
Covered California (Commercial) experience required.

4 years of experience in an Independent Physician Association (IPA), hospital or health plan setting.
4 years of experience with managed health care programs.
1 year of experience with submissions to Covered California.

N/A

Develop rapport and establish and maintain effective working relationships with CalOptima Health's leadership and staff and external contacts at all levels and with diverse backgrounds.
Work independently and exercise sound judgment.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Work a flexible schedule; available to participate in evening and weekend events.
Organize, be analytical, problem-solve and possess project management skills.
Work in a fast-paced environment and in an efficient manner.
Manage multiple projects and identify opportunities for internal and external collaboration.
Motivate and lead multi-program teams and external committees/coalitions.
Utilize computer and appropriate software (e.g., Microsoft Office: Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) and job specific applications/systems to produce correspondence, charts, spreadsheets, and/or other information applicable to the position assignment.

Ability to speak (enunciate) clearly in conversation and general communication.
Hearing ability for verbal communication/conversation/responses via telephone, telephone systems, and face-to-face interactions.
Manual dexterity for typing, writing, standing and reaching, flexibility, body movement for bending, crouching, walking, kneeling and prolonged sitting.
Lifting and moving objects, patients and/or equipment 10 to 25 pounds

Dataminr’s Domain Experts work with Dataminr’s AI platform in real time ensuring the alerts and intelligence we send to our clients are of the best possible quality. Domain Experts use deep human expertise to examine and analyze our data feeds and annotate, label, and edit signals in real time. You will be an integral part of our algorithm training process and our advanced realtime human-AI feedback loop that integrates key knowledge domains into our AI models and develops our AI platform. As a Domain Expert, you will also play a key role in defining new factors to improve our alerts, data source coverage, machine learning, AI models, and AI tooling.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI:
our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI:
we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI:
our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

Serve as an expert on the Middle East and North Africa, related geopolitical developments, and the relevant data sources associated with the region to improve our AI models
Monitor and analyze the quality of our data feeds
Own and develop projects to improve performance of AI models and AI tooling in the real time event detection space
Lead strategic initiatives across teams, addressing critical opportunities or issues

Collaborate on and communicate about daily priorities in a team-centric environment

jobs.title: Applied AI Security Architect - Healthcare & Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As an Applied AI Security Architect, you will serve as Anthropic's trusted security expert for our most demanding enterprise customers. You'll engage directly with CISOs, security architects, compliance officers, and technical leaders at some of the largest healthcare and life sciences organizations to address their most critical questions about deploying Claude safely and securely.

This is a pre-sales technical role focused on security, compliance, networking, and data architecture. Your job is to walk into a room full of security professionals and demonstrate deep expertise in enterprise security, regulatory compliance, and data protection. You'll help customers understand Claude's security architecture, data handling practices, and deployment options, and partner with them to design solutions that meet their specific regulatory and organizational requirements.

You'll bring significant experience in enterprise security, cloud architecture, and technical pre-sales within regulated industries. Whether you've been a Security Architect, Solutions Architect, Field CTO, or senior pre-sales engineer at a cloud or security vendor, what matters is that you understand how large institutions evaluate and adopt technology, especially in healthcare and life sciences, and can speak credibly to their security and compliance concerns.

We are looking for someone excited to help define how enterprises should think about security and compliance in the age of AI. How do MCP, autonomous agents, and RBAC work together? If working at the intersection of AI adoption and regulated industries excites you, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary security and compliance expert during customer engagements, addressing technical questions about Claude's architecture, data flows, encryption, access controls, and deployment models.
Partner with CISOs, security architects, and compliance teams at healthcare and life sciences organizations to understand their security requirements and design solutions that meet regulatory standards (HIPAA, GxP, HITECH, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, GDPR, federal mandates, etc)
Lead technical deep-dives on network architecture, data residency, API security, authentication/authorization, audit logging, and integration patterns for regulated environments.
Support enterprise security reviews, vendor assessments, and due diligence processes by providing detailed technical documentation and expert guidance.
Collaborate with GTM and Applied AI teams before and after customer engagements to align on strategy, prepare for security discussions, and ensure continuity from initial conversations through deployment.
Partner closely with Anthropic’s product and engineering teams to deeply understand Claude's security capabilities, provide real-time customer feedback on feature gaps and priorities, help assess technical feasibility of customer-specific security requirements, and influence roadmap priorities.
Develop and maintain security-focused collateral, reference architectures, and best practices documentation for regulated industries.
Lead enablement and create content for GTM and Applied AI Teams that helps them inform customers upstream about key security requirements and considerations.
Travel regularly to customer sites for security workshops, architecture reviews, and strategic account meetings.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

8+ years of experience in enterprise security, cloud architecture, or technical pre-sales, with significant exposure to regulated industries (healthcare and life sciences).
Deep technical knowledge of enterprise security concepts: network security, identity and access management, encryption (at rest and in transit), API security, and audit/logging requirements.
Experience navigating compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare and life sciences organizations (HIPAA, GxP, HITECH, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and GDPR).
A track record of engaging with CISOs, security teams, and compliance officers at large enterprises.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture and deployment models (AWS, Azure, GCP), including VPCs, private endpoints, and hybrid connectivity.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
The ability to navigate ambiguity and move fast in a rapidly evolving market.
A collaborative mindset: sales at Anthropic is a team sport.
Excitement about AI's potential to transform highly regulated industries, and a genuine desire to help customers adopt it safely and responsibly.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$315,000—$380,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
